你什么都回忆不起来。
记忆像是被揉碎的梦境，只等随便某个念头兴起，便无影无踪。
这让你偶尔焦躁，偶尔担忧，也让你有了一些空间思考。
但更多时候，你无暇多想，你选择相信眼前的人，只需前行。
也许记忆已经被你短暂地抛诸脑后……
……所以，你什么都回忆不起来。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>CODENAME: Endministrator 
GENDER: ■■ 
AUTHENTICATION: ■■ 
DOB: ■■ 
RACE: ■■ 

You remember nothing. 
Your memories lie in fragments, like dreams crushed to dust, disappearing at the slightest thought. 
Sometimes it makes you unsettled, sometimes uneasy, yet it grants you a quiet moment to breathe and think. 
Most of the time, however, there is no pause for doubt. You simply just trust those before you and press on. 
Perhaps you have tucked your past memories away, even if just for a little while... 
...and so, you remember nothing. </>

recordDesc.cn: <@profile.key>你过去的生命贯穿了塔卫二至今的历史……</>
recordDesc.en: <@profile.key>You have lived through all of Talos-II's history...</>

recordDesc.cn: <@profile.key>……那么，未来呢？</>
recordDesc.en: <@profile.key>But ... what will you make of its future?</>

voiceDesc.cn: 源石在歌唱。
voiceDesc.en: I hear Originium singing.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地一定会继续前行。
voiceDesc.en: Endfield won't stop progressing.

voiceDesc.cn: 帝江号，我已就位。
voiceDesc.en: I'm in position, Dijiang.

voiceDesc.cn: 该出发了。
voiceDesc.en: It's about time.

voiceDesc.cn: 还不赖。
voiceDesc.en: Not too shabby.

voiceDesc.cn: 这就是工业的成果。
voiceDesc.en: A fine product of industrial manufacturing.

voiceDesc.cn: 熟悉的感觉……
voiceDesc.en: I recognize this feeling...

voiceDesc.cn: 我不会再忘记他们的身影。
voiceDesc.en: I'll never forget the sight of them.

voiceDesc.cn: 更进一步。
voiceDesc.en: Another step forward...

voiceDesc.cn: 我会保护终末地的。
voiceDesc.en: I'll protect Endfield. Always.

voiceDesc.cn: 过去和现在……必须合二为一。
voiceDesc.en: The past and the present must become one.

voiceDesc.cn: 我听见了她的声音，像是梦中的呢喃。我常在梦中遇见一片无垠的海，令人悲伤，令人怀念……也让我再一次下定决心。
voiceDesc.en: I heard her voice, echoing like a whisper in dreams. Time and again, I've dreamed of a boundless sea — one that brings sorrow, stirs memories ... and strengthens my resolve.

voiceDesc.cn: 还在等什么吗？
voiceDesc.en: Still waiting for something?

voiceDesc.cn: 源石会开辟道路。
voiceDesc.en: Originium will carve a path for us.

voiceDesc.cn: 多谢！
voiceDesc.en: Many thanks!

voiceDesc.cn: 那边是……
voiceDesc.en: Look, over there...

voiceDesc.cn: 那儿有很重要的东西！
voiceDesc.en: Something important lies over there!

voiceDesc.cn: 附近有需要调查的区域。
voiceDesc.en: The nearby area needs a proper survey.

voiceDesc.cn: 是强敌，谨慎应对。
voiceDesc.en: High-threat hostile. Approach with caution.

voiceDesc.cn: 这些矿物能派上用场。
voiceDesc.en: These minerals may come in handy.

voiceDesc.cn: 我也来帮忙。
voiceDesc.en: Let me help out.

voiceDesc.cn: 满载而归！
voiceDesc.en: This is one rewarding trip.

voiceDesc.cn: 熟悉的触感。
voiceDesc.en: This feels familiar.

voiceDesc.cn: 确认消除。
voiceDesc.en: Blight elimination confirmed.

voiceDesc.cn: 整队完毕。
voiceDesc.en: Everyone is rested.

voiceDesc.cn: 效果不错吧！
voiceDesc.en: Feeling better?

voiceDesc.cn: 感觉很好。
voiceDesc.en: Much better now.

voiceDesc.cn: 有危险，注意时机！
voiceDesc.en: Incoming! Watch out!

voiceDesc.cn: 我还能坚持……
voiceDesc.en: I'm still in fighting shape...

voiceDesc.cn: 抱歉，接下来就交给各位了。
voiceDesc.en: I'm sorry... It's in your hands now...

voiceDesc.cn: 你的招式很利落。
voiceDesc.en: You pulled off a sleek move.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们的配合天衣无缝。
voiceDesc.en: We're in perfect sync.

voiceDesc.cn: 过奖了！
voiceDesc.en: You flatter me.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，我们越来越默契了。
voiceDesc.en: Our teamwork just keeps getting better.

voiceDesc.cn: 该我们上了。
voiceDesc.en: Time to fight.

voiceDesc.cn: 有我在。
voiceDesc.en: I'm with you.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地又前进了一步。
voiceDesc.en: We made another step forward, Endfielders.

voiceDesc.cn: 辛苦了，各位。
voiceDesc.en: Good work, everyone.

voiceDesc.cn: 做得不错！
voiceDesc.en: We handled that fight well!

voiceDesc.cn: 没事吧？
voiceDesc.en: Everyone okay?

voiceDesc.cn: 不要心急，调整完毕后再做打算。
voiceDesc.en: No need to worry. We'll regroup and figure this out.

voiceDesc.cn: 尝尝这个！
voiceDesc.en: Take this!

voiceDesc.cn: 看清楚了！
voiceDesc.en: Watch this!

voiceDesc.cn: 迎击！
voiceDesc.en: Engage!

voiceDesc.cn: 交给我！
voiceDesc.en: Get crushed!

voiceDesc.cn: 击溃他们！
voiceDesc.en: Take 'em out!

voiceDesc.cn: 随时可以行动。
voiceDesc.en: Ready to strike.

voiceDesc.cn: 相信我！
voiceDesc.en: Trust in me.

voiceDesc.cn: 接招！
voiceDesc.en: Crystallize!

voiceDesc.cn: 到此为止了！
voiceDesc.en: Face your end!

voiceDesc.cn: 就现在！
voiceDesc.en: This ends now!

voiceDesc.cn: 抓住破绽了。
voiceDesc.en: Gotcha!

voiceDesc.cn: 没有第二次机会。
voiceDesc.en: No second chance.

voiceDesc.cn: 你将迈向终结。
voiceDesc.en: Your end awaits.

voiceDesc.cn: 闹剧该结束了！
voiceDesc.en: Show's over.

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>佩丽卡，终末地工业的监督，也是终末地的官方发言人之一，主要负责管理和推进协议源石技术的开发与应用，同时也承担帝江号的管理工作。

对她是否配得上“监督”这一职位的质疑，我已经很久没听到了。她用实绩打消了所有人的怀疑，也用事实印证了M3的说法：“这个职位是因为佩丽卡才存在，别搞错了先后顺序。”确实连我也不敢相信，一个如此年轻的人能够担起协助管理整个终末地工业的重任，但在她的管理下，终末地所追求的未来景象更加清晰了。
不过，她也不是事事都能处理妥当，比如，作为协助管理危机处理小组的关键人物，她不该总是陪着小组成员在第一线冒险。就算她继续驳回我的申请，我还是会督促她重新评估风险。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Perlica, Supervisor of Endfield Industries, is one of the official spokespersons for Endfield. She is primarily responsible for overseeing and advancing the development and application of Protocol-Originium technology protocols, while also managing the operations of the Dijiang. 

It's been a long time since I last heard anyone question whether she deserves the title of Supervisor. She has silenced all doubts with tangible results, proving M3's words true: "This position exists because of Perlica. Don't get the order wrong." I still can hardly believe someone so young is capable of supporting the management of the entire Endfield Industries. Yet under her leadership, the future that Endfield strives toward has only grown clearer. However, she isn't flawless in handling everything. For instance, as a key figure in managing the Crisis Team, she shouldn't constantly risk herself on the front lines alongside the members. Even if she continues to dismiss my requests, I will still urge her to reassess the risks. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>和终末地工业的不少干员一样，儿时的佩丽卡监督在灾难中幸存下来，并和其他失去家庭的孩子一同接受了管理员和终末地工业的庇护。在学习和成长的过程中，她对协议技术表现出了极大的好奇，并逐渐开始接触终末地工业在塔卫二的各项基础事务。不到两年的时间，她的足迹就已经遍布这颗星球的大小城市，她对我们所面对威胁的认知也远超常人。而她对协议技术的热情，也促使她加入了研发中心，并在日后帮助终末地工业在协议技术开发与应用领域取得了重大突破。之后她也顺理成章地被正式任命为“监督”，开始真正掌舵帝江号这个高悬于塔卫二人工静止轨道的庞然大物。

【权限记录】
佩丽卡的过去当然不可能像公开记录里那样总是被幸运所眷顾。
十多年前，你在筹备远征时救下了她，在那个她还惶恐茫然的时候给了她最大的支持。但她也无法预料到不久后的远征会再一次改变她的生活……她失去了你。后来的日子里，和她一起被你救来的孩子大多也都开始了新生活，甚至连那个和她情同姐妹的孩子，莱西娅，也离开了帝江号，选择和她分道扬镳。
身边朋友的逐渐离去，肩上扛下的责任越来越重，协议技术的研发屡遭瓶颈……
她还是固执地留在了这条最难走的路上，并且用实际行动折服了我们。诚然，她一路走来得到了许多人的支持，但她自己付出的努力和经历的坎坷……我比任何人都清楚。
去和她聊聊吧，她已经等了太久。
——M3的语音备忘录</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Like many operators within Endfield Industries, Supervisor Perlica survived a disaster as a child and found refuge under the care of the Endministrator and Endfield Industries alongside other children who had lost their families. During her education and growth, she showed exceptional curiosity toward Techno-Protocol and gradually became involved in the foundational operations of Endfield Industries on Talos-II. In less than two years, her footsteps had reached cities both large and small across the planet, and her understanding of the threats we face far surpassed that of ordinary individuals. Her passion for Techno-Protocol led her to join the R&D Center, where she later played a key role in achieving major breakthroughs in the development and application of Techno-Protocol for Endfield Industries. Naturally, she was officially appointed as "Supervisor", taking the helm of the Dijiang—a colossal structure suspended in the artificial stationary orbit above Talos-II. 

DOCUMENT: A certain log that requires sufficient authority level 
Of course, Perlica's past was never as consistently fortunate as the public records might suggest. 
Over a decade ago, you rescued her while preparing for the expedition, offering her unwavering support at a time when she was still lost and fearful. Yet she could never have anticipated that the same crusade would soon turn her life upside down once more ... she lost you. In the years that followed, most of the children you saved alongside her moved on to new lives. This includes Lycia, whom she considered a sister, eventually left the Dijiang and chose to go her separate way. 
As friends gradually departed, the weight of responsibility on her shoulders grew heavier, and the development of Techno-Protocol repeatedly hit roadblocks... 
Yet she stubbornly remained on this most difficult path, winning us over through her actions. It's true that she received support from many along the way, but no one understands better than I do the effort she has poured in and the hardships she has endured. 
Go and have a chat with her. She's been waiting far too long.
 ——M3's Audio Memo</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>帝江号上其他干员总说，佩丽卡监督似乎有一种神奇的魔力。只要有她在，任何问题都会迎刃而解。
所以当我得知能有幸在她身边学习的时候，我一度兴奋到失眠，可现实狠狠重击了我。因为没法适应她的工作强度还有严苛的标准，我一度考虑中途退出……但我实在不舍得放弃这次宝贵的机会。
因为马上就是管理员预计苏醒的日子，每个人都绷着一根弦，连佩丽卡监督也不例外。在她日程全被塞满的情况下，她还要见缝插针地去见各部门的前辈，来确保工作万无一失。
但这些临时的私密小会议之后，她的脸色总是不太好，难道有些事情连她也搞不定？我只能埋怨自己帮不上什么忙。
我的无所适从被她看在眼里，她主动安慰了我，还塞给我从没见过的怪味鳞肉丸一起分享。那味道呛得我眼泪直流，佩丽卡监督反倒看着我心满意足地笑起来……那一天的苦恼，也都随着我的眼泪一起被冲刷一空。
那一瞬间我才突然意识到，佩丽卡监督……的确存在那种魔力。
——一位见习后勤干员的工作日志，她仍在继续申请留在佩丽卡监督身边见习的机会

【未被成功删除的记录】
“她也去找你了吧，卡拉德？请教要怎么和她在乎的管理员正常相处，对吧？”
“不愧是搞情报的，不在帝江号消息还这么灵通。她匆忙来训练室找我的时候，我还以为是什么环节出了岔子。结果一本正经地问这个，吓我一跳。”
“习惯了她当监督的日子，都快忘了她也不是真的无所不能。不过我喜欢她和我通信时忸怩的样子，还是和小时候一样可爱。”
“所以你给了什么建议？”
“和你一样喽，什么也没给。其他老家伙也都差不多，大家都准备看好戏呢。”
“不过我打赌，她重新见到管理员的时候一定会藏得很好。”
“反正M3肯定会陪着她，你还怕没法知道现场的所有细节？”
“也是。还有，别忘了，我们答应过她要绝对保密。尤其是对管理员。”
“放心吧，卡拉德。我的嘴可是最严的，这是职业操守。但这样就看不到小佩丽卡生闷气的样子，是不是有点太遗憾了？”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Other operators aboard the Dijiang often say that Supervisor Perlica seems to possess a kind of magical quality. As long as she's around, any problem finds its solution. 
So when I learned that I'd have the privilege of studying alongside her, I was so excited I couldn't sleep. But reality hit me hard. Unable to keep up with her intense workload and exacting standards, I seriously considered quitting along the way … yet I couldn't bring myself to give up such a precious opportunity. 
With the expected awakening of the Endministrator just around the corner, everyone is on edge—even Supervisor Perlica is no exception. Despite her schedule being completely packed, she still manages to squeeze in meetings with senior members from every department to ensure everything goes off without a hitch. 
But after each of those impromptu private meetings, she always comes out looking uneasy. Could it be that there are things even she can't handle? I can't help but blame myself for not being able to do more to help. 
She noticed how lost I felt and took the initiative to comfort me, even sharing some strangely flavored fin meatballs I'd never seen before. The taste was so strong it brought tears to my eyes, yet Supervisor Perlica just watched me with a satisfied smile … That day's worries were washed away along with my tears. 
In that moment, I suddenly realized that Supervisor Perlica … truly does have that kind of magic. 
—From the work log of a trainee operator, who is still applying for the opportunity to continue her apprenticeship under Supervisor Perlica. 

[Record That Has Not Been Successfully Deleted] 
"She went to see you too, didn't she, Krad? Asking how to get along with the Endministrator she cares about so much, right?" 
"Wouldn't expect anything less from Intel. You're not even on the Dijiang and you're still this well-informed. When she rushed into the training room to find me, I thought something had gone wrong. But then she asked me that dead seriously. Totally took me by surprise." 
"Guess I've gotten so used to her being the Supervisor that I almost forgot she isn't actually invincible. But I do love that awkward tone she takes when she messages me. Still just as adorable as when we were kids." 
"So, what advice did you give her?" 
"Same as you, nothing at all. The other old-timers did about the same too. We're all just waiting to see how this plays out." 
"But I bet she'll hide it perfectly when she sees the Endministrator again." 
"Don't worry, M3 will definitely be with her. You really think we won't get every last detail from the scene?" 
"Right. And remember, we promised her we'd keep this completely confidential. Especially from the Endministrator." 
"Relax, Krad. You know I am the last person to talk. Professional ethics and all. But honestly, it's almost a shame we won't get to see little Perlica pouting over this, isn't it?"</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>无论你在帝江号上的哪个地方偶遇佩丽卡监督，她总会平静地向你问好，然后继续投入到自己手头上的工作中，以至于不少人猜测监督的真面目是一台披着黎博利皮的机器，可以完美执行某个超级思维的指令。虽然这种玩笑话在新进干员间流传甚广，但监督本人不光不抵触，还偶尔故意在新人面前“调皮”一下，帮忙缓解干员们的压力。
按照马丁·马文·马伦的非官方说法，正式担任监督之后，佩丽卡强迫自己用最恰当的面貌去履行自己的职责。但积累的情绪和压力总归需要一个宣泄口。而在管理员回归之前，佩丽卡就已经找到了一套足够让她放松自己的办法。“你听说过‘机油与机械的热弹创意赛’吗？据说它最初源于某位血魔天才和神秘机械师的创意对决。研发中心的前辈也把这项古老的泰拉活动带来了终末地。现如今，热弹赛中出现的怪点子不光给干员们带来了许多欢笑，还极大促进了我们的技术革新。但很少有人知道，这项活动在终末地的真正推手是佩丽卡监督。毕竟她从没有正式参过赛，也很少发表看法。事实上，她重启这项活动的初衷，只是给自己创造一个能缓解手痒，验证脑子里古怪想法的平台。”

虽然今年我被禁止参赛，但也不算缺席吧。这辆获奖的“电浆轰鸣”还是我起的名！它主人带着“把引力铳械塞进加速引擎”的想法找到我时，我就知道有搞头。最后拆了不少好铳才成功呢……欸？当、当然没有动我爸的宝贝库存！
——蝉联多届热弹赛冠军的铳械天才少女

这辆车刚拿下了新都筑地下热力赛的冠军啊！怎么会在帝江号上？！
——某位竞速爱好者

“电浆轰鸣”？主人是“嫌疑人伊里奇”？佩丽卡，这又是哪个部门冒出来的新人？
——陈千语</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>No matter where you run into Supervisor Perlica aboard the Dijiang, she always calmly greets you before immediately returning to her work. Some even joke that beneath her Liberi appearance, she might actually be a machine, perfectly executing the directives of some higher intelligence. While this kind of rumor spreads widely among newer operators, the Supervisor does not mind it at all. In fact, she occasionally plays along with the joke on purpose, lightening the mood and helping to ease the tension among the crew. 
According to the unofficial account by Martin Marvin Malen, after officially assuming the role of Supervisor, Perlica forced herself to adopt the most appropriate demeanor to fulfill her duties. But accumulated emotions and pressure always need an outlet. Even before the Endministrator's return, Perlica had already found a way to truly relax. "Have you heard of the 'Crankcase Creative Contest'? They say it originally started as a creative showdown between a certain Vampire genius and a mysterious mechanic. Seniors in the R&D Center brought this ancient Terra event to Endfield. Nowadays, the wild ideas that emerge from the CCC not only bring a lot of laughter to the operators, but also greatly drive our technological innovation. Yet very few know that the true force behind this event at Endfield is Supervisor Perlica. After all, she has never officially participated, and rarely voices her opinions. In truth, her reason for reviving this event was simply to create a platform where she could relieve her restless hands and test the strange ideas in her head." 

Even though I was banned from competing this year, I wouldn't call myself entirely absent. After all, I’m the one who named the award-winning "Blast-ma Roar"! When its creator came to me with the idea of "stuffing a gravity firearm into an acceleration engine", I knew it had potential. We ended up taking apart quite a few fine firearms to make it work, though… Huh? O-of course we didn't touch my dad's precious stockpile! 
—The reigning champion of multiple Crankcase Creative Contests, a prodigy in firearm engineering. 

 This vehicle just took first place in the Neo Tsukushi Underground Heat Rally! What is it doing on the Dijiang?! 
—From a racing enthusiast. 

"Blast-ma Roar"? Owned by "Ilyich, the Suspect"? Perlica, which department did this newcomer come from? 
— Chen Qianyu </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>M3，这份文件作为“零号委托”的附件封存，不可强制生效。
我现在任命佩丽卡为“‘零号委托’签署人”。
但是否生效需完全遵循其个人意愿。
如果她最终决定留在终末地工业，那由你作为执行人，带她去见创始人。

【权限记录】
“你决定了？”
“留在终末地，我不需要犹豫，M3。”
“那好吧。跟我来，创始人要见你。”
…………
“我们还是见面了，佩丽卡监督。”
“监、监督？等等，你的样子——”
“我们的时间不多了。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>M3, file this document as an annex to "Zeroth Directive" under sealed status. It is not to be enforced under any circumstances. 
I hereby appoint Perlica as the "Signatory of Zeroth Directive". 
However, its activation must be entirely subject to her personal consent. 
If she ultimately decides to remain with Endfield Industries, you, as the executor, shall take her to meet the Founder. 

DOCUMENT: A certain log that requires sufficient authority level 
"Have you decided?" 
"Staying with Endfield Industries was never a question, M3." 
"Very well. Come with me. The Founder wishes to see you." 
...... 
"So we finally meet, Supervisor Perlica." 
"Su ... Supervisor? Wait, your appearance—" 
"Our time is running short."</>

voiceDesc.cn: 全员待命，随时可以出发。
voiceDesc.en: All Operators accounted for. The team is ready for the mission.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地危机处理小组已就绪。
voiceDesc.en: Endfield Crisis Team ready for action.

voiceDesc.cn: 指挥权限暂时交给你了，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Transferring command authority now, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 带领我们更进一步吧，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Lead us in our next step forward, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 该研究一下适合这件武器的作战方式了。
voiceDesc.en: Time to come up with optimum tactics for wielding this weapon.

voiceDesc.cn: 这也是集成工业系统的成果。
voiceDesc.en: The fruit of the Automated Industry Complex.

voiceDesc.cn: 只需略微调校……这便于取得更多战果。
voiceDesc.en: Now I would just need to tune this ... to maximize the spoils of our victories.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们曾这样不断抵抗……期待着你能再一次归来。
voiceDesc.en: We once fought on and never gave up ... for it is our wish to witness your return.

voiceDesc.cn: 感谢你的认可，管理员。我会继续努力的。
voiceDesc.en: Your approval is much appreciated, Endministrator. I shall carry on with greater effort.

voiceDesc.cn: 作为监督，我还有很多不成熟的地方，但我已经下定了决心，责无旁贷。
voiceDesc.en: Though I am a little too young and untested, my mind is set. I shall fulfill my duties as Supervisor of Endfield Industries.

voiceDesc.cn: 你又一次选择了信任我……管理员。我绝对不会辜负你的期待。
voiceDesc.en: Once again you've placed your faith in me, Endministrator... I shall live up to your expectations.

voiceDesc.cn: 没什么，只是得到你的夸赞……让我有些怀念过去。那曾是我努力的唯一理由，而现在，我很庆幸能够带领着终末地，站在你的身旁。
voiceDesc.en: I'm alright. Hearing your encouraging words just made me ... nostalgic about the past. It used to be the only reason I kept going. Now, I'm glad that I get to lead Endfield Industries, and stand by your side.

voiceDesc.cn: 我一直坚信，你会再一次为我们指明前进的方向。欢迎回归终末地，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: I have always believed that you will lead us upon the right path once more. Welcome back to Endfield Industries, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 随时准备。
voiceDesc.en: Prepped and ready to go.

voiceDesc.cn: 干员佩丽卡，待命中。
voiceDesc.en: Operator Perlica standing by.

voiceDesc.cn: 高效的规划，我会努力的。
voiceDesc.en: An efficient assignment. I shall do my best.

voiceDesc.cn: 适应得还好吗，管理员？
voiceDesc.en: How are you holding up, Endministrator?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，注意休息，不要勉强自己。
voiceDesc.en: Don't push yourself too hard, Endministrator. Keep yourself rested and well.

voiceDesc.cn: 自从管理员醒来以后，帝江号每天都在变得更有活力……我很期待未来的日子，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Since your awakening, Dijiang is becoming a livelier place with every passing day... And this makes me hopeful for the future, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你的气色好多了。如果还有什么需要，可以随时找我。
voiceDesc.en: You're looking much better, Endmin. Feel free to talk to me if there's anything you need.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你的需求是最优先的。我可以把其他事情先放下……或是交给菲奥娜去办。
voiceDesc.en: Your needs are our top priority, Endmin. To see them met, I'll gladly set aside other tasks ... or ask Fiona to handle them.

voiceDesc.cn: 中央环厅总是这么繁忙，这意味着一种责任。百余年来，一代又一代的终末地干员都在为复兴文明环带而努力。也许有一天，帝江号会落回到地上，在我们亲手建设的乐土中小憩片刻吧。
voiceDesc.en: The Central Ring is always this busy. It is a symbol of our obligations to this world. For more than a century, generations of Endfielders have devoted themselves to reviving the Civilization Band. Perhaps a day will come when Dijiang can finally land, and take a well-deserved rest within the haven we've built.

voiceDesc.cn: 有很多干员并不会停留在帝江号，特别是精英干员们。比起逗留在天空之上的安全地带，危机四伏的文明环带更需要他们。没关系，你们迟早会见面的。到时候，我会好好向管理员介绍大家。
voiceDesc.en: Many operators wouldn't spend too much time aboard Dijiang, especially our elites. They are sorely needed by the Civilization Band where danger lurks, and not by this orbital refuge. No matter, you will meet them soon. I shall make the proper introductions when the time comes.

voiceDesc.cn: 曾经我们在帝江号上这样交谈的时候，我还是个只有现在一半高的孩子。如今物换星移，我长大了，帝江号也有许多变化，管理员你却……依旧如初。
voiceDesc.en: When I last had a conversation like this, I was a girl barely half my current height. Times have changed. Dijiang received plenty of modifications and I grew up... But you, Endministrator... You remain the same as before.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我为你申请了一些补给，应该能帮上你的忙。你有时候太过努力了，但其实，依赖一下我和终末地也没什么不好。
voiceDesc.en: I've requested for a set of supplies on your behalf, Endmin. I hope it can help. There are times when you overwork yourself. But do remember: it is alright to count on me and Endfield Industries.

voiceDesc.cn: 非常感谢，管理员，我一定会珍惜的。
voiceDesc.en: I really appreciate this, Endmin. I shall treasure it well.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你需要定期检查身体，别太勉强自己。特别是，不要太滥用自己的源石技艺——如果还有干员请你维修Delta型机器人……请拒绝！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, don't miss your physical exams, and please avoid overworking yourself. Most importantly, never abuse your Originium Arts — Should other operators request your assistance to fix a Delta Bot again ... just turn them down!

voiceDesc.cn: 小时候，我走遍了帝江号的每一个角落，在心里为每一个房间都取了昵称。我以为我不会再回到地面上了，我觉得这艘船就是我的家。可是之后，为了能帮到管理员，我还是离开了帝江号，去了塔卫二的很多地方。帝江号看起来变得狭窄了，可我始终觉得……它能装得下我的所有回忆。
voiceDesc.en: When I was a little girl, I explored every corner of Dijiang and nicknamed every cabin. It was a time when I believed I would never see the surface again ... a time when I felt that Dijiang was my home. But to better support you, I left the ship and traveled across many places on Talos-II. Now, Dijiang looks more cramped than I remember ... but to me, it's still a vessel capable of holding the entirety of my memories.

voiceDesc.cn: 陈其实是我作为监督亲自招募的第一位干员，也是我最好的朋友之一。我在宏科院的合作项目现场偶遇了陈千语……呵呵，她总说那时候我不苟言笑，担心我，所以才主动帮了我的忙。也许真的是这样。刚成为监督的时候，有太多东西要学习，让我甚至无暇去关注身边的人和事。如果不是她的洒脱和笑容，恐怕我会走不少弯路吧。
voiceDesc.en: Chen is actually the first operator I personally recruited since becoming Supervisor of Endfield Industries. She is also my best friend. I ran into her unexpectedly during a joint project with HAS... Hehe. She kept saying I always wore a stiff face, and only decided to help because she got too worried about me. Perhaps it was the truth. I was an untested Supervisor and there were so many things I had to pick up. I barely had time to focus on the people and things around me. Her smile and candid personality probably kept me from taking many wrong turns.

voiceDesc.cn: 不用担心，管理员。我当然也是有休息时间的，不要听陈胡说。放假的时候会做什么？会看书。嗯，文学和理论类的都看，为了能在未来的工作中——抱着这种想法就不算休息了？那……其实我会一个人骑着摩托在开拓区驰骋。我、我只告诉了管理员，其他干员要是知道了会担心的。我能理解他们，但我只是想听听这颗星球的风声。
voiceDesc.en: There's no need for concern, Endmin. Don't take Chen's teasing about me too seriously, of course I have off hours. What do I do for vacation? Hmm, mostly reading — literature and theoretical science, since they're relevant to upcoming work. It's not a break if I'm doing things for work? Well then ... I enjoy racing through frontier lands, alone on my bike. Endmin ... you're the only one who knows about this. The other operators will get worried if they learn about this secret. I know where they're coming from, but part of me yearns to hear the winds of this planet.

voiceDesc.cn: 醒了吗，管理员？累的话，就早点休息吧。睡脸？管理员的睡脸我已经看了十年了。嗯？当然了，以前我总是会和其他孩子一起去探望石棺中沉睡的管理员。后来，就只剩我一个人了。通过干员测试的时候，当上监督的时候……我都会去探望沉睡中的管理员。你不必愧疚，毕竟我本来就打算等管理员恢复记忆之后，一股脑说给你听的。
voiceDesc.en: Are you awake, Endmin? You should turn in early for today if you're feeling tired. I caught a glimpse of your sleepy face just now... I've actually been looking at that same sleepy face of yours for a decade. Back then, I visited the Sarcophagus with the other children, just to see you hibernating peacefully. But as time passed, I was the only one left. I'd come by often — after I passed the operator trials, after I became the Supervisor... Don't feel bad about this, Endmin. I actually have plans to tell you everything once we restore your memories.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地与这片大地上的许多组织都有合作。公约阵营自不必说，环塔商会是现代物流和物资供应的保障，联盟工团则是开拓区最有力的盟友，宏科院始终站在技术前沿与我们互通有无。正因为有这样的盟友，我们才能在这个残酷的新家园站稳脚跟。
voiceDesc.en: Endfield Industries is partnering with many organizations upon this land. The Accordatories, definitely. The TGCC is the best provider of modern logistics and supplies, and the UWST is a most reliable friend in the frontier. The HAS is always perched at the edge of the latest tech breakthrough, and we openly share our scientific findings with each other. Allies like these guarantee our ability to stand strong and firm in this cruel, new home.

voiceDesc.cn: 从没当面见过菲奥娜？啊……菲奥娜稍微有些特殊。她说过，她很喜欢现在这样在作战通讯中和大家沟通的感觉。特别是对于管理员你，菲奥娜很担心……见到她本人以后，你对她的态度会有很大的改变。
voiceDesc.en: Never met Fiona in person? Ah... Fiona's condition is quite ... special. She told me that she enjoys being on air and connected with everyone via our combat comms. And Fiona is rather worried that if you ... met her in person, you might start treating her very differently.

voiceDesc.cn: 我作战的样子看起来像是一位指挥家？这是我接受作战训练的时候留下的习惯……传说在泰拉时期，莱塔尼亚人会将音乐和法术天赋联系起来，而教我使用法术战斗的老师也是一位和音乐有关的奇才。我的战斗天赋算不上出众，但只要把法术的流向理解为韵律和节奏，我很快就能抓住诀窍。
voiceDesc.en: I look like a maestra in battle? I picked up the habit during combat training... They say Leithanians during the Age of Terra combined music with their innate gift for the Arts. My Arts instructor also happened to be a gifted musician. My aptitude for combat wasn't particularly outstanding, but I quickly mastered the techniques when I interpreted the flow of Arts as musical notations and tempos.

voiceDesc.cn: 在帝江号上也能看见的那片极光，就像是塔卫二这颗星球开出的一朵诡异的花。北方的天幕被超域能量笼罩，极光像是一面墙阻拦在我们的面前。墙的那一边，曾经是无数人类的理想之地。如今，那里只剩下一片废墟，和占据了那片废墟的……敌人。
voiceDesc.en: The Aurora is also visible from Dijiang. It is the anomalous flower that bloomed upon Talos-II. The Northern Veil is enveloped in Æther, making the Aurora look like a wall that blocks our way. A utopia for countless souls once existed on the other side of this wall... Though naught is left but devastation... and enemies that occupy the ruins.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你觉得帝江号的商铺应该新增什么品类？没什么，只是商务办公室定期会进行调研报告。帝江号的生活区并不大，常驻干员也不算很多，不过，只靠自动贩卖机确实缺乏了点人情味……咖啡厅怎么样？管理员，你会想在休息的时候去买一杯咖啡吗？
voiceDesc.en: What vendors should we add to Dijiang? Any ideas, Endmin? Oh, nothing special, just another regular survey from the Business Office. Dijiang doesn't have a large lounge area, and our resident crew isn't that big either... Auto-vendors work fine, but they do lack that human touch... What about a cozy café, Endmin? Would you grab a cup of coffee while you're on break?

voiceDesc.cn: ……抱歉，管理员。这是我的私心……但是我不希望在现在的管理员面前主动提起我们相遇的过去。我希望——不是作为终末地的监督，只是作为佩丽卡——我希望管理员能……自己回想起那些回忆。
voiceDesc.en: Apologies, Endministrator... I know it's selfish, but I'd rather not bring up our past right now. I just hope you can find those memories on your own. This isn't a request from the Supervisor of Endfield Industries — It's from me.

voiceDesc.cn: 帝江号很壮观，对吧。如果把协议技术理解为源石网络，帝江号就是所有协议源石的总服务器。不仅如此，它也是泰拉文明穿过星门，抵达塔卫二后的历史缩影。帝江号经历过战争和混乱，但最终翱翔在了这片星海之中。也许终有一天，所有人都可以不再受引力的束缚，如前人所想的那样，漫步于繁星身侧。
voiceDesc.en: Impressive, isn't she? Picture the Techno-Protocol as the Originium Network, and Dijiang would be the Protorig master server. She is also the embodiment of the Terran Civilization that traveled through the Cosmic Gate, as well as all the events that followed our crossing. Dijiang has endured war and chaos, and now she cruises in the sea of outer space. Perhaps a day will come when humanity frees itself from the shackles of gravity ... and walks amidst the stars as our ancestors have dreamed.

voiceDesc.cn: 很久以前，我会用“姐姐”来称呼M3。后来，我正式成为了终末地的干员，M3就不让我那么叫她了。对我来说，她真的就像姐姐一样，亲切，乐观，无所不能。不过这些年，她越来越少出现在帝江号上了。我知道她有一个独一无二的使命，但如果可以，我希望现在的终末地可以为她分担。
voiceDesc.en: There was a time when I addressed M3 as my elder sister. But she put an end to that after I became an actual Endfield operator. Truth be told, she felt like a true sister of mine. Kind, gentle, optimistic, and skilled in everything. I don't see her on Dijiang much these days. I know she is carrying out a mission of her own... And if possible, I hope that Endfield can share her burden.

voiceDesc.cn: 很少有人知道，塔卫二这颗遥远的星球才是我们真正的起源，而即使知道这一点，也无法磨灭很多人对于泰拉故土的怀念。离开泰拉，前往塔卫二，就像是孩子离开柔软的摇篮，投入母亲的怀抱。可是，对我来说，情况完全相反……我在塔卫二加入了终末地，结识了管理员，而泰拉似乎只是一个使命的符号而已。
voiceDesc.en: Very few people know that this distant world of Talos-II is actually where we all came from. And despite this knowledge, almost none could give up their nostalgia for Terra. Leaving Terra for Talos-II is akin to a babe who left its soft, comfortable cradle for their mother's embrace... But I felt the opposite. It was on Talos-II where I joined Endfield and met the Endministrator. Terra is now little more than a symbol of my mission.

voiceDesc.cn: 参与零号委托的并不止我一人，而且参与者之间，也未必知道其他人负责的内容是什么。在过去的管理员意识到自己的情况时，就已经做好了很多的布置。在你这次醒来之前，我无数次预演过执行零号委托的那一刻……可当真的再见到你，好像很多话顺理成章地就说出口了。
voiceDesc.en: I wasn't the only participant of the Zeroth Directive. But none of us knew the missions of the others. In the past, you always had plenty of preparations in place, even before you became aware of your situation. For this awakening, I've rehearsed executing the Zeroth Directive countless times... But when I met you again in person, all those words flowed out of me naturally with great ease.

voiceDesc.cn: 集成工业系统是终末地近些年的主要攻坚对象。它表面上的功能和意义，想必管理员已经深刻体会到了。不过，之所以执着于协议技术，当然是有更深层次的目的。源石即是信息，即是一切飘渺概念的体现和结晶。最终，我们能够“建设”和“生产”的，远不止工业品那么简单。
voiceDesc.en: Endfield Industries spent our recent years focusing on the Automated Industry Complex. The goals of the AIC are evident in its name, and I believe you have extensive first-hand experience with it. Needless to say, our obsession with the Techno-Protocol isn't just about this. Originium is information. It is the crystallized manifestation of every ephemeral idea. Its final embodiment ... will let us "manufacture" and "construct" more than just industrial products.

voiceDesc.cn: 危机处理小组其实是管理员设立并领导的一支行动小队，一度是塔卫二名闻遐迩的尖兵队伍。后来，小队指挥权移交给了创始人和M3，但依然发挥着原本的作用。而在我成为监督并接任指挥权后，我确实感受到指挥“英雄们”所带来的压力……以及，所有人都在为了一个无私的目标而战的热血沸腾。
voiceDesc.en: You founded the Crisis Team, Endmin. It is a special operations team that you've led in person. The Crisis Team was a team of elites famed throughout Talos-II. Team leadership was later transferred to the Founder and M3, but its purpose and function still remained the same. When I became Supervisor and took over the team's leadership, I sorely felt the pressure from commanding a team of heroes ... as well as their fiery passion as they threw themselves in battle for our selfless goal and ideal.

voiceDesc.cn: 我听M3说，终末地过去并不设监督职位。管理员是终末地的领袖，M3、创始人和精英干员们辅佐着管理员，这一决策层被称为“源点”。“源点”管辖着三大中枢，支撑着终末地一路走到今天……但在你沉睡的时候，终末地也被迫做出了许多改变，不过也因此，我们才能继续前进……我才能站在你的身边。
voiceDesc.en: I heard M3 say that Endfield did not have a Supervisor back then. The Endministrator led the entire company, while M3, the Founder, and our elite operators provided support. We called this decision-making organization the Provenance. The Provenance managed the three major nexuses and has kept Endfield running till this day... Endfield was forced to change while you slept, but these changes kept us going ... and this was how I could stand by your side.

voiceDesc.cn: 似乎有值得调查的东西……
voiceDesc.en: Something seems to warrant closer scrutiny...

voiceDesc.cn: 附近似乎有高价值的物资，值得留意。
voiceDesc.en: We seem to have high value supplies nearby. Keep an eye out for those.

voiceDesc.cn: 又一处未被人类探索的区域。
voiceDesc.en: Another area uncharted by humanity.

voiceDesc.cn: 眼前的敌人非同小可，提高警惕。
voiceDesc.en: Stay alert. This hostile poses significant threat.

voiceDesc.cn: 矿物是工业的基础，多准备一些吧。
voiceDesc.en: Mineral ores form the foundation of industry. We should gather more.

voiceDesc.cn: 我也来帮忙。
voiceDesc.en: Let me help you.

voiceDesc.cn: 不错的收获。
voiceDesc.en: An impressive acquisition.

voiceDesc.cn: 醚质是破碎的宇宙，它穿越了遥远的距离才抵达我们面前。
voiceDesc.en: Aurylene is a fragment of a shattered universe. This one traveled massive distances to be here, right before us.

voiceDesc.cn: 侵蚀已经无法威胁如今的终末地。
voiceDesc.en: The Blight no longer threatens the Endfield of today.

voiceDesc.cn: 休整完毕，各位，准备继续行动。
voiceDesc.en: R&R complete. Team, make ready to continue our operations.

voiceDesc.cn: 不要掉以轻心。
voiceDesc.en: Patching up. Stay alert.

voiceDesc.cn: 调整好状态。
voiceDesc.en: Conditions stabilized.

voiceDesc.cn: 未知的行为，小心！
voiceDesc.en: Incoming! Unknown hazard!

voiceDesc.cn: 没关系……比起我们的目标……
voiceDesc.en: I'm good... Focus on our objective...

voiceDesc.cn: 保护好自己……管理员……
voiceDesc.en: Protect yourself... Endmin...

voiceDesc.cn: 出色的技巧，令人赞叹。
voiceDesc.en: Outstanding technique. Impressive.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们团结一心！
voiceDesc.en: We are united as one!

voiceDesc.cn: 全靠大家。
voiceDesc.en: We did it as a team.

voiceDesc.cn: 这就是终末地工业。
voiceDesc.en: This is the power of Endfield.

voiceDesc.cn: 战斗开始，请以自身安全为优先。
voiceDesc.en: Engaging. Stay safe, team.

voiceDesc.cn: 没有超过预案的设想。
voiceDesc.en: All variables within estimates.

voiceDesc.cn: 出色的配合，必然的结果。
voiceDesc.en: A definitive outcome achieved through strong teamwork.

voiceDesc.cn: 各位，确认一下自己的状况吧。
voiceDesc.en: Verify and report personal status, team.

voiceDesc.cn: 暴力并非我们的目的，继续前进吧。
voiceDesc.en: Violence is never our objective. Let's press forward.

voiceDesc.cn: 先确认伤员的状态，采用安全队形，重整旗鼓。
voiceDesc.en: Check all injuries. Assume defensive formation and restore combat readiness.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们不会重蹈覆辙……
voiceDesc.en: We won't let this happen again...

voiceDesc.cn: 协奏！
voiceDesc.en: Concerto!

voiceDesc.cn: 序列！
voiceDesc.en: Sequence!

voiceDesc.cn: 已定位！
voiceDesc.en: Target locked!

voiceDesc.cn: 轰击指令！
voiceDesc.en: Strike command!

voiceDesc.cn: 清除！
voiceDesc.en: Terminate!

voiceDesc.cn: 施术单元已就绪！
voiceDesc.en: Arts Unit hot!

voiceDesc.cn: 我来支援！
voiceDesc.en: Arts support ready!

voiceDesc.cn: 乘胜追击！
voiceDesc.en: Push forward!

voiceDesc.cn: 抓住机会！
voiceDesc.en: Here's our chance!

voiceDesc.cn: 赋格！
voiceDesc.en: Now, fugue!

voiceDesc.cn: 尾声！
voiceDesc.en: Coda and finale!

voiceDesc.cn: 歼灭坐标，权限七！
voiceDesc.en: Commence AL-7 annihilation!

voiceDesc.cn: 目标锁定，开火！
voiceDesc.en: Target locked. Fire!

voiceDesc.cn: 帝江号，清空区域！
voiceDesc.en: Sterilize this area!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员陈千语出身宏山城，此前曾于武陵科学发展区服役，后通过佩丽卡监督私人渠道招募至终末地，现今已成长为危机处理小组核心成员。该干员作战能力突出，机动性强，是团队中不可或缺的一分子。

尽管前来终末地供职的各色人等在遣词造句上各有千秋，人力资源事务部对于“动机陈述”一项内容的审核仍有基本标准。碰到过于直白和简单的案例，我会劳请干员以他们舒适的形式重新录入。但看到陈千语干员在经过五个标准日的打磨后，仍然在该项表单上提交了“就是想来，缘分到了”几个字时，我需要反思先前的审核标准，并特加重视陈千语干员声称其并非出于威胁的目的放置在我面前桌上的双剑，重新构建一套逻辑——
陈千语干员的内在思考并不像她所呈现出来的那样随意，结合她此前丰富的履历来看，她显然经过了一番深思熟虑，才最终决定以尤其简洁的方式输出自己的结论。
另外，我注意到陈千语干员的招募渠道是佩丽卡监督的特批。在我检测到监督近年来时有的情绪波动时期，陈千语干员为佩丽卡监督提供了稳定的支持，解决了不少问题。
更重要的是，我或许忽略了“就是想来，缘分到了”这寥寥数语，实际上含有一种与终末地工业的战略目标相吻合的内在逻辑，也是我的记录中管理员所提倡的“齐心合意”这一合作方针的另类诠释。现在，想必各方都会满意这个解释。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Chen Qianyu was a native of Hongshan City and once served at the Wuling Scientific Developmental District. Supervisor Perlica later recruited her, via a private channel, to Endfield Industries. She is now a core member of the Crisis Team. Given her outstanding capabilities and mobility, Operator Chen Qianyu is an indispensable component of the Team. 

Those seeking to join Endfield have demonstrated a wide range of literary skills when describing their motives. However, the HR Division has yet to establish basic standards for reviewing the [Personal Motivations] section. If this section were completed in a manner that is too curt and/or straightforward, I will ask the operator to re-write their motivations in a style that they are comfortable with. However, despite being given five standard days to revise this section, Operator Chen Qianyu still persisted in writing: "I just wanna join. It's fate." Reading this, I realized the need to reflect upon our current review standards and establish a new framework, while paying extra attention to the two blades that Operator Chen Qianyu placed on my table (though she claimed that she did not do so to threaten me). 
Operator Chen Qianyu's inner thoughts and feelings are not as casual as she makes them out to be. Taking into consideration of her relatively rich past experiences, it is obvious that the extremely brief and terse description of her personal motives was a conclusion she arrived at after an extended period of self-contemplation. 
Additionally, I also realized that Operator Chen Qianyu's recruitment has been specifically approved by Supervisor Perlica. From my readings, the recent years have been a period where our Supervisor exhibited emotional fluctuations. The operator managed to solve many potential issues by offering much needed stability and support. 
Most importantly, I may have neglected how the simple line: "I just wanna join. It's fate." is actually congruent to the inner logic of the Endfield strategic objectives. In other words, these words could be seen as an alternate interpretation of the "Unity in Purpose" approach in partnership espoused by our Endministrator, which I also have in my records. Perhaps we now have an explanation capable of satisfying all parties involved in this review. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>陈千语干员的背景调查结果并不复杂，如同其本人所呈现的那样表里如一、简单干脆。
陈千语成长于宏山环形山，幼时曾于谈剑堂受训剑艺，在来到终末地工业前，曾在多处不同性质的单位及个人下属进行实践。因此，即便年纪尚轻，陈千语干员已具有多年独立战斗经验，经过一段时间的磨合，已经适应了团队作战模式。
与塔卫二上众多在灾异侵扰与拓荒的过程中失去了双亲的孩子不同，陈千语在一个美满、幸福的家庭中度过了童年。相对简单的成长环境也养成了其几乎不可动摇的乐天性格，在既往的多次小队行动中，陈千语干员皆因良好的合作度与乐观的性格受到赞誉。此外，多名重要合作者，包括总工程师安德烈先生在内，都对陈千语干员寄予厚望，认为其代表着终末地对外展示的另一种形象：年轻、积极、友善，以热烈的态度介入一切亟需解决的困难。

【补充记录】
在早期接触中，我们意识到，于多地驻留期间，陈千语干员的表现都堪称优异，这一点无可挑剔；但仍然有人好奇她为何只在各地作短暂停留，因为截至目前，终末地已经成为陈千语干员驻留时间最长的单位。我们在一次定期会谈中向她提出了这个疑问，得到如下回答：
“菈梵朵玛‘碰碰杯杯’奶茶店？我竟然在那里待了三个月？！很简单嘛，喝够了奶茶，就走了。”
“啊……临时安保，是那时我年龄不够做正式工，又很需要钱去下一站旅行，就只能以这种形式在展览和会议之间打工啦。不过那几个月，我可见到了不少在塔卫二这块儿的大人物……”
“等等，谈剑堂给我留下的毕业考核等级竟然是——优秀？！等等等等，你们没看错吧？我、我不知道不是很正常嘛，嘿嘿！我一直没敢查那个最终结果呢……嗯，是有点怕师父他们拿我跟妈妈比较。”
“在应龙特勤队的一年多……嗯，这个可以先不聊吗？不是，也没什么需要隐瞒的事啦，就是感觉不太合得来。啊，你是说陈千语竟然还有合不来的人？！对啊！我可是能跟艾什柏环岛臭名昭著的黑帮老大，那个‘半脸人杜乔’，都能聊得有来有回的哦！”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Results of Operator Chen Qianyu's background checks are not complicated. The operator is as consistent, simple, and straightforward as she appears. 
Operator Chen Qianyu grew up in the Hongshan Crater and studied swordmancy at Tanjian Hall. Prior to joining Endfield, she has interned at various organizations and served different individual employers. Hence, in spite of her young age, Operator Chen has years of solo combat experiences. After a period of adjustment, she has now grown used to team-based combat. 
Unlike many youths who lost their parents in pioneering operations in the unforgiving and disaster-ridden lands of Talos-II, Chen Qianyu grew up in a wholesome and happy family. Her relatively simple childhood also gave her unshakable optimism. She is often praised for her excellent teamwork and sunny personality in multiple instances of team-based operations. Many key collaborators, including Chief Engineer Andre, have high hopes for Operator Chen and believe that she is a poster child for a certain facet of Endfield: Young, positive, friendly, and eager to intercede and solve any problem that needs to be solved. 

[ADDITIONAL NOTES] 
During early contact, we realized that Operator Chen Qianyu has, without question or doubt, earned stellar performance reviews at multiple employers. However, many are still curious why she never stayed at any particular employer for extended periods of time. To date, Operator Chen has spent the longest period of time working for Endfield. We asked her this question during a regular interview and her answers are provided below: 
"Cheers and Drinks at La Fantoma? Wait, did I actually work there for three months?! Yeah, that's easy to explain. I had my fill of the milk tea so I left." 
"Oh... Temporary security personnel. Yeah, I wasn't old enough to get an actual job but I really needed the money for my next stop. My only choice was to work in EXPOs and conferences. But yeah, those were the months when I met plenty of big shots in Talos-II..." 
"Hold on! My graduation year performance at Tanjian Hall is actually — EXCELLENT?! Wait! You're not reading it wrong, right? I ... well, it's normal for me to be clueless about this! Heheh! I never picked up enough courage to check the results... Yeah, I'm just a little worried that my mentors would compare me to my mom." 
"I spent more than a year in Yinglung Special Task Force... Yeah, I did that, but can we not talk about this? Well, there's nothing to hide. I just don't find the place a good match for me. Wha? Did you just say there are people who don't get along with me?! Okay, that's ridiculous! Know anything about Duccio the Half-Face? That notorious gang leader at the Asphalt Roundabout? I actually had a pretty nice convo with him, you know!"</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>我发现，在帝江号和终末地的各个驻地办事处里，举办大小庆功、退休、日常派对时，大家都会第一个在邮件邀约系统中输入“陈千语”的名字，而这并不仅仅因为她的名字按照炎国拼音的顺序排在前列，否则，为什么没有人经常邀请安塔尔？
陈千语确实能够为一个拘谨的舱室带来热络的气氛和惊人的活力。从她走进门来开始计时，不到五分钟，她就能让最内向的干员开口说话，让最克制的干员展露笑容。而她做到这一切并不需要费太多的口舌功夫，实际上，由于一贯以来的心直口快，陈千语的谈话技巧仍是她需要加强练习的一个部分；她打动众人，依靠的是一些别的特质。有的干员归因为她热情的笑容；有的干员归因为她的大惊小怪将平平无奇的事烘托得无限精彩；有的干员认为是她源源不断的新点子，引领不擅长社交的大家享受休息时间的快乐——比如，办公椅竞速这项悠久的传统就是在陈千语的提倡下重新开展的，她还主动承担了帝江号上给大家放电影的活儿，当然，很多都是大炎武侠片。也有干员说，陈千语有时候只是关切地倾听他们一天的遭遇，偶尔提出一些连他们自己都没有注意到的细节，让乱成一团的事态突然就像她细致打理的两根长辫一样梳理畅通。
在一位精英干员的退休派对上，佩丽卡监督畅饮了一杯半的低度数潜地虬兽血酒后难得微醺，望着远处正拿着小剪子的陈千语，后者正在大家的簇拥下给沙发上睡着的安德烈剪眉毛。监督突然张口说：“是因为陈能够给人带来安全感。”
“什么？这里好吵……‘安全感’？监督，第一次听你说到这个词。”
陈千语似乎通过与人相处就能恢复活力，哪怕她在繁忙的行动安排间，还要拨冗在大小聚会上露面，至少将在场的气氛盘活，再悄悄离场。对此，她辩称自己天生就少觉。
“但是，陈千语干员的体力消耗，怕是不输任何人吧？就算是再受过什么大炎秘法的训练，也没有人能在只睡三个小时的情况下保持着这样的精力。”
“再说了，我有一次看到她打坐冥想的时候其实在打瞌睡……”
佩丽卡监督摇摇头：“陈的身上……有一种为大家担起一切的决心。只要她决定做到的事，其实很少有人能劝得了她。”
“啊，我还以为小陈是个随性的人呢……”
“也可能只是笨吧。”
“佩丽卡监督竟然会这么评价小陈！”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>I found out that "Chen Qianyu" is always the first name in the invite list for all sorts of celebrations, retirement parties, and daily hangouts at various Endfield regional offices as well as Dijiang. Everyone would punch in "Chen Qianyu" first when writing their invitation mail. This is not an alphabetical issue. Otherwise, Antal should be the first name on the list. 
Chen Qianyu is marked by her incredible vibes and abilities to liven up the atmosphere of an otherwise somber cabin. Once she steps into a place, it would take her less than five minutes to get the most introverted operators to start talking and the most restrained operators to start smiling. However, she usually does not have to use too much diplomacy to achieve these effects. In fact, Chen's direct and straightforward nature means that tact and technique are things she needs when communicating with other people. Chen actually relies on other properties when she livens up the atmosphere. Several operators attribute this to her warm, passionate smile. Others believe that it is her excessive over-reactions and her ability to inflate ordinary-looking incidents into exciting moments. Certain operators would emphasize Chen's seemingly endless reservoir of new ideas that bring about joy and happiness during recess, even for those unskilled in socializing — An example would be the tradition of office chair racing (which has been re-instated with Chen's insistence). Chen also actively took over Movies Aboard Dijiang, though most of her picks happen to be martial arts films from Yan. According to a few operators, when being a friend and listening to their accounts of the day, Chen could bring up points they had overlooked. Her inputs sorted out seemingly convoluted incidents as neatly as her meticulously combed and kept twin ponytails. 
During the retirement party of an elite operator, Supervisor Perlica got a little tipsy after going through a few glasses of Tunneling Nidwyrm bloodbrew (low kohlic content). While Andre snoozed on the sofa and Chen, surrounded by a crowd, trimmed the engineer's eyebrows with a pair of scissors, the Supervisor suddenly blurted out, "Chen has the power to make people feel safe." 
"What? It's so loud in here... Feel safe? I never heard these words from you before, Supervisor." 
Chen seems to regain her vigor by simply hanging around people. Even if her schedule were packed with field operations, she would do whatever she could to show up at various gatherings. She would liven up the event and then leave without a sound. When asked about this, Chen would say she was born without a serious need for sleep. 
"Wait. Operator Chen probably uses up more stamina and energy than most people, right? Sure, she might have training in esoteric Yanese techniques, but how can anyone maintain such levels of energy on just three hours of sleep per day?" 
"Speaking of which, I actually saw her dozing off during her meditative sessions..." 
Supervisor Perlica shook her head, "Chen is ... determined to shoulder the brunt for everyone. Once she has set her mind onto something, persuading her to give up is extremely difficult." 
"Oh? I thought Chen's a really easy-going person..." 
"Maybe she's just a little slow." 
"Supervisor Perlica, did you just say something bad about Chen?!" </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>按照她后来翻箱倒柜找出来的出生证明来看，132年，“陈”所登记的出生地点远在文明环带之外，但那个地名她不认得。在那之前的事，她也不晓得。好在，之后在宏山城的岁月，她全部都记得。
比如说，她记忆里的第一眼世界，是被妈妈抱在怀里走路的一个晚上，环形山尖锐的山脊像藏在盾牌后的枪，又像苍劲的老人朝天上举起的拳头，刺向塔卫二的夜空。
她记得她说出的第一句话，是在游乐园的回音筒前，咯咯笑着说，妈妈。千万道回音，就像说了千万句话，所以，建山啊，就叫她千语吧，反正她估计会像我一样成绩超级差，那名字简单点儿，罚抄也快。
她记得她的第一把剑是一根被精心修去了毛刺和树皮的树枝。
她记得她的第一个奖励是终于打掉另一根树枝后一个温柔的吻，落在头顶上。
她记得她的第一次晓事是大人们说天使来了，妈妈突然从衣柜后面一扇她从没见过的门里取出一把陌生的剑，冲出家去。
她记得她的第一次伤心是十岁生日会结束以后，爸爸把她叫到膝前，用指节抹掉她脸颊上的奶油，告诉她那个消息。她记得从那以后就再也没有见过妈妈。

“不过我也没觉得这有什么大不了的。”陈千语说。今天下午，她刚刚认识面前这个黎博利——名字叫作佩丽卡，像环塔商会来的千金小姐，却说自己来自于一个叫“终末地”的地方。她们俩坐在泥泞的小路边分吃着一只馍，虽然刚才推那辆驮兽车她出了大力，但佩丽卡不声不响、斯斯文文的样子，竟然吃得比她还多。也可能是她一个下午都在忙着倾吐，把自己前二十年的人生都交代完了。
“也就是说——”佩丽卡说，“那一天起，她突然从你的生命里消失了。”
“没有消失啊，”陈千语说，“我知道我妈还活着。我们只是不知道她去哪儿了，什么时候能回来。况且，她跟我还有一个重要的约定呢！”
佩丽卡点点头。
“我都说了这么多了！佩丽卡，你的家人呢？说说。”
“和你一样，”佩丽卡轻声说，“我也不知道……什么时候能回来。一个重要的约定……”
“那看来我们太有缘啦！”
陈千语一把揽住这黎博利女孩的肩膀，感到她在手心里僵硬了一下，随后放松下来。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>According to her birth certificate (which she found after an extended search through her personal belongings), "Chen" was born at a place far outside the Civilization Band in the Year 132. She does not recognize the name of the place or what happened there. Thankfully, she remembers everything about her wonderful childhood at Hongshan City. 
For example, the first sight of her memories was an evening where she was lying in her mother's embrace. The sharp ridges of Hongshan Crater resembled spears behind a wall of shields, like ancient fists raised high into the night skies of Talos-II. 
The first word she spoke in her memories was "Mom!" that she voiced into an echo tube with plenty of jiggles. The echoes made it sound like a chorus of a thousand voices. And Chen remembered her mother saying, "Jianshan, we should call her Qianyu. She'll probably end up at the bottom of her class like I did, so a simpler name will make it easier when the teacher makes her write it over and over." 
The first sword of her memories was a stick carefully trimmed and sanded to remove all the thorns, barbs, and bark. 
The first reward of her memories was a gentle kiss on her head, awarded after she disarmed the wielder of another stick. 
The first time she understood things in her memories was when the grown-ups announced the Aggeloi had arrived. Her mother suddenly opened a door hidden within the wardrobe and took out a blade she never seen before, and rushed out of their home. 
The first sad moment in her memories was after her tenth birthday party. Her father called her and she went over. He wiped the cream off her cheeks, told her the news, and she never saw her mother ever since. 

"I thought it was no big deal." Chen Qianyu said. She had just met a Liberi this afternoon — One that called herself Perlica. Though she resembled a TGCC heiress, she claimed she came from a place called Endfield. The two shared a Mo bun besides a mud trail. Although Chen was the one who put in a great deal more effort to push that burdenbeast cart, the quiet and well-behaved Perlica ate way more than she did. Then again, Chen got a smaller share because she spent most of that afternoon sharing moments from the first twenty years of her life. 
"So it means —" Perlica said, "that was the day when she suddenly disappeared from your life." 
"She didn't disappear," Chen Qianyu said, "I know she's still alive. We just don't know where she went and when she'd be back. She also made a very important promise with me!" 
Perlica nodded. 
"Okay, I've shared more than enough already! What about your family, Perlica? Tell me about them!" 
"Just like yours," Perlica said quietly, "I don't know ... when my family would return. And we also made an important promise..." 
"Oh, I guess we're really fated to meet each other!" 
Chen grabbed the Liberi's shoulder and felt her stiffen up temporarily before relaxing. </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>小院大门的门轴其实已经坏了很久，时间大概是陈迟迟离开后两周，当广建山发现门轴裂开两半时，心里倒是浮泛起一种“果真如此”之感。每当推门而入或开门而出时，它就会发出一声聒噪难听的“嘎”，直传到屋子里，在书房都能听见。清晨五点的“嘎”，是千语出去练剑。早晨八点的“嘎”，是千语急匆匆地跑进来拎起书包，从桌上抓起他盘里的食物，往嘴里胡乱塞了两口，赶去谈剑堂上课。下午五点的“嘎”，是千语带着一根恰合心意的小树枝，一路哼着歌，追着树林间的羽兽，在黄昏时跑进小院来。半夜的“嘎”，是千语从二楼卧室跳下来，以为他不知晓，偷偷溜出大门去玩儿。
他实则早都门儿清，只是默默把门口那条小路凸起来的石块都铲平了，怕这个马大哈夜黑风高时绊到脚。
他一直是这样的好爸爸，行动大于言语，像他的名字一样，“建山”，就是建设宏山的意思。迟迟第一次听到他的真名，就笑说这个名字也太接地气，像块又臭又硬的石头。这块石头，牢牢地镇着他们在环形山里的生活。这块石头收起了自己水上漂的本事，沉入了市井中央。这块石头，在她离开之后还留在那里，自顾自地长着苔藓。
今天，门口传来一声“嘎”。建山从书桌前猛地站起来，走到客厅里。女儿在门廊蹬掉鞋子，甩开行囊，长手长脚，瘫倒在沙发上。这不寻常。建山在脑子里数了数日子，上次新年放假回来短短待了三天，往后已有六个月没见过了。她怎么在一个寻常的礼拜一中午就回了宏山城，在这三四天里都没有刷卡消费记录是怎么生存的，又怎么一副灰头土脸的样子，是不是坐错了车，毕竟环形山的地形九转千回，不常回来的人根本弄不清楚，因此要多走不少路——这些他都没问。
“饿不饿？”
女儿点点头。
他去下面条。今天多放两块肉，还是长身体的时候。
千语到厨房来，帮他摆放碗筷，看来在外面野了一年又两个月，也没有忘记迟迟叮嘱她的规矩。他们正对坐下，吃面条。
“爸爸你最近做了什么实验啊？”
“说了你又听不懂。”
“我是说，你做饭要是像你做实验一样，能拿宏科院的奖金，就好了啊。”
“你妈妈喜欢吃。”
“我妈没有味觉的？好咸。”
说归说，她以往都会耐心地把汤也喝完。但今天她扒拉了两口就停了箸，坐在椅子上，定定望着窗外。
“爸爸，我好像一直没有办法在同一个地方待上很久。”
他知道，她心里清楚他不能或者不想多说，也不知道怎么说，所以每次都乖乖打住。但也许是她低垂的尾巴和面上的忧伤，令他再次意识到这个离家在外的女儿早就成长得更加通透，也许有些事她也开始慢慢懂得。
“烫脚？”广建山问，“不过老爸以前也能跑得很快。跑得快，才不会被你妈的剑追上。”
“你在说什么啊。”
“老爸以前天天扛着两百斤的勘测设备爬山，你以前见过的，那种望远镜。都是练出来的，老天师在前面飞，我们在山脚下玩命地追……”
“不跟你说了！……唉，我觉得是找不到适合我的地方。”
她抬起头来时好像她。他一阵恍惚。
“你妈妈……光是离开宏山，就有三回。”
“啊？你怎么以前从来不告诉我！”
“告诉你又听不懂。”
建山看到女儿脸上仿佛骤然被点亮一般，很快地，陈千语回来了。
“都是什么时候的事？生我以前吗？还是你们搬回宏山的时候啊？最近一次是那个时候吗？你以前说她去那个罗……”
“得寸进尺了。她不让我告诉你的。”
“啊啊啊，烦死她了！”
她又开始大口吃面了。他瞧着她。
“下次，准备什么时候出发？”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>The hinge of the courtyard gate had broken down for a while. It probably broke two weeks after Chen Chichi left. When Guang Jianshan noticed the hinge broken in two, he couldn't help but feel he had already seen this coming. Every time someone pushed open the gate to enter or leave the garden, the hinge would release an irksome groan loud enough to be heard in the house. Even the study. The groan at five during sunrise was Chen heading out to practice swordmancy. The groan at eight in the morning was Chen rushing back home, picking up her school bag, grabbing the food from her father's plate, taking two messy bites out of it, and rushing out to Tanjian Hall for her classes. The groan at five in the afternoon was Chen running back into the courtyard while chasing fowlbeasts through the grove, humming a song, and swishing a well-balanced stick around. The groan at midnight was Chen secretly jumping out of her second floor bedroom. She thought her father would not know how she sneaked off to have fun on her own. 
Jianshan knew everything. He had quietly paved a flat path leading to the gate and got rid of the protruding stones. He would not want his careless darling girl to trip and fall in the darkness. 
He had always been a dutiful father who acted rather than lectured. His name, Jianshan, meant "builder of Hongshan". When Chichi first learned about his actual name, she laughed and said that it was too down-to-earth, like a hard and stubborn stone. The stone was the ballast that secured their life in the Hongshan Crater. The stone restrained its ability to skip across rivers and lakes, and sank itself into cities and civilization. The stone stayed behind, even after she left, and allowed itself to be covered in moss. 
And today the gate groaned again. Jianshan leaped up from his desk and went straight to the living room. His daughter kicked off her shoes, threw down her traveling satchel, and collapsed into the sofa. None of it felt normal. Jianshan counted the days in his mind. She stayed for three days during the new year holidays and had not been back for six months afterwards. Her return to Hongshan in an ordinary Monday afternoon was strange. Her credit card reported no expenses for nearly four days. How did she survive? And why did she look so tired and exhausted? Did she take the wrong bus? Hongshan Crater was known for its complex geography and people who seldom returned often messed up the rides and had to walk long detours to be home — But Jianshan kept all these questions to himself. 
"Hungry?" 
His darling girl nodded. 
He made some noodles and added two extra pieces of meat. The young lass was still growing. 
Qianyu came to the kitchen and served the table. She did not forget Chichi's rules despite romping through the world for fourteen months. They sat facing each other and had their meals. 
"What experiments have you been running, Dad?" 
"You probably won't know much about it." 
"Well, it'd be great if you cook as well as you do science. Your tests got all those generous HAS grants." 
"Your mom likes what I make." 
"Does that mean Mom had no taste? This is really salty." 
No matter the conversation, she would typically finish everything, even the soup. But this day was different. She set her chopsticks aside after two bites, and just sat on the chair as her eyes gazed outside. 
"Dad, I think I have trouble staying at a single place for long." 
He knew that Chen was clear that he could not and would not say anything, and probably did not know how to continue this topic. He usually just let the discussion slide. But her drooping tail and expressions looked particularly sad on this day. He suddenly realized that his prodigal daughter had matured somewhat, and was slowly learning her lessons. 
"Coals on your feet?" Guang Jianshan asked, "Your old man used to be a pretty fast runner. I can't afford to be slow, or your mama's blade would catch up to me." 
"What are you talking about?" 
"I used to hike the mountains carrying a hundred kilos of surveillance gear. You've seen them before. Big telescopes? It's always down to the training. The old Tianshi would fly around and lead the way while we ran along the foot of the mountains and tried to keep up..." 
"Ugh. Stop it already...! Hooo. I don't think I can find a place that fits me." 
She raised her head. The resemblance hit him and left him a little dazed. 
"Well, your ma... She actually left Hongshan three times. And that's just counting this place." 
"What? Why didn't you tell about this?!" 
"Because you probably won't understand." 
Jianshan saw the glimmer and spark return to his daughter's face. Chen was back, and quickly enough. 
"When did all this happen? Before I was born? Or when you moved back to Hongshan? Was that the last time she left? You told me she went to that Rho..." 
"Push me all you want. Your mama told me to keep it from you." 
"Ahhhhh! That silly old woman! Why?!" 
He looked at the girl who started eating her noodles once more. 
"So when are you moving out again?" </>

voiceDesc.cn: 准备？嘿，我的剑可没有懈怠的时候！
voiceDesc.en: Get ready? Heh. My blades are always ready as they never rest!

voiceDesc.cn: 能不能让我再往前站站？我想第一个出门！
voiceDesc.en: Give me the front row this time. I wanna be the first out of the door!

voiceDesc.cn: 轮到我们了？该出手时就出手嘛。
voiceDesc.en: Our turn already? Nice. One should strike when the timing is right.

voiceDesc.cn: 交给我就对啦！
voiceDesc.en: Leave it to me!

voiceDesc.cn: 哇，给我用这么好的家伙？普通的也够啦，照样能把他们揍得屁滚尿流！
voiceDesc.en: Wow. This is pretty sleek. But I can also use standard issue weaponry to unleash a healthy dose of whoop-ass.

voiceDesc.cn: 唔……大侠应该穿得更轻便才对嘛。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm... Maybe a true master should wear lighter gear.

voiceDesc.cn: 剑招千遍，其势自明！
voiceDesc.en: With practice comes enlightenment of the swordmancer's art!

voiceDesc.cn: 这样，再这样？好嘞，我已经明白了！
voiceDesc.en: So this ... and follow up with this? Alright, I got it!

voiceDesc.cn: 我特地让佩丽卡把我的晋升环节留到现在！来自终末地的认可，当然得是你这个核心人物亲口告诉我我才能放心啦。
voiceDesc.en: I asked Perlica to stave off my promotion till this moment! I'll only rest easy when my approval from Endfield is personally delivered by you, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 怎么样，我有没有打破最快晋升纪录？我在谈剑堂可是提前毕业的——很惊讶？嘿嘿，在那边我一直是第一哦！
voiceDesc.en: What do you think? Did I break the fastest promotion on record? After all, I actually skipped a few years in Tanjian Hall. Surprised? Heheh. I was always the top of my class.

voiceDesc.cn: 看来我不只在武学上有天赋嘛，当你的干员是不是也是一把好手？哎呀，夸得我都不好意思啦——再来两句！
voiceDesc.en: Well, turns out I'm great at something other than martial arts. I just can't help but end up as your best operator. Oh, your flattery is making me blush already — keep it coming though!

voiceDesc.cn: 不，还远远没到头呢。管理员，我曾听说，妈妈的剑能碰触到天上的云彩。我会做到的，然后，成为你和佩丽卡最信任的人！
voiceDesc.en: I'm still far from the pinnacle. They say my mother's blade stirred the very clouds themselves, Endmin. And I'll do exactly that ... and become the one that you and Perlica can always count on!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员！我——嗯？走流程？哦，懂了懂了。终末地干员陈千语，前来报到！
voiceDesc.en: ENDMIN! HOW ARE —— Oh. Okay, stick with the process. Here goes. Endfield operator Chen Qianyu, reporting for duty!

voiceDesc.cn: 起势——！怎么样，帅不帅？
voiceDesc.en: Watch this! Hehe, awesome, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿，这儿呢，管理员！
voiceDesc.en: Over here, Endmin! Heehee.

voiceDesc.cn: 收到收到，管理员你就放一百个心吧。
voiceDesc.en: And roger that. Set your mind at absolute ease, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 你好呀，管理员。要陪我练练剑吗？
voiceDesc.en: How are you doing, Endmin? Interested in sparring with me?

voiceDesc.cn: 哎呀，管理员，剩下的还是交给我吧。劳逸结合！
voiceDesc.en: Just leave the rest to me, Endmin. Go enjoy a breather — you've earned it!

voiceDesc.cn: ……哇！差点没看到你，管理员！嘿嘿，刚才我在琢磨新想到的剑招，没看路。
voiceDesc.en: Woah! I almost didn't see you, Endmin! Heheh, yeah. I was trying to perfect a new move and didn't see where I was going.

voiceDesc.cn: 离开宏山的时候可没想到自己会天天待在这——么高的地方。这样一看，塔卫二也很渺小呢。不知道我和我的剑，最终能抵达哪里……塔罗斯有可能吗，管理员？
voiceDesc.en: I never expected to be somewhere *THIS* high in orbit after leaving Hongshan. Talos-II actually looks pretty small from where we're standing. I wonder where me and my blade could reach... Talos, maybe? Watchu think, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，之前借给你的武侠传记你有看吗？小说？不不不，那可不是小说，都是真实发生在大炎过去的故事哦！“以指为剑”很难想象？的确呢……不过“拳定春秋”更离谱吧？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin! Did you read that martial arts legend I lent you? No, no, no, it's not a novel. It's based on things that really happened at Yan! What? You can't picture someone whose "fingers can cut like blades"? Oh... You make a good point... But the "fists that settled the tides of Spring and Autumn" are even worse, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 我？哎哟——在放松肌肉呢。来到终末地之后，光是每天出任务，体能训练量就能达标了！要不……我也帮你松松？我可是知道几个穴位哦！来嘛来嘛，把外套脱了，别客气！
voiceDesc.en: What am I doing? OW! Ugh. I'm trying to loosen my muscles. Being an Endfielder and running all these missions took me way beyond my daily PT quota... Hey, interested in loosening up a bit? I actually know a few meridians! Come on! Off with that jacket! And you're welcome!

voiceDesc.cn: 我正要去武库取剑，一起吗？说起来，我本来想在剑柄上刻字来着，只是一直没想好刻“当破即破”还是“当断即断”……管理员，你帮我出出主意呗！
voiceDesc.en: Join me on a trip to the Arsenal! I got a sword to claim. What should I engrave on the hilt? "Cleave now as cleft" or "Once known be deft"? Endmin, puh-lease help me decide!

voiceDesc.cn: 最近经常感觉到有一些瓶颈呢。和技术无关，总觉得是心情方面的问题。传说有一些神兵利器就是会根据主人心境的变化而变化的……可我这只是普通的剑啊！管理员，帮帮忙嘛。
voiceDesc.en: I recently ran into a bottleneck. Ugh. It's got nothing to do with technique and I think something's bugging me from the inside. The legends say that the finest weapons will adapt to their wielders' mind... But ... but this is just an ordinary piece of steel! Endmin! Puh-lease help me out with this!

voiceDesc.cn: 我们常说“礼轻情意重”。倘若真的心怀情意，又会觉得送什么礼都嫌轻，但愿你能喜欢！
voiceDesc.en: "A gift is but a gentle token of heartfelt sincerity." That's how the saying goes. But if someone's truly sincere, no gift will be fitting enough. Well, I just hope you'll like this one, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 给我的？！哇……我现在就拆开看看！
voiceDesc.en: For ... me?! WOW ... I'm totally gonna open it right now!

voiceDesc.cn: 以前总是听着佩丽卡念叨你，现在你本人就这么活生生站在我眼前，这感觉还真奇妙欸！什么？才不会失望呢！看着她嘴里那个天下无敌、举世无双的家伙在我旁边吃饭睡觉，有意思得很呢——欸，这儿，你嘴角有饭粒。
voiceDesc.en: Perlica used to drone on and on about you, but now you're just right in front of me! Feels rather otherworldly, if you ask me! What? No! I'm not disappointed! Having meals and sharing a roof with Perlica's ultimate and invincible legend is like the most interesting thing ever—! Hold on. You got crumbs on your face.

voiceDesc.cn: 离开家乡，来到终末地之前，我在环带游历过一段时间。嘿嘿，其实一开始我还挺期待经历些类似“事了拂衣去，深藏功与名”的事情。可真的切身体验了宏山之外的人间百态，我意识到侠客是不能对自己行为的后果视而不见的。所以，步子就慢了，去的地方就少了。无妨，以后补回来就是。
voiceDesc.en: After I left my home, I actually traveled around the Band for a while before joining Endfield. Heheh. I actually hoped to be a nameless heroine of legendary deeds — one who leaves nothing but mystery. But having experienced life outside Hongshan, I realized that true warriors can't just walk away from the results of their actions. So ... I slowed down my pace and visited fewer places. No matter, I'll make up for this missed opportunity.

voiceDesc.cn: 应该是十岁……差不多十一岁的时候吧，我在谈剑堂的后山偷偷练剑，却遇见了离群的天使。那是我第一次提剑实战。我把断剑带回家的时候，父亲表扬了我，但也问了我一个问题：我的剑只是断了，那些没剑的人，又该怎么办呢？嘿，别看他平时那个样，这一问，我到今天都在琢磨。
voiceDesc.en: I think I was about ten ... maybe eleven. I was practicing my swordmancy in secret in the hills behind Tanjian Hall when I ran into an Aggelos that got separated from its cluster. It was my first real battle. Father praised me when I returned home with a broken blade, but he also said this: "You may have broken a blade, but there are those who don't even have one." I guess I got to see beyond my old man's usual self. What he said got me pondering, even to this day.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么要来终末地？唔……说来话长。但如果你一定要问是哪个时刻——我想，是在和某个穿着光鲜亮丽的黎博利一起把那辆驮兽车推出泥坑的时候吧。佩丽卡那时候的笑是发自真心的。当时我就想，剩下的路途，或许我可以不用一个人走了。
voiceDesc.en: Why did I become an Endfielder? Hmm... That's a long story. If you really wanna know when I got interested ... I guess it was that occasion when I helped a really well-dressed Liberi pull a burdenbeast cart out of the mud. Perly gave me such a genuine smile. And I thought to myself ... maybe I didn't have to travel around on my own anymore.

voiceDesc.cn: 应龙拿起职责放下了同伴，妈妈拿起赤霄放下了我。在拿起更“重”的东西之前……大家似乎都要先放下那些更“轻”的。但终末地走过的地方，没有轻重之分，没有东西被放下——终末地拿得起整个塔卫二，而我还能再多拿一把剑！
voiceDesc.en: Yinglung left behind friends to take up the mantle of duty. And my mother left me behind to take up Chi Xiao. I guess people who find a true calling would just ... drop the less important things they have. But Endfield doesn't do that. Everything and everyone are just as important and nothing gets left behind — If Endfield has taken up a vision for Talos-II, then I'll swing another blade to see it through!

voiceDesc.cn: 让佩丽卡休息是件难事，好在我对付师兄师姐们的技巧反过来就能在这里用上：想让他们动起来得把所有的活都交给他们，想让佩丽卡休息当然就是把所有的活都一口气帮她干完啦……啊？这不算技巧吗？
voiceDesc.en: Taking Perlica off her work won't be easy. But I got a trick I used on my swordmancy seniors. If I wanted them to start working, I simply pushed all the chores to them. Now let's flip this around. We can simply finish all of Perly's work and she would have no choice but to start taking a break... What? Come on, it's a clever technique, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 发型？其实很简单，只要对准头上的两个角，就很容易梳对称啦。这是大院儿里的王奶奶教我的办法，说是他们丰蹄的独门秘诀……哎呀，院儿里的孩子都是这样，说不清是谁带大的，大伙儿都像一家一样亲呢。
voiceDesc.en: My hairdo? Easy! Just use the two horns for guidance to achieve symmetry. My neighbor Granny Wang told me it's a Forte secret and taught me this trick... That's odd? It's just life in a typical dayuan neighborhood. People helped raise the neighbors' kids and we all grew up in the same courtyard. You could say we were more than neighbors. It felt like being in a huge extended family.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的剑法可谓集百家之长！首先肯定是谈剑堂的师父教的，板正、利索，极尽实用；然后是小时候闹着让妈妈带我练剑学到的，传承悠远、招数驳杂，每招每式都别有蕴意；最后嘛……是我看那些传记小说自己琢磨的。大侠总得有一两招自创的独门秘技，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: Many, many schools have inspired my special swordmancy! The biggest influence? Definitely my master at Tanjian Hall. He taught me disciplined moves, efficient strikes — pure substance, no fluff. Next comes whatever my mother demonstrated to me when I whined hard enough. Her swordmancy was passed down through generations and ultra complex. Every move carried a special meaning. As for the rest ... well, I just came up with them after reading up on all those swordmancer legends. A true warrior must have a signature technique or two, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 武陵的空气总是湿湿的，黏糊糊的，我习惯了好一阵子呢。在侵蚀潮涨起的时候，宿舍的墙壁上就会凝结出水珠。但那里的饭菜好吃呀，人也——呃，大多数人都不错。心事？没有！绝对没有想起什么讨厌的人！
voiceDesc.en: Wuling is a wet, humid, and sticky place, but I stayed there for a bit and I got used to that. The walls would bleed water droplets every time the Blight Tide rose. But Wuling food is just awesome and the people there are like — I mean, most people are pretty nice. Bad memories? NO! I definitely can't think of anyone I hate at that place!

voiceDesc.cn: “千语”这个名字据说是妈妈给我取的。简单、好写——多亏如此，不然以前被师父罚抄的时候要费很多力气呢。
voiceDesc.en: People told me that my mother named me Qianyu. Thank goodness it's easy to write in Yanese — Spared me a ton of grief when my Master punished me to write my name a thousand times.

voiceDesc.cn: 从帝江号的舰桥往下看，可以看到宏山环形山呢。两年前我除了迷茫，什么都没从那儿带走。那些走过的路从舰桥上看下去只有指甲盖这么长……不过，等到这距离能用手掌丈量——甚至手掌都不够用的时候，我大概就能把这些迷茫都丢光了吧！
voiceDesc.en: You can actually see Hongshan Crater if you look down from the bridge of Dijiang. I left that place two years ago with nothing but aimlessness. But all those roads I traveled barely reached the width of a single fingernail... Guess I'll just do more traveling till I run out of fingers or even palms to measure all my walking. I would probably have tossed my aimlessness aside by the time that happens!

voiceDesc.cn: 妈妈有一把赤红色的剑。她说，那是很早以前，一位大炎的侠女赠送给我们祖上的，是我们的传家宝。我甚至见过很多宏山来的老爷爷老奶奶对着那把剑长吁短叹。之后，妈妈就和那把剑一起消失了。长大一点后我才明白，那把剑不只是剑，是一条道路、一种信念。我还是想去找她，只不过，这次小千语会带着自己的剑去找她。
voiceDesc.en: Mother has a crimson sword. She told me it was a family heirloom that a heroine of Yan gave to our ancestor. I remember how old folks from across Hongshan visited our family home to see the blade and recall its epic tales. Then ... mother disappeared with the sword. As I grew older, I realized that it wasn't just a weapon. It was a path. A belief. I still want to look for her. However, her little Qianyu will be doing so with her own blade.

voiceDesc.cn: 我最早见到佩丽卡的时候，她就是个努力到没边的人。偶尔听她提起她拼命的原因，是和一个叫管理员的人有关，我还替她打抱不平呢。可真的见到了管理员，似乎也能理解一些……除去那些伟大的理想之类的，佩丽卡也许只是单纯地想要能和你肩并肩前行而已呢。
voiceDesc.en: Perlica was already an extreme workaholic when I first met her. I occasionally overheard that a certain Endministrator was the reason she pushes herself so hard. I felt really sorry for Perly — but after seeing you, I kinda get where she's coming from... Aside from the epic vision and enterprise she's working on, I feel that Perlica simply wishes to fight by your side.

voiceDesc.cn: 那儿是不是有什么东西？
voiceDesc.en: Hm, I think I spot some goodies over there?

voiceDesc.cn: 发现宝物！咱们快过去看看！
voiceDesc.en: I spot treasure! Let's go take a look!

voiceDesc.cn: 咦？这里我们是不是没来过？
voiceDesc.en: Wait. We've never been here before, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 那里似乎有个厉害的家伙，让我来试试手吧。
voiceDesc.en: Danger up ahead. Lemme see how good this one is.

voiceDesc.cn: 没想到吧？我有专门对付石头的剑法。
voiceDesc.en: Didn't expect this, right? My special swordmancy for rocky stuff!

voiceDesc.cn: 剩下的交给我吧，用剑更快！
voiceDesc.en: Leave the rest to me! It's faster with a blade!

voiceDesc.cn: 秘笈总是放在这种箱子里面呢！
voiceDesc.en: They usually hide secret tomes in crates like this.

voiceDesc.cn: 圆又圆，亮晶晶……原来醚质是这个大小啊。
voiceDesc.en: It's round and it's shiny... Oh, this is the actual size of Aurylene.

voiceDesc.cn: 抽刀断水大概也是这种感觉吧。
voiceDesc.en: One can't stop a flood with a single blade. Perhaps this is what it felt like.

voiceDesc.cn: 歇歇，磨刀不误砍柴工嘛！
voiceDesc.en: Good rest! Sharpened blades make up for lost time!

voiceDesc.cn: 快，用这个！
voiceDesc.en: Quick! Take some of this!

voiceDesc.cn: 呼……恢复过来了！
voiceDesc.en: Hoo... I'm feeling better!

voiceDesc.cn: 当心，快退后！
voiceDesc.en: Watch out! Get back!

voiceDesc.cn: 唔，我没事！先对付他们。
voiceDesc.en: Hngh! I'm alright! Focus on the fight.

voiceDesc.cn: 呜……可恶……
voiceDesc.en: Darn it... Hngh...

voiceDesc.cn: 你这招很帅嘛！
voiceDesc.en: That move of yours was incredible!

voiceDesc.cn: 耶！刚刚的配合简直完美！
voiceDesc.en: Yay! That was some perfect teamwork!

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿嘿，应该的！
voiceDesc.en: Heh! Just doing my job!

voiceDesc.cn: 众人合，剑招成！
voiceDesc.en: Unity delivers blade synergy!

voiceDesc.cn: 剑起有光，光若奔夜！
voiceDesc.en: A blade unsheathed, its light unleashed!

voiceDesc.cn: 交给我。
voiceDesc.en: Leave it to me.

voiceDesc.cn: 呼——意料之中。
voiceDesc.en: Hooo— I wouldn't expect anything less.

voiceDesc.cn: 这次轻松。
voiceDesc.en: An easy victory.

voiceDesc.cn: 做得好！
voiceDesc.en: Nicely done!

voiceDesc.cn: 好险。快，先抢救伤员！
voiceDesc.en: That was ... a little too close. Quick. Tend to the wounded!

voiceDesc.cn: ……再来！
voiceDesc.en: ...We'll fight them again!

voiceDesc.cn: 吃这招！
voiceDesc.en: Take this!

voiceDesc.cn: 看剑！
voiceDesc.en: Right there!

voiceDesc.cn: 挑！
voiceDesc.en: Slash!

voiceDesc.cn: 洗！
voiceDesc.en: Sweep!

voiceDesc.cn: 截！
voiceDesc.en: Deflect!

voiceDesc.cn: 趁现在！
voiceDesc.en: Now's our chance!

voiceDesc.cn: 交给我吧！
voiceDesc.en: Leave it to me!

voiceDesc.cn: 轮到我了！
voiceDesc.en: My turn!

voiceDesc.cn: 你的对手在这儿！
voiceDesc.en: You're fighting me!

voiceDesc.cn: 有破绽！
voiceDesc.en: Weakness spotted!

voiceDesc.cn: 断！
voiceDesc.en: Break!

voiceDesc.cn: 当破即破！
voiceDesc.en: Cleave now as cleft!

voiceDesc.cn: 当断即断！
voiceDesc.en: Once known be deft!

voiceDesc.cn: 当弃即弃！
voiceDesc.en: Cast off as cast!
