The Landbreakers' way of life has left its mark on Wulfgard. Each scar stands as evidence of past trials. Though the pain doesn't seem to weigh on him now, that may not always be the case. He must learn to approach missions with greater regard for his own life — or at the very least, to place more trust in his teammates, rather than charging in alone every time.</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员狼卫，全名卡特洛·狼卫·卢皮诺，裂地者狼群氏族成员。作为狼群代表与终末地工业达成合作。之后经佩丽卡监督推荐，加入特种技术部门，以危机处理小组成员的身份接受派遣。

狼卫拥有极强的观察能力与应变能力。据我所知，他能自如应对绝大多数目前已知的高危环境。
他显然习惯单独行动，同时擅长隐秘工作。但在与他人的交际中，狼卫似乎并不乐于处理一些人际关系问题，因此在进行需要团队协作的任务时，建议尽量让该干员独自行动。
值得注意的是，根据已有的测试反馈，狼卫在体能与反应速度上都表现得十分优秀，他精通铳械，熟练掌握各项肉搏技巧，也擅长将任一物件用于战斗——哪怕是一支钢笔。
或许是得益于丰富的荒地生活经验，狼卫不仅对野外环境中的各种危险情况了如指掌，还很清楚如何与开拓区居民打交道，尤其是在与裂地者有关的事宜上……相信每个和他搭档过的干员应该都对此印象深刻。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Wulfgard, full name Catello Wulfgard Luppino, hails from a Landbreaker clan known as the Pack. As their appointed representative, he established a partnership with Endfield Industries. Recommended by Supervisor Perlica, he joined the Specialist Tech Division and now serves on the Crisis Team. 

Wulfgard possesses exceptional observational skills and adaptability. As far as I know, he can handle most high-risk environments with ease. 
He clearly prefers to operate alone and excels at covert operations. However, he seems reluctant to engage in interpersonal matters, so for missions requiring teamwork, it's recommended that he be given as much autonomy as possible. 
Notably, test reports show that Wulfgard performs extremely well in both physical endurance and reaction speed. He is proficient with guns, adept at hand-to-hand combat, and has a knack for turning any object (even a pen) into a weapon. 
Perhaps his time in the wildlands has sharpened his instincts — Wulfgard has an acute sense for danger and a deep understanding of how to interact with frontier residents, especially when Landbreaker affairs are involved. I believe anyone who's ever partnered with him would agree. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>在狼卫刚加入终末地的时候，一些干员一度因为裂地者的身份而对他心存成见，甚至认为他另有所图。但几年过去，他们发现这位来自“狼群氏族”的青年尽管多数时候一脸冷漠，言辞也总显得颇具攻击性，但却意外地不难相处。
他总是无比准时、高效、尽责，经常什么都不说就完成了所有善后工作——几乎具备了一切常人能想象的“好队友”特征。可惜的是，他本人似乎并不喜欢和人组队，每次被迫提交的报告里总少不了“希望执行单人任务”这条。
不过与此相对的，狼卫对于自己在武器改装上的“小小心得”却从不吝于分享，这一度让终末地的武库工程师们颇为头疼。很多干员第一次见到狼卫本人，就是在武库工程师固定会举办的新型武器测试活动上，通常都能目睹他是如何面不改色地在武库工程师面前改装完了新武器，然后指着它说“我认为这样更好用”，致使武库工程师差点当场被气晕的全过程。
哪怕这让狼卫一度上了武库的黑名单，他也毫不在意，一如既往地对拿到手的新武器进行改装，直到他觉得好用为止。

“成熟的猎手，理应挑选自己最趁手的猎具。——如果够不上最趁手，那就改装到最趁手。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>When Wulfgard first arrived at Endfield, his Landbreaker background raised a few eyebrows. Some operators suspected he had hidden motives. But as the years passed, they discovered that behind the cold exterior and sharp tongue was someone surprisingly easy to get along with. 
He's always punctual, efficient, responsible, and thorough with cleanup. In many ways, he checks every box of the "ideal teammate." Unfortunately, he doesn't seem to enjoy working with others. Whenever he's required to submit a report, he always requests to be assigned to solo operations instead. 
On the other hand, Wulfgard has never been shy about sharing his insights into weapon modifications, which has caused headaches for Endfield's Arsenal Engineers. Many operators first met Wulfgard during one of the regular new weapon testing sessions, where they'd watch him coolly tweak a weapon right in front of its designer, then say, "It works better this way." This often left the engineers on the verge of losing their composure. 
Though this earned him a spot on the arsenal team's "unwelcome" list, Wulfgard didn't care. He kept modifying every new weapon he got until it felt right to him. 

"Experienced hunters always select their best hunting tools or modify them until they become the best."</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>在裂地者普遍被视作“秩序破坏者”的当下，重视秩序、对文明环带持温和态度的狼群氏族可谓是异类中的异类。直到现在，他们依然固守着某些古老的传统，譬如家族文化与崇尚团结。
而这份特殊性，也让本就与他们对立的碾骨氏族更加仇视这些行走在荒地上的孤高猎手，甚至在十几年前发动过一次截杀行动，重创了当时刚失去头狼，正处于薄弱时期的狼群。
作为那场劫难的亲历者，狼卫虽然得以与妹妹一同幸存，却对当时发生的种种讳莫如深。
他在完成成年礼的几年后便离开了狼群，只与妹妹和极少数的友人保持了联系。
没人清楚他离群的原因，他也像对当年的事缄口不言那样，不曾说过自己的目的。
再后来，他以寻求合作为由找上了终末地，并以干员的身份加入了特种技术部门。
曾有人问过狼卫，为什么会选择终末地作为合作对象？
他先是沉默，接着十分坦诚地给出了答案：
“我希望为狼群寻找到另一个未来……而‘终末地’拥有让这件事成真的可能。”
狼卫对狼群如今面临的困境表现得相当坦然，他的诚恳与务实最终让这项合作得以推进。
与此相应的，他成为干员似乎也成了一件顺理成章的事，因为他的理由是——他有义务向合作方展示狼群的优秀之处，也有义务回报终末地的信任。
于是，在不少或困难或艰险的任务里，都能看到狼卫隐秘却活跃的身影。
不少曾对裂地者心存成见的干员，也因为狼卫的存在，改变了自己的看法。
虽说这些看法在狼卫的妹妹——洛茜干员加入后又有了别样的变化，但那就是后话了。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>In a time when most Landbreakers are seen as "destroyers of order", the Pack stands out as an anomaly. They value order and hold a peaceful attitude toward the Civilization Band. Even now, they cling to certain old traditions, such as strong familial bonds and a deep respect for unity. 
That very difference only fueled the long-standing feud between them and their rivals, the Bonekrushers. Over ten years ago, the Bonekrushers struck with a vicious ambush, shattering the Pack when they were at their weakest — just after the death of their Alpharion. 
Wulfgard and his younger sister survived the attack, but they refused to speak of what truly happened. 
Wulfgard then left the Pack a few years after his coming-of-age ceremony, keeping in touch with only a few trusted friends and his sister. 
No one ever knew why he left. He stayed silent, just like he did about the attack. 
Later, he approached Endfield and proposed a partnership. He eventually joined the Specialist Tech Division as an operator. 
Someone once asked why he chose Endfield. 
At first, he was silent. Then, with startling honesty, he answered: 
"I want another future for the Pack... and Endfield holds the possibility of making it real." 
Wulfgard spoke candidly of the Pack's struggles. His steady resolve and honest intent opened doors. 
So it made perfect sense when he became an operator. As he put it, he had a duty — to prove the Pack's worth and to repay Endfield's trust in him. 
Since then, he's become a quiet but reliable presence on many tough and dangerous missions. 
Operators who once held deep prejudice against the Landbreakers began to change their views — thanks to Wulfgard. 
Then, opinions shifted once more after the arrival of his sister — Operator Rossi. But that's a story for another time...</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>“这次要留多久？不打算回家看看？”
“……一天。嗯，没必要。”
“这么快？那算了……唉，不过前两天小洛茜又来跟我念叨你，说是怀疑这次她过生日，你又要‘礼物到了人没到’……下次你就算不回家，好歹也找机会跟她见一面嘛。
“你想啊，自从你们兄妹上回在托马索家里聚了一次，都已经过了大半年了。”
“还有些事要尽快处理……等事情结束了——”
“打住！你上次也这么说，结果呢？结果你隔了几天又跑开拓区去了，说什么要帮人善后……
“唉，搞不懂你们这些年轻人，怎么整天都有做不完的事……
“反正我要是你，就算事情再多，肯定也要多回来几趟照料妹妹的！她才那么小，氏族里和她差不多年纪的，哪个不是被家人们宠着长大的……”
“你们也是她的家人。”
“那当然！不对，差点被你小子带跑了……我知道你总有自己的想法，但作为过来人，我看到小洛茜总会想起我那个可怜的女儿……没能在那时多花些时间陪着她，是我最大的遗憾……
“听点劝吧，卡特洛……少做点会让自己后悔的事。”
“我明白你的意思，鲁斯特叔叔。
“但洛茜……她知道我今天回来。”
“什么？不可能！
“她要是知道，怎么会一大早就和路易家那对双胞胎跑去猎场了？总不会是……”
“嗯，就和你猜的一样。”
“……你们兄妹啊，果然是同一窝的鲁珀，骨子里根本一模一样嘛！
“算了，我也懒得管了！就算这样，你总不在她身边，不怕哪天出什么纰漏吗？
“本来想替小洛茜保密的……现在看来，还是得给你说说——六个月前，洛茜她为了给老巴特他们出头，不小心惹来了影颅的杀手……当时我记得清清楚楚，整整十四个人，一个比一个难缠，要不是托马索提前找来了卡邦的‘獠牙’们帮忙，我们几个那天指不定连地下黑市的门都走不出去……”
“……”
“怎么样？现在知道后怕了吧？”
“不，我只是在想，洛茜知道我去北方的事……是不是也是鲁斯特叔叔你说的。”
“呃……这个……呵呵……那是……我一不小心给说漏嘴了……真的……
“咳，对了！你的双铳我都检查好了！没什么大问题！保养得不错！就是少用点你那些个改装弹药……再好的铳口也禁不住你那么耗的……”
“嗯，我会注意的。
“以及……当时是十五个人。”
“啊？”
“那么，下回见。”
——“恶狼扳机”店内监控的录音记录</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>"How long are you gonna stay this time? You coming home?" 
"...A day. And nah." 
"Just a day? Then never mind ... sigh. Well, a couple of days ago, Rossi was whining again, saying she thinks you'll pull the same stunt this year — you know, 'the gift arrives, but the brother doesn't.' Come on, even if you're not planning to come home, you could at least find time to see her once in a while." 
"It's already been what, over half a year? Since you two last met up at Tommaso's place." 
"I still need to take care of a few things. Once it's done..." 
"Stop right there! That's what you said last time! Then you ran off to the frontier, saying you had to clean up someone's mess..." 
"Gosh, I don't get you young folks. How do you always have so much to do?" 
"Hey, if I were you, no matter how swamped I was, I'd still swing by more to check in on my little sis. She's a kid! Every other kid her age in the clan's doted on by their families all day every day..." 
"You're her family too." 
"Well, yeah — Wait! No, don't try to spin this on me... I get you've got your own things going on. But listen, as someone who's been there — whenever I see little Rossi, I can't help but think of my own little girl... Biggest regret of my life? Not being there for her when I still had the chance." 
"Just hear me out, Catello... Life's short, don't do things you'll end up regretting." 
"I hear you. Uncle Rust."  
"Rossi knows I'm back today." 
"WHAT? No way!" 
"Then why would she run off to the hunting grounds first thing in the morning with the Louis twins? Unless..." 
"Uh-huh. Exactly." 
"Argh... You two really are true Lupus. So stubborn and so damn alike ... it's scary." 
"Alright, alright. Do whatever you like! But if you're always absent, aren't you worried something might go wrong?" 
"I was gonna keep it from you for Rossi's sake ... but looks like you need to hear it. Six months ago, she got herself into serious trouble — stuck her neck out for Old Bart and his men, and ended up on the Shadowskull's hit list. I remember it clear as day. Fourteen of them showed up, each nastier than the last. If Tommaso hadn't pulled some strings and brought in Capone's Fangs, we probably wouldn't have even made it out of the black market alive..." 
"..." 
"Worried now, huh?" 
"Nope. I was just wondering how Rossi found out I was heading north. It was you, wasn't it?" 
"Oh! Um, heh ... well ... yeah, I might've let that slip ... wasn't on purpose though..." 
"Ahem, anyway! I checked your guns! They're as good as new! Just ease up on those custom rounds of yours. No barrel's gonna last with the way you burn through them..." 
"Got it." 
"And ... there were actually fifteen of them." 
"Huh?" 
"Alright, see you around." 
— Audio log from Howlfire Gunsmiths</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>他很清楚，既然打算长期离开狼群，就意味着这是一次无法确定归期的远行。按照自己以往的习惯，最好把能派上用场的东西全带上。
但是，当狼卫站在“猎手号”前，环视了一遍这辆自己与妹妹生活了快十年的大车，又觉得似乎也没什么该拿的了……
他忍不住又在脑海里过了遍那些原定的安排：再和洛茜交代一遍氏族里真正能信任的人，还有唯二能联系上自己的方式；跟托马索打个招呼，让他多看着洛茜一点；去鲁斯特叔叔的店里还掉仅剩的那笔定制费；替乔万尼再喂一次那几只完全散养的羽兽，并将它们托付给隔壁的小文森特……他确信自己并没有遗漏其中的任何一件事。
想到这里，他放心了一些，打算最后再去看一眼床头，以防自己又忘了关洛茜送的那盏源石灯。
只是才走进自己睡的那节车厢，他的目光就落在了柜子里一个不起眼的角落，那里放着外漆已经掉得差不多的双铳——是他拿到的第一件武器。
尽管它们是二手货，口径适配的弹药也十分稀少，但对那时的他来说，却已经是足以让自己与妹妹活下去的珍宝。他用它得到了第一份雇佣兵工作，也靠它击杀了第一个任务目标，甚至因为其中一支铳的源石激发单元过度老化，他被迫领悟了单手换弹的技巧，还因此学会了拆卸铳械的手法。而在靠佣金养活一家人的第三年，他终于成功换掉了老旧的源石激发单元，并专门为双铳做了一组蚀刻弹药。
但就像从他人那里继承来的梦想总是难以延续，这对从氏族老一辈那里获赠的铳械，后来还是在一次危急的护卫任务中，因长时间铳口过热而报废了。
不久后，在环带当赏金猎人的鲁斯特叔叔回归了狼群氏族，在他家对面开了间翻新、改造旧铳械的铺子，名字叫“恶狼扳机”。从鲁斯特那里，他第一次知道了什么是“定制武器”，也终于学到了一些改装武器的窍门。
那之后，他用的武器总能被他改造得最适合自己，当然……也可能只适合他。
即便如此，这对最初的铳械还是没被他处理掉，而是放在了一个如果不是即将远行，自己平时也不会多看一眼的位置。
——为了什么呢？铭记？提醒？还是纯粹地想要为那段充斥着苦痛的回忆留点纪念品？
狼卫想了想，发现自己似乎还答不上来，好像都是，又好像都不是。
在确认了源石灯的关闭状态后，他走向车门——正式踏上这段说不定能给他一个确切答案的旅程。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Wulfgard knew better than anyone, that leaving the Pack for good meant this journey had no return date. By his own standards, that meant packing everything that might prove useful. 
Yet, standing before Il Cacciatore and sweeping his gaze over the massive rig that had been his and his sister's home for nearly a decade... he realized, abruptly, that there was nothing left worth taking. 
He went over his plans once more in his mind: make sure Rossi knew exactly who in the clan could be trusted, confirm the two ways people could reach him, ask Tommaso to keep a close watch over Rossi, settle the last bit of custom work fees at Uncle Rust's, feed Giovanni's semi-wild fowlbeasts one last time, entrust them to little Vincenzo next door... No, he hasn't forgotten a thing. 
Satisfied, he turned for one final check. Just to be absolutely sure he hadn’t left Rossi's handmade Originium lamp glowing on the bedside table. 
But as soon as he stepped into his sleeping compartment, his eyes caught sight of something in an unremarkable corner of the cabinet: his worn guns — the very first weapons he'd ever owned. 
Though secondhand and now running low on compatible ammo, those guns were priceless treasures back then. They kept him and his sister alive, earned him his first mercenary contract, and helped him take down his first target. When one of the Originium activators failed, he was forced to master one-handed reloads and gun maintenance. After three years of supporting his family with mercenary pay, he finally replaced the worn Originium activator and even crafted a set of custom-etched ammo. 
These guns were passed down from the clan's elders. Like many inherited dreams, they met their end during a high-stakes escort mission, overheating after prolonged firing. 
Soon after, Uncle Rust — a bounty hunter who had returned to the Pack and opened a weapon refurbishment shop called "Howlfire Gunsmiths." There, Wulfgard was introduced to custom weapon modifications for the first time. 
Then he learned to make weapons truly his own, even if they only suited him. 
Still, he never got rid of those guns that got him started. They remained tucked away in a quiet corner. 
Why keep them? As a reminder? A keepsake? Or a memento of painful memories? 
He wasn't sure — maybe all, maybe none. 
After confirming the Originium lamp was off, he headed for the door, ready to embark on a journey that might finally give him an answer.</>

voiceDesc.cn: 你来指挥。
voiceDesc.en: Command is yours.

voiceDesc.cn: 现在出发？
voiceDesc.en: Are we setting off now?

voiceDesc.cn: 要我配合吗？可以，只要他们跟得上。
voiceDesc.en: Need me in the team? Sure. Just make sure the rest keep up.

voiceDesc.cn: 团队作战？明白了，我会做好该做的。
voiceDesc.en: A team assignment...? Understood. I'll do what needs to be done.

voiceDesc.cn: 很趁手的武器，多谢。
voiceDesc.en: Very well-balanced. Grazie.

voiceDesc.cn: 武装到牙齿……聪明的决断。
voiceDesc.en: Armed to the teeth... A very wise decision.

voiceDesc.cn: 越娴熟的技巧，越该用在关键时刻。
voiceDesc.en: Skills truly mastered shall be used in situations that are truly desperate.

voiceDesc.cn: 面对敌人，狼群只会选最高效的围猎手段。
voiceDesc.en: The Pack hunts with purpose. Only the quickest path to victory will do.

voiceDesc.cn: 谢谢你的认可，管理员，那我能不写这次的报告吗？不能？……好吧。
voiceDesc.en: Appreciate your approval, Endmin. So, can I skip the mission report this time? No...? Fine.

voiceDesc.cn: 如你所见，管理员，你让我去做我擅长的工作，我就不会给出让你失望的结果。
voiceDesc.en: As you can see, Endmin — you trust me with the right tasks, and I let the results speak for themselves.

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群的地位建立在鲜血之上，只需狩猎到足够的猎物即可。我是否能认为你认可了我的狩猎，管理员？
voiceDesc.en: Every wolf in the Pack earns its place through bloodshed. Take down enough prey, and you rise. Endmin, does this mean you have approved of my hunt?

voiceDesc.cn: 我见过狼群遭受重创时的惨烈，所以才下定了决心，要为洛茜、为狼群的其他人寻找新的出路。管理员，很庆幸能与你同行。
voiceDesc.en: I witnessed the Pack brought low and the devastation that came with it. This is why I've decided to find a new path for Rossi and the rest of the wolves... Fate brought us together, Endministrator. It's an honor to walk this path with you.

voiceDesc.cn: 卡特洛·狼卫·卢皮诺，终末地危机处理小组成员。目前代表狼群氏族与你们合作，任何雇佣兵能干的活儿我都能做。合同期内，我将成为你的獠牙。
voiceDesc.en: Catello Wulfgard Luppino, Endfield Crisis Team. I represent the Pack. Give me any merc job, and as long as our contract stands, I'll be your claws and fangs.

voiceDesc.cn: 有新任务？
voiceDesc.en: Got a new assignment?

voiceDesc.cn: 我在。
voiceDesc.en: I'm here.

voiceDesc.cn: 这里也缺人手？
voiceDesc.en: Short on people here too?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，要我同行吗？我抽得出空。
voiceDesc.en: Need me to tag along, Endmin? I can make time for you.

voiceDesc.cn: 和其他干员合作并不算简单。狼群的手段很难让普通人立刻接受，更别提我本就习惯独来独往。但如果是管理员您的要求……我会尝试做出一些改变。
voiceDesc.en: It's not easy working with the other operators. The Way of the Pack and my solitary nature aren't for everyone. But if you want me in line ... I'll adapt and make it work.

voiceDesc.cn: 相比帝江号，我还是更习惯在开拓区待着。这里太安逸了，容易让人丧失该有的警惕。但洛茜很喜欢这里，能够满足她的好奇心。
voiceDesc.en: I'm more at home in the frontier than aboard Dijiang. A comfortable place like this makes you soft. But Rossi loves this place. The ship satisfies her curiosity.

voiceDesc.cn: 老实说，我并没有研究裂地者其他氏族的兴趣。只是在荒地行走的日子久了，自然会牢记那些能够保命的常识。对于狼群而言，求生意志就是最好的老师，也是唯一的信仰。
voiceDesc.en: I'll be blunt with you. I was never interested in studying the other Landbreaker clans. I just spent enough time in the wildlands ... and survival skills simply became part of me. In the Pack, we believe the best teacher is our survival instinct. It is our *only* belief.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地的干员来自塔卫二各个地方，其中有一些熟面孔……或者说，一些危险人物。我对你们的选择保持信任，但如有必要，各位应该相信我的直觉。
voiceDesc.en: Endfield operators come from all corners of Talos-II, and I see quite a few familiar faces... Or should I say ... familiar threats. I still have faith in your judgment, but when the situation calls for it, I hope you can have faith in my instincts.

voiceDesc.cn: 我在检查铳械，这是我的习惯。拿着弹尽的铳械，和赤裸裸地被丢在荒野中心没有区别。你手无寸铁，沦为猎物，一切技能和技巧都不再作数。那种感觉令人窒息……我在很小的时候体会过，所以，我会杜绝再次感受的可能。
voiceDesc.en: Gun checks are my ritual. In the wild, if your fangs fail, you're meat. Same goes for a dead weapon — all your skills, all your training, useless. No power, no defense — just slow death. I went through it as a young pup. That lesson stuck. I won't be prey again.

voiceDesc.cn: 我确实已经有一段时间没回到过氏族的据点，更有很长一段时间没有带领过氏族的行动。我更擅长为他们开辟一片新的猎场，而不是成为每一次狩猎的头狼。
voiceDesc.en: It's been a long while since I last visited my clan, or led them on a hunt. I'm better at finding new hunting grounds than leading raids as the Alpharion.

voiceDesc.cn: 有空吗？上次任务我发现了一些有趣的东西……特意带给管理员的。
voiceDesc.en: Got a moment, Endmin? I found something interesting on my last mission ... and I brought it for you.

voiceDesc.cn: 给我的？谢谢，我会物尽其用的。
voiceDesc.en: For me? Grazie. I'll put it to good use.

voiceDesc.cn: 我已经在按终末地的需要改变对待猎物的方式了。如果是以往……猎物们从一开始就会“闭上嘴巴”。
voiceDesc.en: I'm already treating my targets according to Endfield requirements. If I did things the old way ... they'd be *very, very* quiet as soon as I laid hands on them.

voiceDesc.cn: 我想你应该已经意识到了……成为狼群的领袖从来不是我的目标，洛茜比我更适合那个位置。至于终末地是否能成为“卡特洛·狼卫·卢皮诺”最后的归处？我不知道，“裂地者”与你们想要实现的“理想”相差太远。但是，管理员，至少在为终末地带回成果的时候，我比我想的还要乐在其中。
voiceDesc.en: I believe you realized that ... becoming the Pack Alpharion has never been my goal. Rossi might be a better fit for that role. I'm also uncertain if Endfield is a proper resting place for Catello Wulfgard Luppino. The Landbreaker vision can't be more different from yours. However, working with Endfield is at least far more enjoyable than I expected, Endmin.

voiceDesc.cn: 我时常会看着天空？是，我确实喜欢观察天空。你好像很意外？天空是公开的情报板。你可以预测天气，确定时间与方位，甚至能提前预判敌人的行动。天空之下，猎手们身处于一个公平的猎场。你也可以适当吸取一些经验，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Why do I keep looking at the sky? Well, it's something I enjoy. Why do you look surprised? The sky is a free source of intel. It tells you about the weather, the time, and your orientation. You can even use it to predict enemy actions. Every hunter plays by the same rules under the sky. You can learn something about this as well, Endmin.

voiceDesc.cn: “裂地者”的身份是我的祖先们一次失败的选择，跟随裂地者军阀叛离文明环带并没得到我们想要的秩序。我无法亲自去问问长辈们是否后悔，但我从出生就在荒野上流血、厮杀……比旁人更清楚活下来的艰辛。佩丽卡监督说，我们能通过与终末地的合作摆脱这个身份……但我已接纳了它的逻辑，我确实是裂地者。你会失望吗，管理员？
voiceDesc.en: My Landbreaker identity is the result of a bad choice made by my ancestors. We betrayed the Civilization Band to join the Breaker Lords, yet we failed to bring about the order or justice we dreamed of. I can't ask my forebears if they regretted their choice, but being born into a life filled with conflict and bloodshed in the wildlands, I know survival better than most. Supervisor Perlica said we could shed the Landbreaker label by working with Endfield ... but for me, it's who I am. *Sigh* Does that disappoint you, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群氏族建立在一个简单的逻辑上：弱小的人们需要共同猎杀强敌，才能在残酷的环境中苟活。无论是氏族的秩序，还是“裂地者”的身份，都来源于此。可是，终末地呢？伟大的信念有时是一柄双刃剑。狩猎可以重新开始，你却不被允许失败。这很残酷，管理员。至少我能加入你的狩猎，分担你的一些压力。
voiceDesc.en: The Pack is built upon simple logic: The weak must band together to defeat the strong and survive a world without mercy. Every code of the clan and the very Landbreaker identity itself is based upon this. But what does Endfield have? A great vision is a double-edged sword. While the Pack can always start another hunt, Endfield could ill-afford a single defeat. This world is without mercy, Endministrator. But at least I'm part of your hunt, and I shall share part of your burden.

voiceDesc.cn: 我知道力量并不代表一切，但在塔卫二，没有力量通常不是什么好事。
voiceDesc.en: I know that strength isn't everything, but in Talos-II, you can't live without it.

voiceDesc.cn: 洛茜很爱收集这样精巧的东西，虽然我不明白这些小玩意儿有什么用，但她喜欢……只好多给她找找了。
voiceDesc.en: Rossi loves collecting intricate things like these. I don't know what they're good for, but if it's for her ... I'll just go around and look for more.

voiceDesc.cn: 不切实际的理想主义总是害人也害己。这个道理，我想大部分在开拓区待过的人都明白。区别在于，多数人自始至终只配当受害者。
voiceDesc.en: Unrealistic idealism breaks more lives than it saves. Most frontiersfolk learn that the hard way. The real tragedy is, some people are destined to be casualties.

voiceDesc.cn: 我确实更习惯一个人解决问题——不是认为自己有能力承担一切，只是觉得有些事我做了，本该去做这些事的人……就能轻松一点。
voiceDesc.en: I do prefer taking care of problems on my own. Not that I think I can handle it all — just hoping to take the weight off someone else's back.

voiceDesc.cn: 离群的狼依然不会轻易背弃狼群……这点毋庸置疑。但为了生存，或是难以放下的东西，总会有离群者踏上不归路。我做不到去同情他们，也不打算干涉他们，但至少会尊重他们。
voiceDesc.en: One can hardly force a lone wolf to turn its back on its former pack... This goes without question. But a few took the path of no return for the sake of survival ... or for something they hold dear. I can't sympathize with them, and I don't intend to interfere. I simply recognize the resolve behind their choices.

voiceDesc.cn: 直到今天，我仍在寻找那个属于狼群的未来……与终末地的合作未必是最好的选择，但在我看来，这依然是尤为重要且特殊的一步。全凭外力改变狼群固有的认知纯属妄想，但有时，变化也只是缺了一个契机——如何将“它”带回去，正是我在反复考虑的事。
voiceDesc.en: Even till this day, I'm still looking for the future of the Pack... Working with Endfield might not be the best option, but I believe it is an important and special step we must take. I understand no outsider can change the Pack's mentality, but what we need is an opportunity to start the change. How to present this "opportunity" to the Pack is something I've been trying to figure out.

voiceDesc.cn: 我陪伴洛茜的时间很少，但有时候看着现在的她……我每一次都会惊讶于她的成长。她与荒野共同呼吸，她调遣着狼的血脉。使用武器，觉醒技艺，学会狩猎，一切都水到渠成。我知道，她已经不是那个在浸血的襁褓中奄奄一息的婴孩，她是卢皮诺家族的“狼珀”。我只会是狼群的爪牙，而她终会是狼群之心。
voiceDesc.en: I should spend more time with Rossi, but when I look at her right now ... I can't help but feel surprised by how much she's grown. She shares the breath of the wild and easily taps into the Blood of the Pack. Weapon mastery, Arts activation, and hunting... Everything came naturally to her. She is no longer the helpless babe wrapped in blood-soaked blankets. No. She is the Wulfperl of Famiglia Luppino. I am just the fangs of the Pack, but Rossi will always be its heart and soul.

voiceDesc.cn: 裂地者氏族的构成比世人想象得更加复杂。除了碾骨与狼群，也有沙盗这样组织松散、只靠一艘私掠舰立足的异类。除此之外……灰疤氏族会在身上纹满“誓歌”，没人会想在太阳落山后和影颅氏族的刺客交手。这些能在荒地上幸存的小氏族，总是比一般人掌握更多活着的诀窍。
voiceDesc.en: Landbreaker clans are more complicated than most people think. Besides the Bonekrushers and the Pack, there's the Sandreavers — a strange, loosely organized clan that made their name with just a single bergantin. Then there are the Grayscars, who tattoo their entire bodies with Binding Verses... And the Shadowskulls, a merciless group of assassins no one dares cross after sunset. These minor clans survived the wildlands, so it's natural they know a few tricks about staying alive.

voiceDesc.cn: 那里有些能带走的东西。
voiceDesc.en: There's something we can gather over there.

voiceDesc.cn: 特别的战利品，我们应该拿下它们。
voiceDesc.en: Special loot in sight. We should grab it.

voiceDesc.cn: 那附近我们还没去过，最好留意下。
voiceDesc.en: We haven't been over there yet. Better make a note.

voiceDesc.cn: 棘手的味道，我们的对手并不简单。
voiceDesc.en: Smells like trouble. This is no ordinary enemy.

voiceDesc.cn: 希望它们有足够的价值，配得上我们费的功夫。
voiceDesc.en: I hope their worth can pay for our efforts.

voiceDesc.cn: 我一个人也……不，麻烦各位了。
voiceDesc.en: Maybe just let me handle... Actually, let's finish this as a team.

voiceDesc.cn: 非凡的战利品，这足以宣告狩猎的丰收。
voiceDesc.en: Outstanding loot. This hunt has proved itself fruitful.

voiceDesc.cn: 醚质，如果终末地认为它有价值的话……
voiceDesc.en: Aurylene... I guess Endfield finds it valuable.

voiceDesc.cn: 侵蚀会干扰行动计划，正确的判断。
voiceDesc.en: You made the right call. The Blight only impedes our operation.

voiceDesc.cn: 弹药清点完毕，下一轮狩猎该开始了。
voiceDesc.en: Ammo check complete. Time for the next hunt.

voiceDesc.cn: 小心点，别乱来。
voiceDesc.en: Careful now. Don't push it.

voiceDesc.cn: ……缓过来了。
voiceDesc.en: ...Caught my breath again.

voiceDesc.cn: 注意闪开！
voiceDesc.en: Evade!

voiceDesc.cn: 不必管我。
voiceDesc.en: Focus on the battle, not me.

voiceDesc.cn: 唔……暂时撤退。
voiceDesc.en: Hngh... Medevac.

voiceDesc.cn: 有两下子。
voiceDesc.en: Nice moves.

voiceDesc.cn: 精彩的配合。
voiceDesc.en: Great teamwork.

voiceDesc.cn: 还可以更好。
voiceDesc.en: This isn't my best.

voiceDesc.cn: 只是做了我该做的。
voiceDesc.en: Just doing what I must.

voiceDesc.cn: 我会找准时机。
voiceDesc.en: Got my eyes peeled for an opening.

voiceDesc.cn: 别在意我，按你的步调来。
voiceDesc.en: Don't mind me. I'll keep up with your tempo.

voiceDesc.cn: 这是理所当然的结果。
voiceDesc.en: Wasn't expecting anything less.

voiceDesc.cn: 符合我先前的判断。
voiceDesc.en: Just as I predicted.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，能赢就好。
voiceDesc.en: We won. That's what matters.

voiceDesc.cn: 比预想的麻烦不少……但，胜者是我们，这就够了。
voiceDesc.en: It was harder than I thought... But we are the victors. That's what counts.

voiceDesc.cn: 猎手与猎物本就是一念之差……重整旗鼓吧。
voiceDesc.en: The hunter can sometimes become the hunted... I say it's time to begin the chase anew.

voiceDesc.cn: 安静点！
voiceDesc.en: Shut up!

voiceDesc.cn: 想逃？
voiceDesc.en: No escape!

voiceDesc.cn: 速战速决！
voiceDesc.en: Make it quick!

voiceDesc.cn: 狼之血！
voiceDesc.en: Blood of the Pack!

voiceDesc.cn: 别挡路！
voiceDesc.en: Outta my way!

voiceDesc.cn: 弹药补充完毕。
voiceDesc.en: Locked n' loaded.

voiceDesc.cn: 到我了。
voiceDesc.en: My turn.

voiceDesc.cn: 我来处理。
voiceDesc.en: On it.

voiceDesc.cn: 别挣扎了。
voiceDesc.en: Stand down!

voiceDesc.cn: 闭嘴。
voiceDesc.en: Zip it.

voiceDesc.cn: 解决你们！
voiceDesc.en: You are going down!

voiceDesc.cn: 猎物，一个不留！
voiceDesc.en: None shall live!

voiceDesc.cn: 撕咬吧！
voiceDesc.en: Go for the throat!

voiceDesc.cn: 群狼，围猎！
voiceDesc.en: Wolves, let's feast!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>弧光，众生长地游人。在奥里莎师者的引荐下加入终末地工业，任终末地外勤干员，同时为终末地工业的多项行动以及器械车辆保养与维护提供协助。

对弧光而言，摩托车不仅仅是交通工具，更是一个需要陪伴“生长”的伙伴。一次次拆解与重塑，不是修补破损，而是蜕变与新生。或许，正是这份将机械与生命一同呵护的信念，才造就了她无与伦比的机械美学和机械工程的理解力。
可能是因为她来自众生长地，只要有人需要，她就会毫不吝啬地将她知道的一切分享给需要的人。虽然她的话语往往会夹带着大量隐喻，但这正是弧光干员对这片荒野独特而深刻的洞见。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Arclight is a Songseeker from the Hannabit Circuit, and she has joined Endfield Industries as a field operator with recommendations from Aldertone Orisha. Arclight also provides support for various Endfield operations as well as maintenance and repairs for Endfield machinery and vehicles. 

To Arclight, the motorcycle is more than just a transport vehicle. She regards them as a companion that "grows" with her. Every dismantling and modification achieved more than just simple repairs — they brought transformation and new life. Perhaps the need to protect both machinery and life gave Arclight her excellent understanding of mechanical engineering and aesthetics. 
Also, since Arclight hails from the Hannabit Circuit, she is more than eager to share everything she knows with those in need. Although the phrases and words she uses are full of metaphors, they also reflect her unique and in-depth knowledge of the wildlands. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员弧光，本名伊库特。每当被人问起她是否隶属于众生长地时，弧光总是回答：“我追随师者奥里莎，且一位游人只属于她自己。”
弧光干员对摩托车似乎有着说不尽的热爱，曾经与弧光干员在关于她的摩托车这方面多次交谈的武库工程师谢苗干员这么说：
“起初，我以为这是一辆偶然流入民间的军用特制摩托车。得知这台摩托竟然是弧光亲手组装、亲自调校的作品时，我一度难以置信。在得到她的许可后，我仔细研究了这辆车。它的源石发动机是梅什科工业十年前淘汰的旧型号。传动系统则来自特里格拉夫军工厂。减震器的标识已经磨损，但从结构推测，很可能出自北进重工支援所。而最令人惊叹的，是那副车架——显然是手工锻造，每一处焊点都细腻结实，整个车架仿佛天然一体。更难得的是，这副车架并非单纯拼接，而是以极高的技巧整合了各家设备的优点，使整车在力量、耐久与操控之间达到了近乎完美的平衡。”
虽然弧光干员扎实的技术得到了所有人认可，但有不少干员不止一次地指出：弧光干员待人冷淡，她说的话总是难以理解。包括谢苗干员，也曾反映过她少言寡语。或许是由于她特殊的经历，弧光干员能给予他人的热情十分有限，第一次接触可能会留下不好相处的印象。但接触多了就会发现，她实际是个异常讲道理的人。如果和弧光干员经常交流的话，有时甚至能听到她的嘴里冒出一些仿佛在说笑的惊人发言。无需怀疑，她并不是在说笑，她就是这么想的。
至于说弧光难以交流，那只是她的语言承载了众生长地特有的表达方式。她喜欢用自然的隐喻来表达判断，比如用驮兽的脾气比喻机器故障，用晨雾形容人的犹疑。对习惯直白语言的人来说，这种交流方式可能显得生疏，但只要认真倾听，就能发现她思路清晰、行动坚定。众生长地的游人有对世界的独特理解和自己的行事原则，要想听懂她的话，需要理解她讲述世界的方式。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Ekut is the actual name of Operator Arclight. Whenever people ask if she came from the Hannabit Circuit, Arclight always answered with this line: "I follow Aldertone Orisha, and every Songseeker is her own master." 
Operator Arclight has an indescribable passion about motorcycles. Arsenal Engineer Semyon often conversed with Arclight regarding her motorcycle, and these are what he had to say: 
"Initially, I thought it was a custom military vehicle that found its way into the civilian market. I could hardly believe what I saw when it turned out to be a work of engineering that Arclight assembled and tuned on her own. I studied the motorcycle closely after acquiring her permission. Its Originium engine was a ten-year-old piece of obsolete tech from Mieszko Industries. The drivetrain was produced by Triglava Armoury. Labels on the suspensions were worn out, but I guessed, based on the structures, that they were from Northmarch Support Hub. The most impressive component would be the chassis — the entire thing was handcrafted, and every weld made to the greatest detail. The entire framework felt almost seamless. Even more extraordinary was the fact that the motorcycle wasn't just an assembly, but an integration that exemplified the strengths of every component's manufacturer. This could only have been achieved with the highest level of technical expertise. The entire vehicle was a near-perfect balance of power, endurance, and handling." 
Although everyone approves of Operator Arclight's superb technical abilities, many also pointed out this observation: She treated people rather coldly, and spoke in a manner that was rather difficult to understand. Even Operator Semyon reflected that Arclight rarely spoke. Perhaps Operator Arclight's unique experiences made her appear lukewarm, and her first impressions often gave off the vibe of an unfriendly individual. However, people who got to know her better would learn that she was an incredibly reasonable person. Those who often converse with Arclight even heard her saying shocking things that resembled jokes. Needless to say, Operator Arclight was simply speaking her mind and wasn't trying to be funny in these instances. 
Comments about Arclight being difficult to converse with typically arise as her language was heavily influenced by the Hannabit Circuit's unique form of expressions. Arclight has a tendency to use metaphors inspired by the natural world, such as using burdenbeast temper to describe mechanical breakdowns, or the morning mist to illustrate an individual's hesitation. People who are more forthright in their manners of speech may be thrown off by Arclight's unique linguistic choices. However, good listeners would appreciate her clear reasoning and steadfast consistency in her actions. Songseekers of the Hannabit Circuit have their own unique understanding of the world and modus operandi. If one wishes to understand Arclight better, one would do well to appreciate her way of describing this world. </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>我至今仍记得第一次见到伊库特的情景。当时的她奄奄一息，被巡逻的狩卫带回了营地。很难想象是什么让这个小女孩独自在荒野中流浪数月，还差点因缺乏食物和水而丧命。至于她右手的伤势，我们不得不以电路的方式重新连接她的右臂神经。当然，希望你们不用太担心她的右手是否安全，我们为她设计了一副特殊的绝缘手套，让她能够像正常人一样生活。
我以歌谣中强壮且灵性的驮兽“伊库特”为她取名，希望她能像驮兽一样经受住风霜的考验，健康茁壮地成长。她做到了，而且比我预想的还要好。
或许是因为她曾战胜了死亡的威胁，又或许是因为她背负着歌谣赋予她的名字，这孩子被“伊库特”这三个字赋予了太过沉重的使命。十五岁时，她踏上了游人的旅程，在荒野间流转。她总是倾尽全力去扶助每一个陷入困境的聚落，即便有时力不从心。
我至今仍记得那场暴雨。在我们的那次救援行动中，她为了保护他人，孤身被卷入风暴深处。我们本以为她凶多吉少。就在所有希望即将破灭之际，一道闪电划破长空，她如一道弧光，穿透风暴，跃上最后一辆篷车。从此，荒野的人们便以“弧光”之名呼唤她。这个名字也被许多游人吟唱进他们的歌谣。她从歌谣中取走一个名字，又将一个全新的名字还给了歌谣。
当她告诉我，她想去终末地寻找新的答案时，我并不感到惊讶。这让我想起了自己年轻时的那个选择。那时，我也曾远游至遥远星河的上方，感受着在漂泊之城中凝聚的希望与勇气。
回首这一刻，恍若隔世。但我始终相信，只要星辰仍洒满天际，文明终将再次团结。而弧光，连同她在歌谣中种下的名字和誓言，也一定会找到她真正需要的答案。
——奥里莎师者写给终末地工业的推荐信</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>I still remember the first time I met Ekut. The patrolling Huntsingers brought her back to the camp and the girl was barely alive. It was difficult for us to fathom why such a young child was left to roam the wildlands for months on her own, a suffering that almost killed her with malnutrition and thirst. To treat the injuries on her right arm, we were forced to reconnect the nerves with circuitry. Of course, there is no need to be worried about the hazards posed by her right hand. We have designed a special pair of insulation gloves so that she may live normally like us. 
I named her Ekut, based on the strong and intelligent burdenbeast of our hanna. It is my hope that she could grow up strong, and survive the wind and frost like the powerful burdenbeast. She achieved all that, and went beyond my expectations. 
But Ekut grew up with an immense duty that seemed far too heavy for her. Perhaps it was her early victory over death itself, or her powerful name we took from the hanna. When she turned fifteen, Ekut started to seek the songs and roamed the wildlands. The Songseeker did everything she could to help villages and towns in dire straits, even when the challenges were far too great. 
I still remember that rainstorm. During our rescue operation, Ekut ventured alone into the heart of the tempest. We thought she would never come back. Just when all hopes seemed lost, an arc of lightning streaked across the sky. Like that arc, she pierced the fury of nature and leaped onto the last wagon. And with this act, the wildlands began to address her as Arclight. The name was woven into the hanna of numerous Songseekers. She took a name from the verses and returned a new name to their songs. 
I was not surprised when Arclight told me that she wanted to seek new answers from Endfield. In fact, it reminded me of the choice I made when I was younger. I once roamed far to the canopies of starry night, and from there I felt a chorus of hope and courage assembled in the floating city. 
Those memories felt like they belonged to a lifetime ago. But I believe that as long as the stars still shine in the sky, Civilization will one day be united once more. I also believe that Arclight, along with the names and oaths she wove into her hanna, will find the answers she truly seeks. 
— Letter of Recommendation for Endfield Industries, written by Aldertone Orisha</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>一支庞大的裂地者部队将荒野上的一处定居点围住，企图发动一次规模庞大的袭击。在肉眼可见的威胁下，绝望开始在驻扎于此的终末地干员与聚落成员之间蔓延。
就在这时，他们看到了她。一名骑着轰鸣摩托车的游人独自呼啸着冲进了聚落——此人正是来自众生长地的弧光。
她从裂地者后方冲出，毫不犹豫地接管了局面。在她的统筹安排下，聚落成员们用篷车和废料搭建防线，将老人和孩童转移到高处。弧光动员所有尚有劳动能力的人，挖掘壕沟，布置简易的源石防御单元。她的每一个举动都冷静而简洁，穿梭的身影仿佛和荒野融为一体。
在裂地者进攻前夕，远处传来了阵阵雷声，雨季如期而至，一夜暴雨在山谷中催生出一条湍急的新河。或许弧光记得荒野的每一个角落，奔腾的河水冲刷着弧光先前改造过的地势，将整个聚落环绕成一座“孤岛”。洪水径直冲向裂地者营地，粉碎了他们的阵形。
不甘失败的裂地者们试图渡河强攻防线，但屡屡被弧光连同终末地干员和聚落成员击退。最终，这支劫掠的部队在雨夜中逃之夭夭。
笼罩在荒野上的乌云散去后，弧光找到了正在向帝江号汇报的终末地干员，将介绍信在空中挥了挥，说道：“荒野上沙土的震动将我带到了这里。现在，请你们引领我前往终末地。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>A massive Landbreaker army had encircled a wildlands village. The breakers prepared themselves for a full scale assault. Hopelessness spread like a plague amongst the garrisoned Endfield operators and the local residents. 
That was the moment when they saw her. Arclight of the Hannabit Circuit — the lone Songseeker who roared into the town astride her motorcycle. 
She tore through the rear of the breaker army and seized control of the situation without hesitation. Under her leadership, the residents created a defense line with their wagons and salvage. The elderly and children were moved to the hills. Everyone who could work dug the trenches and set up simple Originium defense units. Every action was calm and simple, and she moved throughout the place like a part of the wildlands itself. 
On the eve of the Landbreaker attack, thunder rumbled from afar. The monsoons came as usual, and a nightlong of torrential rain carved a new creek that coursed through the place. Arclight may have memorized every corner of the wildlands. The river coursed through the trenches that Arclight directed and became a protective moat that protected the entire village. The flood waters also washed through the breakers' camp and foiled their attack formations. 
The Landbreakers did not leave empty handed. They attempted to ford the moat and assail the defenses, but every attack was beaten back by Arclight, the Endfielders, and village residents. In the end, the raiders were forced to escape under the cover of a rainy night. 
When the dark rainclouds finally left the wildlands, Arclight found the Endfield operator who was sending a report to Dijiang. She waved a letter of recommendation to the skies and said, "The quaking of the wildlands dirt led me here. Now, please lead me to Endfield."</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>曾几何时，芳草如浪，河水平静如丝。
如今，大地的骨骼已然松动，
天空低垂，风雨交加。
断骨散落荒野，尘土飞扬。
游人的歌声，掩盖不住悲叹与怒吼。
我如跛足的驮畜，逃离翻滚的黑色海洋。
何处是众生长地，众生长地？
我的道路布满荆棘与灰烬。
何处是众生长地，众生长地？
漂泊的城市将希望的锚抛向大地。
而我，追随沉寂的星辰，再次启程。
众生长地，引领我到尽头。
风儿不停，我亦不止。
——弧光的“歌谣”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Once the grasses rippled and ripened, while rivers flowed and glistened. 
Now the bones of the land have loosened, 
the sky hanged low as rain fell in torrents. 
Bones bleached in the wildlands, winds choked with dust. 
No Songseeker hanna could hide anger nor angst. 
Like a lame budenbeast, I escaped dark waves that tossed and rolled. 
Where is the Hannabit Circuit, the land where all may grow? 
My path is filled with dust and thorns. 
Where is the Hannabit Circuit, the land where all may grow? 
The drifting city cast to the lands the anchor of hope. 
And I, in pursuit of silent stars, will start another trip. 
Hannabit Circuit, take me to the brink. 
As winds never cease, I shall never quit. 
— "Hanna" of Arclight</>

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野充满了危险，你准备好了吗？
voiceDesc.en: Are you ready? The wildlands are filled with danger.

voiceDesc.cn: 风不会停下，我也不会。
voiceDesc.en: The wind never stops. Neither will I.

voiceDesc.cn: 终于能出去透透气了，我都快忘了泥土的味道。
voiceDesc.en: Finally, a breath of fresh air. I almost forgot the smell of the earth.

voiceDesc.cn: 你放心，无论多快的速度，我都能跟得上。
voiceDesc.en: You can go as fast as you can. Don't worry. I always keep up.

voiceDesc.cn: 我能感受到它的呼吸，它很适合我。
voiceDesc.en: I can feel it breathing, and how it is a match made for me.

voiceDesc.cn: 精湛的工艺……我见过不少师者，但这样的精度，很少有人能做到。
voiceDesc.en: Such craftwork... This precision is rare, even amongst all the Aldertones' work I've known.

voiceDesc.cn: 和师者教给我的不同，但最终殊途同归。很有启发。
voiceDesc.en: My Aldertone taught me differently, but you aim to reach the same goals. I have been enlightened.

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野生活带来经验，而这些……是将经验锻造成利刃。
voiceDesc.en: Living in the wildlands teaches you things... And such lessons help forge a keen blade.

voiceDesc.cn: 晋升？也就是，被认可？能得到你的认可……我很开心。
voiceDesc.en: Promotion...? It means that I've earned your approval? Then I ... I'm pleased to be approved.

voiceDesc.cn: 荣誉的背后是责任。这一切都在提醒我，要尽力帮助更多人。
voiceDesc.en: With honor comes duty. All of this serves as a reminder to help more people.

voiceDesc.cn: 自然不教人如何生存，它只是留下痕迹。过去我只是在适应，现在……我开始明白一点它的道理。
voiceDesc.en: Nature does not teach us survival. It merely leaves a trail for us. I once did my best to adapt... Now ... I'm beginning to understand how it works.

voiceDesc.cn: 在你身边，我学到了很多。我逐渐明白，为什么“歌谣”将我引向这里，引向你的身边。我会好好运用它们。
voiceDesc.en: I've learned much traveling with you. I'm starting to understand why the hanna verses led me here to your side. I shall use the knowledge well.

voiceDesc.cn: 我叫伊库特，代号是弧光，你好。我不会说什么漂亮话，就祝你像涨水的河流一样奔涌吧。
voiceDesc.en: I am Ekut. Callsign is Arclight. I am not a trained weaver of words, but I wish you well and may you flow like a rising river, Endfielders.

voiceDesc.cn: 前面的路已经清楚了。
voiceDesc.en: The path ahead has been revealed.

voiceDesc.cn: 已调整到最佳状态。
voiceDesc.en: I'm primed for optimal performance.

voiceDesc.cn: 没问题，游人从不懈怠。
voiceDesc.en: On it. We Songseekers never rest.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，今天的风向如何？
voiceDesc.en: Where do the winds hail from today, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，刚从外面回来吗？你身上有荒野的味道。
voiceDesc.en: Coming back from a trip to the surface, Endmin? You smell of the wildlands.

voiceDesc.cn: 修摩托车就像给瘤兽看病一样，都需要仔细倾听，然后给出回应。
voiceDesc.en: Repairing an iron steed is like treating a cystybeast. One must listen closely before administering the treatment.

voiceDesc.cn: 这里的星空，与荒野不同……但同样让人想一直看下去。
voiceDesc.en: The stars here are different from what we see from the wildlands... But both vantages are equally enthralling.

voiceDesc.cn: 我在看那些云团，边缘很锋利，是暴风雨的预兆。近期如果要去那一带，请务必小心。
voiceDesc.en: I am studying those clouds. Their sharp edges herald a storm. Be wary if your next mission takes you down there.

voiceDesc.cn: 你的头发很漂亮，像被晨雾打湿的兽皮。没见过？总之……很好看。
voiceDesc.en: Your hair is lovely, like beast hide wet with the dew of dawn. You've never seen it? Well, it's just beautiful.

voiceDesc.cn: 你见过草原上的迁徙吗？篷车驱赶着兽群，缓缓追逐着雨和云。那就是我想守护的东西。
voiceDesc.en: Ever seen the Prairie Migrations? An army of beasts and wagons chasing the rain and clouds. Such are the things I wish to protect.

voiceDesc.cn: 你常常对着这颗星球出神，我想，我能理解。即使距离再远，我们的心也总会留在最牵挂的地方。
voiceDesc.en: You often lose yourself gazing upon this world. I think I know how you feel. Our hearts always yearn for places we care for, no matter how far away they may be.

voiceDesc.cn: 我给你带了点东西，荒野的馈赠，希望你会喜欢。
voiceDesc.en: I brought you something. A gift of the wilds. I hope you like it.

voiceDesc.cn: 礼物？荒野上的赠礼意义非凡……我会认真对待的。
voiceDesc.en: For me? Gifts are important in the wildlands... I shall treasure this one.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我建议你学习一些基础的野外生存技能。可以从徒手制作捕捉长耳兽的陷阱开始，我教你。
voiceDesc.en: I recommend learning basic wildland survival, Endmin. Handcrafting long-ear traps is a good place to start. This I can teach you.

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野上的生活确实艰苦，但是，也很美。比如漫长雨季刚结束时的天空，比如月落时分破壳而出的羽兽。
voiceDesc.en: Life in the wildlands is difficult, but it is also beautiful. Like the clear skies ending a long monsoon, like a hatching fowlbeast under the moon.

voiceDesc.cn: 废旧设备组装在一起，为什么能有更好的性能？其实没什么神秘。就像让彼此陌生的驮兽学会一起拉车，慢慢来，总能配合上。
voiceDesc.en: There is nothing mysterious about old devices working better when cobbled together. Yoke two unfamiliar burdenbeasts to the same wagon and give them time. They will eventually become a good team.

voiceDesc.cn: 我开始游历，是为了寻找一个答案。荒野的平衡早已被打破，我该做些什么？我在湖泊的浪涛和密林的风声中寻求过答案。而现在，我想听见你的声音。
voiceDesc.en: I started my wandering to look for answers. The wildlands have been unbalanced and I must do something. I listened to the lapping lakes and the whispering woods. And now, I wish to hear your voice.

voiceDesc.cn: 我会把这里的故事唱进“歌谣”里，记录那些我们一起走过的路。值得传唱的事实在太多，得花些时间整理。等到“歌谣”成形，你会是第一个听众。
voiceDesc.en: I shall weave these tales into the hanna of our journey. This will take time, for too many things are worthy of song. Once the hanna is complete, you shall be the first to hear it.

voiceDesc.cn: 那些想活下去的人，总会发出声音；那些四处游历的游人，总能听见它们。这就是众生长地存在的意义。
voiceDesc.en: Those who wish to live will make themselves heard. And the Songseekers who wander shall always hear. Such is the purpose of the Hannabit Circuit.

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野聚落的人很好相处，我们关心的东西很实际：天气、食物、威胁。这些已经足够占满我们的时间。
voiceDesc.en: Being a friend of the wildlander tribes is simple. We focus on what matters: the weather, the food, and the dangers. These alone take up much of our time.

voiceDesc.cn: 记住“歌谣”并不难，每个众生长地的游人都能做到。它贯穿我们的生活，而我们，也只是其中的一部分。
voiceDesc.en: Every Songseeker of the Hannabit Circuit knows the hannas by heart. It isn't hard. The verses cover every aspect of our lives. Likewise, we are woven into the verses as well.

voiceDesc.cn: 师者说，泰拉上的城可以移动，为了躲避天灾而迁徙。这样看来，我们不过是在用另一种方式延续祖先的生活。
voiceDesc.en: My Aldertone told me about Terra and cities that move to avoid Catastrophes. It seems we have inherited our ancestral practice, but just in another form.

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野上有专门交易旧货的地方，想淘到好东西，得有足够的耐心。我的通讯器就改装自一件耶尔什的旧设备。那里产的东西在极端环境下很可靠。
voiceDesc.en: You can trade used goods in certain wildland bazaars, but one must be patient to find a good deal. I modified an old Kjersch device for my communicator. They make things that work reliably in extreme environments.

voiceDesc.cn: 塔卫二比我想象得更广阔。起初，我以为所有的城都千篇一律，钢铁、道路、灯光，不过是换了排列方式。但当我真正走进它们，才发现每座城都有自己的脉搏和气息，它们的区别之大，甚至不亚于两片截然不同的草场。
voiceDesc.en: Talos-II is bigger than I thought. I once believed that every city is just another arrangement of steel, roads, and lights. But when I actually visited them, I realized every city had its own pulse and vibe. The distinction is more striking than two pastures of different grasses.

voiceDesc.cn: 我去过很多地方。就连最偏远的聚落，也流传着关于你的故事。虽然那些故事早被传得走了样，但有一点出奇地一致——你的名字，总和希望连在一起。
voiceDesc.en: I have traveled much, and tales about you are sung by even the most distant of tribes. Though these stories may differ wildly, one amazing thing remains the same — hope is always bound to your name.

voiceDesc.cn: “歌谣”最初只有三句，由一位难民在临死前唱出。众生长地，就从那三句歌词里生长。从第一位师者开始，游人们便循着“歌谣”游历，直到自己也成为“歌谣”的一部分。
voiceDesc.en: A dying nomad sang our very first hanna and it had but three lines. These verses gave birth to the name of the Hannabit Circuit. And starting with the first Aldertone, the hanna has led the wandering Songseekers till they, too, become part of the song.

voiceDesc.cn: 师者很少直接讲述道理。奥里莎师者会说，知识都在“歌谣”里。她习惯用行动教导我：只有尽力互助，我们才能在这颗星球上生存。
voiceDesc.en: The Aldertones rarely speak directly. Orisha said that the hanna contained all the knowledge we need. She taught me through her actions. We must help each other in order to survive in this world.

voiceDesc.cn: 我成长的那个聚落并不大，不足百人。启程游历前，它就是我生活的全部。在那里，我学会给瘤兽挤奶、骑摩托车和荒野生存所需的一切。我没有离开那里，我只是带着它一起上路了。
voiceDesc.en: I grew up in a small tribe with no more than a hundred souls. It was all I knew before I started my journey. It taught me to milk the cystybeasts, ride my iron steed, and survive the wildlands. I never left it. I simply brought it with me.

voiceDesc.cn: 利于生存，尽可能带上。
voiceDesc.en: If it helps with survival, bring it.

voiceDesc.cn: 师者会对这些东西感兴趣的。
voiceDesc.en: My Aldertone will be interested in these.

voiceDesc.cn: 跟上，去看看。
voiceDesc.en: Keep up. We need a closer look.

voiceDesc.cn: 危险的气息，是个棘手的敌人。
voiceDesc.en: I sense danger. This one won't go down easily.

voiceDesc.cn: 大地的馈赠。
voiceDesc.en: The bounties of the land.

voiceDesc.cn: 换我来吧，体力活，我的强项。
voiceDesc.en: Let me do it. I'm good with physical work.

voiceDesc.cn: 这在荒野上不常见，值得好好利用。
voiceDesc.en: A rarity in the wildlands. We'll make good use of it.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们会把这些光球捉进瓶子里照明。
voiceDesc.en: We usually bottle them to give light.

voiceDesc.cn: 大自然应当回到正轨。
voiceDesc.en: We should let Nature take its course.

voiceDesc.cn: 这里让我想起了荒野里的篝火，而且似乎有同样的温度。
voiceDesc.en: This reminds me of campfires in the wildlands. Both seem to share the same warmth.

voiceDesc.cn: 稳住呼吸节奏。
voiceDesc.en: Steady your breathing.

voiceDesc.cn: 体力在恢复。
voiceDesc.en: Returning is my strength.

voiceDesc.cn: 别停，动起来。
voiceDesc.en: Don't stop. Keep moving.

voiceDesc.cn: 速度会慢些，但还能继续。
voiceDesc.en: Still in the fight, just a bit slower.

voiceDesc.cn: 抱歉，没能帮到你。
voiceDesc.en: Sorry ... I wish I could help you more...

voiceDesc.cn: 好快的反应！
voiceDesc.en: You responded like lightning!

voiceDesc.cn: 像风和雷一样默契。
voiceDesc.en: Like wind and thunder we gave them a storm.

voiceDesc.cn: 这在我职责之内。
voiceDesc.en: It's what I'm expected to do.

voiceDesc.cn: 我只是配合大家。
voiceDesc.en: Just being part of the team.

voiceDesc.cn: 我已经进入状态了。
voiceDesc.en: I'm in the flow.

voiceDesc.cn: 那个方向就交给你了。
voiceDesc.en: I'll leave that side to you.

voiceDesc.cn: 归于平静吧。
voiceDesc.en: To serenity they shall return.

voiceDesc.cn: 愿大地接纳你们。
voiceDesc.en: I pray that the land accepts you all.

voiceDesc.cn: 这是自然所愿。
voiceDesc.en: Such is the will of Nature.

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野中的每一件事物，都在磨砺中成长。
voiceDesc.en: Every wildland being must endure hardship to grow.

voiceDesc.cn: 经验再丰富的牙兽群，捕猎也不会每次都成功。但至少，我们学到了教训。
voiceDesc.en: Even the most experienced tuskbeast pack can fail to bring down their prey. At least we learned something from this hunt.

voiceDesc.cn: 停下！
voiceDesc.en: Break!

voiceDesc.cn: 破开！
voiceDesc.en: Shatter!

voiceDesc.cn: 疾风！
voiceDesc.en: Raging winds!

voiceDesc.cn: 奔雷！
voiceDesc.en: Rolling thunder!

voiceDesc.cn: 瞬闪！
voiceDesc.en: Arcing flash!

voiceDesc.cn: 风速刚好！
voiceDesc.en: Perfect is this wind!

voiceDesc.cn: 剩下的交给我。
voiceDesc.en: I shall sweep the rest.

voiceDesc.cn: 这是最佳路径。
voiceDesc.en: Such is the optimal path.

voiceDesc.cn: 看准时机！
voiceDesc.en: I spot an opening!

voiceDesc.cn: 结束了。
voiceDesc.en: It's over.

voiceDesc.cn: 机会来了。
voiceDesc.en: Here's my chance.

voiceDesc.cn: 避无可避。
voiceDesc.en: You can't escape this.

voiceDesc.cn: 从风暴中来。
voiceDesc.en: From the storms it came.

voiceDesc.cn: 瞬息而至。
voiceDesc.en: Like a flash it struck.

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员余烬，铁誓军陷阵旗队成员。余烬曾活跃于北方抗击天使的前线，后为处理队友丧葬事宜与新兵征募工作返回文明环带。经铁誓军堡主杰拉德·“受祝颂的杰拉德”·萨索介绍，余烬开始与终末地工业接触，接受任务调遣。

余烬擅长合作，不避讳分享想法，甚至十分照顾交谈者的感受。作为一位铁誓军的战士，她了解言辞传达的重要性。本次面谈流程耗时低于干员平均水平约37%，申请将其纳入本部门《有效沟通范例精选》。
另，应佩丽卡监督要求重申以下提醒：尽管余烬本人表示她并不介意，但是不必要地追问过往仍然属于一种冒犯行为；那片战场上什么事都会发生，对直面绝境并存活下来的人，我们应该给予尊重。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Ember served in an assault banner of the Order of Steel Oath. She saw active service on the northern front against the Aggeloi before returning to the Civilization Band to manage the posthumous affairs of her late comrades and recruit new soldiers. Following a recommendation from Order Castellan Gerald "The Sanctified" Zasso, Ember began collaborating with Endfield Industries and carrying out various operations on their behalf. 

Ember is a team player and never hesitates in sharing her thoughts. She is also an extremely sensitive listener. As an Oathkeeper soldier, she appreciates the importance of discourse. The duration of this particular interview is about 37% shorter than the average. We recommend adopting the relevant recordings in the Select Examples of Effective Communication of this division. 
Also, pursuant to Supervisor Perlica's requests, the following reminder shall be re-emphasized: Although Ember herself expressed no particular concerns, unnecessary questioning of her past remains an offense to her personal dignity. Anything could have happened in a battlefield, and anyone who endured and survived such extreme adversities shall deserve the utmost respect. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>许多铁誓军战士习惯用“钉子”来称呼执行锚点根除任务的陷阵旗队，不是尖刀，不是子弹，不是矛头。钉子需要锐利的头部、坚韧的躯干和扎实的尾端，一切都与陷阵旗队的特质完美契合：他们刺破防线，击溃要害，在包围中坚守位置，直到最后的总攻降临，一锤定音。
作为陷阵旗队中的精英与典范，余烬几乎就是为执行这种任务而生。她有丰富的火线空降经验，熟悉团队作战，擅长在近距离战斗中压制对手，援护同伴。她掌握的源石技艺不仅能制造火焰灼伤敌人，也能进行基础应急治疗。虽然身为萨科塔而不偏好铳械这点有些出人意料，但她依然是所有指挥官梦寐以求的顶尖战士：技术杰出、意志坚韧、经验丰富，永远清楚自己在做什么。

“北方的战斗就像一道数学题。5分的敌人要派6分的战士去解决，因为能拿8分的人还要留给7分的对手。我们经常要用100分的队伍和200分的天使周旋，少赚的每一分都会在某个时刻加倍报复回来。
“陷阵旗队就是乘号后面的那个数字。如果没有他们，我们无从展望胜利；如果失去他们，先前的一切努力都会变成零——现在，你应该理解我们只会挑什么样的人加入‘钉子’了。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>The assault banner often carry out Ankhor-busting missions, and is often nicknamed the "Nail" by fellow Oathkeepers. Unlike blades, bullets, or spear heads, nails require a sharp point, a strong, stiff shaft, and a sturdy head. Everything matched the properties of the assault banner. They would pierce through the defenses, hit the mark, survive the encirclement, and wait for the main hammering strike to silence the Ankhor permanently. 
As an elite and exemplary member of an assault banner, it would seem that Ember was born for this role. She has extensive experiences in performing hot combat drops and team battles. She is also skilled at suppressing enemies and supporting allies in mid- to close-range combat operations. Ember also wields Originium Arts that can burn enemies or offer basic first-aid to her allies. It is also rather surprising that Ember does not prefer fighting with guns like most Sankta. Nevertheless, she is a dream soldier for any commander: skilled, professional, steadfast, experienced, and always aware of her mission and actions. 

"The war in the north is an arithmetic problem. A 5-point enemy force can only be engaged with a 6-point formation, because our 8-point forces must be held in reserve to take down 7-point enemies. It is not uncommon to fight 200-point Aggeloi forces with a 100-point company. Every score we miss must be avenged with interest." 
"The assault banner is our force multiplier. Without them, we have no hope of victory. If we lose them, everything we've fought and bled for so far will be lost as well. I believe you now have a better understanding of the caliber of people who get to become the Oathkeepers' nails." </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>铁誓军里有二十种关于雨的修辞。当我再次见到她时，她就像被二十种雨轮流浇灭了一次。
“阿兹瑞拉，”我说，“我们都会犯错。”
这句话显然很苍白。我没有在任何一支陷阵旗队服役过，如今也不在战场第一线。我和其他人一样，至今仍然不知道她是如何从那个活地狱中生还的。但我不打算相信身边已经开始发酵的流言——质疑同伴会带来可怕的后果，哪怕从理性角度出发，那些疑问完全合情合理，裂痕也不该从内部出现。
她沉默不语，只是用僵硬的眼神扫过四周。当然，没有更多送行者。我第一次读不懂她的表情，那不像是悲伤，同样不会是释怀。我甚至觉得她似乎松了一口气。
“堡主已经给过结论了。”我说。
我本想拍拍她的肩膀，但很快就意识到或许不该这么做。那副肩甲在她身上第一次显得有些松垮，束带末端敲打着匕首。
不管再怎么努力，二十八个人的骨灰也不可能放得进行李箱。阿兹瑞拉显然退而求其次，坚持要随身携带所有名牌，这让她的每个动作都会不合时宜地叮当作响，只是没有人笑得出来。
“尼拉的武器已经放回遗产库。她的家族过几天应该就会来取其他东西，你要再去看看吗？”
“不，”她终于开口，“我这就出发。”
尼拉的家族十分重视传统，他们拒绝了由铁誓军送还骨灰和遗物的请求。
或许不该再问下去了。我的脖子有些刺痒，也许窗户背后已经有几道视线开始切割这里，划出界线。
“完成任务吧。”我为她打开堡垒的大门。车辆已经装好货物等候多时，司机细细擦拭保险杠上的泥泞，北方总是在下雨。“以个人名义，我会看好你的守护铳。”
“谢谢，大司库。”阿兹瑞拉停了一会儿。
“远征总会结束的。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>The Oathkeepers have twenty words for rain. When I saw her again, it felt as though she had been smothered and battered by each and every type of the downpours. 
"Azrila," I said, "We all make mistakes." 
Those were feeble words. I had never served in any assault banner, and I was not at the frontlines. Like the others, I still had zero knowledge how she survived the living hell. I had no intention of paying any heed to the festering rumors — doubting your fellow Oathkeeper was a path to calamity. Even if the concerns were grounded in reasonable doubt, any fracture should never emerge from within. 
She remained silent and swept the surroundings with her stiff gaze. No one else came to see her off. This was the first time when I failed to read her expressions. It was not sadness, but neither was it release. I thought I could hear her breathe a sigh of relief. 
"The Castellan has given his verdict." I said. 
I wanted to give her a pat on the shoulder but quickly realized it wasn't the right thing to do. For the first time, her pauldrons seemed too big for her, and the straps rattled against her dagger. 
There was no way we could fit the cremation urns of twenty-eight Oathkeepers into her baggage, no matter how hard we tried. Azrila settled on something else, insisting on carrying their service tags with her at all times. They clattered and rang with every movement, but no one laughed. 
"Nilla's weapon has been placed in the Vault of Relics. Her family will be here in a few days to retrieve her other things. Don't you want to go and see them again?" 
"No," she finally spoke, "I intend to set off at once." 
Nilla's family placed great importance on traditions, and turned down the Order's request of returning the cremation urns and her personal effects. 
Perhaps I should not question any further. My neck slightly itched. Perhaps several pairs of eyes were gazing at this place from behind the safety of the windows and blinds that demarcated the boundaries. 
"Go forth and see to our mission." I opened the gates of the keep. The vehicle was already loaded and had been waiting for a while. The driver was meticulously cleaning the mud from the bumpers as it always rained in the north. "I shall look after your patron firearm. I swear it by my name."  
"Gratitude, Grand Treasurer." Azrila then paused for a while. 
"The Crusade will eventually end." </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>高级参谋格鲁曼大师，本人情报官罗兰·阿尔洛斯，奉堡主萨索之命，向您报告本次战役相关细节。
战役历时七日，我方投入第四、第六大旗队共二十二旗，作战人员六千一百四十三人。经统计，共摧毁天使约四万二千个体，锚点三十二枚。战役中出现多种未登记的天使形成模式，平均战力接近或超过“欧墨萨隆”，大部分已送交大文献馆甄别归类。（批注：已收到，如果样本能再完整一些更好，不过我知道说了也没什么用。）
现梳理战役大致经过如下——
拦截阶段：
152年2月10日23时，极光带西二区发现锚点反应。第四大旗队按条例集结，完成紧急起飞。
11日0时5分，拦截行动开始。
11日0时8分，锚点提前下降，进入机动轨道。拦截机群错过预定交汇点，未能对大部分锚点造成足够损伤。
（批注：最大且最严重的失误。为什么预警位置如此靠外？如果这批锚点的目标在更后方，我们已经错过了初段拦截窗口，监测站部署位置是否已经调整？）
接触阶段：
11日5时，先头部队于M-320a战区高地构筑阵线，按侦测情报清剿天使集群，向已知锚点推进。
11日11时，新批次锚点直接于近地高度入场。芬萨大师响应态势抢占M-322a、M-322b战区，增派“灰楔”“洪峰”“炽焰”“黑翼”四支陷阵旗队突入锚点着陆位置。
（批注：我必须重申，野战预警编制不充足的弊端近年已经逐渐显现。陷阵旗队本不应该在如此低强度的战斗中被投入，铁誓军正在面对恶化的局面，我们亟需引入新的侦测手段，或培养更多专长侦察的术师加入旗队编组。）
主要阶段：
11日16时，锚点摧毁时间晚于预期，战况升级。
12日1时，天使生成速度爆发性上升。受炮击影响，防空覆盖范围收缩，预备队伍输送遇阻。同时，未知个体（前线临时代号“高塔”）出现。接触期间，“灰楔”陷阵旗队提前接近“高塔”，导致进攻锋线连锁破溃。“洪峰”“炽焰”陷阵旗队失联，锚点先制打击战术失败，战场态势转为炮击对抗与防线巩固。
13日18时，“黑翼”陷阵旗队失联，战斗陷入完全僵持。
15日21时，大量巨型天使攻入M-322a战区，“灰楔”陷阵旗队失联。
（批注：未知个体已获正式代号“提希罗松”。）
结束阶段：
16日8时，第六大旗队增援母舰抵达，完成制空增援，我方轰炸能力恢复。格利穆尼尔大师分派十五支步兵与炮兵旗队抵达M-320a战区。
18日23时，全部锚点被破坏，约八成天使被彻底摧毁，残部转移至极光圈内，无法追击。
本次战役，我方两支大旗队共计阵亡六百二十三人，重伤八百五十四人，航天母舰需返港大修。“石爪”“血债”“荆棘利刃”步兵旗队伤亡损失严重，已执行合并重组。“洪峰”“炽焰”“黑翼”陷阵旗队移除编制。另，“灰楔”陷阵旗队残余一人，无法继续参与作战。缺编旗队已根据堡主签署指令，返回后方执行“远征”。
（批注：总部向来尊重现场的判断，没必要特意提点最后这段内容。如果你坚持想为陷阵旗队的那位战士寻找辩护支持，我会给“提希罗松”再出一份更详细的分析报告。老实说，我也不相信我们的精锐会轻易出现如此严重又低级的失误。现在掌握的情报的确太少，我甚至有些怀疑那是否真的是一种天使……总之，在公正原则允许的范围内，我会尽可能做一些工作。）
目前所知情况如上，堡主等待您的回复。

（批注：意见如上，我将直接原件寄回给你。另外，大文献馆对天使生成速度突然提升的原因十分关注。这场战斗你们似乎打得相当不顺手，也许我们近期会有面谈的机会。）</>
