recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员昼雪，隶属于罗德岛。在罗德岛与终末地工业合力进行的多次救援行动中，以救援专家的身份解决难题，现以此身份派驻终末地工业开展合作。

无论是干员昼雪的生存能力还是她在危机时刻的应变能力，都不止一次地向我们表明了她在北方的救援经历是何等的可贵。
她曾向我绘声绘色地介绍了她是如何在极端环境下救出那些铁誓军与极地商旅的，包括如何规划并实施有效的救援行动，以及在危险的自然环境中如何选择应对策略。她的工程学背景为她提供了强大的技术支持，使她能够在救援行动中发挥相当关键的作用。干员昼雪对待工作充满热情和责任感。她在工程学和救援工作上的丰富经验和深刻理解，将为终末地带来宝贵的价值。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Snowshine works for Rhodes Island. As a SAR professional, she has engaged in multiple search and rescue (SAR) missions jointly carried out by Rhodes Island and Endfield Industries, resolving a range of complex issues in the process. Snowshine now serves as Endfield Industries' SAR liaison. 

Operator Snowshine has, in multiple occasions, demonstrated her extensive experiences in conducting SAR operations in the north. She has proved the value of her survival skills and her ability to quickly respond to various contingencies. 
Snowshine enthusiastically recounted her successful SAR mission rescuing the Oathkeepers and polar caravans, highlighting her careful planning, precise execution, and strategic decisions in overcoming natural hazards. Snowshine's engineering background gives her vital technical expertise that has been key in her SAR missions. The operator is extremely passionate and dedicated to her work. Her deep experience in both engineering and SAR operations makes her a valuable asset to Endfield. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>在加入终末地后，仅仅几个月的时间，昼雪小姐就给帝江号的很多干员留下了非常亲切的印象。
她经常在空闲的时候给其他人帮忙，有时是帮忙跑个腿，有时则是替人传个信。尽管大多是些小事，可有时候却是能让人长松一口气的“雪中送炭”。
“……要不是昼雪小姐及时送来那瓶陈醋，我这道糖醋兽肉可就出不了锅了！”来自食堂后厨的报告。
同时，在科普救援知识与教授雪地生存技巧方面，昼雪小姐更是不遗余力，经常亲自向大家演示——无论是急救时的关键步骤，还是雪地滑行时快速过弯的技巧。
“天啊……她到底是怎么做到的！我上次看到这么漂亮的过弯……还是在环带滑雪大赛的总决赛上！我打赌，要是她去参赛，至少能拿前三名回来！”某位没有透露姓名的干员曾在观看了昼雪小姐的演示后这么说。
而特种技术部门的伊冯小姐更是对她赞不绝口：
“哇！我还是第一次遇到能有人这么熟练地使用这套制冰施术单元！来来！再帮我多试用几套吧！至少能省掉十天的测试时间喔！”
但食堂负责现场补货的干员总会在昼雪小姐驻留帝江号时严阵以待，以免“甜品区好像只剩下了甜品名标签”的报告反复出现。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>After joining Endfield, it only took a few months for Miss Snowshine to give many operators a friendly and warm impression. 
Snowshine often helps others in her spare time, usually with simple errands and deliveries. Though they may seem small, these tasks often prove to be real lifesavers, making people truly grateful to have Snowshine around. 
"...That bottle of vinegar Miss Snowshine delivered was just in time. My sweet and sour meat would have been ruined without it!" reported the canteen chef. 
Miss Snowshine also spared no effort trying to popularize SAR knowledge and polar survival skills, and often gave everyone proper demonstrations — these include crucial first-aid procedures as well as quick turn techniques for snowboarding. 
"BY TALOS...! How did she do that? The last time I saw such a beautiful turn was ... during the finals of the Band Snowboard Championships! She's a guaranteed medalist if she ever attends, I'll bet my money on this!" said an anonymous operator after watching Snowshine's demonstration. 
Miss Yvonne from the Specialist Tech Division also has plenty of good things to say about Snowshine: 
"Oh ho! This is the first time I've met someone capable of using ice-making Arts Units with such expertise! Alrighty! I hope Snowshine can test more of my ice makers! She'll shave at least ten days off my testing phase!" 
However, canteen staff responsible for stocking the shelves would post warnings when Snowshine returns to Dijiang. Extra attention must be given to prevent the "dessert bar from being left with only the labels". </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>你问我对北方的印象？那真是糟透了……我发誓，当初答应和鲁特一块儿去找根本不知道在哪儿的什么萨米商人就是一个错误！我们才进到那里没两天，刚越过第一座雪山，就在山脚下被一场侵蚀雪暴给“逮住”了！
我这辈子都忘不了那沾了侵蚀的雪唰的一下把驮兽卷飞的画面。当时脑子里就剩一个念头：“完了，这下肯定得交待在这儿了……”
谁知道是不是我前十几年没用上的好运气都留在这一遭了，就在那雪暴离我们只剩几米不到的时候，一个乌萨斯姑娘突然从天而降——对，我没说错，她就是踩着一个滑雪板飞过来的，落在我们旁边二话没说，拿着个大盾往地上一砸！也是唰的一下，就造出了个大冰墙！把那雪暴全挡在外面了！
总之，我和鲁特就这么被她给救了下来，送到了一个山洞里，说是什么临时的避难所。
那里真是什么人都有……什么铁誓军军人、塞什卡商旅，甚至还有裂地者！
我到现在还记得，我们才刚进去就被一个看起来凶神恶煞的高个儿菲林指着鼻子骂：“这就是两个打算去萨米招摇撞骗的奸商！我在路上就听到他们在密谋怎么骗人。你们救援队怎么连这种货色都救！别被骗了！”我这才认出来，这菲林是之前和我们同行过几天的向导……难怪他突然就赔了我们佣金，不肯继续当我们的向导了……
我本以为这下要糟，不曾想带我们进来的乌萨斯姑娘却什么都没说，只是看了那菲林一眼，然后……然后那菲林就乖乖坐下，什么都没再说了。
当时呢，我本想亲自谢谢她的，但她立马又继续出去救人了。我连她名字都没问到，就被后来的救援队带去了另一处安全地带。
不过我记住了她衣服上的标志，和那个避难所里画的一样。
然后……然后我不就找到你们这儿了吗？哈哈，这些物资就当是给那位乌萨斯姑娘的谢礼吧！
——北方走廊救助联合会的一位捐赠者的来访录音记录</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>What do I think of the north? Worst place ever ... I swear! I seriously messed up agreeing to join Rooter on his hunt for that mysterious Sami vendor out in the middle of nowhere! We went over the first snowpeak and were barely two days into the north when some Blighted snowstorm "caught" us at the foot of the mountains! 
I will never forget the sight of an entire burdenbeast being swooshed away by the Blight-tainted snow. The only thing on my mind was: "Blasted blightery! I'm gonna die here..." 
But I guess I saved up enough luck for the past decade or so! The snowstorm was just meters away from us when an Ursus girl swooped in from the skies — I kid you not! She flew in on a snowboard, pulled off a perfect landing next to us, slammed a shield on the ground, and suddenly a wall of ice appeared with a WOOSH! That wall kept the snowstorm away! 
Anyway, she saved both Rooter and me. She escorted us into a cave that she called our temporary shelter. 
And there were all sorts of people there... Oathkeepers, Seš'qa caravan drivers, and even Landbreakers! 
I still remember how we just walked in and some tall and mean-looking Feline started pointing his finger at us, "These two! They're frauds plotting to bring their swindling ways to Sami! I heard all about their dirty plots along the way. Why are you saving these lowlives? Don't let them cheat you!" It was only then when I suddenly recognized the Feline. He was the guide who traveled with us a few days back... I had wondered why he suddenly returned the commission and refused to guide us any longer... 
Anyway, I thought we were finished but the Ursus lass who brought us in said nothing. She gave the Feline a glance and the big mean kittyboy ... just sat down and said nothing else. 
I wanted to thank her personally back then, but she soon rushed out to carry on with her SAR. I couldn't even get her name. Another SAR team soon arrived and brought us to safety. 
But I recognized the badges and markings on her outfit. They were the same as the illustrations in the shelter. 
What happened next...? Well, I found your place. That's what happened. Hah! Just take these supplies. My token of gratitude to that Ursus lass! 
— Recordings from a donor of the Northern Corridor Rescue Union </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【一封私人信件】
艾尔温：
现在或许该叫你“昼雪”？总之，原谅我离队时没能来得及和你告别……这并非我的本意，但那时队长和为我治疗的玛格丽特医生都强烈建议我最好立刻离开北方，以免我的幻觉症状进一步加重。
耶尔什是个美丽的城市，尽管这里看不到极光，但一样有巍峨的雪山。山脉之间没有侵蚀也没有天使，只有印着城市标志的悬空缆车来往交错——我坐过几次，那种毫无顾虑地望着雪原发呆的体验令人难忘……
我想你肯定会很意外。曾经入队时发誓要留在北方永远走在救援路上的人，竟然会在那么一场寻常的暴雪救援后退缩了……但我想说的是，有时候人或许真的没有自己想象中那么坚强，或者说比自己以为的更脆弱。
我不曾畏惧过暴雪、侵蚀这些指不定什么时候就带走我们性命的灾害。只是当目睹内尔森为了护住那个倒霉的勘探员而被卷入侵蚀最后失去了一条腿，当得知莉莎为了给所有人预警而超负荷使用她的源石技艺最终确诊失明……我逐渐开始自我质疑，质疑自己是不是哪里做得还不够，最终开始质疑起了其他队员……
多亏了队长，那时是他制止了我继续拿起施术单元，让玛格丽特医生及时替莱德进行了治疗……不然我一定会后悔一辈子吧。而艾尔温，你作为队里我曾经最看好的后辈，甚至是我心中最合适的副队长继任者，其实是个比我更重视情谊、更容易因为顾及他人而忘了自己的人啊。所以，就当是过来人的劝诫吧，在救助他人的时候，也多在乎一点自己，保护好自己。
因为你对我们、对那些关心着你的人，都一样重要，都是最无可替代的。
我期待你的回信，也随时欢迎你来耶尔什做客，最好拉上队长一起。到时我就带你们去吃这里味道最好的奶酪火锅，它的味道和你跟我描述的简直一模一样。

玛德琳·克里克

【一封私人信件】
玛德琳前辈：
谢谢你寄给我这封信！
直到现在，我都始终记得你第一次教我在雪地里修建避难所时的耐心，记得你告诫我作为救援队员必须保持警惕时的严肃，记得你半夜四点帮我修好了我那台无人机并让我下次注意时的温柔……这些都是我终生难忘的重要回忆。
所以我从来没有怀疑过前辈对救援行动的热忱，也一直相信就算离开了北方，前辈也一定在用自己的方式在哪里帮助着别人。
那时山上的事，莱德和队长他们虽然一直不肯多说，但我大概也从行动记录里猜到了一些……我想无论是他们还是其他人，都不会责怪前辈的，所以希望你好好养病，有空的时候也别忘了到处走走。等到我什么时候路过了耶尔什（队长好像最近依然很忙，我都没能联系上他），肯定会来看望你的。对了，你说的那家奶酪火锅真的那么好吃吗？真想吃一次看看！
另，信件附上的包裹里我放了你最喜欢的莓果果干，记得在保质期之前吃掉哦！

艾尔温</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: A private letter 
Eyrwin: 
Maybe I should call you Snowshine now. In any case, please forgive me for not saying goodbye when I left the team... That was never my intention. But my captain and my attending surgeon, Margarit, told me to leave the north immediately. They said it would prevent my hallucinations from getting worse. 
Kjersch is a beautiful city. We don't see any auroras here but there are equally majestic mountains in snow. The ridges are untouched by the Blight or the Aggeloi, and are linked by criss-crossing cable tramways that the city is so famous for — I took quite a few rides in them, and the experience of gazing into the vast snowfields without worry is unforgettable... 
You must have been surprised by my decision. Someone who had sworn to stay in the north and the SAR team for eternity ... was suddenly beaten by a most mundane and ordinary blizzard. What I want to say is that sometimes people are not as strong as they like to think. Perhaps I'm actually more fragile than I think I was. 
I never feared blizzards, the Blight, or any other disasters that could suddenly swoop in and take our lives. But when I saw Nelson lose a leg after getting sucked into the Blight while trying to save that unlucky prospector ... and after learning that Lisa lost her sight from overexerting her Originium Arts to give everyone an early warning... I started doubting myself. I began to think if I had fallen short ... and my suspicions soon spread to other members of the team... 
I have the captain to thank. I was about to use the Arts Unit when he stopped me and ordered Medical Officer Margarit to give Ryder the timely treatment he needed... He saved me from doing something I would've regretted for the rest of my life. Eyrwin, of all the young people on the team, I have the highest expectations for you. In fact, I believe you are the perfect candidate to succeed as deputy captain. You value friendship and care for others deeply, often to the point of neglecting your own safety. So take this as advice from someone who's been through it: never forget to look after yourself, especially when you're out there saving others. 
You are important and irreplaceable to the SAR team and everyone who cares for you. 
I look forward to your reply. Feel free to let me play the host in your visit to Kjersch. And try to bring the captain along. I'll take you all to the best fondue in town. It tastes exactly like what you described to me. 

Madeleine Crick 

DOCUMENT: A private letter 
Madeleine: 
Thank you for writing to me! 
Even now, I still remember your patience when you first taught me how to build an igloo shelter in the snowfields; your stern expression when you reminded me that every SAR teammate must maintain constant vigilance; and your tenderness when you helped me fix my drone at 4 AM, telling me to be more careful next time. These are precious memories I'll carry with me for the rest of my life... 
So, I have never doubted your passion for SAR operations. Even though you have left the north, I believe you're still helping everyone at your new place in your own special ways. 
Ryder and the captain refused to tell me what exactly happened on the mountain, but I could sort of guess from the operational logs... I don't think they, or anyone for that matter, would blame you for this. So I hope you can focus on getting better, and don't forget to explore the place when have time. Once I swing by Kjersch (captain seems pretty busy and I couldn't get hold of him) I'll definitely pay you a visit. And is that fondue place really as good as you say? I really wanna try it out! 
P.S. The pack that came with this letter is your favorite sundried berries. Eat them before they expire! 

Eyrwin </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【记录编号0000000】
……呼，给未来某个时刻的我与能够听到这份记录的人。
在离开那片森林后，她曾说：“可以尝试记录一些你认为意义非凡的时刻，这或许有助于你锚定自身在这个世界的位置。”
到现在我都不确定自己是不是真的理解了她的意思，也不知道究竟怎样的时刻能算是“意义非凡”……所以干脆就把我觉得值得记一下的事都记录下来吧！

【记录编号0000001】
……这是我第一次离开罗德岛，踏上塔卫二的土地。这里好像比地图与全息投影展示的景象更加广阔一些呢……有很多即使在她的记忆里也没有见过的东西，虽然和泰拉都不太一样了，但不知道为什么，有时候看着这里的人与建筑，总有种陌生但好像又有一些熟悉的感觉……真奇妙啊……
不过如果可以，果然还是想看看这里的雪……听说在北方和环带中部都能看见雪山，好像北方离这里更近一点，就先去那里看看吧。

【记录编号0000009】
……今天抵达的地方是北方的一座雪山。这些极地的风景常常让我觉得特别亲切，无论是那六棱柱状的雪花，还是薄纱般的极光……对了，下山的时候遇到了一场大暴雪，有两个信使打扮的丰蹄差点被卷进附近的侵蚀里，我用滑雪板把其中一个拉了出来，另一个则被一名全副武装的佩洛及时送到了安全位置……后来我才知道，那名佩洛是一位隶属于“北方走廊救助联合会”的救援志愿者，正在筹备一支专门的救援队伍。和他告别时，他还给我留了一张名片，说是觉得我虽然没经过专业训练，在救援过程中却十分冷静沉稳，选择了最恰当的救援手段，问我有没有兴趣加入他的队伍……
老实说，当我把那位信使救出来的时候，确实感受到了一种……从没有过的喜悦，让我觉得我应该这么做，甚至该做得更多。

【记录编号0000010】
……我想试试看，于是联系了那位名叫“克里斯”的佩洛，跟他说我想成为一名救援队员。
为了再次见到那天暴雪过后格外晴朗的天空，也为了我自己。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>LOG ID: 0000000 
Hoo... This message is for me (at some point in the future) and the person who could hear these logs. 
After leaving the Woods, she once said, "Try recording special and unique moments in your life. It may help you anchor yourself in the world." 
Till now, I don't know if I really understood what she meant. And I'm unsure what type moment can be considered "special and unique"... So, I might as well record everything that I think is worth remembering. 

LOG ID: 0000001 
...This is my first time leaving Rhodes Island and stepping on the land of Talos-II. It's more spacious and open than what the maps and panoramic holograms suggested... There are also plenty of things I have not yet seen in her memories. Although this place is quite different from Terra, the people and buildings feel distant yet familiar at the same time... It's so strange... 
But if possible, I really want to see and experience the local snow... They say there are snowy mountains in the north and the central part of the Band. The north seems closer, so I guess I'll head over there first. 

LOG ID: 0000009 
...Today I arrived at a snowcapped mountain in the north. I felt right at home in this polar landscape. Everything, including the hexagonal columnar snowflakes and the veil-like aurora, felt really familiar to me... Before I forget, I ran into a huge blizzard when I made my way down the mountain. Two Fortes dressed like messengers were almost trapped in a nearby Blight. I used my snowboard to pull one of them to safety. The other was saved by a fully armed Perro. We escorted them to a safe place in a timely fashion... I later learned that the Perro is a volunteer with the Northern Corridor Rescue Union. They are planning to establish a professional SAR team. That Perro also left me a business card when we said goodbye. He said I behaved with calmness and reason despite my lack of professional training, even choosing the best rescue measures possible. Then he asked if I'd be interested in joining his outfit... 
Truth be told, when I pulled that messenger to safety, I did feel ... a kind of ecstasy and joy I had never experienced before. It became a calling I couldn't ignore, and I even wanted to do more. 

LOG ID: 0000010 
I thought about giving it a shot, so I called the Perro named Chris. I told him I want to be an SAR teammate. 
I am doing this for myself. The sunshine after the blizzard was also especially bright. I want to see that again. </>

voiceDesc.cn: 听候你的指示，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Waiting for your orders, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你来啦！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin! You're here!

voiceDesc.cn: 是新的外勤任务吗？我准备好啦！
voiceDesc.en: A new field mission? I'm totally ready!

voiceDesc.cn: 我会保护好大家的！
voiceDesc.en: I'll protect everyone!

voiceDesc.cn: 很棒的性能，能适应各种极端环境！
voiceDesc.en: Wonderful performance! And it's also usable in extreme environments!

voiceDesc.cn: 这套装备充满了工匠的巧思呢。
voiceDesc.en: The one who made this really gave it a lot of thought.

voiceDesc.cn: 我有在努力锻炼身体呢！为了应对各种突发情况！
voiceDesc.en: I've been exercising really hard! Gotta get ready for all sorts of emergencies, you know!

voiceDesc.cn: 这份记录也很有参考价值，很多思路都可以用在救援行动里！
voiceDesc.en: These records offer valuable references! They give me plenty of ideas for future SAR operations!

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，我会继续努力的！肯定不会辜负终末地和大家的信任！
voiceDesc.en: Mmh! Hard work always pays off! I'll not let Endfield or anyone down!

voiceDesc.cn: 接下来就能去更远的地方完成任务了？放心吧，野外急救、数据采样、后勤支援之类的工作都可以交给我哦！
voiceDesc.en: This gives an extension to my operational range, right? Don't worry! Count on me for all your needs in emergency rescues, data sampling, logistics support, and all kinds of field work!

voiceDesc.cn: 这一次我把救援用的制冰施术单元都升级了一下！管理员，这是我新造的临时庇护所！要不要进来住一晚？
voiceDesc.en: I upgraded all my SAR ice-making Arts Units this time, Endmin! Look! I just built a temporary igloo! Come on in for a sleepover!

voiceDesc.cn: 在终末地的这段时光，我学到了很多新知识，也收获了很多美好回忆……这都多亏了你们的信任，管理员。今后，我也会继续尝试攀越更高的山峰，去帮助更多身处险境的人们。
voiceDesc.en: The time I spent with Endfield taught me many new things, and gave me many wonderful memories... Thanks for placing your faith in me, Endmin. From henceforth, I shall continue to climb ever higher peaks ... and to rescue as many people as I can.

voiceDesc.cn: 你好，我是罗德岛的特派干员，代号昼雪，擅长极寒地带的救援工作。如果有需要前往冰原或雪山的任务，请一定要带上我！
voiceDesc.en: Greetings! I'm your operator from Rhodes Island. Codename's Snowshine. I'm a search and rescue expert specializing in low temperature operations. Get me on the team if you have a mission in the icefields or snowy mountains.

voiceDesc.cn: 要来和我一起滑一段吗，管理员？
voiceDesc.en: Wanna come snowboarding with me, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 风速适中，能见度良好，是滑雪的好天气。
voiceDesc.en: Wind speed's okay. Visibility's good. Perfect weather for snowboarding.

voiceDesc.cn: 没问题！这里的工作我都尝试过！比搭建工事轻松多了！
voiceDesc.en: Not a problem! I've actually tried every job at this place! And they're way simpler than putting up fortifications!

voiceDesc.cn: 你好啊，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Greetings, Endmin.

voiceDesc.cn: 需要帮忙吗，管理员？我可以当你的护卫。
voiceDesc.en: Need a hand, Endmin? I can be your defender!

voiceDesc.cn: 每次来帝江号都能学到很多新东西：没见过的技术设备，特别的作战思路，大胆的监测方案……真的是数都数不过来！嗯，终末地果然好厉害！
voiceDesc.en: I learn tons of new stuff every time I step aboard Dijiang: There's tech and machinery that I've never seen before, special combat theories, bold monitoring plans... Oh, I can barely keep pace with everything! Endfield is just awesome! And I mean it!

voiceDesc.cn: 什么？帝江号食堂的点心是不限量供应的吗？！啊，抱歉，我只是稍微有些吃惊……没、没打算一口气全吃完的！真的！
voiceDesc.en: What? The Dijiang canteen has an all-you-can-eat snackbar?! Ah, apologies. I was just a little surprised... No, of course not! I'm not going to eat everything! Honest!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员你来得正好！我刚好收到了之前采购的食材，要不要来试试我亲手做的奶酪火锅呀？……唔，口味应该算比较特别的吧？好多吃了的同事都说是种“终生难忘的味道”……
voiceDesc.en: Endmin! You came at just the right time! My package just arrived and I wonder if you're interested in trying out my special cheese fondue? The flavor...? I think it's quite ... special? Plenty of my colleagues told me it's an "unforgettable experience of a lifetime"...

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿咻！伸展四肢，活动关节。这套热身运动不仅有助于预防拉伤，在极地环境下也能降低失温风险哦，管理员，来一起试试吧？没关系，我当过培训课的助教，会帮你调整姿势的！——你看，很简单吧？
voiceDesc.en: Hnnnggghh! Stretching will help limber up the joints. This routine can help prevent muscle tears and keep hypothermia at bay in polar environments. Wanna give it a go? Don't worry. I've been an assistant coach in the training sessions, so I can definitely get your posture right! — See? Easy, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 每次遇到小道奇教官，我就会想起我们的队长。他也是个佩洛，虽然平时很好说话，但到了救援行动的时候，他总是要求最严格的那个，连热水钻头的直径都会反复确认……“救援无小事”的道理就是他教给我的。
voiceDesc.en: Lil' Dodge reminds me of our captain every time I see him. My captain's also a Perro. He's a really nice guy — but once an SAR mission begins, he turns into super bossy-boots. He even makes us do multiple caliber checks on the hot water drill bit... "Every tiny detail matters in SAR!" That's what I've learned from him.

voiceDesc.cn: 塔卫二云层上的光真的很漂亮，很像我印象里的“极光”……如同梦中的景色。我常在北方雪峰的最高处望见它们，虽然知道那是危险的超域能量，却总觉得像遇到了一个老朋友，在遥远的地方注视着我，守护着我……
voiceDesc.en: The light reflecting off the clouds of Talos-II can be so beautiful. It reminds me of the aurora I know ... and the visions of my dreams. I often see them when I'm atop the highest peaks of the northern snowy mountains. I know the light is a form of dangerous Æther energy, but seeing it felt like meeting an old friend... One who watches me ... and protects me from afar...

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我从冰原带回来了一点小东西，请收下吧。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, take this. It's a tiny something I brought from the snowfields.

voiceDesc.cn: 这是给我的吗？谢谢，有种很温暖的感觉……我会好好珍藏的！
voiceDesc.en: Is this for me? Oh, thank you! It's got such a warm feel... I'll definitely treasure it!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你看，这是我用源石技艺新造的冰墙！是不是很结实？别担心，就算再用力些也没事！不会裂开的！
voiceDesc.en: Look, Endmin! I used my Originium Arts to create this ice barrier! Super sturdy, right? Don't worry! Feel free to swing at it with more oomph! You won't put a crack in it!

voiceDesc.cn: 最近有好好休息吗，管理员？总看到你到处跑来跑去，就没怎么停下来过……要注意劳逸结合噢！上回救援训练，我背你的时候真的被吓了一跳……简直比刚出生的小驮兽还要轻……
voiceDesc.en: Got some much-needed rest, Endmin? I always see you running all over the place with hardly a break... Hmm, you really should watch that work-life balance. Remember that last SAR training we had? You gave me quite the surprise when I carried you on my back... I could hardly believe you're lighter than a newborn burdenbeast calf...

voiceDesc.cn: 救援工作也不是每次都那么顺利……突发天气或是地形变化总会来得比预想中更快。所以每次出发前，我都会多检查两遍我们的救援设备，从无人机到体温识别仪……它们也是救援队员重要的伙伴，是我们敢于大胆行动的底气来源。
voiceDesc.en: Not every SAR operation is a success story... Sudden changes in weather or terrain can happen in ways faster than you expect. This is why I would triple-check my gear before setting off on a mission. Drones, thermal imaging cams ... every piece of equipment is an important assistant for any SAR operator. They're the reasons why we could launch bold rescue plans with confidence.

voiceDesc.cn: 我曾在一场雪难里救下过一对父女……他们那时好像在闹矛盾，待在我搭的临时庇护所里也互不理睬。但当风雪来袭的时候，爸爸总会把食物留给女儿，女儿也总关心着爸爸……等到获救后，两个人还是不和对方说话。那时我就在想，这会不会就是那种叫做“亲情”的牵绊呢？即使说不出口，关键时刻也会为彼此挺身而出……
voiceDesc.en: I once rescued a father and his daughter in an avalanche... They probably had an argument and deliberately ignored each other in the temporary shelter I built. But when the blizzard came down hard, the father always set aside food for the girl, and the girl did her best to care for her old man... They were successfully evacced, but the two still refused to talk to each other. It made me wonder if that's what the bond of kinship is about. Even if they couldn't find the words, family would always stand up for each other in crucial moments...

voiceDesc.cn: 拯救生命是一项艰苦的工作，而我也没妄想过能不付出任何代价就帮助所有人。我入队时的同期，已经没人留在队里了。他们有些在侵蚀灾害中落下了残疾，有些在冰冷的雪夜失去了理性……我的确感到过茫然，甚至有些胆怯。但是，终末地的大家都很厉害，也很坚强！在管理员的帮助下，相信我们所有人都能走得更远一点！
voiceDesc.en: Saving lives is no easy task. I never fantasized about rescuing everyone without making sacrifices. I'm the only one left from my cohort of SAR teammates. Blight disasters left a few with crippling disabilities. Some lost their minds in the frigid, snowy nights... There were times of confusion, and moments when I felt the touch of fear. But you Endfielders are so awesome, and so strong! I believe all of us will be capable of going further and higher, all thanks to your support, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 这块滑雪板吗？它是我离开罗德岛时，华法琳女士送我的礼物。和我的盾牌一样，它也是用稀有的材料打造的，在救援行动时特别有用！嗯？难道管理员对滑雪感兴趣？我可以教你！
voiceDesc.en: What about this snowboard? It's a gift from Lady Warfarin when I left Rhodes Island. The board's constructed using rare materials, just like my shield. And it's ultra versatile in SAR missions! Hmm... Endmin, are you interested in snowboarding? I can totally teach you all about that!

voiceDesc.cn: 救援队隶属于北方走廊救助联合会，我们遇到的救援对象常常是那些因公前往北方的信使、来往贸易的商人，偶尔还有遭到天使或野兽袭击后迷路的军队斥候。而我们的成员同样来自天南海北，大多数是志愿者。虽然总是在和冰天雪地打交道，但其实也结识了很多不一样的人呢。
voiceDesc.en: The Search and Rescue organization is under the Northern Corridor Rescue Union. Our missions typically involve messengers working in the north, traveling merchants, and military scouts who lost their way after being ambushed by the Aggeloi or beasts. My SAR teammates come from all across the world, and most of us are volunteers. The SAR experience was a constant battle against the ice, snow, and rough terrain, but it gave me a chance to meet all sorts of different people.

voiceDesc.cn: 最近也有干员问过我，要怎样才能加入救援队。其实不难的！只要平时经常进行高地徒步训练，能坚持数个小时无休的搜救，学过一些极地生存技巧，知道怎么躲避锚点与大型野兽，再接受完整的急救培训课程——至少到能处理突发矿石病的水平，最后通过我们队长专门设计的实地测试，就能正式加入啦！
voiceDesc.en: An operator recently asked me about joining the SAR. It isn't hard, really! Just constantly train yourself for mountaineering, endure hours of non-stop rescue operations, master some polar survival skills, learn how to avoid Ankhors and large beasts, and complete the full first-aid training course — at least to the level where you can handle sudden Oripathy! Finally, pass the special field trial designed by our captain and you'll become an official member of the SAR!

voiceDesc.cn: 我喜欢冰雪，喜欢雪山，喜欢这些严寒下依然璀璨的事物……所以我才更不希望它们给人带来痛苦的回忆。我想要让更多人在看到雪山时，最先想到的是山顶美丽的风景；想要让更多人看到冰雪时，最先想到的是纯净的冰晶与漂亮的雪花……而不是那些因雪灾带来的不幸。为了这个目标，我想我会一直努力下去的。
voiceDesc.en: I like the snow, the white-capped mountains, and the shimmering beauty revealed only in the frigid cold... This is why I don't want them to leave painful memories to the people they touch. When people see the snowy mountains, the first thing they remember should be the enrapturing views from the summit. And when the snow falls, I hope they think of pristine crystals and blossoms of ice... *Sigh* It would be so sad if all anyone thought of was catastrophe. Endmin, I will continue to strive towards these goals of mine.

voiceDesc.cn: 昨天你有来找我吗，管理员？抱歉，我那时肯定是在补觉，所以才没发现。对，现在每次救援行动回来，我都会先好好睡一觉……有时一不小心就睡过头了，要过好久才能自然醒。不过要是有什么急事，直接来叫我就好啦！要是听到管理员的声音，我肯定马上就醒过来了！
voiceDesc.en: Were you looking for me yesterday, Endmin? I'm so sorry I didn't notice back then. I was definitely taking a nap to make up for missing sleep. Yeah, napping is the first thing I'd do after coming back from an SAR mission... And sometimes I would accidentally oversleep by ... quite a bit. But you can simply wake me up if you got an emergency! The sound of your voice will get me up and ready in no time, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 救援训练当然很重要啊！尤其是面对雪崩这样的自然灾害，如果大家都有很强的避险意识，可以在最短时间里找到身边坚固的躲藏地，往往就能大幅提高生存的可能性……所以管理员，下次的训练你肯定会来的，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: Definitely! SAR training is super important! When natural disasters like an avalanche strike, people can quickly shelter themselves in safe, sturdy places ... And that would greatly improve their odds of survival! But this could only happen when people have strong disaster awareness... So, Endmin, you'll be attending the next SAR training session, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 洁尔佩塔小姐现在也在帝江号上吗？啊，之前的救援行动中，她帮我们做了很多额外的工作，像是物资搬运和伤员运送，甚至还在暴雪中精准定位到了高空中的求救信号。后来救援队本想送她点什么作为谢礼，她却全都拒绝了，说是拍些雪山的风景给她就好啦。嘿嘿，管理员你看，这些照片怎么样？相框也是我亲手制作的哦！
voiceDesc.en: Is Miss Gilberta aboard Dijiang as well? Oh, it's just that she really went out of her way to help us in multiple SAR missions. She delivered vital supplies, air-lifted the injured, and even pinpointed a mid-air SOS signal in the middle of a terrible blizzard! The SAR team tried giving her a token of our appreciation but she turned everything down. In the end, she asked for a few photos of a nice view from the snowy peaks. Heheh. What do you think of this one? I made the photo frame myself as well!

voiceDesc.cn: 想在极地生存可不是件容易的事……你要懂得怎么在暴雪中的帐篷里过夜才不至于失温，要学会从存在侵蚀的冰原上找到能入口的食材，要能判断冰川上哪里才适合落脚。最重要的是，要知道怎么在没有向导的时候，找出一条前往目的地的安全路线——避开天使、饥饿的动物还有那些危险的受灾地带。
voiceDesc.en: Polar survival is not easy... Essential knowledge includes proper overnight camping to avoid hypothermia during blizzards, finding edible food in the Blighted icefields, identifying sturdy footholds to cross glaciers ... and most importantly, plotting a safe passage to the objective — This means you have to learn how to avoid the Aggeloi, hungry beasts, and other dangers in disaster zones.

voiceDesc.cn: 这些物资最好都收集起来，救援时说不定能用上！
voiceDesc.en: We should gather these resources! They might come in handy for rescue operations.

voiceDesc.cn: 好像找到了不得了的东西呢，或许能在以后的行动中发挥很大作用！
voiceDesc.en: Seems like a terrific discovery. Perhaps they'll be useful for future operations!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>在帝江号上忙碌的日常事务中，很少有人注意到一位新干员的加入，并且，黎风自己也毫无意向要达成某种轰动的效果。但他在登舰第三天就引起了一些关注——传言称，有个人在培养舱里晨练。大家赶赴现场，瞧见一个阿纳萨盘腿端坐于舱室地板上，闭合双眼，运气呼吸，不知道是眼花还是舱内培养皿的灯光所致，在场者竟然看到他周身浮现出一种微茫的柔和亮光——
“因为他是萨卡兹的缘故，所以怎么都不奇怪，我称之为‘灵’！”
“可能他用的是一种大炎的秘法？！我觉得是‘气’……”
“不管怎么样，他往那儿一坐，就给人感觉……周围都安静了下来……像有种魔力，让人想脱口而出叫他一声‘小师父’……”
“小师父？我觉得是陈千语昨天给我们看的那种，武侠片里的少侠！”
“嘘，他好像回头看过来了！快、快躲起来……”
随后便是一阵丁零当啷的动静，长枪在光照单元上错乱地划拉了好几下，劈开了控制组件的三个进出液口，在滚滚喷出的气体中，大家看见少年慌忙收拢姿态，拍散周围的白烟，立正站好：“对不起！我以为这里没有人使用！”
原来还是个稚气未脱的小孩子。大家恍然大悟，但随后又疑惑起来：“你怎么做到看起来又年轻又老的？！”
黎风露出了困惑的表情：“因为阿纳萨是一个古老又有智慧的种族，但我年纪还小……？”
大家再次恍然大悟——好像有点道理，但又好像完全没有解释！

小师父或者小少侠黎风身上这一种大家很少见过的，又老又新、又板正又柔软的奇妙反差，在众人与他逐渐亲近的相处过程中得到了进一步的验证。
最先注意到黎风的能力的，是代理作战教官小道奇。在一番交手后，小道奇对黎风干员的枪法赞不绝口。在他提交的报告中，一向严厉的教官在黎风干员的多维测评中使用了极少见到的表述，“出枪速度迅于常人”“力量非常到位”“是不可多得的武才”，——“真想得知他的师承！”
对此，黎风干员受宠若惊，表示自己在师父大潘面前只是班门弄斧。
而大潘在大家百般追问和贿赂后才勉强透露，他自己天生不会带孩子，却被庄方宜委以教导黎风的重任。漫长的暑假里，面对这个精力充沛、死缠烂打、万事刨根问底的小子，索性随手甩了他六百多盘从宏山城的古董店淘来的社戏录像带，扔在自己店里，让他对着电视机坐一整天。没想到那小子还真看得入了迷，学进了心里去。一日，他在阳台上拿着晾衣杆子耍弄时，愣是给大潘瞧出了一个未来的好苗子。
“低调、低调，”大潘摆摆肉手，“这小子现在也只学到武生皮毛。打起来是漂亮，可真正的战斗不靠花招儿。”
“那靠啥呀？”
“靠个‘会’字。跟人打，不是跟枪打。耍枪学的是枪谱，战斗要读的是对手。”
“好玄奥啊，大潘老师。这个要怎么学？”
“嗐，这事儿还真吃个性。您瞧着吧，黎风这孩子是耐得住的。他心细。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>It was another busy day as usual aboard Dijiang. Not many people took notice of the new operator. Lifeng also did not intend to do anything spectacular. But he soon caught some attention by the third day he came aboard the ship — People started talking about a lad doing morning exercises in the Growth Chamber. On arrival, the team found an Anasa meditating cross-legged in the chamber, eyes shut, breath steady. Those who were there reported seeing a soft, gentle glow emanating from his body. No one knew if they were seeing things or if the phenomenon was a result of artificial lighting from the cultivation tanks... 
"He's Sarkaz, that's why. Nothing to be worried about. It must be his 'Spirit'!" 
"It might be some secret Yanese technique. I think it's called the 'Ki'..."
"It doesn't matter what it's called. The moment he sat down ... it brought about a vibe of serenity... It's like a form of artsy power that made me wanna call him 'Young Master'..." 
"Young Master? I think he's more like the Young Warrior from the martial arts movies that Chen showed us yesterday." 
"Shh! I think he heard us! And he's turning around! QUICK! HIDE..."
After a brief, noisy moment, the lance made a few random slashes on the lighting module. Three fluid inlets and outlets of the control module were split open. They saw the youth fumbling to get back to his feet to wave off the white, billowing smoke around him. The youth then stood at attention: "I'm so sorry! I thought nobody was using this place!" 
They realized he was just a boy, but their realizations quickly gave way to confusion: "How do you look so young and old at the same time?!" 
Lifeng looked confused. "Because ... the Anasas are an old and wise race, but I'm still a little young...?" 
It was an enlightening answer — Meaningful in some way, but also wholly incapable of answering the question! 

Lifeng the Young Master (or Young Warrior) gave off an aura of rarely observed contradiction. He was ancient yet young, stiff yet flexible. These quirks were further verified as people started to befriend him. 
The first to notice Lifeng's ability was provisional combat instructor Lil' Dodge. The instructor gave nothing but praise about Operator Lifeng's spear fighting skills after a friendly spar. The instructor (notorious for strictness) lavished extremely rare praises in Operator Lifeng's multi-dimensional assessment report. Things like: "Lance strikes way faster than the average"; "Hits with just the right force"; "A warrior of rare quality"; and — "I really wanna know where he learned how to fight!" 
Lifeng was extremely surprised by these commendations, and said that he was but a little boy playing with sticks when compared to his master, Da Pan. 
After becoming the target of endless questioning (and all sorts of bribes), Da Pan finally agreed to reveal certain secrets. The Ursus confessed he was not good with children but Zhuang Fangyi gave him the important task of training Lifeng. Finding himself stuck with an energetic and inquisitive kid who followed him everywhere, Da Pan found a solution. He purchased over 600 video tapes of folk festivals and plays from a Hongshan antique store and allowed Lifeng to watch TV all day. He did not expect the kid to become engrossed with what he saw and took it all in. One day, Lifeng grabbed a cloth drying pole to fool around with. It was at that moment when Da Pan realized the boy's potential. 
"Let's just keep it down," Da Pan waved his meaty paw around, "The kid barely scratched the surface of the martial arts. Sure, his attacks look great and the flourishes are pretty, but true combat got nothing to do with that." 
"So what is true combat all about?" 
"It's all about 'knowing'. True combat is about defeating the opponent, not the spear. A spear wielder studies the spear manuals. A true fighter studies the foe." 
"That's really deep, Master Da Pan. How exactly do we study that?" 
"Well, it boils down to personality. Just you watch. He's just a kid, but Lifeng has the patience for it. And he's a meticulous one, too."</>

正巧，我对长枪的使用和实战有些心得体会。先说我的看法，环塔商会印刷的三个版本都是假的，因为其中许多谬误简直匪夷所思。虽然每一版《武典》都有记载各类炎国枪法神技，比如“回天枪”“武陵梨花枪”，其中一版更是传出了古代天师能枪挑日月的夸张说法，却从来不见详实可信的描述和点评，配图只是一堆不知真假的大侠飞来飞去（详考泰拉蓝卡坞兴盛时期的电影业，说不定有不少是以讹传讹、化用假典）。反观终末地资料库中的《武典》，较之朴实无华，却有对枪法传人身份、师承的详细记录，甚至还有传承人自己批注的心得和意见。而且不仅民间武学，对炎国禁军、卡西米尔的银枪天马、维多利亚的破城矛持有者、卡兹戴尔的雇佣兵都有详细描摹。光是记录者包罗万象，却又能平视天下群雄的气度，就足够令人心生钦佩！作注的记述文字更是夯实遒劲，寥寥几笔就能栩栩如生。故此，我认为只有终末地资料库里的《武典》是泰拉时期的正本，大家平时能买到的无非都是些噱头仿品，真是可惜！

RE: Anonymous User 981902#8090 12:50 
Speaking from experience, if people around me act as though everything is fine, I would know they're trying to keep their views to themselves. And that would make me sad. But if people really focused on it and do what they can to help me, I would also feel sad since I'd keep focusing on my missing part. So I guess this is a really tough situation to handle. The most important thing should be the fact that you and your friend care for each other. Just be honest with your feelings.

TOPIC: There are 3 versions of Martial Codex in circulation and certain parts contradict each other. Which one is closer to the OG? 
ORIGINAL POST: And MOST importantly, none of the 3 versions have the official HAS seal of approval. And the differences are humongous. 

RE: Anonymous User 981902#8090 10:26 
I happen to have personal experience in the practice and field use of the spear. Here are my two cents. All 3 versions published by TGCC are fake, and contain plenty of ridiculous and misleading errors. Every version of the Martial Codex includes records of Yanese spearmancy such as Spear of Empyrean Return and Pear Blossom Spear of Wuling. But one of the versions made a super exaggerated claim that ancient Tianshi could flick the sun and moon with their spears. They even furnished this section with great warriors of questionable authenticity flying all over the place (for details, refer to the Wrankwood movie industry during the Age of Terra, plenty of their stuff is based on false fantasies). The Martial Codex we have in the EFDB might be a dry and boring read, but it contains detailed records and identities of the practitioners and masters of various spearmancy schools. The Codex even has commentaries and suggestions written by the practitioners themselves. The Codex has detailed descriptions of everything from folk martial artists to Imperial Guards of Yan, Silverlance Pegasi of Kazimierz, wielders of Victorian piledriver spears, and even Kazdelian mercenaries. The author is truly admirable for being able to secure such a huge range of resources while giving off the vibe of being on equal standing of numerous legends! The commentaries were also written in a concise yet vivid style. It takes great conviction to achieve this. Hence, I truly believe that the Martial Codex in the EFDB is the original from the Age of Terra. The others that we can easily buy are just crude and exaggerated copies. A true shame, if you ask me.

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>武陵的街坊邻居对于黎风前往终末地实习的选择反响不一。
有的人真诚地为他高兴，比如眼看着他从毛头小子长大的老一辈们，都说年轻人到岁数了，是该出去闯一闯，长长见识。
“要论德行，咱们武陵的孩子都是个顶个的优秀，特别是黎风，心里装着所有人的事儿，连白奶奶忘记什么时候吃哪种药，都会先打电话问一问黎风。”
“大清早的，出来练武，他便会沿途把各家各户放在门口的垃圾袋一并收去垃圾站里。这就叫眼里有活儿！”
也有的人为此难过，例如从小玩到大的同伴们。对于他们而言，黎风就是大院里的孩子王，没了他拿主意，大家心里总觉得少了一根主心骨。
黎风安慰他们说，他即将要去实习的地方——终末地工业——和武陵有着密切的合作。想回来的时候，向管理员申请休假就行。
即便如此，离别的焦虑还是搞得人心惶惶。
那天日常安全预警演习，弭弗队长来了大院里，听到角落里孩子们的议论，硬邦邦地打断了他们：“想什么呢。肯定会回来的。心就在这儿，人能跑多远？”
“真的吗？”
“之前黎风从来没跟我们说过他要离开武陵呢，他明明那么喜欢这里。”
“是啊，弭队长，他之前不是一直跟你说要加入巡卫队的吗？黎风去终末地那边也只是学习经验吧，肯定还会回来的！”
“可是，在这里就很好啊，他为什么要走呢？”
弭弗把嘴里的粑粑签子拿掉。一般这个时候，大家就知道她要认真起来了。
“黎风是会给自己找麻烦的人。他闲不住。”
“什么叫找麻烦？”
“离开就是一件很麻烦的事。”
“弭队长……没懂。”
“呃，怎么说啊，”弭弗挠了挠头发，“就像穿鞋子。旧的鞋子穿着舒服，换新的鞋子，要适应，磨脚，还会流血。”
“对啊，弭队长，那为什么要换新鞋子啊？”
“我知道！是因为脚变大了。”
“可是人不是长到一个岁数以后，脚就不会变大了吗？”
“笨啊！为了走更远的路啊！”
“呜哇，弭队长突然好大声，好可怕……”
“……记住，离开是为了更好地回来。你们应该为他高兴。”

对于黎风而言，前去一个从未亲眼见过的地方的决定，是突然诞生的。侵蚀潮涌来，他发现自己引以为傲的枪在它面前脆如白纸。
他亲眼见过巨大的协议核心刺破云层，从天而降，落在他面前；又在一眨眼间，将所有的东西呈于眼前。在它面前，他发现自己很渺小，渺小得守护不了这一切；又发现自己太大，先前竟以为一直这样下去就可以保护大家。他就像被人从池子里抓起来扔进了大海。随后他想起，自己也不知道大海真正是什么样子，武陵是没有海的。
所以，他要去看看海，看看天上，到世界里去。在那里他会变成更有力量的人，然后他会回来扛起他深爱的武陵，继续往前走。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Lifeng's neighbors in Wuling reacted differently when he received an internship opportunity at Endfield. 
Some genuinely felt happy for him, especially the elderly who saw him grow up. They all agree that it was time for the youth to head out there and see the bigger world. 
"The youths of Wuling are the best and most virtuous. Lifeng, especially. Lad is always thinking about others. When Granny Bai forgets about her meds, Lifeng is the first person she calls." 
"The boy trains in the wee hours of the morning. He'll also carry all the trashbags from the entire neighborhood to the dump. That's what I call looking out for your neighbors." 
A few felt sad, such as Lifeng's childhood companions. They treated him as the chieftain of the group. Now that Chieftain Lifeng found a serious job, the group was left without a leader. 
Lifeng comforted them by revealing he would be interning at Endfield Industries, a company that works closely with Wuling. He could simply ask the Endministrator for leave to visit Wuling again. 
Despite his efforts, everyone got pretty anxious on the day of departure. 
The regular safety drill was also scheduled on that day. Captain Mi Fu came to the neighborhood and listened to the children talk about this. She interrupted them brusquely: "Nonsense. He'll be back. Won't be going nowhere 'cause this is where his heart is." 
"Really?" 
"Lifeng never told us he was leaving Wuling. I thought he likes this place a lot." 
"Yeah, Captain Mi. I thought he always wanted to join the Watchguards! Lifeng is just gonna learn some skills at Endfield, right? He'll be back!" 
"But this is a nice place. Why would he leave?" 
Mi Fu removed the baba breadstick from her mouth. People know that this was her cue for dropping some serious truthballs. 
"Lifeng has a habit of getting himself in trouble. He's not the idle type." 
"Getting himself in trouble? What does that mean?" 
"Leaving is troublesome, right?" 
"I don't understand, Captain Mi..." 
"Hmm, how should I put this?" Mi Fu combed her hair with her fingers, "It's like wearing shoes. Old shoes are cushy and fitting. New shoes are another thing. Tight and loose at all the wrong places. Might even leave you bleeding." 
"Of course, Captain Mi. So why do we swap to new shoes?" 
"Oh, I know! Our feet got bigger!" 
"But everyone's feet get bigger when they get older, right?" 
"Stupid kids! You get new shoes to travel to other places!" 
"KYAA! Captain Mi is so loud and so mean..." 
"...Just remember. People leave to better themselves before coming back. You should feel happy for him." 

The decision to visit a brand new place came suddenly to Lifeng. When the Blight Tide surged forth, Lifeng realized his proud spear was as fragile as a rolled paper. 
He witnessed the massive Protocol Automation-Core breaking through the clouds and landing right in front of him. And in an instant, it deployed all sorts of machines before him. Lifeng realized how small he was, and smallness meant that he could not protect everything. He then realized that he was getting older. He always thought he could protect everyone by simply staying put. It felt as though someone scooped him out from a pond and cast him into the sea. Then he remembered that he had never seen the oceans before. There are no beaches at Wuling. 
And thus he desired to look at the oceans, the empyrean, and the world itself. These would transform him into a person with true strength. When that day comes, he shall return to his beloved Wuling and continue his march forward.</>

"One month to master the staff, one year to master the blade, and one lifetime to master the spear." And propriety is harder than spearmancy. It's all about agility, dexterity, flexibility, speed, haste, and being razor sharp. 
MUST REMEMBER THIS! (This line is furnished with double underlines) 
...... 
Never slack when holding a spear. The point shall be right before the chest to convey power and might without fury. 
Never direct the point to yourself, but only at the enemy. 
Never thrust a foe that enters the circle, but only block. Thrust a foe attempting a stab. 
...... 
Stance of the Azure Dragon's Claw 
Capable of parrying various moves, with just the right strength. Counter-thrust when the enemy strikes with a spear. Steady one's footing to keep the enemy pinned. 
...... 
FEINT (the word is given a double underline)! Gotta put more time in this! Fall backwards to feint defeat, wait for the foe to thrust, leap back on the feet and seize the foe's weapon. 
(Scribbled comments) Take a step backward to make a good advance? This is so difficult.

Must get the basics down. 100 rounds for the lance and spear. EACH. Meihuazhuang and Liuhequan routines must be done daily. Skip 3 days of training and your body will notice. Skip 7 days and your foe will exploit it. MUST REMEMBER THIS!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员！这回我能派上用场了吗？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, finally got an assignment for me?

voiceDesc.cn: 哎，鞋带开了……管理员来了！不管了，立正！
voiceDesc.en: Oh, my laces are untied... Wait, Endmin's coming! Attention!

voiceDesc.cn: 打击对象，在哪个方位？！——别紧张管理员，我就是预先演习一下。
voiceDesc.en: Where's the target at?! ...Oh, my bad, Endmin. Just a bit of pre-battle practice.

voiceDesc.cn: 正如潘叔老说的，闻鼓则进，断不能怯！
voiceDesc.en: Uncle Pan always says, no backing down once the war drums start beating.

voiceDesc.cn: 练家子挑长枪，切勿盲追材质。趁手的，白蜡杆也能耍出花头！
voiceDesc.en: It's not the weapon that makes the lancer. Even a simple waxwood staff can strike true!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，这些战术装备真的是给我的吗？这是不是说明，我也正式加入队伍了？！
voiceDesc.en: All this tactical gear's for me? You serious, Endmin? Does this mean I'm officially recruited?!

voiceDesc.cn: 我来终末地就是为了学东西的！只是……这里的东西多得有点儿学不完啊……要加把劲！
voiceDesc.en: I came to Endfield to learn. But ... there's way too much to take in. Gotta work even harder!

voiceDesc.cn: 潘叔也老叫我把练习的动作录下来回去揣摩。说真的，不看不知道，原来到处都是破绽！
voiceDesc.en: Uncle Pan always tells me to record my training. Well, he's got a point — I had no idea how off my moves were until I watched the playback!

voiceDesc.cn: 呼，原、原来是晋升啊！我还以为叫我过来，是因为我犯了什么事儿……
voiceDesc.en: P-promotion? Phew... I thought I was in trouble for something I messed up!

voiceDesc.cn: 一回生二回熟，这回我完全知道了！管理员，我最近的表现是不是有望冲击本月“办公室座椅竞速比赛”的头名？！
voiceDesc.en: It's always tough at first, but I've totally got the hang of it now. Endmin, you've seen my recent performance. Think I can win the Office Chair Racing this month?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，能不能透露一下，往上还有多少级啊？……我只是要更新日记本的内容，比如说——“本月目标”！
voiceDesc.en: Hey Endmin, just curious — how many ranks come after this one? I'm thinking of adding "Monthly Goals" section to my journal!

voiceDesc.cn: “鉴于你近期优秀的表现”“在行动中展现了良好的适应性和合作能力”……这些话我都能背下来了！管理员，我已经做好了充分的准备，我会成为你最信任的伙伴。
voiceDesc.en: "Outstanding performance," "strong adaptability and teamwork," ... I can recite those compliments in my sleep now. Anyway, Endmin, I'm ready to roll. I promise I'll work my hardest to become your most reliable comrade.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，是我是我，我叫黎风！我还是个新手，您见笑了！我一直被教导，艰难困苦，玉汝于成！可我还在琢磨，到底怎么样才能算是“成”呢……变得像您这样吗？那么，能请您多指教吗？
voiceDesc.en: Hey Endministrator, it's me, Lifeng! I'm still a bit green, but I'll work super hard! They say hardships shape and perfect us, but what does perfection really look like? Maybe someone like you has the answer. I'd really appreciate your insights.

voiceDesc.cn: 手到擒来！
voiceDesc.en: Piece of cake!

voiceDesc.cn: 交给我吧！
voiceDesc.en: Leave it to me!

voiceDesc.cn: 收到，管理员！我刚刚还在琢磨你怎么这会儿才来找我呢！
voiceDesc.en: Got it, Endmin! Actually, I was just wondering what took you so long to assign me a task!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你好忙啊！好难得见你一回！
voiceDesc.en: Hi Endmin! You look tied up, but it's good to see you.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员有空吗？我学了个新招，给你看看！
voiceDesc.en: Got a sec, Endmin? I've picked up a new move. Wanna check it out?

voiceDesc.cn: 咳……这种时候应该怎么说话呢……管理员，终末地正式干员黎风向您问好。
voiceDesc.en: Uh ... what should I say in a moment like this... Lifeng, official operator of Endfield Industries. It's an honor to meet you.

voiceDesc.cn: 啊，你刚才就瞧见我了？……我没有在这里等任务啊，没有，嘿嘿……
voiceDesc.en: Oh, you saw me just now and wonder why I'm still here? Uh ... I'm totally not waiting for a mission. Hehe, not at all!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你还认识别的阿纳萨吗？我们这一支好久以前就生活在城市里了，但我听说还有一些族人留在荒野里……下次你见到和我不一样的阿纳萨，叫我去看看！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, do you know any other Anasa? My branch of the family has lived in the city for ages, but I've heard that other branches still live in the wilds. If you happen to come across them, please let me know so I can pay them a visit!

voiceDesc.cn: 其实我……会晕车，连武陵那种动力五轮车我都吃不消。但是在帝江号上站着，还真没感觉到自己在动呢。
voiceDesc.en: Actually ... I get carsick pretty easily. Even riding a five-wheeler at Wuling would make me queasy. But for some reason, I don't feel any motion at all on Dijiang.

voiceDesc.cn: 用帝江号上的望远镜真的能看到息壤堰啊！就是很小，好像两根手指头就能夹起来……没想到那么大的东西，换个角度看就变得这么渺小。唔，我得去琢磨琢磨。
voiceDesc.en: I can actually see the Xiranite Dam through Dijiang's telescope! It looks so tiny from here, like I could pinch it between two fingers... Amazing how a change in perspective makes something huge seem small. Mmm, I need to ponder on this.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，培养舱里的植物，一直都是有人专门照顾的吧？……有意思，它们竟然能在离地面这么远的地方生长。不过，我也没想到我会在这儿就是了。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, there's someone looking after the plants in the growth chambers, right? Ooh... It's amazing to think they can thrive here, a place so far above the ground. But hey, I didn't think I'd be here either.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，上次打游戏输给你的时候说好给你送的小礼物，嘿嘿，你快拿着！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, remember I promised you a gift when I lost that game to you? Well, here it is!

voiceDesc.cn: 这是大家都有的奖励？……专门给我的吗？！谢谢您，管理员！
voiceDesc.en: Is everyone getting this?... No? It's just for me? Thank you so much, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，您刚刚是在跟我说话吗？我……还没有走过汇报工作的流程。噢，只是聊聊天啊，好的，您想知道什么，我全都告诉您！
voiceDesc.en: Were you speaking to me, Endministrator? My apologies, I've ... never really followed the standard reporting procedure before. Oh, you just want to talk? Then feel free to ask anything. I'll gladly give you all the details.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我从小就跟着潘叔习武，有一次大院着火了，我右肩扛起两个小孩，左肩上还架着一个，这么就往外冲！您看到上周的测试数据了吗？医疗部的老师说我就是胳膊腿儿细了点，出拳的力道不输别人！有敌人要打，千万记得叫上我！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, I've been training in martial arts with Uncle Pan since I was a kid. Once, when our family compound caught fire, I threw two kids over my right shoulder, one more over my left, and rushed them to safety! By the way, did you see the test data from last week? The Medical Division says my toothpick arms aren't an issue, and my punches hit just as hard as anyone's. So if you need someone to take down enemies, I'm your guy!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我申请来终末地时，您读过弭长官、庄天师、潘叔给我写的证明信了吧？我当时求了好久，他们不太愿意让我出这么远的门。但是我心意已决，一定要出来历练一番。所以，不能浪费这个宝贵的机会，您就对我委以重任吧！……好，我这就去打扫动力舱！
voiceDesc.en: When I applied to join Endfield, I brought a few letters of recommendation. I trust you've read them all, haven't you? I begged Captain Mi, Tianshi Zhuang, and Uncle Pan so much — they preferred I stay closer to home. But I'm determined to learn through experience, which is why I have to make the most of this opportunity. Endmin, please give me something major! ...Oh, engine room cleaning? Got it, I'll make every gear shine!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员亲自来邀请我？！咳，我将尽全力为行动小组分忧解难。我对战术布置已经有了些想法，这是我昨晚听你们提到后做出的五种预案。去哪里签字？……一般这种情况不需要签字吗？好的，就来。
voiceDesc.en: An invite straight from the Endmin?! Ahem, in that case, I'll do everything I can to help the operations team. I've already put together five contingency plans after hearing your briefing last night. So, where do I sign? Wait, no signature needed? ALRIGHTY! Here I come!

voiceDesc.cn: 接下来的旅程，我会成为您的左膀右臂！……扑哧，看您的表情，是不是觉得我在开自己的玩笑？哈哈，没关系的，我一定是一只能堪大任的“手臂”，有朝一日，我会扛起一切的。管理员，等我。
voiceDesc.en: From here on, I'll be your right hand man... Hmph, you probably think I'm joking, don't you? Haha, it's okay. I might not look the part now, but I'll grow into it. One day, I'll be capable enough to take on the toughest missions. So look forward to it, okay, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 要不要跟我掰手腕？我可以玩这个玩一整天！
voiceDesc.en: Wanna arm wrestle with me? I can do this all day long!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，给人送花这件事有一个诀窍，我教你。从一捧花里抽出来一朵，留在自己手里，这样等自己手里那朵花凋谢了，就知道送给对方的花也该换新的了。嘿嘿，这其实也是我自己悟出来的办法，不然爸爸妈妈墓前的花谢了，我总是没法及时换新的。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, I know a little trick for sending flowers. When you send a bouquet, keep one flower. When it wilts, you know it's time to send a new bunch. *Giggle* I actually thought of it myself. It's how I make sure my parents' tombs always have fresh flowers.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地的大家伙儿，好像都有点害羞。比如说，我发现有几位干员很好奇我每天早上在房门口打的那套宏山拳法，他们会偷偷跟在我后面，学我沉肩运劲……但我一回头他们就跑掉了。后来，队伍越来越长，我至今都没问过他们的名字……
voiceDesc.en: Everyone at Endfield seems a little shy. Like, when I was practicing Hongshan boxing in the morning, I saw some curious operators watching from a distance. They tried to mimic my moves, copying how I relax my shoulders and channel my force. But the moment I turned around, they'd scattered. The group has gotten even bigger lately. I still haven't asked any of their names...

voiceDesc.cn: 这只手没了的时候我还很小，那时候也不知道痛不痛的事儿，就记得……进医院的那一刻是春天，走出来的时候，又是春天了，但是……好像有些东西再也长不出来了。
voiceDesc.en: I was just a little boy when I lost this arm, and at the time, the pain didn't quite register with me... It was spring when I entered the hospital, and spring again when I left. *Sigh* And I realized ... that some things, once lost, never return.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我这回出来这么远，不知道老家那群朋友们怎么样了。街坊邻里的大小事我都记得很清楚：白奶奶什么时候要去按摩腰；刘巡卫的腿下雨天要换药；李阿姨要做红烧肉，每周三都得买酱油；小然去采样总是忘记带手套；阿仔做小本生意，月初总是要找我借点儿“本金”……下次联系他们的时候，我得把每个人都问候一圈！
voiceDesc.en: I've come a long way from home, Endmin. I really wonder how everyone's doing back there. I still remember the little things: Granny Bai heading out for her back massage, Captain Liu changing his leg dressing when it rained, Auntie Li buying soy sauce for her braised pork on Wednesdays, Xiao Ran always forgetting her gloves during sampling, and Ah Zai borrowing money from me at the start of every month for his little business... I'll make sure to check in on them the next chance I get!

voiceDesc.cn: 我这只义肢，在庄天师没空的时候，都是潘叔帮我养护的。他在机械啊，工程啊那些事情上，可是一把好手！只是不知道他为什么要解甲归田……管理员，偷偷告诉你，我看过老照片，潘叔早年风光得很——蹬着五轮车！机车服、大墨镜、爆炸头！据说在宏山科学院的时候，他操着一把菜刀就能从环带砍到开拓区……想不到吧？
voiceDesc.en: When Tianshi Zhuang's too swamped, Uncle Pan helps me with my prosthetic. He's actually a whiz with machines! He knows everything from engineering to fine-tuning gear. I've always wondered why he chose to retire. Psst, Endmin! Wanna hear a little secret? I've seen photos of him back in the day — rocking a five-wheeler, leather jacket, shades, and a wild afro! I heard he was unstoppable at HAS. Folks said he could chop his way from the Band to the frontier with a Yanese cleaver. Shocking, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 我小时候经常去庄天师的实验室写作业。她有空的时候，就帮我调整手臂的参数，只是每次调着调着就睡着了……她的屋子其实都是我帮着收拾的。她真的太忙了，没时间做这些琐事……她把整个武陵都扛在肩上呢。
voiceDesc.en: When I was a kid, I used to do my homework in Tianshi Zhuang's lab. She'd fine-tune my prosthetic when she had a moment — then quickly fall asleep mid-fix. Most of the time, I was the one tidying her place. She was way too busy for chores. But hey, that's fair — the future of all Wuling's riding on her shoulders.

voiceDesc.cn: 虽然弭长官不让我们这么说，但是她其实很善良。她见到我，总是丢给我几块钱，让我去田老姨的摊上替她买一串糖油粑粑。她会把粑粑全部捋下来给我吃——光是叼着那根小竹签，她就一副很满足的样子。
voiceDesc.en: Captain Mi doesn't like us saying it, but she's actually a really nice person. Every time she saw me, she'd slip me a few coins and ask me to grab a skewer of Tangyoubaba from Auntie Tian's stall. It's a sweet treat made of sugar-glazed rice balls. When I brought it back, she'd slide them off the skewer and let me enjoy all the sticky goodness for myself. She'd just nibble on the bamboo stick with a contented smile.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们武陵人要活下去，从小就得跟这东西斗智斗勇。以前在天师桩阵列没完工的时候，我们都不敢靠近未知的水源。大人们吓唬我们说，沾上天使，它们就会从家里的管道、地砖缝里爬出来……嗐，我们都习惯了。不过，我也是来了终末地，才知道原来世界上还有其他模样的天使……
voiceDesc.en: We Wuling kids grew up fighting these buggerloids just to survive. Back when the Tianshi Pillars were still going up, even getting near unknown water was a risk. The adults used to scare us — "Touch the Aggeloi, and they'll crawl out of your drain or between your floor tiles." Sounded like a ghost story, but that was life. Honestly, I didn't even know there were other kinds of Aggeloi till I joined Endfield.

voiceDesc.cn: 爸爸妈妈说，我们的祖上在跨越星门前，不是像在塔卫二这样生活在城市里的。他们在炎国移动城市边缘的荒漠和草原游荡，以天为被，以地为席，与世界一道生与灭。现在想来，他们反复对我提起这些传说，是为了告诉我，哪怕有一天他们的“实在”离开了，也会以另一种样子，回到我的身边。所以，我早就……不想念他们了。
voiceDesc.en: Mom and Dad used to say our ancestors weren't city folks. Before they crossed the Cosmic Gate to Talos-II, they roamed the dry plains outside the Nomadic City of Yan — sky for a blanket, earth for a bed, living with the land's rise and fall. I didn't get it then, but I do now. Mom and Dad weren't just telling me a story — they were preparing me. Even when their Astitva left this world, they'd return in another form. That's why… I stopped missing them a long time ago.

voiceDesc.cn: 你们现在看到的武陵，历史也不算长呢——就和我这只手差不多岁数！在这么短的时间里，它就变成了塔卫二上数一数二好的地方，是不是特别神奇？但是，就算它变得再快，我都能记住每一块砖的位置。我现在闭上眼睛，都能回想起下雨的阴天，街上那股湿漉漉的味道。
voiceDesc.en: The Wuling you see today hasn't been around for long — it's about the same age as my prosthetic arm! Pretty incredible, right? In such a short time, it's grown into one of the finest places on Talos-II. Still, no matter how much it's changed, I know where every brick belongs in the city. If I close my eyes now, I can still smell the damp air of those rain-soaked streets on a drizzly day.

voiceDesc.cn: 说到这个，我还没去过宏科院本部呢！爸爸妈妈当年是从那边过来的，和庄天师、潘叔他们一块儿。我……也没太想过去宏山这事儿，那边没有一个我认识的人……听说那里全是聪明脑袋打架，我有点担心他们看不上我……
voiceDesc.en: Funny thing — I've never actually been to HAS HQ. That's where Mom, Dad, Tianshi Zhuang, and Uncle Pan all worked. I just never had a reason to go. I mean ... I don't know anyone there, and from what I've heard, it's full of sharp minds and short tempers. I guess I've always worried they wouldn't take me seriously...

voiceDesc.cn: 走路留心脚边的好东西！
voiceDesc.en: Watch your step, there could be goodies around!

voiceDesc.cn: 那东西好稀罕！我们上那边看看去？
voiceDesc.en: Rare stuff spotted. Shall we check it out?

voiceDesc.cn: 这条路你认识吗？我们好像还没走过。
voiceDesc.en: You sure you know this path? I don't think we've been down it before.

voiceDesc.cn: 敌人！让我来，让我去！
voiceDesc.en: Enemy sighted! Let me handle this!

voiceDesc.cn: 课本上讲过这些东西！是不是很值钱啊？
voiceDesc.en: I've seen these in textbooks! Are they valuable?

voiceDesc.cn: 举手之劳！
voiceDesc.en: No trouble at all!

voiceDesc.cn: 捡到这么好的东西，是不是要上交给巡卫啊……
voiceDesc.en: Nice find. Do we really have to turn it over to the watchguards...?

voiceDesc.cn: 老师说，野外飘浮的醚质其实很安全，只是不要追得太深。
voiceDesc.en: My mentor said the floating Aurylenes in the wilds aren't really dangerous. Just don't go after them recklessly.

voiceDesc.cn: 武陵的孩子从小就跟侵蚀打交道，小事儿，交给我！
voiceDesc.en: The Blight's nothing new to us Wuling kids. Don't worry, I got this one!

voiceDesc.cn: 好像全身涌过一股暖流……我得起来热热身，活动活动！
voiceDesc.en: I feel a warm surge coursing through me... Time to get up and stretch a little!

voiceDesc.cn: 全都给你，快好起来啊！
voiceDesc.en: Grab my meds! Heal yourself!

voiceDesc.cn: 我喘口气儿，马上就好！
voiceDesc.en: One sec, just need a quick breather!

voiceDesc.cn: 哇啊啊，快闪开！
voiceDesc.en: WARHH, dodge the attack!

voiceDesc.cn: 还能坚持，还能坚持……
voiceDesc.en: Keep going ... gotta keep going...

voiceDesc.cn: 要是我足够强大……
voiceDesc.en: If only I were stronger...

voiceDesc.cn: 怎么做到的？教教我！
voiceDesc.en: How'd you do that? Please teach me!

voiceDesc.cn: 大开眼界了！我也不能落后！
voiceDesc.en: That was incredible! I'm fired up!

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿嘿，别夸我了吧……
voiceDesc.en: Heh heh, you're making me blush...

voiceDesc.cn: 三人行必有我师，我们有四个人！
voiceDesc.en: Two heads are better than one, and four are even better!

voiceDesc.cn: 晚辈武陵城黎风，失礼了！
voiceDesc.en: Lifeng of Wuling, ready to fight!

voiceDesc.cn: 谅他们接不住我这枪！
voiceDesc.en: They can't handle my lance!

voiceDesc.cn: 这一架打得痛快极了！
voiceDesc.en: Now that's what I call a real fight!

voiceDesc.cn: 呀，这就结束了？我还有几招没使……
voiceDesc.en: Is that it? I haven't even shown you my best moves...

voiceDesc.cn: 叫他们好好瞧瞧！
voiceDesc.en: Hmph, we taught them a lesson!

voiceDesc.cn: 最好的永远是下一场战斗，大家稳住。
voiceDesc.en: Victory loves preparation. Keep pushing, team.

voiceDesc.cn: 潘叔说，出枪不是比手快，而是看谁心稳，这口气我还是没沉住。歇口气，再来一次。
voiceDesc.en: Uncle Pan says that being a great lancer isn't about speed, it's about keeping your cool. I lost mine this time, but I'll regroup and go again!

voiceDesc.cn: 看我的！
voiceDesc.en: Watch this!

voiceDesc.cn: 得罪了！
voiceDesc.en: Pardon my strike!

voiceDesc.cn: 明心见性！
voiceDesc.en: Purity grants truth!

voiceDesc.cn: 何苦来哉！
voiceDesc.en: Obsession breeds sorrow!

voiceDesc.cn: 心快，枪快！
voiceDesc.en: A keen mind strikes quick!

voiceDesc.cn: 尽管招呼我！
voiceDesc.en: Give me a shout anytime!

voiceDesc.cn: 助你一臂之力！
voiceDesc.en: Let me help!

voiceDesc.cn: 见识过这招吗？
voiceDesc.en: Ever seen this?

voiceDesc.cn: 伏魔金枪！
voiceDesc.en: You shall be banished!

voiceDesc.cn: 助你破执！
voiceDesc.en: Obsess no more!

voiceDesc.cn: 劝你罢手！
voiceDesc.en: Renounce or perish!

voiceDesc.cn: 猜猜在哪只手？
voiceDesc.en: Guess which hand will crush you?

voiceDesc.cn: 摧破业障，降伏诸恶！
voiceDesc.en: Evil shall face karmic justice!

voiceDesc.cn: 现忿怒相，破！
voiceDesc.en: I AM BECOME WRATH!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>再旅者干员莱万汀，由管理员直接引荐加入。结合其本人意愿，在得到人事部门同意及罗德岛授权后，以管理员直属干员的身份入职终末地工业。

莱万汀比预约时间提前了整整四十五分钟来到接待区，没多说话，只是把入职通知放在桌上，说：“我到了，可以开始了。”
开场流程她配合得很到位——签字、虹膜扫描、协议权限绑定，从头到尾一句多余的话都没说。我尝试用“欢迎来到终末地”来调节气氛，她点了点头，说：“我已经来了。”
在职业倾向测试环节，我照例询问她有没有考虑过在更多非战斗岗位发挥作用，比如计划制定、训练教学等等，她露出了明显不耐烦的表情。
最后，莱万汀干员只留下一句话：“让我去尽量多的地方，那些可以留下尽量多回忆的地方。”
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Reconvener and Operator Laevatain joined Endfield with the Endministrator's direct recommendation. After acquiring her personal agreement, as well as approval from the HR Division and authentication from Rhodes Island, Laevatain joined Endfield as an operator under the direct command of the Endministrator. 

Laevatain arrived at the reception area a full 45 minutes ahead of the agreed-upon schedule. She simply placed the employment notification on the table and said little else except, "I'm here. We can begin." 
She was quite cooperative during the initial phase of the interview — giving her signature, submitting a retinal scan, and linking her Protocol Authority Level without a single fuss or comment. I tried to liven up the atmosphere by saying, "Welcome to Endfield." She nodded and replied, "I'm already here." 
During job-inclination testing, I followed the prescribed list of questions and asked if she considered utilizing her skill set in other non-combat roles, such as combat planner, coach, or instructor. She did not say anything but appeared obviously annoyed. 
In the end, Operator Laevatain left with this final line: "Just let me go to as many places you can — places that let me build as much memories as I can." 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>终末地工业的管理员、佩丽卡监督：
很高兴得知莱万汀已经在管理员的帮助下回归。她的旅程远未结束，但这至少说明，她已找到了新的目标和愿意同行的人。
莱万汀是被强烈的“愿望”驱使而踏上塔卫二的。第一次察觉到她的存在时，那炽烈的光芒令人目眩。后来我意识到，那是她的内核——解答“我是谁”这个问题的执念——在闪耀着。
在执念的牵引下，碎片苏醒为完整的人格，崭新的“她”走出源石森林，以“莱万汀”之名来到罗德岛。我原以为她会马上成为我们强大的支援，但被她拒绝了。如同特立独行的史尔特尔一样，她无法被引导，也不能被强留；在从失忆的迷瘴中找到答案之前，她不会属于任何一方。因此，我们决定打开大门，送她远行。
我担心过，莱万汀的选择会使其他再旅者动摇，但我也觉得，正因为他们每个人都尚未忘怀曾经的目标，才会成为“再旅者”，并与你们在同一条路上重逢。现在，这块悬着的石头终于落了地。
既然她已经正式加入终末地，与你们并肩作战，那根据我对“她”的了解，给你们一些“相处建议”吧。
第一，坦然面对她的直率。她说话经常毫不修饰，那不是敌意，也不是厌恶，更不是无礼，这往往代表她最真诚的态度——“我愿意直接告诉你我的想法”。
第二，如果她真的表现出明显的愤怒和不耐烦，不要试图说服她“冷静”。相信我，用点别的手段会更快见效。比如冰淇淋或者其他能快速“降温”的东西。她并非不能沟通的人，只是不喜欢“被教导”。
顺带一提，在离开罗德岛前，她拿走了我实验室冷藏柜里所有的猩红莓果冰淇淋——而且还理直气壮地在我面前吃完了。“你不是说记忆会骗人的么？”她舔着勺子说，“那我就多吃点，这样留下的记忆才会更牢固。”这既是她的告别，也是对记忆最真诚的保存。她其实比大家想象的，还要在意眼前的人。
第三，其实她和史尔特尔还挺像的，不过以她的个性……请千万、千万不要在她面前说她像史尔特尔，也别说她不像史尔特尔，总之除非她主动提及，不要将二人相互比较。切记！
愿你们在塔卫二同行顺利。

罗德岛</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Endministrator and Supervisor Perlica of Endfield Industries: 
I am extremely pleased to learn that Laevatain has returned with the Endministrator's help. Though her journey is far from complete, her return proves that she has found a new objective and people whom she is willing to travel with. 
Extremely powerful "desire and hope" drove Laevatain to step onto the lands of Talos-II. When we first sensed her existence, the light she gave off was bedazzling. I later realized that this light was emitted by her obsession — her innermost ego demanding the answer: "Who am I?" 
Led on by the said obsession, the fragments awakened and created a complete persona. "She" walked out of the Originium Woods, new and intact, and arrived at Rhodes Island bearing the name "Laevatain". I thought she would immediately become one of our strongest assets and supporters, but she turned us down. Just like Surtr who had always walked alone, no one can command Laevatain or force her to stay in one place. She will answer to no faction until she finds the answer to dispel her own miasma of amnesia. Hence, we decided to open the doors and give her our best farewells. 
Once, I was worried that Laevatain's choice would affect other reconveners. Then I realized that they became reconveners because every one of them did not forget the old dream and vision. And that is why they reconvened with you on this very same path. Now, this thought alone has lifted a stone off my chest. 
Since Laevatain is currently an official Endfielder fighting along your side, then allow me to share a few words of advice (based on my knowledge of "her") for "getting along with her". 
Firstly, accommodate and accept Laevatain's straightforward nature. She often says whatever that comes to her mind. It is not an act of hostility, malice, or rudeness. In fact, such words are a symbol of her sincere and undisguised attitude — "I prefer to simply tell you what I'm thinking right now." 
Secondly, should Laevatain exhibit obvious signs of fury or impatience, do not attempt to persuade her to "calm" down. Believe me, there are more effective means, such as the provision of ice cream or other things that can rapidly "cool" the situation. Laevatain is someone you can communicate with, but she dislikes "being told what to do". 
Just as a side note, before she left Rhodes Island, she took all the crimsonberry ice cream from my lab freezer — and ate them all, right before my eyes, as though it was the right thing to do. "Thought you told me memories can lie," she said as she licked the spoon, "So I better have more of this to make it as memorable as possible." Laevatain marked her farewell with this action to ensure the veracity of the moment. She actually cares very deeply about her friends, far more deeply than most would like to think. 
Thirdly, Laevatain is extremely similar to Surtr, but according to her temperament... Do not tell her that she resembles Surtr. Also, do not tell her that she DOES NOT resemble Surtr. In fact, do not ever compare her to Surtr, unless she brings the topic up herself. Always remember this! 
Best wishes in your collective journey across Talos-II. 

Rhodes Island </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>《终末地工业医疗部门服务手记》
记录人：心理医师杜拉·格蕾

【记录一】
安斯沃思医生被紧急派往地面，所以这将是我入职终末地以来，第一次单独提供心理支援服务，内容是为一名新加入干员进行心理测评。希望这对我和她都是一个好的开始。
…………
等待了六个小时，那位干员没有出现。

【记录二】
我再次核对了资料，那位干员是一名被“多重记忆混乱”所困扰的再旅者，以后还是由我来专门负责。
和莱万汀干员的第二次（实际上可以说是初次）会面很顺利，我们补上了未能进行的心理测评，她解释了上一次失约的理由——那时她正被噩梦造成的烦躁情绪困扰，因此径直前往地面“散了散心”。在我的疏导下，她同意复述那些梦境。

她梦见自己站在一间教室中，同学们依次上台介绍自己。轮到她上台时，张口，却发不出声音；再试，喉咙发痛，最终只吐出模糊喑哑的音节。
老师转身，面容是一团腾跃的火焰：“你说不出来，因为你从来都不曾拥有自己的生活。”
她尝试离开教室，却进入到另一间熟悉又陌生的屋子中，周围的一切都在燃烧，火焰吞噬墙壁、书页、镜子。房间中还站着她的同学、朋友、师长、亲人，甚至在罗德岛和帝江号上结识的同僚，但那些人的面目也都被烈火扭曲，不堪辨认。
她跑向门口，发现门后是同一间屋子——燃烧着的、她刚刚离开的那一间。再跑，再开门，仍然是同样的景象。
每一次，房间都变得更小，火焰离她更近。
最后，她推开门，来到无火无烟、只余一片灰烬的房间。房间正中坐着另一个自己，对她微笑：
“你终于把一切烧光了。”

以上反复出现的梦境，源自某些在她脑中盘桓已久的“记忆”，其真假已无从辨明。原来，她一直在与这样的东西“同行”。

【记录三】
尝试为莱万汀干员拟定了若干治疗建议，但效果欠佳。在请示过安斯沃思医生之后，我询问莱万汀干员：如果困扰她的记忆和噩梦始终不可能停歇，是否考虑以医疗方法抹去这些记忆？
她沉思片刻，给出了否定的答案。
数日后，她向我讲述了另一个梦境。

她在一个白色的世界中醒来，天空纯净无瑕，地面一望无际。
她走了很久，没有风，没有人，没有声音，也没有影子。
走到尽头，那里矗立着一扇门，门上写着——如果你不想是任何人，请进去。
她停下脚步。没有选择推开门。

这次会面结束时，莱万汀干员赠予我一束火红色的花，作为“日后继续分担这些记忆”的感谢。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Endfield Industries Medical Division Service Log 
AUTHOR: Dulla Gray, clinical psychologist 

LOG 1 
Surgeon Answorth has been dispatched to the surface in response to an emergency. So, this is my first time providing psychotherapeutic services on my own ever since I joined Endfield. The details of the job is to provide psychological evaluations for an onboarding operator. I hope this is the start of a beautiful relationship between us. 
............ 
I've waited for six hours but the operator did not show up. 

LOG 2 
I verified the records. Turns out the operator is a reconvener troubled by "polymnestic disorders". I remain the chief therapist in charge of this case. 
My second meeting (which is technically the first, all facts considered) with Operator Laevatain was successful. I did the psychological evaluations that we missed last time, and she also explained why she failed to show up for that meeting. It appeared that she was deeply troubled and annoyed by certain nightmares. Hence, she chose to head to the surface and "sort the feelings out". With my encouragement, she agreed to describe her dreams to me. 

Laevatain dreamed of herself standing in a classroom. One by one her classmates introduced themselves on the stage. But when it was her turn, she tried to open her mouth but no voice came out. She tried again, but her throat began to hurt and she only managed to emit blurred, raspy noises. 
The teacher turned around, but a raging flame danced where her face should be, "You could not say it because you never had your own life." 
Laevatain tried to leave the classroom, only to find herself in a familiar yet alien-looking house. Everything around her was burning. The fire consumed the walls, the books, and the mirrors. Her classmates, friends, teachers, families, and even colleagues she met in Rhodes Island and Dijiang stood in the room, but all their faces were contortions of twisted flame and no longer recognizable. 
She then ran for the door and forced her way through, only to find herself in the exact same house, also on fire. She ran again, opened the door, and saw the same thing. 
With every door she went through, the room got smaller and the flames got closer. 
In the end, she opened the final door and arrived at a room of ashes with neither fire nor smoke. She saw herself seated in the room, smiling at her: 
"You finally burnt everything." 

Laevatain's recurring dream appears to be rooted in "memories" she has carried in her mind. Whether these are drawn from real experiences or mere illusions is unclear, but it seems she has been journeying with this burden for a long time. 

LOG 3 
I tried prescribing several recommended therapies for Operator Laevatain but the results were less than ideal. After receiving suggestions from Surgeon Answorth, I asked Laevatain if she ever considered medical removal of these memories as the scenes and nightmares continue to affect her in an unabated fashion. 
She pondered for a moment and denied this advice. 
Several days later, she described another dream to me. 

In this dream, Laevatain woke up in a white world. The sky was clean and flawless, and the land seemed endless. 
She walked for a long time without feeling the wind. She met no one, heard nothing, and saw no shadows. 
A door stood at the very end. Posted on the door was a note — Enter, if you do not wish to be anyone else. 
There she stopped. She chose not to open the door. 

When the session ended, Operator Laevatain gave me a bunch of fiery red flowers — a token of gratitude for "future sessions of memory-sharing". </>

<@profile.key>《战斗适应性测试记录》（文件编号：L-067）
【测试者】莱万汀（再旅者）
【监控员】卡拉德（终末地安全专家）
【测试系统】S7战斗模拟系统
【测试内容】群体压制、精准打击模拟
【测试时长】3分42秒
【测试结果】通过（有条件）

【记录摘要】
第一阶段测试开始后第7秒，干员莱万汀即单手唤出火焰巨剑（无装备识别编号，推测为其个人源石技艺衍生物），未作口令确认，直接冲入模拟敌群核心。
热能读数在31秒时突破测试场阈值，系统自动启动高温应对程序。安全专家卡拉德要求中止测试，被干员莱万汀拒绝。
1分24秒，干员莱万汀全毁敌方单位，并在战场中央以站立姿态调整呼吸，调节高强度爆发后的状态。
38秒后恢复战斗，进入第二阶段测试，开始执行“定点压制”环节。其表现较第一阶段更加激进，于1分40秒后完成测试。

【行为总结】
作战风格呈现显著进攻性，优先以力破局。
以主动战斗代替战术协同，团队配合意识不稳定。
情绪接近临界时会大幅激化武器效能，表现为外焰扩散、局部灼痕、信号干扰等现象。

【测试简评】
她很强，但尚未具备相应的心理建设。她并非享受毁灭，而是用战斗宣泄情绪，确认自己的存在。她必须从这种不稳定的状态中学会自我约束——控制火，而不是成为火。否则，一旦与医疗人员和掩护人员脱节，谁都救不了她。
——安全专家卡拉德评语

你们让我来测试不是为了确认“我还能不能打”，而是想知道“我会不会失控”？放心吧……我分得清。
——干员莱万汀自述

【附注】战斗测试区域需重新铺设耐高温层，如有下一次测试，需准备“冷却剂饮品”三份。

《行动简报补录》（文件编号：SU-58R-TR）
在本次战斗行动中，作战成员莱万汀于战斗初期选择独自突进，未响应队内战术信号。此举一度导致通信中断，指挥链混乱，并引发队员间短暂的恐慌，所幸未造成减员。
行动结束后，根据残留能量痕迹与战术记录仪分析可确认，莱万汀干员采取主动暴露位置、持续释放高热火焰干扰敌方布防的方式，成功引诱敌方火力向其转移。她以自身为诱饵制造突破口，掩护主攻干员渗透，成功达成战术目标。
行动结束后，莱万汀干员独自坐于熔岩残渣旁，周围焦痕表明其所处区域曾承受高密度打击。检视战场期间她未发一言，仅在确认其他干员无恙后，低声说了一句：“那就好。”</>
