<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Combat Adaptation Test Records (ID: L-067) 
CANDIDATE: Laevatain (reconvener) 
MONITOR: Krad (Endfield Security Professional) 
OS: S7 Combat Simulation System 
CONTENTS: Mass suppression and precision strikes 
DURATION: 3 minutes 42 seconds 
RESULTS: Pass (conditional) 

TEST SUMMARY 
At the 7th second of Phase 1, Operator Laevatain summons a giant flaming blade with one hand (no equipment ID identified; said blade is likely created by Laevatain's Originium Arts) and charges directly into the center of the simulated enemy group before verbal instructions were given nor confirmed. 
At the 31st second, thermal readings exceeded simulation environment monitoring thresholds. System automatically activates anti-heat measures. Security Professional Krad requests to stop the test but Operator Laevatain denies the request. 
At the 1-minute and 24-second mark, Operator Laevatain had destroyed all enemy units and assumed a standing pose in the center of the simulation area, while adjusting her breathing after a high-intensity burst of activities. 
Combat resumed after 38 seconds to initiate Phase 2. Test item "Stationery Suppression" was initiated. The operator's performance was far more extreme than Phase 1 and the entire test was completed after 1 minute and 40 seconds. 

BEHAVIORAL SUMMARY 
Combat style is highly aggressive and prioritizes breaking the stalemate with overwhelming force. 
Prefers seizing combat initiative instead of focusing on tactical coordination. Willingness to support teamwork is unstable. 
Weapon efficacy is significantly improved at emotional thresholds. Effects include spreading fire, localized scorch marks, and signal interference. 

TEST REVIEW 
She is incredibly powerful but has yet to build up the mental fortitude to master it. She does not enjoy destruction, but uses combat as a means to vent her emotions and prove her existence. She must learn how to restrain herself and bring that instability under control — master the fire, but don't become the fire. If she loses her connection to medic or support operators in the team, no one would be able to save her. 
— Evaluations by Krad, Security Professional 

I don't think you gave me this test to see if I can still fight. You wanted to know if I would "lose control", right? Don't worry ... I know exactly what I'm doing. 
— Comments from Operator Laevatain 

NOTE: New thermal insulation must be installed in the combat testing area. If there is another test, also prepare 3 servings of Coolant Beverages. 

DOCUMENT: Post-Operational Summary (ID: SU-58R-TR) 
During this combat operation, Operator Laevatain charged into the enemy on her own accords at the initial stages of battle, and did not respond to tactical calls from her team. Her actions temporarily severed communications, disrupted the chain of command, and caused momentary panic amongst team members. Fortunately, the team did not suffer any casualties. 
When the operation ended, analyses of residual energy traces and tactical dataloggers confirmed that Operator Laevatain successfully diverted the focus of enemy fire toward herself with these means: deliberate exposure of her own position and continuous emission of super hot flames that disrupt enemy defenses. In other words, she used herself as a lure to create a tactical breach and allowed our attacking operators to exploit the opening and achieve our tactical objectives. 
Upon concluding the operation, Operator Laevatain sat on a cooled fragment of molten rock. Burn marks in the vicinity suggested that this area was subjected to extremely intensive strikes. Laevatain said nothing as we surveyed the battlefield. After ascertaining that all other operators were well, she softly said, "Good." </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【直属干员定期工作汇报】
汇报人：莱万汀

我护送信使来到了这个火山盆地。滚烫的岩浆被封在脚底下，加热雨水与溪流，让地面不停地轻轻冒泡，监测站就坐落在这口“活着的汤锅”上。
源石在这里很稀缺，驻守的研究员靠地热来烹饪食物：口粮罐头埋在地里不到一小时就能熟。还有“口袋炖菜”，他们把汤和佐料一股脑倒进食用口袋里——片刻之后，用力咬开，热流直冲脑门，烫得我仿佛在喷火。
吃第一顿饭时，研究员教我用他们的“仪式”吟唱：“愿你的汤不洒，愿你的火不灭。”
我跟他唱了。这是我在塔卫二第一次被陌生人祝福。
——发自34号监测站

作为离事发地点最近、有能力响应紧急呼救的干员，我被要求以最快的速度抵达这座未标示在地图上的工团基地。
问题并不复杂。高炉发生故障后熄火，失去了动力。我稍微花费了点力气，帮他们重新点燃了核心。温度回升，系统复位，暂时渡过了危机。
给我留下难忘印象的，是他们的“名字”。这是一座秘密基地，位于严寒的█████，平时只能以特殊信标代码称呼它。在这里的每一个人，都被禁止透露自己的真实姓名，也不允许随意起代号，而只能使用被“分配”的名字。
我在这里的临时名字是“奥列加·朗道”。据说在此之前，这个名字已经经历了三个主人，而在我之后，它会被赋予递补派来的下一任计算员。
奇妙的体验。对“奥列加·朗道”这个名字而言，我只是它片刻的使用者。就像脑海中那些支离破碎的记忆，它们或许不属于我，在当下，却又暂时地构成了我。
——发自联盟工团信标DAU.14

解决了盘踞在货运中继站的天使之后，我重新打开了这条隧道紧闭已久的大门。
隧道里维持着失重环境，那些被困了几个月的避难者们纷纷飘到出口，然后颤颤巍巍地离开——他们得重新学习在沉重的引力下走路。
不过有一个女孩，她浮在隧道中间，自顾自跳了一段舞蹈后才出去。她告诉我，这是在被困的时间里保持心态平静的方式。
我记下了她的舞步，兼具舒缓与有力的韵律。如果你愿意，我回去后，可以带你试试。动作不难，重点是呼吸和节奏。
——发自MC-20货运枢纽

这段时间里，我有了很多新的记忆。我还记得，你也正在追寻自己的记忆。我发现了一些地方，和曾经那个“你”有关。感兴趣的话，可以直接来找我。
——加急信息，发自084A联络点</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Regular Work Report for Operators Under the Endministrator 
REPORTED BY: Laevatain 

I escorted the messenger to this volcanic basin. Molten lava flowed through the ground beneath our feet, heating the rain and creek, causing the earth to froth and bubble endlessly. The monitoring station stood right atop this "cauldron of living soup". 
This place is extremely poor in Originium. Resident scientists rely on geothermal heat to cook food. A ration tin can be cooked through simply by burying it in the dirt for an hour. They even have "pocket stews": a liquid stock and other ingredients sealed in a food-grade bag — after quick cooking, you can just tear it open with your teeth. I got a face full of hot stew once, and it felt like I was on fire. 
When I had my first meal, the scientist taught me to sing their "ritual" chant: "May your soup never spill, and may your flame never die." 
I sang the chant with him. It was the first time I received a stranger's blessing on Talos-II. 
— Sent from Monitoring Station 34 

As the Operator closest to the incident and the most capable emergency responder, I was ordered to reach the UWST base not marked on the map with the greatest speed I could muster. 
The issue was not complicated. Just an unexpected blast furnace malfunction, shutdown, and loss of power. I spent a bit of my powers and helped them re-ignite the core. Temperature returned to operational levels and the system was restored. The crisis was temporarily averted. 
Their "names" left quite an impression on me. The place was a secret base in the frigid lands of █████, usually referred to by its unique beacon code. Everyone there was forbidden from using their real names or any self-chosen codenames; only the "assigned" name was allowed. 
My temporary name here was "Olga Randall". I was told there were three others before me with the same name, and it's likely that the next replacement actuary sent here will also take on this name. 
It was a strange experience. I was just a temporary user of the name "Olga Randall". It felt similar to the memory fragments swimming in my mind. Neither the name nor the fragments were truly mine, but at that very moment, they were all part of me. 
— Sent from UWST Beacon DAU.14 

After eliminating the Aggelos camping in the freight station, I reopened the gate that had kept the tunnel sealed for quite a while. 
They maintained a low gravity environment within the tunnels. Refugees, trapped here for months, floated their way to the exit, trembling and struggling as they left the place. They must relearn how to walk and run under the ponderous influence of gravity. 
But there was a little girl who floated within the tunnels and danced for a bit before leaving the place. She told me it was how she kept herself calm and sane when they were trapped in this place. 
I memorized her dance, a comforting yet powerful routine of rhythms. If you want, I can show it to you and let you have a go once I head back. The moves aren't hard. It's all about the breathing and the rhythms. 
— Sent from freight nexus MC-20 

I've made plenty of new memories during this time. I still remember that you're chasing after your own memories as well. I found a few places related to the old "you". Seek me out if you're interested. 
— Emergency message, sent from Contact Point 084A </>

voiceDesc.cn: 我讨厌麻烦，但更讨厌无聊。
voiceDesc.en: I hate trouble, but boredom's worse.

voiceDesc.cn: 接下来的事，最好值得我记住。
voiceDesc.en: Whatever comes next better be memorable.

voiceDesc.cn: 有我一个人就够了。
voiceDesc.en: I can do this. Alone.

voiceDesc.cn: 我是剑，我是火焰。
voiceDesc.en: I am the sword. I am fire incarnate.

voiceDesc.cn: 这把剑不错，希望能承受住火焰的温度。
voiceDesc.en: Nice blade. Hope it can tolerate the heat of my fire.

voiceDesc.cn: 这点重量不妨碍我挥剑。防火层？多事。
voiceDesc.en: The weight won't slow down my attacks. Flame-resistant coating? Pfft.

voiceDesc.cn: 现在，了解我的实力了？
voiceDesc.en: So, how's that for my real power?

voiceDesc.cn: 值得参考。嗯，就这样。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm, solid reference.

voiceDesc.cn: 这算什么？鼓励？肯定？不需要。只不过是碰见了一些碍眼的家伙，顺便把它们都烧成了灰而已。
voiceDesc.en: What's this supposed to mean? Encouragement? Approval? Don't need those. All I did was run into a bunch of buggly things and turn them all to ash.

voiceDesc.cn: 所以按我晋升后的权限，可以要求马上举行一对一年度谈话了，对吧？走，现在陪我去吹吹风。
voiceDesc.en: Now that I've been promoted, my new authority level should give me a one-on-one annual review meeting, right? Good. Let's take a walk. I need some air.

voiceDesc.cn: 还来？我不需要信物作为嘉奖或回报。这样吧，如果是代表了共同的记忆，那我可以留下它，作为一种证明。
voiceDesc.en: Back again? I don't need any token for a job well done. But if you insist, I'll keep it as a symbol and proof ... for all the memories we made together.

voiceDesc.cn: 看来你们对我的依赖越来越深了。那这份荣誉，我就接受吧。从此以后，可以叫我终末地干员莱万汀……喂，别露出这种表情！
voiceDesc.en: You Endfielders seem to be increasingly reliant on me. I guess you leave me no choice, but to accept this honor. You may now address me as Endfield Operator Laevatain... Hey! What's up with that look on your face?

voiceDesc.cn: 我们不是见过了吗？比起自我介绍，还是用剑与火焰来记住我吧。
voiceDesc.en: Haven't we met already? Hmph. Doesn't matter. You'll remember me by this sword and flame.

voiceDesc.cn: 我讨厌乱指指点点的家伙，还好你不是。
voiceDesc.en: I hate fools who like to micro-manage. Thank goodness you're not one of them.

voiceDesc.cn: 你找我？想起了什么吗？
voiceDesc.en: Looking for me? You finally remember something?

voiceDesc.cn: 偶尔在这里浪费时间也不错……
voiceDesc.en: Hmm, seems like a good place to waste my time in...

voiceDesc.cn: 啊，你在这里。
voiceDesc.en: Ah, here you are.

voiceDesc.cn: 是你……别误会，我没在特意等你。
voiceDesc.en: It's you... Oh, I wasn't waiting for you specifically.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么在这里无所事事？出发，去舰桥，把你过去的足迹和未来的目的地都指给我看。
voiceDesc.en: Why are you idling here? C'mon, let's go to the Bridge. Then you can tell me all about the places you went in the past, and the destinations you have in store for the future.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……我为食堂有无限量供应的冰淇淋，向后勤部门表达崇高的敬意。要帮你拿一份吗？
voiceDesc.en: Mmmm... I hereby offer my utmost appreciation to the Logistics Division for the all-you-can-eat ice cream bar. Need me to grab a few scoops for you?

voiceDesc.cn: 待会儿有任务要去处理，一起？不，不用协议传送，我更喜欢用降落舱，带着火焰和呼啸直接砸到他们头上。
voiceDesc.en: I got a mission. Wanna come with? No, no need for tele-protocol. I prefer the drop pod. I'm going in a deafening howl of fire, right on top of their heads.

voiceDesc.cn: 感觉有点冷？是我要求把温控度数调低的，谁让这艘船连露天吹风的地方都没有。要是受不了的话，就站得离我近点儿。
voiceDesc.en: Cold? I told them to lower the thermostat, because some dummy built this ship and forgot to leave a spot for fresh air. If you can't take the cold, stand a little closer.

voiceDesc.cn: 空闲的时候，我能边吃冰淇淋边盯着外面看一整天。脑海里有成百上千段记忆，却没有哪一段是从这个角度看着大地与星空的。
voiceDesc.en: When I have nothing to do, I would just eat ice cream and enjoy the view outside. I can do that all day. My mind is filled with countless fragments of shattered memories. Yet none of them gave me a look of the world or starry nights from this angle.

voiceDesc.cn: 还被困在回忆里？哼，想不起来就别想了。记住接下来发生的事情。
voiceDesc.en: Still trapped in your memories? Hmph. If they're gone, they're gone. Just remember what happens from here on.

voiceDesc.cn: 给你的，作为你一直记住我的回报。嗯？不会忘记在意的人本身就是回报？嘁……
voiceDesc.en: Here. It's yours. Thanks for keeping me on your mind. Huh? Being able to remember someone you care about is gift enough...? Pfft...

voiceDesc.cn: 哦？我不是很喜欢接受礼物，因为最后总是会忘记。不过既然是你的……那就另当别论。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm, I don't really like receiving presents, because I always end up forgetting about them. But this one's from you ... so it will be an exception.

voiceDesc.cn: “莱万汀”，没错，我亲自选的，来自那把剑。有人说不算真名？它被我驯服之后，这名字当然也就属于我了。就像那些记忆——要做它们的支配者，而不是被支配。
voiceDesc.en: Laevatain? Yeah. Picked it myself. Got the idea from the sword. Some don't take it as my real name? Hmph, I tamed the thing so its name is mine. Just like those memories — I intend to rule over them, not be ruled by them.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的脑海里依然充斥着各种各样的记忆碎片，它们没有消失，只是我暂时不去看而已。如果哪一天收拾完了眼前的杂事，或许我会照着这些“记忆”，开始新的旅行。
voiceDesc.en: My mind is still filled with all sorts of fragmented memories. They didn't just vanish. I simply chose not to study them. Perhaps when I'm done taking care of these mundane chores, I'll follow these memories and start a new journey.

voiceDesc.cn: 史尔特尔……她的怒火，她的失落，她的茫然……都还留在我脑海里。那么真实，那么挥之不去。不过，一想到她自己最终做出的选择，我也就释然了。
voiceDesc.en: Surtr... All her rage, her sense of loss, and her confusion ... remain in my memories. They feel so real and permanent. Yet when I recall the decision she made for herself in the end, I find some measure of solace.

voiceDesc.cn: 再旅者的使命？我不在乎。那不过是又一个被硬塞给我的“记忆”罢了。真让我同意与你们并肩作战的，是在这里遇到的人、走过的路、寄宿过的甲板、收拾过的恶棍……这些真正属于我的记忆。
voiceDesc.en: The duty of the reconveners? I don't care about that. It's probably something stuffed into my memories. I only agreed to fight by your side because of the people I met, the paths I walked, the decks I napped on, and the breakers I crushed... It's because of the memories that are truly mine, made here in this place.

voiceDesc.cn: 之前不理解，为什么你不能和我一样放下过去。到了终末地，才看清楚——你是被层层期待包围的“管理员”，是每个人心目中“救世主”的投射。但一个人真正的模样，不该只由他人的愿望所塑造，所以你还是要通过记忆找回自我。在这条路上，无论去哪儿，都可以叫我同行。
voiceDesc.en: There's a time when I couldn't understand why you wouldn't just let go of the past. I only figured things out when I arrived at Endfield — You're the Endministrator, a vessel of everyone's expectations, and a projection of everyone's ideal of the world's savior. But nobody should allow their image to be molded by the wishful thinking of others. And that is why you must use your memories to rediscover your true self. If you need a companion for this journey, just give me a call. I won't care where you're headed.

voiceDesc.cn: 这道残缺的“环”？就当是我的宠物兼“施术单元”吧。终末地的武库工程师研究过它的具体原理，试图修复它……但被它自己阻止了。
voiceDesc.en: My shattered "Ring"? Treat it as my pet and "Arts Unit". The Arsenal Engineers of Endfield tried to figure out how it works. They also made an attempt to repair it... But the Ring acted out on its own, and put an end to that.

voiceDesc.cn: 来了？帮我看看这个：华法琳寄来的一幅拼图，说上面是泰拉的风景、人群、历史……大得出奇，耗了我很长时间，到现在都还没拼完。别盯着残损的地方看，那些烧焦的部分和我无关，收到的时候就是如此。
voiceDesc.en: You're here? Come look at this for me. Warfarin mailed me a jigsaw puzzle. She said it features the scenery, peoples, and histories of Terra... It's huge. I spent ages on this and it's still not done... Hey, quit staring at the torn edges. Also, I have nothing to do with the burned places. This was how it looked when I received it.

voiceDesc.cn: 在塔卫二执行任务的夜晚，我会梦见帝江号，还有终末地的人与事。我等待着，把脑海里那些不属于我的记忆一点一点遗忘，再用我亲身经历的记忆重新填满。
voiceDesc.en: When carrying out missions on Talos-II, I would dream of Dijiang as well as the people and events of Endfield at night. I am patiently waiting for my mind to forget every shard of the past that isn't mine, then fill the gaps with memories that I've forged myself.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么而挥剑战斗？为了有朝一日站在山巅，目睹世界被火海吞噬……你这是什么表情，我只是讲述了一个困扰我很久的梦魇而已。放心，无论什么时候，什么地方，我都不会让它成真的。
voiceDesc.en: Why do I fight? Because a day will come when I stand atop a mountain, and gaze upon a world consumed by fire... Why give me that look? I was simply describing a nightmare that's been annoying me for quite a while. Set your worries aside. I will not let the vision come to pass, no matter the time nor place.

voiceDesc.cn: 有时候是在荒野中徘徊的难民，有时候却成了摧毁城市的刽子手；前一刻还在庭院里修剪花朵，下一刻就在实验室里忍受刺鼻的药剂味；和看不清面目的人决斗，但不知道为何拔剑……别打瞌睡，我才刚开了头呢。
voiceDesc.en: Sometimes I'd see refugees roaming about the wildlands, or butchers who laid waste to entire cities. One minute, I'm pruning flowers in the garden; the next, I'm choking on chemicals in the lab. I fought shadowy figures whose faces I couldn't see, and I never knew why we were fighting... C'mon, stop dozing off. I barely got started.

voiceDesc.cn: 家乡？我到过一个叫“塞什卡”的地方，那里的建筑、语言、节日、巫术……的确有点“家”的熟悉感。不过我不想轻易再去了——他们有点过于热情，还有人管我叫“炎魔”……我实在不耐烦，在那里闹出了点乱子……
voiceDesc.en: My home? I've been to a place called Seš'qa. They had buildings, language, festivals, and witchcraft that ... felt familiar enough to be a "home". But I won't visit that place again unless there's a very good reason to — Their people were too warm and passionate. Some even called me a Diαblo... Ugh. Let's just say it got on my nerves and I messed up the place ... just a little bit...

voiceDesc.cn: 那个粉红头发的瓦伊凡经常来找我测试她的“速冻仔”，可惜没有一次能熄灭我的火焰。但她制作的冰淇淋看起来挺潮，尝起来也不错。
voiceDesc.en: That pink-haired Vouivre often asks me to test her Frost-e-Bytee. It never managed to put out my flames. But ... she does make pretty and chic-looking ice cream, and the taste is not half bad.

voiceDesc.cn: “火在风手里招致灾难，火在人手里成为伙伴。”有个众生长地的游人这么跟我说。她不仅不畏惧火焰，反而教我在荒野上烧出一条“防火线”，把蔓延的山火阻挡在了另一边。脱险的村民把我们当成英雄，但我只挂念从火里救出的那只云兽。可惜，留给她了。
voiceDesc.en: A Songseeker of the Hannabit Circuit once told me this: "Fire is a fiend in the hands of the wind, but a friend in the hands of humankind." The Songseeker showed no fear of fire. She even taught me how to create firelines on the other side of the wildlands. I managed to contain a spreading forest fire. The villagers who survived the disaster called us heroes, but my mind stayed fixed on the cloudbeast we saved. I let her keep the little one. What a shame.

voiceDesc.cn: 有件事，人事部门让我自己找你处理。喏，就是这张通缉令。没什么大不了的，只是刚离开罗德岛的时候，在一个叫“艾什柏环岛”的地方放了几把火而已。既然是不干不净的生意，就该想到会有“引火烧身”的一天。
voiceDesc.en: I need something taken care of. HR Division told me to escalate this matter to you, personally. Here it is. A wanted poster. It's no big deal. Happened back when I just left Rhodes Island. A place called the Asphalt Roundabout tagged me for a few counts of arson. They should really blame themselves. A dirty business with plenty of flammable trash should at least expect some fires.

voiceDesc.cn: 再说一遍，我并没有真正去过泰拉，所以不要跟我聊那里的风土人情……萨米除外。听说那些人的“家乡”直接驮着他们来到塔卫二了？什么时候有任务去那里的话，叫上我。
voiceDesc.en: I'll say this again. I've never been to Terra. In person. So don't talk to me about the sights, the people, or the culture of that place... Unless, of course, you're talking about Sami. I heard their "home" carried them to Talos-II. If we have a mission at that place, give me a call.

voiceDesc.cn: 那边有些东西，没用的话，就拿来试剑吧。
voiceDesc.en: See something there. If it's useless, we can use it to test our blades.

voiceDesc.cn: 那边有你不该遗忘的东西。
voiceDesc.en: Something worth remembering there.

voiceDesc.cn: 放心去看看吧，跟在我身后就行了。
voiceDesc.en: We can go take a look. No worries. Just stay close behind me.

voiceDesc.cn: 看见那个家伙了？要我出手吗？
voiceDesc.en: See that one? Need me to do some trimming?

voiceDesc.cn: 真正有价值的东西经得住火炼。
voiceDesc.en: Only true valuables survive the flame.

voiceDesc.cn: 太慢了，我不喜欢干等着。
voiceDesc.en: Too slow. I hate standing around with nothing to do.

voiceDesc.cn: 我记得你喜欢这些。
voiceDesc.en: I remember that you kinda like these.

voiceDesc.cn: 醚质……和记忆一样飘忽不定。
voiceDesc.en: Aurylene... A thing that's just as unreliable as my memories.

voiceDesc.cn: 警惕比火焰更危险的存在。
voiceDesc.en: Be cautious. This is far more dangerous than fire.

voiceDesc.cn: 如果还觉得冷，可以往我这边靠。
voiceDesc.en: Try getting closer to me if you're still feeling cold.

voiceDesc.cn: 我没兴趣看你硬撑。
voiceDesc.en: C'mon, spare me the theatrics.

voiceDesc.cn: 哼，不碍事了。
voiceDesc.en: Hmph. I'm better now.

voiceDesc.cn: 你想发愣到什么时候？
voiceDesc.en: Don't just stand there, move!

voiceDesc.cn: 啧……死不了。
voiceDesc.en: Tsk... This won't kill me.

voiceDesc.cn: 可恶……这失败的记忆……
voiceDesc.en: Curse this ... memory of defeat...

voiceDesc.cn: 噢，我会记住。
voiceDesc.en: Hmph. I'll remember that.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，不错，下次我来。
voiceDesc.en: Not bad. I'll handle the next one.

voiceDesc.cn: 我知道。
voiceDesc.en: I know.

voiceDesc.cn: 分内之事。
voiceDesc.en: Just part of my job.

voiceDesc.cn: 我已经等很久了。
voiceDesc.en: Now it's time to bring the pain.

voiceDesc.cn: 早该动手了。
voiceDesc.en: About time.

voiceDesc.cn: 连热身都算不上。
voiceDesc.en: This hardly counts as warm-up.

voiceDesc.cn: 胜利是理所应当的。
voiceDesc.en: Victory goes without saying.

voiceDesc.cn: 那就和你们一起欢呼吧。
voiceDesc.en: Guess I'll join your celebrations.

voiceDesc.cn: 已经做得很好了。下一次先把棘手的交给我。
voiceDesc.en: You did alright. Just leave the hard fighting to me next time.

voiceDesc.cn: 我不会再让这种情况发生。
voiceDesc.en: I will not allow this to happen again.

voiceDesc.cn: 斩断！
voiceDesc.en: Slash!

voiceDesc.cn: 破灭！
voiceDesc.en: Perish!

voiceDesc.cn: 熔火！
voiceDesc.en: Melting flame!

voiceDesc.cn: 烧尽！
voiceDesc.en: Incinerate!

voiceDesc.cn: 被吞没吧！
voiceDesc.en: Be consumed!

voiceDesc.cn: 让我来！
voiceDesc.en: I got this!

voiceDesc.cn: 烈焰将至！
voiceDesc.en: Inferno awaits!

voiceDesc.cn: 焚毁！
voiceDesc.en: Burn to cinders!

voiceDesc.cn: 灰飞烟灭吧！
voiceDesc.en: Turn to ash!

voiceDesc.cn: 别想逃！
voiceDesc.en: There's no escape!

voiceDesc.cn: 去死吧！
voiceDesc.en: You shall die!

voiceDesc.cn: 火焰，照亮黄昏！
voiceDesc.en: Let that twilight burn!

voiceDesc.cn: 焚烧黑暗！
voiceDesc.en: I shall cremate darkness!

voiceDesc.cn: 你的末日到了！
voiceDesc.en: Your end is nigh!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员伊冯，经联盟工团的克劳推荐给安德烈，以“特殊人才引进”的渠道被招募进终末地工业的特种技术部门，现负责对超域、侵蚀及其相关装置“全频超域抑稳自动机”的研究。因其出色的科研能力，额外划拨资源帮助其独立研究。

在进行背景调研时，很多人都表示伊冯是一位相当“叛逆”的工程师，但我并不完全认同这一评价。不，与她给我贴的镭射贴纸无关。
在我看来，最核心的原因是大部分人无法跟上她的思考速度，显得她在协作方面有些问题。其次，她对长年研究中形成的个人风格相当自信……并非蓄意违抗规范，而是本能地抗拒对她思考方式与表达路径的干涉。
这份难以被环境塑形的特质很容易被认为是叛逆。但实际上，光鲜的穿着、肆意的涂鸦、那些极繁却又非常实用的机械外形设计，都是她贯彻自我的表现——周围充满条条框框时，任何坚持自我的人都会显得格格不入。幸运的是，终末地并没有僵化的教条，我们的目标本就是改造这个世界，而非循规蹈矩地维持它。
更何况，所有人说她“叛逆”的时候，脸上都带着笑。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Yvonne was recommended by Crowe of UWST to Andre. She joined the Specialist Tech Division of Endfield Industries via the "Specialized Talent Recruitment" channel. Yvonne is now leading several research projects on the Æther, the Blight, and the Trans-Æther Tranquilizer-Automata associated with the previous two. Given her outstanding scientific research capabilities, she has received bonus grants and resources to support her independent research. 

During background checks, many have described Yvonne as an engineer with an obvious streak of "rebellion". However, I cannot be more opposed to this evaluation. And no, this has nothing to do with the laser stickers she adhered upon my chassis. 
In my opinion, the core issue rests in the inability of most individuals to keep up with her rapid train of thought. The end result would appear that she has teamwork issues. Also, she is rather confident in her personal style that she constructed for herself after years of scientific research... Her violations were never deliberate. Instead, they should be considered instinctive reactions when someone or something attempts to interfere with her way of thinking or self-expression. 
Such personality quirks withstood the influences of the environment and many would often regard this as Yvonne's rebel spirit. However, her brightly colored outfits, carefree graffiti, and complex yet extremely practical chassis designs are modes of expression that she has consistently maintained — in a world filled with rules and boundaries, those who remain true to themselves would seem rather out of place. Fortunately, Endfield is not a place dictated by inflexible regulations. Our vision is to change this world, instead of sustaining its current existence by sticking to the law. 
Moreover, when our people described Yvonne as a "rebel", they did so with a smile. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【失物招领清单】
一个镭射果冻手提袋——外部印着灿烂笑脸涂鸦，内袋放着熏香的珠子。
一个指甲油瓶子——内部装着会根据超域能量浓度改变颜色的环境感知涂料。
一件儿童玩具——用螺母、齿轮、轴承等五金工件组装而成，外形为有些眼熟的六边形结构，涂装非常艳丽。
一组纪念镭射卡——似乎是为首届塔卫二“堡垒守御”获奖者专门定制的奖励，背面刻着一位瓦伊凡的头像。
迷你超域读数检测设备——外表像是一根项链。因输入了尚未发表的公式，灵敏度比市面上的同类产品更高。
半盒荞花风味热辣口感颗粒泡芙——目前最流行的甜点，味道十分微妙。（早上看到佩丽卡监督的桌子上还有半盒。）
“好工程师”螺丝刀套组——樱花粉定制款。被使用者保养得很好，没有任何生锈痕迹。
《MARTHE月刊》——今天发售的最新一期，介绍了塔卫二当下最潮流的穿搭。（两周前似乎看到伊冯穿着封面上的这套时装……她好像总是先于潮流，难道她真的是那个传闻中的影子设计师？）
留言：伊冯，我知道原型机的实验很重要，但请快点来拿遗失物品！</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: List of lost items 
A laser jelly bag — printed with a big friendly smiley graffiti, with an inner pocket containing scented beads. 
A bottle of nail varnish — containing an environment-sensitive pigment that changes color according to the concentrations of ambient Æther. 
A children's toy — constructed from nuts, bolts, gears, axles, and other pieces of hardware. It resembles an oddly familiar hexagonal structure and is furnished with a brightly colored coating. 
A set of memorial laser cards — this appears to be a special reward for the winners of the 1st Talos-II Bastion Defense. The back of the cards feature the portrait of a Vouivre. 
A miniature Æther counter — this device has the shape of a necklace. It is furnished with not-yet-released algorithms that grant it far higher sensitivity than existing competition on the market. 
Half a box of cream puffs (spicy buckflower flavor) — the most popular snack on the market with a rather peculiar taste (NOTE: Half a box of the same cream puffs was seen on Supervisor Perlica's desk). 
A set of Good Engineer screwdrivers — special cherry pink edition. The user has kept it well-maintained and rust-free. 
Monthly MARTHE — the latest issue was just being sold today. This fashion magazine introduces the latest and trendiest outfits of Talos-II (About two weeks ago, I think I saw Yvonne wearing the outfit featured on that magazine cover... If she's always ahead of the trend, can it be that she's the legendary Shadow Designer?) 
MESSAGE: Yvonne, I know that testing the prototype is important, but please claim your lost items. </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【一宗火灾意外事故的调查报告】
案件概述：昨日夜里，位于近郊与中心区交界处边缘一栋宅邸二层的图书室起火，大量家具与复古裙装烧毁，火势控制在该房间内部，未造成任何人员伤亡，书籍完好无损。

1. 现场勘查
图书室窗户从内反锁，门锁无破坏痕迹，共提取指纹两组。靠近花园一侧仅有负责定期修剪花园的园林工人脚印。起火点为雕花衣柜。

2. 监控检查
夜间八点左右，屋主的女儿与屋主在会客厅进行了详谈。九点两人走出会客厅，前往图书室。

3. 证人证言
屋主：“抱歉，麻烦你们特地来一趟……不过没关系。每隔几个世纪，人们就得烧一次图书馆。”
屋主的妻子：“我丈夫在女儿出生前就布置好了那个房间，希望她能延续古老的文化，继承那些文学与艺术，在这片新的土地上扎根。我还想着她能去创立一个文化复兴研究团体……发生这样的事故真是太可惜了。”
屋主的女儿：“呃……其实控制得很精准，没什么损失嘛！这也要查？”
女儿的家庭教师：“其实我已经没有在教导小姐了。她对芭蕾舞、礼仪都不太感兴趣，只愿意学钢琴。她要是不想做什么事儿，一百头驮兽都拉不动……您问现在？她在教我怎么谱‘新塔风’的音乐，挺有意思的。哦，还有怎么维修电子设备。她有做工程师的天赋。”

4. 处理方法
多方验证后，确认系个人销毁行为，对屋主进行批评教育与罚款。不移交至社区管理部门处理。

5. 屋主的证言补充
“‘好吧，’我说，‘既然你已经决定好了自己的道路，我们就把那些东西烧掉吧。’她花了很长时间来确认我的表情，直到我们彼此都明白我是认真的。她立刻开始欢呼，说要放个大烟花，把她做的那个什么机……无人机，就是会喷火、会喷冰块的玩意儿拿了出来。
“我跟她一起看着图书室燃烧，门缝里传来明亮的橙色火光。我听到火舌舔舐着木头书架，在烟中劈啪作响。
“其实我还是有些心疼。虽然屋里那些书并不是什么珍藏品，但搜罗过来也花了不少金票……没办法，这是长年一腔情愿逼迫她后要付出的代价，我总得拿出个态度。
“嗡的一声——那两个小玩意儿提着书飞了过来。她嘻嘻一笑，说只是我们‘品鉴’的口味不一样，为什么一定要全都毁了？她说，她喜欢那些‘新塔卫二浪潮’的文学，但可没说过要否定那些更遥远的故事。何况那些东西，她早就都背下来了。
“我说了什么来着……抱歉，光记着那股东西被烧焦的味道了。哦，我说……
“把这里翻修成工作间吧。有空也给我做台无人机，能点雪茄的那种。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Investigation of an incident of fire 
CASE SUMMARY: Last night, a fire broke out in the second floor library of a residence on the border between the suburbs and the central district. Most of the furniture and retro-style clothing were damaged in the blaze. The fire was contained within the house. No casualties were reported. The book collection of the library escaped unscathed. 

1. Investigation of the site 
The library windows were locked from the inside. The locks appear undamaged. Two sets of fingerprints were collected. Footprints of a gardener responsible for regular pruning of the plants were found next to the garden. The fire started at the carved armoire. 

2. Investigation of surveillance records 
At around 2000 hours, the homeowner and his daughter had an extensive dialogue at the living room. At 2100 hours, both headed to the library. 

3. Witness testimonies 
Homeowner: "Apologies for troubling you into making this journey... But things are under control. People must burn the library once every a few centuries or so." 
Spouse of the homeowner: "My husband prepared that room before our girl was born. He wanted her to inherit that ancient culture, literature, and art, as well as to sow its seeds upon these new lands. I was hoping she could start a cultural restoration study group... The incident is a shame, really." 
Daughter of the homeowner: "Erm... We actually applied precision controls and barely suffered any losses! So why are we being inspected?" 
Governess: "I'm no longer giving meaningful instructions to the young mistress. Ballet and etiquette do not interest her. She is only willing to play the piano. The combined might of a hundred burdenbeasts could not force her to do something she doesn't like... What is she doing now? She's teaching me how to compose Neo-Talosian music and it's pretty interesting. Oh, I'm also learning electronic repairs from her. She has the engineer's knack, if you ask me." 

4. Post-incident handling 
After verifying various findings, we have ascertained that the incident was a private act of planned incineration. The responsible homeowner has been censured and fined. The incident does not need to be escalated to the community management department. 

5. Additional testimonies from the homeowner 
"'Fine,' I said, 'since you've chosen your path, we might as well burn the things.' She studied my face for quite a while. When we both realized neither of us was joking, she immediately started cheering. She said something about making a huge fireworks display and took out the contraptions she built... Maybe they're called drones. Anyway, these gadgets of hers could spew fire and ice." 
"I watched the library burn with her. Bright orange flame flickered behind the gaps of the door. I heard the wooden shelves crackle, burst, and split as the fire licked and consumed it." 
"I actually felt a certain degree of pain. The books in the house may not be antique relics, but I spent quite a tidy sum on acquiring this collection... I guess it can't be helped. It is the price I have to pay for spending years forcing her to go against her will. I have no choice but to demonstrate my stance." 
"But those two flying gadgets came buzzing out with the books. She giggled and said that we simply had different "tastes" and questioned on the necessity of destruction. She went on by saying that her preference for New Talos-II Wave literature does not mean she dislikes stories from further back. She even said that she had memorized those older tales." 
"So what was I saying again...? Apologies. I was too busy reminiscing about the smells given off by the fire. Oh, wait, I remember..." 
"I said to her, 'We can make this into a proper workshop. And make a drone for me if you have the time. The one that can light my cigars.'" </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>“小工程师访问的第四个行星上住着一群商人。他们给星星编号，然后把编号锁在保险柜里……
“小工程师访问的第六个行星上住着好多学究……小工程师看到他们厚厚的眼镜，就立刻跑掉了。
“小工程师跟庞大的工业巨兽告别。他对着山谷喊道——‘和我交个朋友吧，我很孤单！’但是呢，大山给他的只有一遍又一遍的回声……
“故事的最后，小工程师倒在沙地上……呃，嗯！他嗖的一下从沙子上站起来，向着自己的朋友挥手，长出一双亮晶晶的翅膀，就这样飞向群星！”

“这个故事好像是高……我老家那边的作者写的。只要不是历史书，泰拉传承下来的故事倒是都很有趣！好了，小滑头们，今天就讲到这里，下次再——”
“伊冯姐姐……”
“哎哟，脸怎么皱起来啦？”
“小工程师好可怜……哪里都不是他的家，也没有交到朋友，好寂寞……”
“而且他最后飞起来，是不是……是不是因为他被天使吃掉了呀？！大人总是说这种谎……”
伊冯眨眨眼，自口袋中掏出那只用五金工件组装的玩具。在日光照耀下，这外形有些像“塔塔”的小东西闪烁着近似钻石碎屑的光泽。
“小工程师只是没有找到合适的伙伴，但不代表会寂寞呀！你们看，这就是他给自己做的第一个伙伴。他还给自己做了很多有趣的伙伴，有可以做冰淇淋的、有可以放烟花的……每一个都是好朋友！而且，后来——”

她循着那道光芒抬起头，天边熨着一层碧蓝，云层在缓慢流动。她能想象出在那之上的轨道，帝江号无拘无束漫游的模样。她又低下头，四号谷地的孩子们围着她，脸上露出对故事的期待。舰船的影子、小工程师闪闪发光的翅膀、五亿盏铃铛中的星光，斑斓而平和的世界自她视网膜上流过。
伊冯感到自在，她讲述故事的语调越来越轻快。
“后来也不是你们想的那样黑暗啦！小工程师选择离开，是因为交到了新的朋友，受到最闪耀的星星邀请，换了个地方住！把眼泪擦一擦，今天再多讲一个管理员的故事吧！嗯……你们想听管理员击碎了太阳那件事，还是用一颗源石变出了一百万个士兵那个？”
“太阳……还有一百万个士兵？！管理员太厉害了吧，这些都是真的吗——？”
“嗯哼，是不是真的呢……一会儿我替你们问问本人！”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>"A group of merchants lived on the fourth planet visited by the Little Engineer. They gave every star a number, and locked the numbers in the safe..." 
"Many academicians lived in the sixth planet visited by the Little Engineer... The Little Engineer saw their incredibly thick spectacles, and immediately ran away." 
"The Little Engineer bid farewell to the Gargantuan Feranmut of Industry. He shouted into the mountain valley, 'Let's be friends! I'M LONELY!' But the mountains only responded with echoes of echoes of echoes..." 
"And in the end, the Little Engineer collapsed in the sand... And uh, oh yeah! With a swoosh he got back to his feet and shook off the sand. He waved at his friends, grew a pair of sparkling wings, and flew toward the stars!" 

"This story is probably written by an author from Ga ... just where my home used to be. Terran stories are interesting, as long as they're not history! Alright, my little rascals, that's it for today. For next time, we'll—" 
"Miss Yvonne..." 
"Awww. You look really down. What's wrong?" 
"The Little Engineer is so sad... He could not find his home anywhere! And he made no friends. He's so lonely..." 
"And why did he fly? Is it 'coz ... 'coz he got eaten up by the Aggeloi?! The grown-ups keep lying to me about this..." 
Yvonne blinked a few times, then fished out of her pocket the toy that was cobbled together with hardware parts. The little thing resembled Tata, and glinted in the sunlight like specks of diamond dust. 
"The Little Engineer just couldn't find fitting companions, but that doesn't mean he's lonely! Look at this! This is the first companion he built for himself. He also built other interesting teammates. One makes ice cream, the other creates fireworks... Everyone of them was a loyal friend! And then—" 

Yvonne followed the light and raised her head. Clouds slowly rolled across a uniform sheen of azure blue. She could imagine Dijiang cruising along its carefree orbit high above the skies. Yvonne then lowered her gaze and looked upon the children of Valley IV, their faces glowing with hope for more stories. The silhouette of the vessel, the sparkling wings of the Little Engineer, starlight of half-a-billion bells, and a world of splendor and harmony flowed across her retina. 
Yvonne felt free. The tempo of her storytelling became lighter and faster. 
"And in the end, it wasn't the darkness you imagined! The Little Engineer left because he made new friends, received an invitation from the brightest stars, and got a new place to stay! Now, dry your tears and I'll reward you with a bonus story about the Endministrator! Yeah... So what do you want to hear? The one where the Endmin smashed the sun, or the one where the Endmin transformed a single Originium crystal into a million soldiers?" 
"Smashed the sun ... and a million soldiers?! The Endmin is so awesome! Are these stories true?" 
"Hmm. Are the stories true...? Well, I guess I'll ask the hero in question right after this!" </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【伊冯的工作日志】
这是我盯着那段超域裂隙数据的第三天。那里面什么都看不到，监测模块全线失效，红外、电磁、振荡响应——统统归零，对面连一声“哔”都懒得还我。
我甚至试过用手语识别器去“读”那片区域的变化！结果只有一堆报错和一句“数据无法解译”。
这已经不是监控失败了，这是被超域狠狠羞辱。我们是彻彻底底的瞎子。唯一能确认的事实是，它存在，而且不友好。
我讨厌看不见的东西！
…………
换个思路。如果我主动往里面发信息呢？不再死守输入端口，而是用主动交互取代被动等待。
今天我尝试了三种不同频段的信号包：一组是标准问候协议，一组是我自己写的脉冲打招呼格式，还有一组是静电噪音（宇宙起源乐章的第一个音符，也许超域会喜欢）。
结果毫不意外……没反应。好吧，乐观一点，也许有回应，谁知道无线电波传播过去，再返回要多久？如果振动一次要至少1000万年，那就只能让速冻仔去听了。
明天我试试颜色编码的光波信号。如果那东西能看见，也许它会跟我一样，喜欢闪闪发光的东西！
光还比声音快呢！
…………
第几次失败？我记不清了。信号调试、模型构建、反馈监听，全都失败。连噪声听起来都像是超域的嘲笑——要真是嘲笑就好了，我非要用速冻仔给它的喉咙降降温不可！
我原本以为只要坚持不懈，总能找到一丝缝隙。但现在我开始怀疑，这是不是一场注定没有出口的探索。
我们连“观察”的权力都没有，更别提“破解”。
我推导的模型、设计的装置，跟侵蚀一比就像是小孩子过家家……
…………
现在我能做的事情只有坐在转椅上，一圈又一圈地摇晃，等待或许1000万年后才会出现的奇迹。
干脆换个研究方向如何？造一支无敌舰队，在天空中托起无数座那些古老歌谣中回响的……城市？不可行，但会比破解超域更不可行吗？
我看向那段超域裂隙的图像，久久地、深深地凝望着它。声音与光都被它吞噬，连我也跌入其中——它碾碎我，用永恒的黑暗包裹着我，让我无处可逃。
我是为了什么才做这些事来着？保护塔卫二……证明自己……跟父母赌气……不。好像只是在某一天，我觉得书上的超域裂隙很漂亮，于是偷偷跑到防护带后，轻佻地去观察它。它泛着明亮的光晕，那感觉就像直视太阳，在刺痛中迎接无法言喻的恐惧，然后——融化。
我怕得在深夜中大哭，缩在被子里发抖，第二天早上起来看到自己的眼睛肿得像是桃子，那很丑。我不想再因为它露出那样的丑态，所以我要破解它，就只是这么简单。
而在终末地，我就能做到。
我再次拍下发送按钮，迟疑不决、动心怵目，啪的一声全都不见了。黑暗消失，将我还回白昼。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Yvonne's work diary 
Day 3 after starting at that particular data section of the Æther rift. I can't see anything inside. All monitoring modules were knocked out. IR, EM, resonance responses — we got flatlined for everything. Not a single blip showed up. Sheesh. 
I tried to "read" the changes of that particular area with a smart sign language interpreter! And all I got was a bunch of errors and a single line that reads: "Failed to interpret data." 
We didn't just fail to monitor the stuff. The Æther rubbed it in our faces. We're completely blind to it. The only thing I'm certain of is this: It exists, and it's not very nice. 
I HATE THINGS I CAN'T SEE! 
............ 
Maybe I can change my approach. What would happen if I actively send data into it? Instead of just passively waiting for a response to come out of the output port, we should seize the initiative and interact with it instead. 
I tried three signal packs with different frequencies: (1) a standard greetings protocol; (2) a set of greetings I wrote myself in pulse-based format; (3) a set of static noise (the first note from the Movement: Genesis of the Universe, the Ætherside might like it). 
The results are just as predicted ... no responses. Fine. Be optimistic. Perhaps there was a response but receiving a radio wave transmission and emitting a response might take a while. If a single vibration takes at least 10 million years, then I have no choice but to keep Frost-e-Bytee on the receiving line. 
Perhaps I can try optical wave signals with various color codes. If that thing can see things, perhaps it'll like glittering stuff, like me! 
Plus light travels faster than sound! 
............ 
How many times did I fail again? Can't remember. Signal modulation, model simulations, and feedback monitoring ... none of it worked. The noise I'm getting sounds like the Æther laughing at me — I really hope it was laughing at me, because that means I'll unleash Frost-e-Bytee and ram some icy cold down its throat! 
I always believed that persistence will eventually identify a crack. But now I am beginning to wonder if this is a futile effort of exploration with no way out. 
We can't even "observe" this thing. How are we supposed to "decipher" it? 
The models I proposed and the devices I designed felt like childish gimmicks when compared to the Blight... 
............ 
Maybe the only thing I can do right now is to spin around on my swivel chair. Perhaps I gotta wait 10 million years for a miracle to happen. 
I might as well change my scientific approach. Time to build an invincible space armada. Let the ancient songs echo as I raise countless ... cities into the skies! Unfeasible? Maybe. But what can be more unfeasible than deciphering the Æther? 
I looked at those images of the Æther rift. I gazed at them long and hard. It devoured both sound and light. Even I got trapped within it — it crushed me and smothered me with eternal darkness. There is no escape for me. 
So why am I doing all this? To protect Talos-II...? To prove myself...? Because I got a grudge against Pa and Ma...? No. I think it all started on that day. I read about the Æther rift in the books and found it beautiful. So I snuck off to the Protection Band so I could observe it, like the giddy girl I was. The rift gave off a bright halo. Looking at it feels like staring straight into the sun. The piercing pain then gave way to a sense of indescribable horror and then it ... melted. 
It was a terror that got me bawling and trembling under my blankets late that night. My eyes swelled like peaches in the following morning — I looked gross. And I don't ever want to look like that again. So that's it: I'm going to decipher it. It's as simple as that. 
And I believe I can do it at Endfield. 
So once again, I punched the [SEND] button. A resounding KABLAM of epic proportions and ZERO hesitation. Gone and dusted. The darkness will be no more, and I shall return to daytime. </>

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，今天咱们去哪里玩？
voiceDesc.en: So, where are we having fun today, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 数据同步完毕，我随时可以出发！
voiceDesc.en: Data sync complete. I'm ready to go at any time!

voiceDesc.cn: 终于想起来叫我了？嗯哼，一定发生了什么大事吧。
voiceDesc.en: Finally decided to call me up? Hehe, I bet you got a sticky situation on your hands.

voiceDesc.cn: 来了来了，设备上的问题就全都交给我吧。
voiceDesc.en: I'm here. If you got equipment issues, leave them to me.

voiceDesc.cn: 这把铳手感不错！嗯……设计上还有拓展空间，我会把它改成我的专属款！
voiceDesc.en: This pair of handcannons feels just right. Hmm... Noticed a few design OFIs. Guess I'll just mod them into a pair of Yvonne-specials!

voiceDesc.cn: 我能给装备改涂装吗？我觉得它的颜色跟我的头发不搭。
voiceDesc.en: Can I apply a new layer of coating to my gear? This color scheme doesn't really match my hair.

voiceDesc.cn: 这也太简单了吧，给我点更难的挑战！
voiceDesc.en: Too easy! Give me a proper challenge!

voiceDesc.cn: 我是快进着看的，但效果应该没差。
voiceDesc.en: I was fast-forwarding through everything. I learn fast so makes no difference.

voiceDesc.cn: 给我升职？眼光不错嘛，管理员！
voiceDesc.en: I'm getting promoted? Wooo, you've got an eye for talent, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 这次晋升过后，我是不是可以换个更大点的实验室了？
voiceDesc.en: So, does this promotion mean ... I can get a bigger lab?

voiceDesc.cn: 亲临战场和光看资料完全是两回事……在开拓区逛一圈能平安回来，对我来说已经是个巨大的进步了，不是吗？
voiceDesc.en: Fighting in an actual battle is really different from studying combat videos... And I've made *massive* improvements by surviving all those trips in the frontier. Right?

voiceDesc.cn: 助理？不需要不需要！我的“小嘀嗒”完全能搞定！整理数据、收拾实验室，对它来说都是小菜一碟！而且……它还不会抱怨我的作息。
voiceDesc.en: Assistant? NEWP! Don't need one! My Tink-a-Bella can handle everything! Data organization and lab cleanups are just some of its most basic features! Plus, it would never complain about my daily schedule.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗨，又见面了，还是叫我伊冯就好。这可是我最近第一次出门，管理员，希望我们能合作愉快——
voiceDesc.en: Hi, Endmin. We meet again. Just call me Yvonne. It's been a very long time since I last went out. Pleasure doing business together!

voiceDesc.cn: 速冻仔，别调皮！管理员要带我们出去呢！
voiceDesc.en: Behave, Frost-e-Bytee! We're going for a walk with Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，在这儿呢！我要带的东西有点多……
voiceDesc.en: Over here, Endmin! Oh, I'm bringing quite a few things...

voiceDesc.cn: 好啦好啦，这里我熟得很，放心吧！
voiceDesc.en: Alright, alright. I'm super familiar with all this, so just kick back and relax!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，装备测试间今天我先预定了哦！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin! I'm calling dibs on the equipment testing chamber. Thanks a lot!

voiceDesc.cn: 最新一期的《MARTHE月刊》到了，要一起看吗？
voiceDesc.en: The latest issue of Monthly MARTHE just arrived. Wanna read it with me?

voiceDesc.cn: 啊啊……无论看几次都觉得，集成工业系统实——在是太完美了！在协议核心的指挥下，生产不再只是冰冷的重复，而像……一套生命系统！可以循环和呼吸！真是天才设计！管理员，能让我玩一下吗？
voiceDesc.en: *Sigh*... Every time I study the Automated Industry Complex, I can't help but feel that it's — pure perfection! PAC-directed production is no longer a cold, repetitive chore ... but a living, breathing system of intertwining process loops! Absolutely ingenious! Endmin, I've gotta try this. C'mon, pleaaase?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，虽然我很喜欢你的造型，但总穿这一身，我都要看腻了！有没有想过换一身更亮眼的衣服？我带你去买！保证搭配得更有型！
voiceDesc.en: I'll be honest with you, Endmin. I like your style, but don't you think it's time for a wardrobe refresh? Come on, let's get you something flashier and brighter! Your fashion upgrade will be the vogue. Gua-ran-teed!

voiceDesc.cn: 佩丽卡不让我带小暴鸰上舰，说太危险。但我又离不开它们，只能妥协喽，上舰前我把爆破模块都拆掉啦！
voiceDesc.en: Perlica won't let me bring my Tweety-Bombs along because she said they're safety hazards. But I just can't live without them! *Sigh*. In the end, I compromised and dismantled the demolition modules before boarding this ship.

voiceDesc.cn: 我打算过阵子去菈梵朵玛度个假，久违的沙滩和海风……管理员，要不要一起？还可以顺便去考察一下那里的海岸工程，听说采用了新研发的防侵蚀涂层。
voiceDesc.en: I'm planning a La Fantoma getaway. Kinda missed the beaches and ocean breeze... Wanna come with, Endmin? We can also check out their latest coastal engineering. I heard it's got a new layer of Blight-resistant coating they just recently developed.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我还没有跟你合过影呢！一起来张自拍吧？我会把它放在“伊冯的年度时刻”集锦里。不要质疑我的拍照技术！如果拍得不好看……那就怪帝江号的灯光咯！
voiceDesc.en: I guess we haven't been in the same picture together, Endmin? How about a selfie? I'm going to add it to Yvonne's Annual Moments collection. And if it doesn't turn out cute, I'm blaming Dijiang's terrible lighting, not my skills!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，咱们喜欢的音乐还挺像的嘛！下次新唱片到了，可以来我的实验室，我们一起听。好音乐就是要和懂的人一起分享！
voiceDesc.en: It appears we have similar tastes in music, Endmin! That means you can swing by my lab and enjoy my latest vinyl once it arrives. After all, good music gets even better with good company!

voiceDesc.cn: 给你准备了点小东西，记得回去后再打开。嘿嘿，我咨询过“专业人士”的意见，你肯定会喜欢！
voiceDesc.en: Got a little something for you. Open it when you're back at your place. Heh. You're definitely going to like it, 'cos I asked plenty of "professionals" to make sure of that!

voiceDesc.cn: 谢谢啦！放心，你送的东西，就算是有点丑我也会当宝贝收着！
voiceDesc.en: Aww, thanks! Don't worry, even if it's a teensy bit weird, I'll still treasure it forever ... because it's from you!

voiceDesc.cn: 我的设计，从来不只是为了让机器的性能更强，而是为了让人在用它的时候不用太紧张，不费脑子，最好还能笑一笑。毕竟工具是拿来用的，不是让人和它较劲的。
voiceDesc.en: Maximizing machine performance was never the intention. Nope. My goal is to provide users with a panic-free and idiot-proof experience. Giving them a good laugh would be the cherry on top. After all, tools should make life easier, not harder.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你的源石技艺能借给我吗？如果能精准控制源石回路，设计上就有了超高的灵活性。比如……我一直想给速冻仔再加一个加热单元，这样它就完美了！嗯？这样就不算是“速冻仔”了？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, can you lend me your Originium Arts? Precision controls over Originium circuitry would grant me tons of design options. For example ... I've always wanted to give Frost-e-Bytee a heating module. Oh, that sounds magnifique! Wait. If it heats things up, it won't be Frost-e anymore...

voiceDesc.cn: 我第一次知道管理员的时候，才三岁，是从一本科普读物上看来的。书上说你是个大人物，要操心好多事。但真的见到了本人，没想到……管理员其实还挺可爱。不过，你是真不知道有些盗版书把过去的你画成了什么样……不，你还是别知道了。
voiceDesc.en: I was three when I first read about you in some popular book about science. It said you're a legend with *tons* of responsibilities. But the real you is surprisingly ... cute, I guess? *Chuckle* Oh, you probably don't want to know how they illustrated you in those unlicensed copies. It's better to keep you in the dark...

voiceDesc.cn: 我刚接手宝贝小车项目的时候，设备原型大得离谱，整个装配车间都塞不下了！工团一开始就想做成那种重型器械，用来大范围清除侵蚀。但如果不试试轻型化，普通人面对突发的侵蚀灾害怎么办？等移动平台轰隆隆开过来？为了这事，我在实验园区连轴转了好几个月……结果你看，后来发生的事，证明我当时的决定——超级明智！
voiceDesc.en: When I first took over my Baby Bot project, the prototype was just humongous! They couldn't even fit the thing inside the vehicle hangar! Guess the UWST wanted a heavy industrial rig-on-wheels for neutralizing major glops of Blight. But what about people who have to deal with Blight creeping up their homes? Wait around and pray for the giant wooster rig to show up? C'mon, someone's gotta carry out miniaturization studies. So I spent months in the Science Park working on that... The results totally speak for themselves. The events that followed proved my decision to be *incredibly* wise!

voiceDesc.cn: 我其实一直都知道，我喜欢的那些东西——美妙的音乐、精彩的演出、漂亮的衣服，还有塔卫二的日出日落……全都很脆弱。正因为这样，我才加入了终末地。我想做点什么，让这些脆弱但美好的东西，能存续下去。我还没有享受够呢，所以这个世界可不许完蛋！
voiceDesc.en: Fabulous music, exhilarating concerts, chic fashion, the beautiful sunrises and sunsets over the Talosian horizon — I actually know that everything I love is teetering on the edge of destruction. It's the reason why I became an Endfielder. I want to do something and ensure that the fragile beauty of our world lives on. I mean, I haven't had enough fun yet, so I'm not gonna let this world end on my watch!

voiceDesc.cn: 如果是生活，我当然首选环塔商会的城市；但工作嘛，那里实在不适合我。你能想象吗？他们一天要打六次卡！
voiceDesc.en: If you ask me, I'll choose a TGCC city in the band for quality of life. But for work? HELL NO! Corporate Practice requires employees to clock in six times a day. Can you imagine that?!

voiceDesc.cn: 这件衣服是巫术时刻出品的，我超喜欢他们的设计风格。他们会从一切地方找点子，甚至会模仿天使外壳的纹理。危险的东西反而更有魅力，不是吗，管理员？
voiceDesc.en: Now this one's from the Witching Hour. I just LURRV their style. They get their design elements from all sorts of things. Even the texture and grain of Aggeloid carapace! Danger is just so much more ... *enticing*. Don't you agree, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: “伊冯”是个高卢名字。我爸说，我们家的血统大有来头，大家都觉得那是很值得骄傲的事。可对我来说嘛，没啥特别的感觉。泰拉离我们都已经够遥远了，更别提那上面一个早就消失的帝国了。真不懂血统这种概念，到底哪里重要了，那个什么科什么一世的，有那么了不起吗？
voiceDesc.en: Yvonne is a Gallian name. Father told me that we inherited a great legacy and everyone in the family was pretty proud of that. But I don't exactly share their sentiments. Terra is far enough away already, and that ancient empire was long gone. What's so important about pedigrees or bloodlines anyway? And then there's this guy called Corsi-Something le First? Was he really that great to begin with?

voiceDesc.cn: 我只是顺手给实验室的热能炉改了个接口，然后这个接口恰好可以煮泡面。这不是偷懒，这是技术验证！行吧，我分给你一份……你不会告诉佩丽卡的，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: Ah, this...? Well... I just swapped out the thermal furnace connector in the lab. Compatibility with an instant noodle cooker was purely *coincidental*. I'm telling you, this is legit technical v&v. Don't look at me like I'm some lazy bum... Oh, fine! I'll share some with you... And ... you won't tell Perlica about this, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 其实我在商会、宏科院和工团都实习过，但当时终末地的人事部给我开了无法拒绝的条件：获得所有超域相关资料的阅读权限。其中还着重标注了一句：权限等级和管理员相同。
voiceDesc.en: I've actually interned at the TGCC, HAS, and UWST. But the Endfield HR Division gave me an offer that I simply couldn't refuse: Unrestricted access to the Endfield databank on everything Ætherside! They even highlighted this particular line: "Access authority level shall be on par with that of the Endministrator."

voiceDesc.cn: 我们对超域的了解，其实少得可怜。里面可能一片漆黑，也可能是……彻底的混乱。我们现在能看到的，就只有那些侵蚀现象。它们的颜色很诡异，像是颠覆了光谱的原理。但说真的，看久了，我甚至觉得它们……有点迷人？
voiceDesc.en: We hardly know anything about the Ætherside. It might be a completely dark place ... or a realm of absolute chaos. As of now, Blight phenomena are the only things we can observe. They come in all sorts of weird colors — like the conventional laws governing the optical spectrum don't even apply. Truth be told, having spent so much time studying them ... I can't help but feel that they're actually quite ... enthralling.

voiceDesc.cn: 我每年都会去环塔商会的城市好几趟，去合金萝卜城采购材料和设备，或是去新蓝卡坞的电影节把电影看个够。但我最喜欢的城市是耶尔什，想不到吧？我喜欢那里的雪，那里的天空，那里的万籁俱寂。
voiceDesc.en: I visit quite a few TGCC cities every year. Alloycarrot is where I get my materials and equipment, and New Wrankwood's Film Festival is where I do some serious movie-binging. But if I'm talking about my favorite city, it has to be Kjersch. Surprised, huh? I love their snow, their open skies, and their quiet serenity.

voiceDesc.cn: “泰拉复古音乐”已经是我爷爷奶奶还年轻的时候听的啦。环塔商会现在的流行乐是“新塔风”。最近那首《立体声》，我就超级喜欢！我们生在塔卫二，长在塔卫二，当然要搞点属于塔卫二的新东西。
voiceDesc.en: Terran Retro is something that my grandparents listened to when they were teens. What's IN right now is Neo-Talosian. I LURRRV the song STEREO! We're Talosians, born and raised — of course we're gonna drop jams that are Talos-II-legit.

voiceDesc.cn: 我爸妈都挺忙的，小时候基本没人陪我。他们送了我一只羽兽，当作我的玩伴。它特别吵，脾气非常暴躁，把我的房间搞得乱糟糟的……但我真的很喜欢它。也许你已经猜到了，它就是“小暴鸰”的原型。小暴鸰虽然安静多了，但还是继承了它的坏脾气。
voiceDesc.en: When I was a child, my parents were really busy and there was no one else around. So they gave me a fowlbeast as a playmate. It was loud, bad tempered, and kept messing up my room ... but I really loved that creature. You probably guessed that it was the inspiration for my Tweety-Bomb. Though my Tweety-Bombs make a lot less noise, they inherited the foul temper of that cute ball of feathers.

voiceDesc.cn: 三年前刚来四号谷地的时候，我压根没打算久留。但克劳老师一把超域试验场的裂隙数据甩出来，我就上钩了！后来，我们俩整天因为研究路线吵架，他吵不过我，干脆把我塞给了安德烈。结果你猜怎么着？有了终末地的技术支持，我的研究简直一发不可收拾！这三年，我的论文大爆发——四号谷地，还真是我的福地。
voiceDesc.en: I actually never intended to stay at Valley IV when I first arrived three years ago. But Professor Crowe showed me some rift data readings from the Æther Test Site — got me hooked right there and then! Shame we couldn't agree on anything after that. Total research meltdown. Old Crowe couldn't beat me, so he sent me to Andre instead. Guess what? My project started spitting out solid results with that sweet Endfield tech support! I was chugging out papers left and right for three years straight! Oh, Valley IV is truly my special zone of fortune.

voiceDesc.cn: 那个那个！带回去研究研究。
voiceDesc.en: Ohhhh! Gotta take that one back for my studies.

voiceDesc.cn: 偷偷告诉你，那儿都是好东西！
voiceDesc.en: Psst. Got a secret for you. The stuff over there is made of awesome!

voiceDesc.cn: 那附近我也没去过。走，咱们去瞧瞧！
voiceDesc.en: Never been to that place. Let's head over for a closer look.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的小暴鸰有点紧张，那家伙应该很厉害！
voiceDesc.en: Tweety-Bomb looks a little nervous. That one's probably a naughty big bad.

voiceDesc.cn: 应该给武器加装一个采矿专用模块的。
voiceDesc.en: Should've furnished my pewpews with a specialized mining module.

voiceDesc.cn: 来帮忙啦！爆破什么的我很擅长哦！
voiceDesc.en: Here to help! I happen to be an expert demolitionist!

voiceDesc.cn: 哇，里面的东西好好看啊。
voiceDesc.en: Wow, that's some nice-looking bling.

voiceDesc.cn: 我一直想要一款像这样流光变幻的指甲油。
voiceDesc.en: Such fluid, effervescent glittering. I've always wanted my nails varnished like that.

voiceDesc.cn: 怎么样？消除得干干净净！
voiceDesc.en: Absolute neutralization! What do you think?

voiceDesc.cn: 终于能歇一歇了，发型都乱了，得赶紧整理下。
voiceDesc.en: Whew. Been waiting for this break forever. Gotta tame this wild hair...

voiceDesc.cn: 别紧张，试试这个。
voiceDesc.en: Don't panic. Try this.

voiceDesc.cn: 啊，现在舒服多了！
voiceDesc.en: Ahhh... I'm feeling much better!

voiceDesc.cn: 我掩护你，快闪开！
voiceDesc.en: Evade! I'll cover you!

voiceDesc.cn: 呜，好疼！好像受伤了……
voiceDesc.en: Hngh... It hurts... They got me bad...

voiceDesc.cn: 讨厌！弹药耗尽了……
voiceDesc.en: Shoot... I'm out...

voiceDesc.cn: 刚才那招好帅！
voiceDesc.en: Spectacular!

voiceDesc.cn: 大家都好厉害！
voiceDesc.en: You're so amazing, team!

voiceDesc.cn: 那当然，也不看看我是谁！
voiceDesc.en: Uh-huh. Greatness is kinda my thing!

voiceDesc.cn: 咱们配合得不错。
voiceDesc.en: Beautiful teamwork.

voiceDesc.cn: 所有装备充能完毕。
voiceDesc.en: All equipment charged and ready.

voiceDesc.cn: 火力支援就交给我吧！
voiceDesc.en: Fire support, hot and ready!

voiceDesc.cn: 赢啦！我要拍张照纪念一下。
voiceDesc.en: Victory is ours! Time for a selfie.

voiceDesc.cn: 没想到吧，战斗对我来说也不在话下。
voiceDesc.en: FYI, I'm also quite the combat expert.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，这么痛快的胜利一定要庆祝一下。
voiceDesc.en: Hmph. This triumph deserves a real partay!

voiceDesc.cn: 战场上变数太多，连“小嘀嗒”都无法预测……但下次我们肯定能做得更好！
voiceDesc.en: Battles are hard to predict, even for Tink-a-Bella... *BUT* we'll definitely do better next time.

voiceDesc.cn: 可恶！我要给速冻仔的功率提升五十倍，下次要赢我可就没那么容易了。
voiceDesc.en: Blasted blightery! I'm upping Frost-e-Bytee's output by 5000 percent! Let's see how they beat that!

voiceDesc.cn: 火力加倍！
voiceDesc.en: Power shot!

voiceDesc.cn: 再来一下！
voiceDesc.en: One more shot!

voiceDesc.cn: 降温了哦！
voiceDesc.en: Feel the chill!

voiceDesc.cn: 给你消消火！
voiceDesc.en: Simmer down!

voiceDesc.cn: 冷静一下吧！
voiceDesc.en: Get iced!

voiceDesc.cn: 武器就绪！
voiceDesc.en: Ready to blast!

voiceDesc.cn: 充能完毕！
voiceDesc.en: Fully energized.

voiceDesc.cn: 去吧，速冻仔！
voiceDesc.en: Go! Frost-e!

voiceDesc.cn: 一起凉快凉快！
voiceDesc.en: Let's get icy!

voiceDesc.cn: 快速瞄准！
voiceDesc.en: KABOOM!

voiceDesc.cn: 精准一击！
voiceDesc.en: Purrrfect shot!

voiceDesc.cn: 来，一起跳个舞吧！
voiceDesc.en: Let us dance!

voiceDesc.cn: 感受我“超载的热情”吧！
voiceDesc.en: Passion supercharged!

voiceDesc.cn: 送你一场烟花秀！
voiceDesc.en: Fireworks for you!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员大潘，本名潘远，出身宏山科学院，自称游历四方的厨师兼游商。经干员陈千语介绍，宏山科学院送函认证，与终末地工业合作，以个人身份加入特种技术部门。尊重干员个人意愿，额外向他开放食堂的部分权限。

大潘提供的过往履历非常杂乱。已确认真实可靠的经历有“辣么大”火锅店店长、宏山科学院天师、电工、木工、钳工，在《合意拳·再临》中客串过两次背景板等。
暂时无法考据的部分主要有两条。首先是他自述在塞梦珂当过一段时间的出租车司机，而我们并未查询到大潘在该城市的相关营运许可证。在我指出这点后，他的嘴角咧开超过七十度，并大力拍打起我的机械面板。另一条则是为帮朋友“撑场子”，他在菈梵朵玛兼职做了三天观赏驮兽替身。在我意识到自己被他牵着问了太多黑车司机与观赏驮兽的事情，反倒忽略了最应当详细了解的天师经历时，我们已经攀谈了将近四小时。
核实那段宏山科学院的经历时，大潘的神情展现出明显的惆怅和不悦，但很快，他恢复了笑容，用一个轻松的玩笑转移了话题——向我展示他与观赏驮兽们亲密无间的合影。我能看出他回避去谈与那几位天师间的龃龉，但这并不是减分项，他至今仍为科考站的事故耿耿于怀，恰恰能证明他的内心最深处依旧是那名秉承理念和操守的宏科院天师。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Da Pan (ID name: Pan Yuan) is a member of the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). He claims to be a very well-traveled chef and trader. He has joined the Specialist Tech Division as an independent, with recommendations from Operator Chen Qianyu and a letter of authentication from HAS. We also respected his personal wishes and granted him partial authority levels for canteen access. 

Da Pan provided an incredibly chaotic CV. His verifiable work experiences include: owner of hot pot eatery, LA-ME-DA (literal translation: Spicily Huge); tianshi at HAS; electrician; carpenter; machinist; and background extra in Heyi Quan: Zailin (literal translation: Fist of Combined Will: Revisited). 
Two of his past experiences cannot be verified. The first was a brief stint of driving taxis at Simonch. We failed to find any commercial driving license or records for Da Pan in the said city. When I pointed out this finding, the Ursus' maw cracked into a 70-degree smile and he applied a rather powerful slap on my mechanical chassis. The second would be "friendly assists and support". Da Pan claims he part-timed as an ornamental burdenbeast stand-in for three days at La Fantoma. By the time I realized that I had been misled into an engrossing dialog about unlicensed taxi driving and ornamental burdenbeasts, we had already been talking for four hours — and I had neglected to ask Da Pan about the experiences that he should remember best: his time as a tianshi at HAS. 
While verifying his experiences in HAS, Da Pan became visibly downcast and displeased. But he quickly resumed his smile and deflected the topic with a casual joke. Then he showed me a friendly group photo of him and other ornamental burdenbeasts. I could obviously tell that he was trying to avoid talking about his disagreeable past with other Tianshi, but this is not a negative consideration for Endfield. Since Da Pan is still affected by the Science Station incident, it proves that he remains, deep inside, a HAS tianshi who upholds a strong sense of principles, responsibilities, and duty. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>《多变的潘叔》
武夌（陵）城有一个多变的潘叔，他是我见过最热心肠的人。他长得黑白分明，眼睛像是葡萄，耳朵则是像两个大大的金元宝，带（戴）着墨镜特别帅。
潘叔会变身，总是穿着各种各样的衣服，有时候是白色的大围裙，有时候是作业服，有时候会带（戴）着黄色的塑料帽子。潘叔有一间火锅店，说我们想家了就可以随时去吃，如果我们火锅吃腻了，他也会变着法子给我们做好吃的馒头、火暴（爆）腰花、松尾林（鳞）。最好吃的是醋留（溜）白菜跟回锅肉，希望能成为招牌菜。
但潘叔也有不好心肠的时候，他会往我的饭盒里放辣交（椒）酱，跟我说是“魔法酱料”，我分给其他小朋友，大家的嘴巴都肿了。
除了照顾小朋友外，潘叔也会特别热心帮助其他人。他总是帮城里的人修电表、接水管、砍竹子。因为潘叔特别好，总是帮助大家，大家也愿意帮他，但因为潘叔太厉害了，大家没什么能帮忙的，只能送水果跟点心……还有偷偷减兔（免）火锅店的租金。听说潘叔的家也在暴（爆）炸里没有了，所以他不得不花钱住在别人家里。
——常客留下的泛黄作文

有一次我问潘叔，为什么他工作这么多年却完全没存下钱来，他说都被吃掉了，我还笑话他嘴馋。后来才知道，原来是招待了那么多孩子……
——陈千语

人们经常会被他的热情与亲切感染，在初次见面的几分钟内就竹筒倒豆子，把自己的事讲给他听。但反过来，干员大潘并不太主动去聊自己的故事，直到现在依旧有许多人对他的印象只是“很热情、会做饭的宏科院天师”。沉痛的过往是一种信息负担，交深言浅是他特有的体贴，但把自己的事情憋在心中并非好事。
我更担心的是他来到帝江号上后，很多人，尤其是管理员的体重在明显增长……
——佩丽卡</>

<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Uncle Pan the Everchenjing 
Uncle Pan the Everchenjing lives in Wuling and hes like the most warmest person i've ever seen. Hes black and white and his eyes look like grapes. His ears look like gold yuanbao and he looks very cool with his sunglasses. 
Uncle Pan can transform and he's got all sorts of clothes like a big white shef apron or crew overalls. Sometimes he also wears a yellow plastic hat. Uncle Pan also has a hot pot shop and tolds us that we can have meals at his place if we miss home and if we got tired of hot pot he will make other delishus stuff like mantow buns, flashy fryd kidnees, or sweet sour fins. The best food made by Uncle Pan is the veeneger bokk choy and refryd meat and he wants to make them the chefs speshow. 
But sometimes Uncle Pan plays pranks on us. He puts spisy saos in my lunch box but tells me its magic jam so i share the magic jam with my frenz and everyone got sosejj lips. 
Uncle Pan takes care of the kids and he also helps other people. He can fix power meeters, do plumming and pipes, chop the bamboos. Cos Uncle Pan is so helpful to everyone, everyone also wants to help Uncle Pan. But Uncle Pan is reely powerfol and theres nothing we can help him with, so we gave him delishus fruits and sweets... and the landlord lowerd his hot pot shop rent. Peepo say that Uncle Pan is homeless cos his home eksploddeded so he has to spend money to liv in a frenz home. 

One day i ask Uncle Pan why he made no money after working for many years. He told me he spent all the money on food but later i lerned that he spent all the money on the kids... 
— Chen Qianyu 

His passion and friendliness are infectious. People often start spilling their beans and sharing their stories within minutes after meeting him. But the reverse does not apply. Operator Da Pan rarely talks about his own story. Nevertheless, many still regard him as the "friendly HAS tianshi who really knows how to cook". A painful past may be a burden to bear. Being a listener with few words makes him a decent friend. However, being secretive and keeping to oneself are rarely good things. 
My other concern is that after Da Pan arrived at Dijiang, many of our operators (and our Endministrator as well) began putting on significant amounts of weight... 
— Perlica </>

<@profile.key>《“先进科研工作者”奖项候选人推荐表》
填写人：罗时乔

综合“创新、影响、适应性”三个维度，我推荐将今年的“先进科研工作者”颁发给潘远天师。在过往工作中，他累计取得了十二项学术成果，并达成六项宏山科学院的可持续发展目标。纵观近十年的获奖人员名单，只有极少数能做出与他当前阶段相同的贡献，而且他还不到三十岁。
虽然我是他的老师，但可以保证以上评价绝无任何偏颇之处。当潘远敲开我办公室的门，说想跟着我做项目时，我第一反应是拒绝。毕竟我对这位年轻人的印象并不算好。他会用正在燃烧的爆炸物打乒乓球，会在“冒辣果创意料理同好会”的电子海报上让几位德高望重的老天师跳踢踏舞，会用废材料做了台迷你高速战舰攻打地下冷库，搞得大楼一整个月都充斥着腐坏的鳞肉味……是，都不算什么，年轻人总是调皮的，宏科院鼓励所有探索行为，我年轻时也把自己送进过急诊室。
有些孩子做恶作剧是为了引起其他人注意，另一些孩子这么做是因为他们对世界有着庞大的好奇心。潘远这孩子的情况又有些不同，他——太聪明了。我能看出他做这些事情时眼里的意兴阑珊。成为他的老师后，我更清晰意识到他做的这一切只是因为他能做，或者说他想证明即使是恶作剧，他也能轻轻松松地比其他人做得更好，整个宏科院里没有他的对手。
遭到挫折，得到乐趣；没有挫折，就没有乐趣——没有乐趣能在学术道路上走多远？一名石匠不眠不休地雕琢一生，也只能留下寥寥作品。潘远是一块极其难啃的顽石，需要打磨才可以绽放光彩，但能让他跌倒，以此雕琢他的，只有比他硬度更高的石头。
我说：“相比我而言，有几位在裂隙研究领域的天师更有学术建树，更适合做你的老师……”
潘远说：“但我现在有一座必须要去攀爬的山，只有您的院管项目与其方向相符。”
那瞬间，他眼神中除了迷茫与痛苦，还隐藏着一些小心翼翼的期盼。或许我对他的判断并不全对，也或许有什么改变了他。只要他怀着执念，我相信他会做出好的改变。

若一定要问我有什么不把奖项颁给他的理由……除了有点冲动的脾气外，大概就是他在实验室炒菜怕别人偷吃，给放着炒米的罐子贴上“还原剂”的标签，害我的初号原型机报废了吧！</>

<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: List of Candidates for the Vanguard Scientist Award 
Author: Luo Shiqiao 

After integrating observations for the three dimensions of innovation, influence, and adaptability, I recommend Tianshi Pan Yuan as the recipient for this year's Vanguard Scientist award. His work so far accrued a total of twelve academic achievements and he has attained six sustainable development goals for HAS. Very few awardees from the last ten years have achievements on par with his. And Da Pan is not yet thirty. 
Although I am his mentor, I can guarantee that my evaluations are completely fair and balanced. When Pan Yuan knocked on my door and described his wish to be on my project team, my first reaction was to turn him down. The young man had left a relatively poor impression with me back then. He played ping-pong with explosives, on fire. He also got several veteran (and well respected) Tianshi to perform tap dance on a digital poster of Creative Maolaguo Cuisine Lovers. He built several high-speed battleships from scraps, and attacked our subterranean cryostorage facility with his fleet. The entire building reeked of rotten fins for a month... Yes. I suppose these are minor misdemeanors that come naturally to the youths. HAS encourages all kinds of scientific exploration, and even I ended up in the emergency medical bay a few times back in my younger days. 
Certain youths play pranks to get attention. Some of them do so to sate their immense curiosity about the world. Pan Yuan doesn't quite belong to either of these categories. He is ... too smart. I saw disinterested boredom in his eyes when he was caught doing these pranks. After becoming his mentor, I realized that he committed these actions because he could. To put it in other words, he wanted to prove that he was simply better than anyone else in HAS — even when it came to pulling off pranks on campus. 
Joy comes from challenges. Take away the challenge and you deprive any opportunities for joy — and a joyless academic pursuit will never get far. A sculptor who spends every moment chipping away at stone would only leave a handful of works behind. Pan Yuan has proved to be most obstinate. This stone must be properly polished to reveal its true beauty. But only another slab of stone harder than him could hope to bring down his pride and chip away at his edges. 
I told him, "There are several Tianshi who made significant achievements in the field of rift research. They would be better mentors than me..." 
But Pan Yuan replied, "But there is a great mountain within me that must be conquered first. Your projects and research focus are the only things that match my goals." 
At that moment, I saw confusion, pain, and maybe a subtle dash of cautious hope in his eyes. Maybe my judgment on his character was not entirely correct. Perhaps something changed him. As long as he is persistent, I have faith he will change for the better. 

And if you must have a reason for not giving him the award ... there is the matter of his rather impulsive temperament. And also because he was cooking in the lab and deliberately mislabeled a tub of puffed rice as "Reducing Agent". Maybe he didn't want others to steal his food, but this action completely wrecked my first prototype! </>

<@profile.key>【一段葬礼上的致辞】
那是个很普通的清晨，跟宏科院每日都要迎来的清晨一样。只是阳光照进办公室时，我的丈夫已经在睡梦中溘然长逝。
他将一生都献给了宏山科学院——所以有段时间我非常憎恶它。每当我提着饭盒走入长廊，听着周遭那些脑中装着数不清典籍的天师不停争吵，我心里只有厌烦。无论他们究竟是想端上铁饭碗，创造些对改善环带境况没实际作用的废纸，去争夺一把名次更高的椅子，还是真的打算让所有人都吃饱，这些事对我来说都不重要。
我无法理解为什么，为什么他们一定要让更多人活下去，却又可以对自己的生命满不在乎？就好像“活着”只是一条院规、一个抽象概念——就好像他们的思想、事业，乃至存在都只是这执念的一部分？
…………
许多年前，我在这处公墓亲手埋下了女儿的一件衣服，她是武陵科考站那初始的一百一十三人之一。
……我跟丈夫有许多年没有说过话了。在我得知女儿生命体征停止的消息时，他正在与老天师们进行连续表决，三天以后才给我打了一个电话。我哭着问他为什么不能带回孩子们的遗体，他只说，没有办法。那时我恨不得能绑上一捆爆炸物，去跟我丈夫、跟老天师们同归于尽——直到……当时有两位非常年轻的天师提出了反对意见，我记得有庄管代，还有一名乌萨斯——他在宏科院大闹了一场，在那之后就递交辞函，离开了宏山。
我以为在闹成那个样子后，这孩子并不会来参加葬礼，但在诸位来到这里之前我看见了他。他长大了，成熟了很多，并没有跟任何人说话，悄悄地来，又悄悄地走……只放下一瓶辣椒老妈。
现在，我又亲手埋下了我的丈夫。我依旧憎恶这间吞噬了我全部家人的宏山科学院，但我知道，他……还有那个孩子，以及现在站在这里的，由我丈夫培养的小天师们，你们爱着它。
至少在他离去的时候，有鲜花，还有他喜欢的拌饭酱。

【修复的语音记录】
“已经几十个小时了。很遗憾，甚大裂隙周遭已经没有任何生命反应。既然大家都没有意见，我们决定停止一切搜救行动——”
“我有意见！我现在不想掰扯是谁提出的方案，为什么会实行成这样！可至少……至少无论生死，都要把人带回来吧？！我们怎么向遗属交代？！庄方宜，你别现在拉偏架——”
“冷静点，让我说一句。黄老师……这次潘天师说的是对的。轻易放弃不符合宏科院的精神，无论是从集体还是个人角度，我都建议继续搜救。”
“小庄，你跟潘天师意见一致居然是在这种场合……听着，我们是‘做不到’。你们作为天师，心里必须有杆秤，衡量活着的跟死了的哪边更重要。现在，坐下！”
“那就想办法去做到啊！”
“……潘远，不是每个人都是你。”
“去你*炎国粗口*的。”</>

<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: A funeral speech 
It was an ordinary morning, like all the other mornings that HAS had received before. But when the sunlight poured into the office, my husband had already passed away in his dreams. 
He committed his entire life to the Hongshan Academy of Sciences — Naturally there was a time when I hated it. Whenever I stepped into the corridors to deliver his meal, I felt only annoyance when I heard the all-knowing Tianshi debate each other. I didn't care if they were trying to get permanent tenure, jostling for higher positions, or really trying to get people fed. I didn't want to know why they were creating stacks of paper with no actual benefits to the environment. None of these mattered to me. 
I didn't understand why they would neglect their own lives just so others could survive and live theirs. It felt as though "survival" was a canon rule of the Academy, or an abstract concept. Perhaps their entire philosophy, career, and even existence was just part of this obsession of theirs. 
............ 
With my own hands I buried my daughter's dress at this public cemetery many years ago. She was one of the 113 who left us in the early days of the Wuling Science Station. 
...My husband and I had not talked for years. When I learned that my darling girl's vital signs ceased, he was carrying out the consecutive voting process with the old Tianshi. He only called me after three days. I was in tears when I asked why we couldn't bring the children's remains back home. He only told me it was impossible. At that time, the only wish on my mind was to strap myself with explosives and take my husband and those old academicians to the grave — that is ... until two incredibly young Tianshi opposed the vote. One was Viceroy Zhuang, and the other was an Ursus. The latter made quite a scene at HAS and soon left Hongshan after submitting his resignation. 
I thought the young lad, having expressed his disagreements in such a physical manner, wouldn't attend the funeral. But I saw him before everyone gathered here. He grew up and matured. He came quietly, and left just as quietly. He shared no words with anyone ... and left nothing but a jar of Mrs. Pepper. 
And now with my hands I buried my husband. I still detest HAS for having devoured my entire family. Yet I know that he ... that child, and every young Tianshi standing here with us whom my late husband had mentored, you have nothing but love for the Academy. 
At least he had flowers and his favorite hot sauce by his side when he left us. 

FILE: Repaired audio log 
"Dozens of hours had passed. Unfortunately, we have picked up no vital signs in the vicinity of the Very Large Rift. Since we have a unanimous consensus, we shall act upon the decision and cease all SAR operations." 
"Objection! I'm not going to argue whose proposal it was and how it ended up this way! But at least have the common decency to bring our people out, dead or alive! How could we even face their families after this?! Zhuang Fangyi, don't you dare side with them!" 
"Calm down and let me say something. Professor Huang... I believe Tianshi Pan is right. Giving up right now goes against the collective as well as individual spirit espoused by the HAS. I recommend continuing our SAR efforts." 
"Zhuang, I couldn't believe you actually agreed with Tianshi Pan on something, but this isn't the moment or place... Listen to us. This isn't giving up. We simply couldn't get it done. As Tianshi, you should use the balance of reason and understand this is us weighing the living against the dead. Now, get back to your seats." 
"Couldn't get it done?! Then think of something to get it done!" 
"Not everyone is like you, Pan Yuan..." 
"[Yanese expletive]." </>

“管理员，这篇论文……嗐，您别夸我，臊得慌。这些东西依旧是从您当年那些基础理论上生长出来的，谈不上什么突破，还差得远呢。”

"..." 
"It's kinda funny, really. I'm already forty plus, yet I'm still obsessed about climbing the highest mountain. There's a little panda deep within me... If I ever mentioned this to people in HAS, I would end up as joke material. They'd laugh and say how far Pan Yuan had fallen."
