voiceDesc.cn: 哟，管理员，家伙什儿都备齐了？
voiceDesc.en: Oh, Endmin! Are you done with preparations?

voiceDesc.cn: 可不能糟践粮食——嘿，您怎么来了？
voiceDesc.en: We can't waste food like this — YO! Good to see you here!

voiceDesc.cn: 还是这儿舒坦。要我露一手？
voiceDesc.en: Finally a place to stretch my limbs! Care to check out my skills?

voiceDesc.cn: 您办事，我放心。
voiceDesc.en: If you're the one calling the shots, I'll be right behind you.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗬，这家伙好使，您张罗这费心了！
voiceDesc.en: Hooo. This piece is well-balanced. You must have spent a fortune on it.

voiceDesc.cn: 很久不试装备了。嚯，紧了点，不过瞅着还不赖。您觉着呢？
voiceDesc.en: Haven't been fully decked out for a while. HGNH! AHH! Well, what do you think? Looks pretty good, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 不会的菜式就得多练！这可不是为了出风头，我掌勺就图个做得敞亮，吃得爽心！
voiceDesc.en: If you're not good with a dish, just make it more often! I don't cook to show off. I do it to make a pretty and joyful feast!

voiceDesc.cn: 活到老，学到老，关键腿脚还得保养好！
voiceDesc.en: One is never too old to learn. The secret lies in keeping your legs in working order!

voiceDesc.cn: 鄙人——能力有限，水平一般，感谢赏识。以茶代酒，先干为敬！
voiceDesc.en: I'm not the best pick nor the best warrior, and I am very flattered by your kindness. I don't have any wine with me, so I'll drain this teapot as a sign of my gratitude!

voiceDesc.cn: 我自认不算什么大拿，但好在办事从不怯勺，这晋升的名头就先受着了。有事您吩咐，我绝不撂挑子拿您开涮！
voiceDesc.en: Though my talents are limited, I always live up to the task. So, I'll take this promotion. Holler me if you need something done. I won't leave you hanging out to dry.

voiceDesc.cn: 劳您担待了。不过眼瞅着我武陵的铺子又得多关些日子——等您得闲了，咱们回去摆上一大桌，让您尝尝鲜，也顺便拜托乡亲们继续帮我照看铺子。
voiceDesc.en: That's very nice of you, but this means my shop at Wuling must stay closed for a while — Once you got the time, we'll head back, throw a feast for you ... and ask my relatives to take care of my business.

voiceDesc.cn: 前阵子回宏山，老师又变着方儿地撺掇我回她的院管项目，最后还得搬出终末地的名头她才消停——甭管您怎么看，但能在帝江号上混着这个差事，我与有荣焉——您咋还脸红上了呢？
voiceDesc.en: During my last Hongshan visit, my Master did everything she could to peg me to a project in the Academy. She stopped when I told her I'm now working at Endfield — Not gonna lie, Endmin, I am TRULY honored to get an official post aboard Dijiang — Hey, why are you blushing?

voiceDesc.cn: 欸，又见面了，管理员。工程上有用得上我的地方尽管言语，保管帮您解决麻烦！要是您愿意招呼我上伙房露一手，那我就更开心了！
voiceDesc.en: Oh, we meet again, Endmin. Got an engineering problem? Point it out, and consider it fixed! And I'll be EVEN happier if there's canteen work for me!

voiceDesc.cn: 您这是要上哪儿？
voiceDesc.en: Where to next, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 有活儿？我替您支着。
voiceDesc.en: Got a job for me? I'll handle it.

voiceDesc.cn: 您先歇着，我换套作业服就过去。
voiceDesc.en: Don't worry. Just take your break. I'll be right there once I squeeze into my work outfit.

voiceDesc.cn: 有空陪您撮顿好的！
voiceDesc.en: Once you have time, I'll throw a feast for you!

voiceDesc.cn: 要是帝江号的伙食吃腻味了，您随时招呼我！
voiceDesc.en: Hungry for something not offered in the Dijiang cafeteria? I can help.

voiceDesc.cn: 您可看着又瘦了。这节骨眼儿上您更该对自己多上上心，要不给您开点小灶？
voiceDesc.en: You lost weight again. Please, take better care of your health. Want me to cook something?

voiceDesc.cn: 哎呀，帝江号之前的伙食总是不得劲儿。您先甭反驳我，今天我掌勺，弄了点新鲜的，您先尝尝！
voiceDesc.en: Hrrmph. The Dijiang cafeteria wasn't hitting the right place. Don't disagree yet. Try this. I cooked it myself!

voiceDesc.cn: 听说您刚批评了那些对我说话刺了点的晚辈？其实不碍事，天师也好，厨子也罢，我听着都开心。帝江号上也难得有愿意找我聊天的同事了。
voiceDesc.en: Heard you talked to the youths who disagreed with me. It's alright. I don't care if they're Tianshi or chefs. Not everyone aboard Dijiang has the time to share a few words with an old panda.

voiceDesc.cn: 我在帝江号上看到不少宏山科学院的技术，院里轨道技术专家们的心血都真切摆在我眼前——您保管想象不出那个场面，几位老师为了一个小自检模块该搁哪儿都能吵个天昏地暗。
voiceDesc.en: I see plenty of Academy tech aboard Dijiang. Actual pieces of hard work carried out by the HAS orbital tech experts — You definitely can't picture this bunch of loud, angry codgers! They'll start wars about where to place a tiny diagnostic module!

voiceDesc.cn: 不是驳您面子，终末地的宿舍不够大呀！早上我伸个懒腰，胳膊和膝盖就都磕青了。您给想想法子！
voiceDesc.en: Endfield dorm rooms aren't big enough! No disrespect, but I just did a morning stretch and ended up bruising my elbows and knees. PLEASE! Do something!

voiceDesc.cn: 您要见到安德烈，就替我招呼一句——我还等着听他的新思路呢！他怎么还躲着我啊？
voiceDesc.en: If you see Andre, tell the Big Owl that — he owes an Old Panda his latest ideas! AND tell him to stop hiding from me!

voiceDesc.cn: 总算逮着您了，管理员！专门弄来的特产，接好咯！
voiceDesc.en: Found you, Endmin! Here! Something special straight from Hongshan!

voiceDesc.cn: 承蒙关照！
voiceDesc.en: I am deeply honored!

voiceDesc.cn: 您有麻烦尽管找我，咱什么活没干过！厨子、电工、木工、司机，甚至练摊儿都称得上职业。毕竟实验室里要忙活的事儿很多。“先进科研工作者”？嘿嘿，只是我顺手拿来泡茶的杯子而已。
voiceDesc.en: I know you got tons of lab work lying around, so you can set me on the task! I've been a proud chef, electrician, carpenter, chauffeur, and roadside entrepreneur. So, I can do ANYTHING. Oh, you got a question about this "Vanguard Worker" flask? Heheh, I just use it for tea.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，有机会您得去宏山科学院本部遛遛。哪怕不为图新鲜，只是去听听学生们的辩论。许多前沿课题会引用您过去的研究，虽然您都忘了——说起来，我的论文是不是也引用了您的文章来着？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, do visit the Hongshan Academy of Sciences headquarters. Even if you're not excited about visiting a new place, the student debates can be quite exciting. You probably don't remember, but plenty of pioneering projects cite your work — Wait. I ... actually referenced your paper as well.

voiceDesc.cn: 我这口大黑锅，防雨防火，还防蚀刻弹，必要时候往身上一背，能挡不少事儿！管理员，咱们有时候多吃点儿苦，就能少吃点儿亏，这买卖我觉得值，太值了。
voiceDesc.en: This black iron wok of mine keeps out both rain, fire, and even etched bullets. When necessary, I can just wear it on my back and it gets me covered nice and safely! Well, Endmin, going the extra mile will earn us a slight advantage when we need it most. This is a good deal. I say we take it.

voiceDesc.cn: 您别看我现在老说得过且过，当年我潘远在宏科院可不惯着别人！谁敢在研究上跟我抬杠，那我们就得当场说道清楚——哎，但要太认咱那死理，可能不经意间就误了旁人大半辈子的努力。哪怕找补回来，自己心里那道坎儿都抹不掉了。不过都是些老黄历了，您就听一乐呵。
voiceDesc.en: Me? Pan Yuan the friendly old panda? HAH! Back then, no one in HAS dared cross my path. Da Great Pan Yuan ENDED scientific disagreements on the spot and, and — Ugh. Well, there are times when sticking to cold, hard facts could unintentionally destroy someone's hard-earned career. I tried making up for it, but stubbornness is a cause for regret... Just take this story with a grain of salt.

voiceDesc.cn: 等帮您把眼下的麻烦都兜住了，劳您赏脸去宏山遛遛。放心，不拖您探店，宏山啥菜我自个儿在家不能给您做啊！就陪我回趟院里，帮我瞅瞅当年落下的研究。您别说，和您见识了那些新鲜事儿后，心里直痒痒！有您在，这次我非得把那硬茬给啃喽！
voiceDesc.en: Once you're done settling your problems here, I'll be very honored if you could visit Hongshan. No worries, you'll have time to visit the local stores and I can make any Hongshan dish at my place! Just swing by the Academy with me. I have an unfinished project and I really hope to try out the new stuff I saw with you! And since you're around, there's no giving up till I smash that bottleneck!

voiceDesc.cn: 想做好菜就甭找捷径。一道菜搞砸了再多次，也都得自己全咽咯，否则怎么咂吧出那个最合适的味儿呢？您说是吧！
voiceDesc.en: There is NO shortcuts for good food. You must keep trying and eat up your own mistakes along the way. It is the only path to hit the perfect blend of flavors. Don't you agree?

voiceDesc.cn: 您是明白人！技术讨论这事儿，就得敞开了聊。就事论事，咱们有分歧谈分歧，谈完了大家还是和和气气。唉，这事就怕有意见还非得心里憋着。不提了，难受！
voiceDesc.en: You got it all figured out! Technical problems can't be solved by beating around the bush. Focus on the issue, talk over the disagreements, and then we're all friends again, right? Never keep it to yourself. Ugh. I'll save the story for later. It left a bad taste in my mouth.

voiceDesc.cn: 每每跟您唠起武陵城，老是绕不开水秀山清，绕不开我那小店，绕不开侵蚀潮跟前搓麻将。虽说都是车轱辘话，但惦记也是真惦记！难说我这性子不是退休后被武陵城给养出来的。您别光偷着笑，话都说到这份上了，搓一轮？
voiceDesc.en: Wuling City. You can't talk about it without mentioning the beautiful natural scenery, or my shop, or games of Mahjong in the face of a rising Blight Tide. I know I can keep droning on and on, but I really miss the place! Perhaps Wuling pampered my post-retirement life too much. Oy, stop laughing. And since I mentioned it, are you up for some ... Mahjong?

voiceDesc.cn: 我游历过环带不少城市，也和很多同行切磋过。各家那点门道，都愿意敞开了放菜里。不过能学到几成，那就看各家造化了。
voiceDesc.en: I traveled to many cities and learned from many fellow chefs. Every chef is more than willing to reveal their cooking methods with their dishes. But mastering various culinary arts ... depends on one's skills.

voiceDesc.cn: 本以为退休了就能老实闲下来，烧烧饭，品品茶，日子照样过……唉，可惜遇见了您，之后就再没消停过咯。您要问这滋味咋样？哈，也不错！
voiceDesc.en: I thought retirement would be a relaxing life with cooking, tea brewing, and just getting by... But then you showed up and brought me an endless amount of work. How do I feel about it? HAH! Not bad at all, I say!

voiceDesc.cn: “感染者”，这个称呼好像早没了绝望的意味。真遇上了，大多数人也无非一句点儿背就带过去了……但要是您也多去环带外的聚落遛遛，保不准会有不同的看法。
voiceDesc.en: Becoming the "Infected" is no longer a death sentence. Most would simply feel they got unlucky and move on... But if you visit the villages and towns outside the Band, your views on becoming Oripathy Positive will change.

voiceDesc.cn: 武陵城底下的特大裂隙我们研究了这么些年，您要是想知道它的尺寸，我就着这口锅都能给您比划得清清楚楚。可真要想出个一劳永逸的解决办法，唉，难哟……
voiceDesc.en: We've studied the Very Large Rift beneath Wuling City for years. I can simply use my wok if you need exact dimension of the thing. But a permanent solution ... is still quite a challenge...

voiceDesc.cn: 哦，您见着庄管代了吧！她还是那副老样子，心里明明软着呢，但做事说话还非得逼着自己上狠手段。苦了自己不说，还落不着个好名声——算了，不提这茬。
voiceDesc.en: Oh. Did you see Viceroy Zhuang? She hasn't changed. Still forcing herself to act and look tough despite being all soft and mushy inside. Made her miserable, very unpopular and — Ugh. Let's skip this for another day.

voiceDesc.cn: 谁跟您胡说宏科院都是炎国人？院里讲究广纳贤才，只要能和其他俩阵营协调好，愿意耐得住性子搞研究，干嘛把人拒之门外？
voiceDesc.en: RIDICULOUS! Who said that the HAS only admitted candidates of Yanese descent? No one gets rejected due to their ancestry. We accept anyone who can work well with the other two factions, and those with the patience for scientific work.

voiceDesc.cn: 黎风那小子每天把身杆儿绷得那样儿，我瞅着就累，所以变着方儿地想让他放松放松。他呀，也乐意陪着我胡闹。那孩子的心思，门儿清！也不知道算好事儿还是坏事儿……
voiceDesc.en: Lifeng is too tense. I get tired just by looking at him, so I do my best to help him relax. Luckily, the boy's willing to fool around with this old panda. He's got a keen mind and sorts things out on his own, but I don't know if that's a good thing...

voiceDesc.cn: 集成工业系统的确可以很大程度改善难民们的生活，但毕竟大家想法不同，一件大好事儿也难免磕磕碰碰，您多担待！但四号谷地的事儿咱可不敢邀功，力所能及罢了！
voiceDesc.en: The AIC Factory will greatly improve the nomads' lives. Nevertheless, everyone has their own ideas, and great enterprises will always run into bumps. We just have to bear with it. This old panda is just doing his best and won't claim credit for what we achieved in Valley IV!

voiceDesc.cn: 来一趟不容易，能带多少带多少。
voiceDesc.en: Finding this is not easy. Fill your pockets with whatever you can.

voiceDesc.cn: 这种稀罕物挺不错，安排一下收集工作吧。
voiceDesc.en: A very rare finding. Time to assign gathering work.

voiceDesc.cn: 这附近有古怪，您千万留意！
voiceDesc.en: This place doesn't feel right. Be careful.

voiceDesc.cn: 有硬茬子，当心！
voiceDesc.en: Careful. That one looks like serious trouble.

voiceDesc.cn: 这些矿物品质不错！
voiceDesc.en: Fine quality ore!

voiceDesc.cn: 劳驾了您嘞！
voiceDesc.en: We appreciate your hard work!

voiceDesc.cn: 哇，金色！哈哈，和您逗闷子呢！
voiceDesc.en: The golden jackpot! Hah! Just messing with you!

voiceDesc.cn: 这醚质替您收着了。
voiceDesc.en: I'll keep this Aurylene for you.

voiceDesc.cn: 这片侵蚀搞定了！呼，累死我了。
voiceDesc.en: Blight neutralized! Hurrr. This is so exhausting.

voiceDesc.cn: 吃饱睡足，就不耽搁了。
voiceDesc.en: Had my fill of food and sleep. Let's keep going.

voiceDesc.cn: 别害怕，我帮您支着！
voiceDesc.en: Don't panic! I got you covered!

voiceDesc.cn: 舒坦！
voiceDesc.en: Feeling better.

voiceDesc.cn: 有险招！您多留神！
voiceDesc.en: Watch it! Don't get hit!

voiceDesc.cn: 咳，浑身不得劲儿。
voiceDesc.en: Hrraak... I'm not doing too well.

voiceDesc.cn: 对不住了您哪，我先喘口气！
voiceDesc.en: Sorry ... but I gotta take a breath!

voiceDesc.cn: 您动作真麻利！
voiceDesc.en: A very professional move!

voiceDesc.cn: 好配合！
voiceDesc.en: We make a good team!

voiceDesc.cn: 您客气了！
voiceDesc.en: You're welcome!

voiceDesc.cn: 大伙都不错！
voiceDesc.en: We're doing good, team!

voiceDesc.cn: 冲着我来？敢情好呀！
voiceDesc.en: Want a piece of panda? COME AT ME!

voiceDesc.cn: 您放开手干，其他我替您包圆咯！
voiceDesc.en: Call the shots! I'll do the rest!

voiceDesc.cn: 您辛苦，您受累！
voiceDesc.en: That's why you're the boss!

voiceDesc.cn: 打得酣畅淋漓——就是，嘿，肚子饿了。
voiceDesc.en: THAT was a good battle — Ah, well, it's time for food.

voiceDesc.cn: 您这话在理，赢得确实爽！
voiceDesc.en: Well said! It was fun, and we won!

voiceDesc.cn: 还好还好，差点连我这口大铁锅都给砸咯！
voiceDesc.en: That was close. They almost broke my iron wok.

voiceDesc.cn: 没啥抹不开面儿的，我来给大伙弄点好东西。吃饱了咱们再干回去！
voiceDesc.en: No need to fret. I'll make food for the team and avenge this defeat!

voiceDesc.cn: 尝尝这个！
voiceDesc.en: Here comes!

voiceDesc.cn: 走你！
voiceDesc.en: TAKE THAT!

voiceDesc.cn: 颠勺！
voiceDesc.en: FLIP DA WOK!

voiceDesc.cn: 满上！
voiceDesc.en: EAT THIS!

voiceDesc.cn: 起！
voiceDesc.en: UP YOU GO!

voiceDesc.cn: 要搭把手吗？
voiceDesc.en: Need a hand?

voiceDesc.cn: 放着我来！
voiceDesc.en: Watch me do this!

voiceDesc.cn: 往哪儿看呢！
voiceDesc.en: Eyes front!

voiceDesc.cn: 下去吧您哪！
voiceDesc.en: Bite the dust!

voiceDesc.cn: 回头见！
voiceDesc.en: See you NEVER!

voiceDesc.cn: 算我请您！
voiceDesc.en: THIS IS ON THE HOUSE!

voiceDesc.cn: 猛火快炒！
voiceDesc.en: ULTRA WOK HEY!

voiceDesc.cn: 尝尝我的手艺！
voiceDesc.en: TASTE MY PANDA SPECIAL!

voiceDesc.cn: 让你挑食！
voiceDesc.en: Time to ... CLEAN YOUR PLATE!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员秋栗，本名斯波红叶，毕业于新都筑高等商学院，以预备干员身份加入终末地工业。现为特种技术部门Z7行动组组长，负责指挥和管理工作。

以她的履历，本可以通过推荐进入环塔商会任何一家赫赫有名的大企业任职，却选择了来到终末地；即便在终末地，她也可以选择文职岗位，却在特种技术部门轮岗时主动提交申请，接下了重建Z7行动组的重担，成为前线行动人员。只能说，她心中一直奔腾着理想与热忱，是终末地最需要的年轻血液。
在候选人提问环节，她问了一个问题——终末地作为一个“伟大企业”的愿景是什么，想要如何实现？我想，答案最好由管理员亲自告诉她。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Akekuri, also known as Shiba Momiji, graduated from the Neo Tsukushi Business School and joined Endfield Industries as a reserve operator. She now leads Operations Team Z7 in the Specialist Tech Division, overseeing both field operations and team management. 

With her background, she could've walked into any renowned TGCC company with a single recommendation. Yet she chose to join Endfield. Even here, she could've opted for a desk job, but during her rotation in the Specialist Tech Division, she volunteered to take on the challenge of rebuilding Operations Team Z7, stepping into the role of a frontline operator. I believe Akekuri has always been driven by ideals and passion, she is exactly the kind of young talent Endfield needs. 
During her interview, she asked me: "What's Endfield's vision as a "great enterprise", and how does it plan to achieve it?" This is a question only the Endministrator can truly answer. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【新都筑高等商学院校报特刊】
在毕业典礼前夕，本报记者对优秀毕业生斯波红叶进行了专访。
“红叶学姐，您连续四年绩点位列专业第一，两次获得‘环塔青年综合商赛’金奖。请问，是什么支撑您始终保持高标准的自我要求？”
她微笑着回答：“习惯吧，也可能是因为我妈妈从小就这样教我做事。”
斯波红叶曾在环塔商会多家知名企业实习，包括在四之洲商事总部的实地经营岗位轮训，也参与了环塔物流协同调度系统的商业策划案制定，并提出了风险评估模型的关键优化建议，最终获得了企业方的高度评价。但是谈到她在四年里最骄傲的事迹，斯波红叶却把公益社团“萤之光”挂在嘴边。
“我一直相信，商业和管理能力的意义不仅体现在利润上，更体现在人与人之间的支持与互助。‘萤之光’让我学会了如何调动有限的资源，去照亮尽量多的人。”
谈及毕业后的去向，“您母亲是芝商社的代表取缔役社长，很多人都认为您会继承这份家业，您也从未公开表达过其他意向。现在毕业在即，可以透露一下未来的打算吗？”
面对这个问题，斯波红叶只是轻轻地摇了摇头，露出了俏皮的微笑：“我已经做好决定了。不过嘛，现在还不方便说。”

【一封自荐信】
致终末地工业人事部：
您好，我是斯波红叶，来自新都筑高等商学院。我希望能加入终末地工业，参与涉及资源管理与人员调度的工作。
我深知自己并非技术出身，也不是战斗人员，但我擅长统筹、调度与现场应变。我相信，这些能力同样可以发挥作用。我愿接受任何培训与考核，也愿意投身前线，只为一个目标：成为值得依靠的支援者，为更多人提供帮助。
感谢您的审阅。后附简历、成绩单、实习记录与比赛案例，希望得到您的回复！

斯波红叶</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Neo Tsukushi Business School News - Special Edition 
On the eve of the graduation ceremony, our reporter sat down with top graduate Shiba Momiji for an exclusive interview. 
"Miss Momiji, you've maintained the top GPA in your major for four years straight and won two gold medals in the TGCC Youth Business Competition. What has kept you so driven all this time?" 
Shiba Momiji smiled and replied, "It's just how I do things. Or maybe it's the way my mother taught me to approach life ever since I was little." 
Shiba Momiji interned at several top-tier TGCC companies. Her experiences included an on-site rotation at the headquarters of Shinozu Trading, as well as contributing to a business proposal for TGCC's logistics coordination system. Her key optimization ideas for the risk assessment model received glowing feedback from company leaders. Yet when asked about the achievement she's most proud of over the past four years, she spoke fondly of her work with the volunteer group Firefly Light. 
"I've always believed that the true value of business and management lies not only in profit, but also in how we support one another. Firefly Light taught me how to stretch limited resources to help as many people as possible." 
When asked about future plans: "Your mother runs Shiba Trading as its CEO. Many assume you'll follow in her footsteps, especially since you've never publicly expressed other ambitions. With graduation just around the corner, can you share your plans?" 
Shiba Momiji simply shook her head and grinned, "I've made up my mind. But ... you'll have to wait a little longer to find out." 

A Self-Recommendation Letter 
Dear HR Team at Endfield Industries, 
My name is Momiji Shiba, a student at the Neo Tsukushi Business School. I am writing to express my interest in joining Endfield Industries in a position focused on resource management and personnel coordination. 
Though I do not come from a technical or combat background, I specialize in logistics, coordination, and on-site problem-solving. I firmly believe these skills can make a meaningful contribution. I am ready to undergo any required training or evaluation and am willing to take on front-line responsibilities if needed. My goal is to be a dependable team member who helps others work more safely and efficiently. 
Thank you for your time and consideration. I have attached my resume, transcript, internship records, and project examples from past competitions. I look forward to hearing from you! 

Shiba Momiji</>

<@profile.key>【环塔商会相关函件】
来函方：芝商社
收函方：终末地工业人力资源事务部

尊敬的终末地工业人力资源事务部：
您好。
我是斯波红叶的母亲，斯波阳子。请原谅我以这样的方式打扰贵方。
作为商社的负责人，我习惯于以理性和效率处理事务。但提笔写下这封信时，我的内心却充满了复杂的情感。
红叶是我唯一的女儿。她的父亲与我的弟弟在讨伐天使的军旅中相识，因此与我结缘，然后有了红叶。在她的成长过程中，我是严格的教导者，而她那充满理想主义的父亲和舅舅则是带她游戏、玩耍的“大朋友”。
直到十年前那场对天使的远征结束后，她的舅舅再也没能回来，她生还的父亲也变了一个人，最后离开了我们的生活。
从那时候起，我便将红叶视为家庭唯一的延续，悉心培养她成为商社的继承人。她远离了那些葬送了我们的家庭的东西，再也不玩“打天使”的游戏，而成了优秀的学生，聪明，勤奋，始终不负我的期望。
然而，在毕业之际，她却选择了加入终末地工业，甚至投身于充满危险的前线工作。
起初，我对此感到震惊和恼怒。我们为此争执不休，关系紧张。
我并非不理解她，相反，我比任何一个人都清楚，她并非一时冲动。她的身体里依然流着她父亲的血，流着那份对理想、对正义的热血与执着——尽管这断送了她的童年。
我不再试图阻止她的决定。她愿意拼尽全力，只为证明自己的价值——这是我无法否定的理由。
我恳请贵方，在可能范围内确保她的安全。但也请相信，我的女儿不是只会念书的孩子。
谢谢你们的照顾。

斯波阳子</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Letter from TGCC 
SENDER: Shiba Trading 
RECIPIENT: Human Resources Division at Endfield Industries 

Dear HR Team at Endfield Industries, 
Greetings. 
My name is Shiba Yoko, mother of Shiba Momiji. Pardon me for reaching out in this manner. 
As the CEO of Shiba Trading, I am accustomed to addressing matters with logic and efficiency. Yet as I write this letter, I find myself overwhelmed by emotions. 
Momiji is my only daughter. Her father met my younger brother while serving in the war against the Aggeloi. That bond eventually brought him into my life, and later, we had Momiji. While I was the strict teacher in her upbringing, her father and uncle were her playmates and protectors, filling her childhood with laughter and idealism. 
Everything changed after the Crusade against the Aggeloi ended ten years ago. Her uncle never returned, and her father came back a different man — only to leave home not long after. 
Since then, I have raised Momiji with care and intention, preparing her to carry forward both our family and our business. I shielded her from the very things that once tore our lives apart. She set aside her childhood game of "fighting Aggeloi" and turned her focus to her studies, growing into a diligent, outstanding young woman. She has never once let me down. 
And yet, upon graduation, she made an unexpected decision — joining Endfield Industries and volunteering for front-line duty. 
I was taken aback and deeply upset. We argued incessantly, and our relationship suffered. 
But over time, I came to realize this was not just a reckless impulse. The same sense of justice and idealism that once guided her father lives on in her. Though these ideals may have cost her a carefree childhood, they now give her purpose — and strength. 
I no longer oppose her decision. She is determined to prove her worth, even if it means risking everything. That is a resolve I cannot deny. 
I respectfully ask that you keep her safe, as much as circumstances allow. But please understand that my daughter is more than just academically gifted. 
Thank you for supporting her journey. 

 Shiba Yoko</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>对曾经的“斯波红叶”而言，总结过去从不是难事。学生时代，她总能把一年中的进步与成果条分缕析，配上恰到好处的图表与注解，顺理成章地收获最佳评价。
但这一次却不太一样。Z7行动组成立满一年了，比起数字和案例，更多涌上心头的是……特殊的“感触”。
秋栗常常担心卡契尔——作为队伍的“盾”与后勤，他就像照顾家人一样照顾每一个人……他会不会太累了？
秋栗挂念着埃特拉的身体状况。外人或许觉得这个姑娘散漫、缺乏干劲，但秋栗知道，她在修复自己虚弱身体的同时，也在帮助Z7行动组修复这个世界的创伤——这很了不起。
秋栗更在意萤石的情绪波动，而不是时不时的“惹是生非”“我行我素”“冒犯他人”……秋栗常常反思自己，有没有成为足够稳妥的“缓冲”，让萤石感受到更多理解与信任？
秋栗也担心安塔尔的孤独。这个总被视作“怪人”的队员，其实热情且可靠，只是表达方式太过不同。她知道，安塔尔一直在努力与大家同步。
正因为有他们，才有了如今的Z7。
她感谢这一切——感谢他们总会说“组长下令就好”，也感谢他们让这支新人小队摆脱了质疑。
更多的感触，则关于秋栗自己：这一年，是否实现了自己的期待——调动有限的资源，去照亮尽量多的人，并且……最终照亮自己？
有时候秋栗会想，只要终末地的理想实现，和平真的到来——或许那个时候，父母就可以冰释前嫌，她可以像记忆里小时候那样，回到家里，和他们一起，好好吃一顿晚餐。
她正为此倾尽自己所有的努力。

《年度述职报告》
呈报人：Z7行动组组长 秋栗

佩丽卡监督：
一年过去，Z7行动组交出了这样的答卷——
全年执行任务40次（成功率95%，全员零伤亡），含跨区物资押运16次、荒野侦察协同9次、高危工程护卫7次、紧急救援8次。
我们的定位逐渐从“实验性补充力量”过渡为“稳定支援编制”。
P.S. 虽然年度考核中，Z7行动组的正面战斗力评级依然为普通，但支援、指挥和管理等评级名列前茅。
…………
此外，关于传说中“管理员”的苏醒，虽然我未能有幸亲眼目睹，但从前辈们的言语中，我感受到了一种前所未有的期待。如果可能的话，请务必让Z7行动组参与管理员指挥的任务！我想亲手把战术板和任务报告递到管理员的面前，并和管理员一起，实现终末地的愿景，为塔卫二带来和平……</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Before, reflecting on the past used to come naturally for Shiba Momiji. Back in school, she had a knack for breaking down a year's worth of progress with neat charts and detailed annotations — earning top grades with ease. 
But now, things are different. It's been a full year since Operations Team Z7 was formed. And instead of stats and milestones, what fills her heart now ... are feelings. 
She constantly worries about Catcher. As the team's shield and support, he looks after everyone like family. Is he overextending himself...? 
She pays attention to Estella's condition. Some may see her as unmotivated or laid-back, but Akekuri knows better. Estella is healing her own fragile body while quietly helping Op Z7 heal the world. That takes a rare kind of strength. 
She watches over Fluorite's moods, not just her frequent outbursts or headstrong ways. Akekuri often asks herself: Am I being a strong enough cushion? One that lets her feel understood and safe? 
She worries about Antal too. Often labeled an "odd one," Antal is, in truth, passionate and reliable — his way of connecting simply different. She sees how hard he's been working to keep pace with the team. 
It's because of them that Z7 stands as it does today. 
She's deeply grateful — for their trust, for their belief in her leadership, and for proving that this team, once seen as inexperienced, could stand on its own. 
But most of all, she wonders about herself: Has she met the expectations she set — using what little they had to help as many as possible ... and to find her own light in the process? 
Sometimes she wonders: if the ideals of Endfield are ever fulfilled, and peace finally comes — maybe, just maybe, her parents might reconcile. And perhaps she could go home, just like when she was little ... and share one peaceful family meal together again. 
She is giving her all to make that future possible. 

Annual Performance Report
SUBMITTED BY: Akekuri, Captain, Operations Team Z7 

Dear Supervisor Perlica, 
This report outlines the major operations and achievements of Operations Team Z7 over the past year. 
We completed 40 missions with a 95% success rate and zero casualties. These included 16 cross-region supply runs, 9 joint wildlands recon operations, 7 high-risk engineering escorts, and 8 emergency rescues. 
We've steadily grown from a provisional support force into a reliable, fully operational unit. 
P.S. While our combat rating remains average in this year's assessment, we ranked among the top in support, command, and management. 
......
Regarding the rumored awakening of the "Endministrator," though I have yet to witness it myself, I can feel the excitement in  stories shared by our seniors. If possible, I'd like to respectfully request that Operations Team Z7 be involved in missions under the Endministrator's command. It would be a privilege to personally deliver our tactical reports — and even more meaningful to work alongside the Endministrator to bring Endfield's vision to life. Together, we can restore peace to Talos-II...</>

voiceDesc.cn: 刚完成预案推演，随时可以出发！
voiceDesc.en: Prepped and primed! Let's hit it, team!

voiceDesc.cn: 这次行动能积累宝贵的经验。
voiceDesc.en: This is our chance to learn and grow!

voiceDesc.cn: Z7行动组，秋栗，很高兴加入这次行动！请期待我的表现！
voiceDesc.en: Akekuri, Op Z7, reporting in! Excited to join the mission, let's make it a success!

voiceDesc.cn: 是管理员的安排！太好了，没有比这更好的学习机会了！
voiceDesc.en: Awesome, another task from the Endmin! What better way to learn than this!

voiceDesc.cn: 新武器……感觉很不一样呢。可以有新的战术安排和行动方式了！
voiceDesc.en: A new weapon, hmm ... definitely feels unique. Alright, I've gotta come up with fresh tactics and strategies!

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，很合身。后续的使用体验，我会报告给武库。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm, fits me just right! I'll be sure to send my feedback to the Arsenal soon.

voiceDesc.cn: 就像拿学分的感觉一样，不过这次不是从课堂上得到的。
voiceDesc.en: This feels like stacking up credits, just not the kind you get from class.

voiceDesc.cn: 这就是精英干员的行动复盘吗……真是受益匪浅！
voiceDesc.en: So this is what an elite debriefing looks like ... truly eye-opening!

voiceDesc.cn: 晋升？太荣幸了！这既是对我的勉励，也是对整个Z7行动组的嘉奖。我们会继续努力的！
voiceDesc.en: Ohhh, a promotion? What an honor! Feels like a nod to me and the whole Z7 crew. Rest assured, we'll keep pushing forward!

voiceDesc.cn: 以后要参加更危险的行动了？不，我不是害怕，而是开心。对还在积累经验的行动组来说，这意味着莫大的肯定。
voiceDesc.en: More risky missions to come? Nope, I'm more excited than scared. It's a sign of your trust, and I see it as a great chance for us to learn and grow.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，谈话结束后有空吗？行动组的大家为我准备了一个小小的庆祝会，我给您预留了蒙布朗蛋糕，别错过哦。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, got a bit of time later? The team's throwing you a little celebration party. I baked a Mont Blanc cake just for you, and trust me, you won't wanna miss it!

voiceDesc.cn: 我在课堂上学到过一个理论，说一个人最终会晋升到自己无法胜任的位置上。所以如果我“停滞”了太久，管理员，请您第一时间给我督促和指导吧。
voiceDesc.en: There's a theory I learned in class that everyone will eventually be promoted to a role they can't handle. So, if I get stuck for too long, Endmin, please be sure to step in and offer me your guide.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地Z7行动组组长，秋栗，向管理员报到！备忘摘要、预算评估、行动预案都已经做好了，您要先过目哪一份？
voiceDesc.en: Captain Akekuri of Operation Team Z7 reporting in! The operations dossier, budget summary, and action plan are ready for review. Which would you like to read first?

voiceDesc.cn: 一个健康的团队不应该有短板。
voiceDesc.en: A strong team is one without any weak links.

voiceDesc.cn: 让我为终末地做些什么吧！
voiceDesc.en: C'mon, let me do something for Endfield!

voiceDesc.cn: 放心交给我吧，我在轮岗时做过这份工作。
voiceDesc.en: You can count on me. I've done the job before.

voiceDesc.cn: 好巧，管理员，您也刚出完任务吗？
voiceDesc.en: Small world, Endmin! You just wrapped up a mission as well?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，要我帮您煮一壶热咖啡吗？
voiceDesc.en: Coffee break, Endmin? I can whip up a fresh pot for you!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，您好呀！我是秋栗，隶属于重建不久的Z7行动组……没关系，虽然现在我们的工作并不起眼，但很快就会让您记住的。
voiceDesc.en: Nice to meet you, Endministrator. I'm Akekuri from Operation Team Z7. Oh, it's okay! We may be newly reformed and flying under the radar for now, but I promise — we're going to make our mark.

voiceDesc.cn: 他们都说管理员是从终末地建立至今，一直以来的领导者……没想到竟然这么有亲和力。我懂我懂，这也是体现领导力的一环。
voiceDesc.en: Knowing you've been guiding Endfield since day one, I thought you'd be a lot stricter. But you're more easygoing than I expected — heehee, I guess that's part of what makes a true leader!

voiceDesc.cn: 比起新都筑的“高端场合”，还是帝江号的大厅更适合我。在这里，每个人显得那么轻松，而且做的事情远比那些“商业精英”们有意义。
voiceDesc.en: I must say, I'd much rather be here in Dijiang than at those so-called "fancy events" run by the business elites in Neo Tsukushi. People here are way more relaxed and actually making a real impact.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，您尝过“生八桥”吗？那是一种东国风格的甜点，有红豆、抹茶，还有烤栗子味的。想试试的话，下次可以列席Z7行动组的行动部署会哦。
voiceDesc.en: Have you ever had nama yatsuhashi? It's a traditional Higashi sweet with red beans, matcha, and roasted chestnut flavor. If you're up for it, come along to the next Z7 team meeting.

voiceDesc.cn: 来，管理员，这里有热红茶，坐下来，听我们讲讲这次任务的见闻吧。
voiceDesc.en: Hey, Endmin. Wanna sit down for a cup of hot tea? We've got cool stories from the mission to share!

voiceDesc.cn: 我喜欢在帝江号的舰桥眺望塔卫二，这里能看到我长大的地方、家人最后踏足的地方，还有被管理员改变过的地方——别惊讶，星球地理学和近代史我都拿了A+。
voiceDesc.en: I love looking up at Talos-II from the Bridge. It's got all my memories — where I grew up, where my family last was, and the places you've changed. Hey, what's with the surprise face? I totally got A+ in planetary geology and modern history!

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，这次外勤任务，我带回来了一些小纪念品，请收下！
voiceDesc.en: Ah, Endmin! I got you a little something from the field mission. Hope you like it!

voiceDesc.cn: 哇，管理员的礼物！我猜一猜，这是奖励吗？还是……
voiceDesc.en: Wow, a gift for me?! Is it a reward for something I did, or...?

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么新都筑的年度模范毕业生会选择终末地？其实我更感激终末地选择了我。比起商会职场里的晋升阶梯，我更喜欢行动组的一切——在这里，我既是战斗者，也是开拓者。
voiceDesc.en: Oh, you wanna know why the valedictorian from Neo Tsukushi chose to join Endfield? Truth is, I'm the one who's grateful they chose me. I like everything about my Op Team, far more than any corporate ladder. Here, I get to be a fellow combatant as well as a pioneer.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的愿望？希望爸爸和妈妈和解吧。我觉得无论是与天使奋战的爸爸，还是打理家庭商店的妈妈，他们之间没有成为“敌人”的理由，对吧？在终末地工业，两者不就能兼得吗？
voiceDesc.en: My wish? I just hope Mom and Dad can make peace. Dad's been out fighting Aggeloi, while Mom's been running the family store. But why should that mean they have to live separate lives? If they both worked at Endfield, maybe they wouldn't have to choose between duty and family...

voiceDesc.cn: 记得很小的时候，爸爸和舅舅经常带我玩“打天使”的游戏，那时我骑在他们的肩膀上，就像个指挥官。十年前，舅舅作为忍客被征召去了北边，再也没有回来，爸爸也和妈妈永不相见。我几乎忘了那时候的“战斗”经历，直到终末地让我再次回忆起来。
voiceDesc.en: When I was little, I used to play this game called "Fight the Aggelos" with Dad and Uncle. I'd ride on their shoulders like I was the commander. Then, ten years ago, Uncle got called up to the north as a shinobi hacker and never came back. That was when my parents stopped speaking to each other. I almost forgot about those "battles" until Endfield brought it all rushing back.

voiceDesc.cn: 在申请重建Z7行动组之后，我经历了一年多的高难度培训和挑战。但真正重要的，是找到了卡契尔、萤石、埃特拉和安塔尔——他们都是无价之宝，是他们给了Z7行动组能够重新成立的资格。
voiceDesc.en: After applying to reestablish Z7, I went through over a year of intense training and trials. But what truly mattered was meeting Catcher, Fluorite, Estella, and Antal. They're the heart of our team and the reason Z7 has a future.

voiceDesc.cn: 啊，管理员，您都知道啦？妈妈把我送去念商科，是希望我将来在环塔商会里成为她的左右手。但现在我背离了她所规划的道路。所以您必须让终末地工业成为塔卫二最伟大的企业，要不然，我就得回去继承家业了。对了，如果去环带购物，记得带上这张卡——嘘，别念出来，就是大家都知道的那家。
voiceDesc.en: Haha, guess there's no hiding anything from you, Endmin. Yeah, my mom had it all planned out — business school, join TGCC, follow in her footsteps. Welp, me joining here was not a part of her script. Sooo ... please make Endfield the biggest deal on Talos-II, or she'll start calling me back! Oh, by the way, if you ever shop in the Band, take this card. Shh... Yes, the store everyone knows about.

voiceDesc.cn: 我知道自己的战斗力不算惊人，因此队友们的信任与配合才是最可靠的保障。您现在知道这支信号铳的重要性了吧！
voiceDesc.en: I know I'm not the strongest fighter out there — that's why trust and teamwork are our best defense. Now you see why this flare gun matters so much!

voiceDesc.cn: 想知道与我的队友们相处的诀窍吗？卡契尔做的饭菜要吃干净，送萤石捕蝇草，陪埃特拉听噪音，在安塔尔的笑话冷场时第一个大声笑出来……就好了！
voiceDesc.en: Wanna know how I keep Z7 running smooth? It's actually quite simple — eat everything Catcher cooks, gift Fluorite flytraps, power through Estella's noisy tracks with her, and laugh at Antal's jokes. Trust me, it works.

voiceDesc.cn: 我忘不了Z7小队执行的第一个任务，很简单，护送终末地的建设人员到开拓区边陲修建水坝。那一次我们闹出来的笑话足以写一本《初级行动组避坑指南》，但我忘不了大坝落成时的感觉：泡在齐腰深水里的冰冰凉凉，还有充斥胸腔的、炽热的成就感。
voiceDesc.en: Our first mission together was just a simple escort gig — helping Endfield engineers build a dam on the frontier. Sounds easy, right? We bungled it so bad we could've written a "101 Things Not to Do" handbook. But when the dam was finally finished, standing waist-deep in that cold water... The sense of accomplishment was real.

voiceDesc.cn: 如果管理员指挥我们……可以让埃特拉和安塔尔来打掩护，我和卡契尔来吸引火力，安排萤石来发出最后一击！欸？您有截然不同的设想吗？
voiceDesc.en: If you were leading us, Endmin ... I'd say let Estella and Antal cover us, Catcher and I draw the heat, and Fluorite lands the final blow. Wait, you've got a totally different plan?

voiceDesc.cn: 想看我的成绩单？唔，每一门成绩都是A+，除了二年级的商业竞争模拟。当时迫于同组同学的压力，我把其他组扮演的“对手”都逼到了破产。但最后教授告诉我，在塔卫二，零和并不是最好的策略。这是我拿的第一个也是最后一个A−。
voiceDesc.en: You wanna see my report card? Hmm, all A+ except for the business simulation in sophomore year. My teammates were counting on me, so oops... I kinda made the other teams go bankrupt. The professor later told me that in Talos-II, zero-sum strategy isn't the best approach. That was my one and only A-.

voiceDesc.cn: 大家都说卡契尔是个好同伴，其实他是最需要同伴关爱的人呢。他甚至会因为怕影响到大家，而在行动组周会上默默喝了两个月的咖啡——直到被发现咖啡过敏，才换成热巧克力。
voiceDesc.en: Everyone says Catcher's a great teammate, but honestly, he's the one who needs the most care. I kept making coffee for everyone at the team meetings, and he just drank it every time for two months — until we found out he was allergic! That's when I switched him to hot cocoa.

voiceDesc.cn: 有些人害怕萤石……因为那“不怀好意”的语气和危险的“帮派”身份。但只要稍稍了解她，就能看到深藏在兜帽下的勇气和正义感。相信我，不会错的。
voiceDesc.en: Some people are scared of Fluorite because of the way she speaks and her background. But if you get to know her, you'll see the courage and sense of justice beneath that hood. Trust me, you won't regret it.

voiceDesc.cn: 又有人投诉埃特拉干劲不足吗？不是哦，看看行动履历就知道了，其实她对于刺激、冒险和体力劳动都乐在其中呢！
voiceDesc.en: Another complaint about Estella lacking motivation? Nah, that's not true. Just look at her record, she's actually all about the thrills, adventures, and hard work!

voiceDesc.cn: 没法理解安塔尔的笑话吗？唔，其实换个角度，设身处地感受他编笑话时的脑回路，是不是就能被逗乐起来……噗……哈哈哈哈……
voiceDesc.en: Oh, you don't get Antal's humor? *Giggle* Try looking at it from his point of view, maybe you'll catch his train of thought and find that funny... Hahaha!

voiceDesc.cn: 好像有一些值得注意的东西，去查看一下吧？
voiceDesc.en: I think I spotted something interesting over there... Let's go check it out!

voiceDesc.cn: 发现高价值目标，申请开展收集行动。
voiceDesc.en: High-value object identified. Requesting approval to initiate collection operation.

voiceDesc.cn: 报告未知区域，有进一步行动指示吗？
voiceDesc.en: Unidentified area detected. Awaiting additional instructions for action.

voiceDesc.cn: 确认高危险目标，别慌，我们演习过应对策略。
voiceDesc.en: High-risk target detected. Stay calm, we've trained for this.

voiceDesc.cn: 这些矿物是对终末地有用的物资。
voiceDesc.en: These minerals are essential materials for Endfield.

voiceDesc.cn: 我也来帮忙，我们是搭档嘛！
voiceDesc.en: Let me give you a hand! We're a team, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，我们收获不小啊！
voiceDesc.en: Nice! Looks like we've made quite the haul!

voiceDesc.cn: 醚质是行动时的高优先级目标，它究竟有什么秘密？
voiceDesc.en: Acquiring Aurylene is our top priority on missions. I wonder what secret it hides...

voiceDesc.cn: 通往终末地目标的路上，又少了一些障碍。
voiceDesc.en: Alrighty, another hurdle down! Onward to our goal!

voiceDesc.cn: 现在可以坐下来，思考行动、修缮装备、检查背包，并且享用热咖啡。
voiceDesc.en: Phew, now I can finally sit down and enjoy my coffee. Oh, I should also plan the next steps, fix up my gear, and check my bag.

voiceDesc.cn: 别担心，快接受治疗。
voiceDesc.en: Stay calm, let's get you patched up first.

voiceDesc.cn: 治疗得很及时！
voiceDesc.en: A timely treatment!

voiceDesc.cn: 有危险，立刻躲避！
voiceDesc.en: Take cover, NOW!

voiceDesc.cn: 身为组长……更不能后退……
voiceDesc.en: A good captain ... should never back down...

voiceDesc.cn: 可以被击倒……但不能被打败。
voiceDesc.en: Even if I fall ... I won't stay down.

voiceDesc.cn: 真是教科书式的示范！
voiceDesc.en: Wow, perfect execution!

voiceDesc.cn: 漂亮！大开眼界！
voiceDesc.en: Beautifully done! I'm amazed!

voiceDesc.cn: 重要的是我们的默契！
voiceDesc.en: It's all about our teamwork!

voiceDesc.cn: 多亏了大家的助攻！光荣属于我们！
voiceDesc.en: Couldn't have done it without you all!

voiceDesc.cn: 是正面作战任务，执行方案A！
voiceDesc.en: We're going head-to-head, execute Plan A!

voiceDesc.cn: 好，相信我们之间的默契！
voiceDesc.en: Let's go! I have total faith in y'all!

voiceDesc.cn: 接下来要复盘、总结……不过先欢呼胜利吧！
voiceDesc.en: Next up is AAR, PCA ... but let's cheer for our victory first!

voiceDesc.cn: 离成为主力又近了一步！
voiceDesc.en: We're getting there — slowly but surely.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，我们都为终末地尽了一份力！
voiceDesc.en: Great job. We've all done our part for Endfield!

voiceDesc.cn: 比起完胜，有缺憾的胜利更有参考意义。
voiceDesc.en: A flawless win teaches little. It's the flaws that sharpen us.

voiceDesc.cn: 试错也能带来宝贵的经验，我们对胜利有了更大的把握，不是吗？
voiceDesc.en: Mistakes help us learn. I'm sure we can do better next time.

voiceDesc.cn: 看剑！
voiceDesc.en: Watch this!

voiceDesc.cn: 贯穿！
voiceDesc.en: Piercing strike!

voiceDesc.cn: 战术清除！
voiceDesc.en: Area sweep!

voiceDesc.cn: 斩开前路！
voiceDesc.en: Make way!

voiceDesc.cn: 尝尝灼痛！
voiceDesc.en: Feel the burn!

voiceDesc.cn: 好机会！
voiceDesc.en: Now's the moment!

voiceDesc.cn: 打个配合！
voiceDesc.en: Let's team up!

voiceDesc.cn: 快闪开始！
voiceDesc.en: Hmph! Blaze through!

voiceDesc.cn: 电光石火！
voiceDesc.en: Now ignite!

voiceDesc.cn: 倒下吧！
voiceDesc.en: You are finished!

voiceDesc.cn: 就此解决！
voiceDesc.en: This ends here!

voiceDesc.cn: 看我的信号！
voiceDesc.en: Team, follow my flare! Let's GO!

voiceDesc.cn: 焰火表演开始！
voiceDesc.en: Let the hanabi rise!

voiceDesc.cn: 决胜行动方案——
voiceDesc.en: Victory strategy, engage!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员卡契尔，本名鲁伊·范·卡契尔，出生于文明环带的军人家庭。经干员秋栗申请，纳入Z7行动组管理。

基于已有的任务反馈，卡契尔先生应是Z7行动组中最令人放心的一位干员。他从不缺勤，总是按时提交报告，无任何不良嗜好，具备极好的合作性。
但与此同时，我们也注意到，受幼年经历影响，卡契尔先生对自身的要求存在过于严苛的倾向。简而言之，他会逼迫自己承担一些他本不需要承担的责任与任务目标。因此建议在为卡契尔先生安排工作时，尽量参考Z7行动组组长秋栗的建议。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Catcher (ID name: Ruy van Catcher) was born to a military family in the Civilization Band. Following Operator Akekuri's applications, Catcher is now a member of Operations Team Z7. 

Existing operational feedback reports indicate that Mr. Catcher is the most reliable operator of Z7. He has never been absent from duty, always hands in his reports on time, does not engage in habits of vice, and is an exceptional team player. 
However, we have noticed that Mr. Catcher has a tendency to place extremely severe demands on himself (which may be a result of his childhood influences). Simply put, he often forces himself to take on operational duties and goals that were not originally assigned to him. When assigning tasks to Mr. Catcher, we advise referencing, where possible, the recommendations of Op Team Z7 Captain Akekuri. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>卡契尔无疑是Z7行动组中备受队友信赖的一位。尽管他平日里似乎更习惯沉默地站在队友们的身后，仿佛对其他人的闲聊毫无兴趣，但实际上，但凡有任何提及他的话题出现，他总会第一时间应声并给予妥善回复，教人有理由相信他从头到尾都没漏听掉一句。

是的，没错，我们的“万能管家”先生就是这么一个很难让人挑出错的家伙。有时候我真的很怀疑，他是不是每次行动结束都要回去写一份反省报告，然后还定期回看？不然你觉得一般人至于连“上上上次行动漏带了一支手电筒”这种事都记得清清楚楚吗？反正我可做不到。
——萤石

卡契尔这个人，简单得有些不可思议了……他的表情管理和安塔尔一样厉害，好像很少有什么特别的变化……嗯，除了那次，我把放了一周忘记扔的奶油蛋糕不小心甩到了他的大剑上……他居然第一次对我皱眉了，真是太不容易了。
——埃特拉

他很擅长解决一些麻烦的问题，也很懂得聆听的重要性，就是不太爱说话，让人忧心他平日的社交。好在他会做烤羽兽，味道甚至可以和我奶奶一拼，所以也就用不着忧心了——没什么能难倒一个会做烤羽兽的人。
——安塔尔

虽然每次说到“Z7最让我省心的人”，大家都会一致认为是卡契尔，但我并不这么认为。因为不管是在任务中还是生活中，他都习惯性地把其他人的想法和诉求看得比自己重要……而作为队长，这绝不是我想要看到的。所以每次发现卡契尔又在自行承担额外工作时，我也会主动调整他后续的任务安排，让他不至于太辛苦。
——秋栗</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Catcher is, without a doubt, the most trusted member of Op Z7. Though he seemed more comfortable hanging back in silence and appeared disinterested in the chatter around him, Catcher would immediately provide a fitting response whenever he was mentioned in conversation. We have reason to believe that he heard everything, from start to finish. 

That's right. You can't pick a bone with our omni-butler. Sometimes I suspect he writes a review report after every operation — and even reads the ones he wrote earlier. Why? Because I don't think any ordinary person could remember that they forgot to bring a flashlight three operations ago. I know I couldn't. 
— Fluorite 

Catcher is so simple and straightforward that he felt kinda unreal... He's got control over his face, just as good as Antal. His expressions hardly change... Yeah, except for that time when I accidentally threw some cream cake onto his greatsword. It was a cream cake I left lying around for a week... I saw Catcher frowning at me for the first time. He's incredibly restrained and controlled. 
— Estella 

He is an expert in solving difficult issues and appreciates the importance of being a listener. However, he is a human of few words, and his social skills are potentially worrying. Fortunately, he knows how to roast fowl fillets, and the flavor in on par with those roasted by my own grandmother. Hence, there is nothing to worry about — people who can roast fowl properly can handle anything that comes their way. 
— Antal 

Everyone thinks that Catcher is the "Z7 teammate that I'm least worried about", but I disagree. He has a habit of putting the feelings and needs of others before his own, both in business and in private ... and that's definitely not something I like to see as the Z7 team captain. So, whenever I see Catcher taking on extra work without being asked to, I adjust his subsequent task assignments. I don't want him overworking himself. 
— Akekuri </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>七年前，在我离开蓝松子安保后的那个秋天，为了方便照料我父亲并为他筹集更多的治疗费用，我在家附近的青少年训练营找了一份教官的兼职。我的主要工作就是把部队里一些最基本的常识一点点讲给这些估计连环带边缘都没去过的孩子们。而在我任教的三年间，有一位年仅15岁，名叫鲁伊的学员最令我印象深刻。他是那一届学员里唯一一个临时入营的，据说他父母本不愿意他来受训，但在他的强烈要求下最终妥协。后来我经常会想，或许我在刚得知这件事之后就应对鲁伊提高一些警惕的，至少该明白这个瘦削得让人怀疑是不是营养不良的孩子，并不像看起来的那么听话。
整个学期我一共教过他十一节课，其中八节都曾被他“找过茬儿”。从与教科书稍有区别的演示姿势到一两个无伤大雅的记忆差错，只要我的课堂中存在任何称得上失误的地方，都免不了被他一一指出。以至于后来我几乎每堂课前都要先自己预习一遍，以免再被他纠错。
后来在他快结业的某天，我终于第一次放下作为教官的矜持，向他问出了那个困扰我多时的问题：“到底是因为什么，让你一直这么执着地给我这个教官挑错？总不会是我哪里得罪了你吧？”而他当时的表情，直到现在我也记忆犹新——他先是摇了摇头，然后拿出了他那本边角都因为翻阅次数太多而卷起来、环塔商会统一发行的《如何成为一名合格的军人？（青少年版）》，指着它看向我，目光无比认真。
“不，卢卡老师，你讲的课很有趣，举的例子也比书上写的生动多了，我其实很喜欢听你的课……但是，你可能不知道，这本书里讲述的一切，曾经是激励我来到这里的支柱……”
“我……会那么在乎里面的每一条常识，只是因为我希望有一天能真正地在战场上应用它们……就像我9岁时梦想的那样……”
在得到他的回答后，我总算从熟识的另一名教官那里知道了鲁伊的童年往事——他曾因为家人的一时疏忽患上了矿石病，虽然治疗得非常及时，却还是让他差点儿就一辈子只能待在病床上。
我不知道他为了像普通学员那样正常受训，到底经历过什么，付出过什么……但至少作为教官，我很肯定，他确实是我值得骄傲的学生，哪怕我确实曾对他的种种行为深感头疼。
而现在想想，如果没有鲁伊那时近乎不依不饶的指正，我恐怕不会那么努力地对照教材进行备课，也不可能改正自己在部队时囫囵学习、不求甚解的习惯，更不会在后来加入高级武装安保人员训练计划，成为一名真正的雇佣兵教官了。
…………
再后来，我的父亲去世，我也离开了合金萝卜城，与训练营的同事也断了联系……不清楚鲁伊后来的去向。
只是从一位意外遇到的学员那里得知，鲁伊似乎是入职了一家颇有名望的公司，从事类似安保的工作……老实说，我有些意外，我本以为他会成为一名军人或是教官……
但无论如何，我依然衷心希望他能有机会善用那些学到的知识，真正实现他那个童年的梦想。
——节选自传奇教官卢卡·伦蒂的回忆录《那些不被记住的》</>
recordDesc.en: <@profile.key>Seven years ago, during the autumn when I left Juniper Security, I worked as a part-time instructor at a youth training camp somewhere close to home. I was hoping to take care of my sick father and make some money for his treatment. My main job description was to share various tidbits about military basics with children who had probably never set foot in the Band Fringes. I worked in the youth camp for three years, and a 15-year old student named Ruy left quite an impression on me. He was the only one in the cohort who signed up temporarily. They told me his parents did not want him to join, but conceded upon the boy's strong insistence. I often reflect upon this moment and think I should have taken this as a warning sign for things to come. Despite being so thin that he looked malnourished, Ruy was not as obedient as he appeared. Ruy only attended eleven courses throughout the entire term, and he "found problems" in eight of them. These problems ranged from slight deviations from textbook examples of military poise to one or two minor memory slips. In fact, he pointed out any non-conformances in my course that could be considered errors. Things escalated to the point where I had to rehearse my materials before every class just so the boy wouldn't call out my mistakes. On the eve of graduation, I finally eased off my usual sternness as an instructor and asked the boy a question that had troubled me for months, "I need to know why you're so obsessed about finding your instructor's mistakes? Did I make you angry at some point?" I still remember the expression on his face. He shook his head, and then took out a copy of How to Be a Proper Soldier? (Young Adults Edition) published by the TGCC. The manual was flipped through so many times that the corners curled. Then he pointed the book at me and gave me a serious look. "No, Instructor Luca. Your classes were very interesting, and your examples made things way more engaging than the manual. I actually liked your lessons a lot... But you probably didn't know that everything in this manual was the only fount of strength that's kept me this far." "I ... I really care about every pointer in the manual because I want to put them to use on a real battlefield... I've been dreaming about this since I was nine..." After hearing these words, I finally learned about Ruy's childhood from another instructor and a close friend of mine — turned out that young Ruy contracted Oripathy due to momentary familial negligence. Though timely treatment was provided, the poor lad was almost forced to live out the rest of his life on a sickbed. I do not know what he experienced or sacrificed in order to receive training like the other students... But as his instructor, I do approve of his efforts and proudly call him a student of mine, despite the fact that many of his actions had caused no small trouble on my part. Come to think of it, if not for Ruy's constant, incessant, and persistent corrections, I would never have worked so hard to ensure conformance to the training materials. I probably would never correct my habits of mindless and rote memorization back in the force. And I most certainly would never have made it into the elite armed security training program or become an formal instructor for a mercenary outfit. ............ After my father passed away, I left Alloycarrot and drifted away from my training camp colleagues... I did not know where Ruy went afterwards. An accidental encounter with a former student of mine informed me that Ruy seemed to have joined a relatively famous company as part of their security detail... Truth be told, I was a little surprised. I thought that boy would have become an officer or instructor... Regardless, I sincerely hope he will make good use of the knowledge he acquired and fulfill his childhood dreams. — An excerpt from Those Not Remembered, an autobiography by the legendary instructor Luca Londi

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>“卡契尔先生！你总算来了！那个包裹的收件人一栏虽然写了你的名字，但我们一致认为，还是由你亲自确认一下比较好……它现在就放在卸货区——对，最大的那个！就在安德烈先生采购的装置模型旁边。”
“可以给我看看寄件人的地址和名字吗？”
“噢，没问题，我找找……地址是‘塞什卡’，寄件人是……‘卡珊卓’？好耳熟的名字……”
“……我知道了。确实是寄给我的。”
“真、真的吗？但例行检测的时候，我们发现这个包裹上有专门施放防止追踪的源石技艺……”
“别担心，真的是寄给我的……寄件人是我姐姐，她因为职业关系，习惯做一些这样的保护措施。”
“你姐姐？等等，我想起来了……你姐姐不会就是给塞什卡商人当保镖当出名头的那个‘雾中的卡珊卓’吧？！”
“嗯。”
“好吧……我完全理解。确实是必要的‘保护措施’。”
…………
“呼，那么相关的流程就走完了，卡契尔先生，现在你可以把这个包裹带走了。”
“我能直接在这里拆开它吗？”
“当然可以！如果需要搬运，可以直接找我们帮忙。”
…………
“这、这是什么？！不会是……外骨骼吧？！”
“……等一下，卡契尔先生，你手上拿的装置是？不然还是找个空旷的地方再按——”
（录音开始播放）
“亲爱的小弟，礼物收到了吗？”
“原谅姐姐最近实在忙得抽不开身，没法去你那边和你一起过生日了。”
“唉，原本那天听大哥说他临时接到命令要去北方一趟的时候，我就打算提前请几天假的，谁知道老板他们突然又接到一笔大单子，选的路还特别偏，只能我亲自出马了……”
“作为补偿，我给你买了这架商会最新推出的民用U-47重型外骨骼作为今年的礼物，哼哼，是不是比大哥上次送你那把还得自己拼的合金大剑帅多了？”
“而且因为听说你要经常出任务，我还托人给它办了五年的维修保养服务，这样你每次穿着它出门，爸妈也能放心点……”
“你也知道的，他们俩一辈子什么都不怕，就怕你什么时候不小心受了伤，又变得和那时一样……”
“所以务必保重身体，别忘了你当初离家时答应我和你哥的事，别忘了爸妈的嘱咐。”
“最后，生日快乐，我最最放心不下的弟弟。”
“——老姐不管去到哪里都会记挂着你的。”
（录音播放结束）

“果然是今年的生日礼物……唉……算了，总比去年的八国草药大礼包好一点。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>"Mr. Catcher! You're finally here! Your name is in the recipient's section, but we all believe that you should come by and verify the package in person... It's now in the unloading area. Yes, the biggest package there! Right next to the facility scale model that Mr. Andre purchased." 
"Can you show me the sender's address and name?" 
"Sure. No problem. Let me take a look... Address is somewhere in Seš'qa and the sender is ... Cassandra? Sounds really familiar to me..." 
"...Got it. The package is mine." 
"Are ... are you really sure? Routine inspections found that someone has specifically cast anti-tracking Originium Arts upon this thing." 
"Don't worry. The package is really meant for me... My older sister sent it to me. She has a habit of applying protective measures given the nature of her work." 
"Your sister? Wait! I remember... Is she that Cassandra? Cassandra of the Mist? That famous bodyguard who made her name while working for Seš'qa merchants?!" 
"Yeah." 
"Fine... I think I know where she's coming from. The 'protective measures' might be necessary, then." 
............ 
"Phewie. Processing is complete. Mr. Catcher, you're free to take this parcel." 
"Can I open it here?" 
"Of course you can! In fact, we can also give you delivery support if you need help carrying it." 
............ 
"Wha — What the hell is this?! Is this some type of ... exoskeletal frame?!" 
"...Stop, Mr. Catcher! What's that thing you're holding in your hand? Maybe you should only press the button at a more spacious—" 
(Recorded audio file starts to play) 
"Ruy, baby, got the prez?" 
"Sorry. Too much work is catching up to your sis. I'm afraid I can't celebrate your birthday at your place." 
"Ay, caramba. When I heard our broder said he got an urgent order to head north, I planned to take a few days off but the boss suddenly got us a major order that cuts through the middle of nowhere. I had to do this myself..." 
"So I got you the latest civilian-grade U-47 Heavy Exoskeleton for your birthday this year. Hurhur. It's far cooler than the DIY alloy greatsword that broder gave you last time, right?" 
"Anyway, people say you got plenty of field missions, so I applied for a 5-year warranty. Wear it when you head out. It'll make Papa and Mama feel safer..." 
"You know. Papa and Mama never feared anything except you getting hurt by accident and ending up like last time..." 
"So please pay close attention to your health. Don't forget the promise you made to me and our broder. And don't forget what Papa and Mama told you, k?" 
"Finally, happy birthday, Ruy. You're the baby broder I am always worried about." 
"Your sister will always keep you in my heart." 
(End of recorded audio file) 

"Turns out to be my birthday gift this year... Ugh. Forget it. At least it's better than the Octo-Herbal Tisane Mega Giftpack last year." </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【一份泛黄的病历】
患者姓名：鲁伊·范·卡契尔
患者年龄：4岁
就诊时间：8月15日
就诊医院：合金萝卜自由市布朗宁医院
主治医师：拉曼·哈伦特

现病史：患者三小时前因不慎卷入一场源石装置失控事故，导致后颈脊椎受到轻微创伤。就诊一小时后，出现眩晕、盗汗、下肢力量不足、呕吐等症状。发病以来，患者精神较差，检测表明其肌群力量持续下降，建议立即入院并进行手术治疗。

诊断结果：确诊为急性矿石病，并伴有相关并发症，待后续观察。

【一段十年前的医疗记录存档】
“卡契尔小先生，作为你的主治医师，我想我有义务提醒你，虽然以当前医疗观察的结论来说，你身上的矿石病已得到了控制，但相比普通人，你的身体素质已远低于平均水平。除了需要长期卧床，最好也尽量不要下床行动，任何对身体造成负担的行为都可能会危及你的生命……我希望你和你的家人都时刻注意。”

【一段六年前的医疗记录存档】
“我需要再次强调，卡契尔小——好吧，看起来你更希望我用‘先生’称呼你，总之，你的病情虽然并未因此恶化，但这种运动量还是已经远远超出我给你提供的参考值了。我非常建议你在接下来几个月里，至少来医院进行三次全身体检，并接受我本人的问询。还有……如果你继续坚持这样超标的康复训练，那么务必保证十米内有家人或是专业护工的看护。我会根据你目前的情况再开一份药品清单，但请记住，在你这样的身体状况下，即使是最高效的药物，能发挥的作用依旧是有限的……”

【一段两年前的医疗记录存档】
“好吧，我想我必须承认，这个世界上确实存在只靠医学常识难以解释的……一些意外状况。卡契尔先生，你能将自己的身体锻炼到现今的水平，我想除了所谓的‘奇迹’，或许更多是因为你本人的意志与毅力……我不认为有生之年我还能见证第二个像你这样打破了常理的患者。当然，基于医生的职责，我仍希望你能每半年进行一次例行检查，以免意外发生。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: A yellowed piece of medical history 
PATIENT NAME: Ruy van Catcher 
AGE: 4 yo 
ADMISSION DATE: Aug 15 
INSTITUTION: Browning Hospital, Free City of Alloycarrot 
ATTENDING PHYSICIAN: Raman Harrent 

PRESENT ILLNESS: Patient was injured by an accidental Originium device failure 3 hours ago, resulting in minor injuries to the cervical vertebrae. Patient symptoms 1 hour after admission include: dizziness, hyperhidrosis, weakness of the lower limbs, and nausea. Patient also exhibits giddiness and reduced consciousness after onset of symptoms. Tests reveal continuous reduction in muscle strength. Recommend immediate hospitalization and surgical treatment. 

DIAGNOSIS: Acute Oripathy with accompanying complications. Continue monitoring. 

DOCUMENT: Medical logs from 10 years ago 
"Young Master Catcher, as your attending physician, I believe I am obliged to give you these reminders. Conclusions based on our current medical monitoring tell us that your Oripathy is now under control. However, your physical strength and fortitude are now far below average. You might need to spend quite a bit of time in bed. I'll also advise against getting off bed or moving around. Any action that unnecessarily stresses your body might endanger your life... I hope you can pay attention to that, you and your family." 

DOCUMENT: Medical logs from 6 years ago 
"Once again I must emphasize, Young Master... Okay. Perhaps you prefer it that I address you as Mr. Catcher. Well then, Mr. Catcher, though there is no sign that your sickness has worsened, your physical exercises have far exceeded the levels I've recommended for your case. It is with my strongest advice that you attend at least 3 rounds of full physical examinations and my personal inquiries at the hospital in the coming months. And ... if you decide to persist in rehabilitative exercises of such excessive nature, please make sure you do so in the presence of a family member or professional caretaker within ten yards of yourself. I am also prescribing you another list of medication. But also keep in mind that given the state of your health, even the most effective pharmaceutical products would have limited use... 

DOCUMENT: Medical logs from 2 years ago 
"Okay. I am now forced to admit there are certain things ... certain accidents in the world that go against medical norms. Mr. Catcher, it is by 'miracle' ... but also primarily your personal force of will and determination, that you have molded your body to its current standards... I did not expect to see a second case of such phenomenal and dramatic recovery as yours. Of course, as your attending physician, I still hope you'll come in for your semiannual examinations, just to be on the safe side." </>

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯？有新任务？
voiceDesc.en: Hmm? A new mission?

voiceDesc.cn: 我已准备就绪。
voiceDesc.en: I am ready to go.

voiceDesc.cn: 任何与掩护、后勤有关的任务，都可以交给我。
voiceDesc.en: If you need cover and logistics, you can leave them to me.

voiceDesc.cn: 希望这次任务的过程也能少一点风险，多一点稳妥。
voiceDesc.en: Let's hope this mission is decently planned and involves less risks.

voiceDesc.cn: 泛用性和实用性都不错，能应对不少场合的突袭。
voiceDesc.en: Practical and versatile. It'll see us through assault operations in various scenarios.

voiceDesc.cn: 这种制式的装备我只在训练营的教材里见过……嗯，实物比想象中更精良。
voiceDesc.en: Standardized gear... We only read about them in boot camp textbooks... The real thing is better machined than I expected.

voiceDesc.cn: 通常情况下，我会准备额外的应急预案……多数时候都用得上。
voiceDesc.en: I would usually prepare extra contingency plans. They ... always come in handy.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，需要注意的点我都记下了……之后我会给队长再发一份总结报告的。
voiceDesc.en: O ... kay. There! I've jotted down all the keypoints... The Captain shall receive my summary on her desk.

voiceDesc.cn: 谢谢，今后的任务我也将尽力而为。
voiceDesc.en: Thank you. You shall have my best performance in our future missions.

voiceDesc.cn: 下次请将更棘手的任务交给我吧，现在的我想必可以胜任。
voiceDesc.en: You can now give me the tougher assignments. I believe I can now see them through.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，为了感谢您的认可，我已经做完了未来三个月的任务准备，随时可以验收。
voiceDesc.en: Really appreciate your approval, Endmin. In return, I have completed mission prepwork for the ... next ninety days. You may review them at any time.

voiceDesc.cn: 有时候我也会想，如果当初没有违背家人的意愿，恐怕会过上比现在平淡不少也安逸不少的生活……只是那个早上，当我下定决心拿起这把剑走出家门，我便不打算回头了。
voiceDesc.en: I sometimes think about what might've happened if I went along with my family's wishes. Perhaps I'd be living a different life. One that's simpler yet more comfortable... But I'd made up my mind when I took the sword and left my home that morning. I do not intend to look back.

voiceDesc.cn: Z7行动组卡契尔，主要负责掩护与后勤，比较擅长防卫战，剑术尚可……但愿能帮上各位的忙。
voiceDesc.en: Catcher, Op Team Z7. My role is giving the team cover and logistics support. I specialize in defensive operations and I'm good with the blade... And I hope I'll be an effective addition to your team.

voiceDesc.cn: 需要掩护吗？我会全力以赴的。
voiceDesc.en: Need defensive cover? I shall give you my best.

voiceDesc.cn: 我认为最好再多做些准备。
voiceDesc.en: I believe we should be better prepared.

voiceDesc.cn: 命令已收到。我会将它视作目前最优先的任务完成的。
voiceDesc.en: Orders received. I've tagged them as my top mission priorities.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，您好，又有新任务了吗？
voiceDesc.en: Greetings, Endmin. Is there another assignment?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我又整理了十卷Z7的作战总结，要看看吗？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, I've compiled ten folders of post-battle summaries for Team Z7. Do you wish to review them?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员？有事找我？嗯，我今天不算忙，就是半小时后需要连上五堂剑术训练课……剩下的时间都挺空的。
voiceDesc.en: You're looking for me, Endmin? Well, I got thirty minutes before five back-to-back sessions of swordfighting... And I'll be free for the rest of the time.

voiceDesc.cn: 根据大家的建议，最近我又改良了一版野炊浓汤……管理员，有空你可以来尝尝。
voiceDesc.en: I have recently reviewed everyone's suggestions and improved my wildlands stew recipe... Feel free to give it a taste if you're curious, Endmin.

voiceDesc.cn: 每次回到帝江号，我都觉得有种莫名的安心感……安塔尔坚称这和宿舍床铺的舒适程度脱不开关系，当然，这点我不打算反驳。
voiceDesc.en: Whenever I return to Dijiang, I always get this sense of comfort and relaxation that I could hardly describe... Antal insists that it was the coziness of the dorm mattresses... Of course, I don't intend to disagree with him.

voiceDesc.cn: 在任务中，我会无条件信任Z7的每个队友。但要我相信他们会听队长的话回来乖乖休息？那还是算了。估计不是在图书室废寝忘食，就是在娱乐室捉弄新人……必须要我亲自“送”他们回宿舍才行。
voiceDesc.en: I have complete faith in my teammates during missions. Yet, I have zero faith that they will heed the Captain's orders and get proper R&R afterwards. One would stay up all night at the library, and another would be pulling pranks on raw recruits at the game room... Such nonsense can only end when I personally "escort" them back to their cabins.

voiceDesc.cn: 前两天我回了趟老家，虽然家里人依然不太能接受我现在的工作，但我还是跟他们讲了不少在Z7的经历。他们没多说什么，只是临走前多给我塞了好几袋特产，大概是够Z7全员吃半年的量……管理员，回头我也分你半袋吧。
voiceDesc.en: I paid my family a visit two days ago. They don't really like my career choice but I told them what Team Z7 was really like. They didn't say much to that, except giving me a few rucksacks of local specialties. Z7 would need six months to go through all that... Endmin, I think you should get half a sack as well.

voiceDesc.cn: 每天都很充实，每天都感觉自己被很多人需要着……这些应该是来到终末地后我最大的感受。即使时不时会累到睡不着，我也不认为是什么坏事，因为对我而言，这也算一种“认可”。
voiceDesc.en: Life is very fulfilling. I actually feel useful and everyone actually appreciates it... That's what being an Endfielder means to me. There are occasions where I get too exhausted to sleep, but I take that in stride. It only means that I've earned someone's approval.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，一点微不足道的慰问品……希望你能收下。
voiceDesc.en: It's just some minor gifts, Endmin... But I hope you can accept them.

voiceDesc.cn: 是送给我的？谢谢，我会把它放在保险箱里妥善保管的。
voiceDesc.en: For me? Thank you so much, Endmin. It shall be secured in a proper safe.

voiceDesc.cn: ……抱歉，管理员，我只是在思考下次任务的准备工作。对了，您觉得手持焊枪、浮力调整器和源石粉尘防护面罩哪个更实用？……嗯，还是全都带上吧。
voiceDesc.en: Oh, sorry, Endmin! I was thinking how I should prepare for the next mission. Wait! I got a question for you. Which of these do you think is more useful: a handheld welder, antigrav modulator, or Originium dustproof mask? Hmm... I'll just bring everything.

voiceDesc.cn: 我出生在一个很平凡的五口之家，父母都是军人，大哥是商会部队里的教官，二姐则是受雇于塞什卡的保镖。他们一直在保护我，一直不愿意我走上与他们相似的路，希望我能过上平稳的生活……然而在塔卫二，谁又能一生都活在家人的保护伞里呢？
voiceDesc.en: I was born to a regular family. My parents were soldiers. My brother is a military instructor in the TGCC while my sister is an armed escort working for the Seš'qamam. I was the youngest child and they kept me protected. Everyone wanted to give me a peaceful life instead of following their footsteps and joining the military... But family protection doesn't last forever, especially in Talos-II.

voiceDesc.cn: 我不太会怀念九岁之前的时光，就像我至今也对消毒水的味道心存偏见……那时的我连稍微重一点的水壶都拿不动，甚至不止一次被医生禁止户外活动，连晒太阳都是难得的奢侈体验……直到现在我都记得，痊愈后我第一次单独走到阳光下，那种仿佛整个人重新活过来的感觉。
voiceDesc.en: I don't miss my childhood before I turned nine. It made me dislike the smell of iodine and peroxide... Back then, I couldn't even lift a water canteen. The doctors also kept telling my family to keep me inside the house. I was only allowed to have fun outdoors in the rarest of occasions... Even now I could still remember my recovery and my first walk in broad daylight. It felt as though I was brought back to life.

voiceDesc.cn: 也许在一些人眼里，Z7并不是个多么优秀的行动组。我并非不能理解这点，毕竟队长她太过年轻，萤石又老会得罪人，埃特拉和安塔尔更是一个比一个不着调。但我依然愿意待在Z7……嗯，待一辈子也不是不行。
voiceDesc.en: Some might find Z7 to be an unimpressive operations team. They're not entirely wrong. Captain Akekuri is a little too young, Fluorite's bite is a little too nasty, while Estella and Antal both need a little more common sense. Nevertheless, I'm more than willing to stay in Z7... In fact, I wouldn't mind being a permanent member of the team.

voiceDesc.cn: 刚来终末地的时候，我一度很怀疑自己是否真的具备足以被他人信任的能力……但无论是Z7的各位，还是你，管理员，你们总会让我更清晰地意识到——我能回应的期待，远比我以为的多得多。
voiceDesc.en: When I first joined Endfield, I doubted if I had what it takes to earn the trust of my betters... But the whole of Team Z7 and even you, Endmin, always made this clear to me — I could achieve far more than I believed and meet everyone's expectations.

voiceDesc.cn: 训练营教的东西其实都大同小异，一些作战常识再加一点户外求生技巧，差不多就是全部了。不过很少会有人指望在里面学到多少实战用得上的知识吧……我可能是个例外，所以会在演练课上为教官姿势和理论标准的差异跟他辩论了一堂课。后来？后来他被我说服了，在第三堂课开讲前。
voiceDesc.en: Boot camp was pretty standard. Just some basic combat courses with a bit of field survival added to the mix. Hardly anyone expects boot camp to teach you things that are actually useful in real battles... I might be the exception, as I spent an entire drill session debating with my instructor how his demonstrations deviated from the standard positions depicted in the manual. What happened next? Well, I convinced him before the third drill session began.

voiceDesc.cn: 在我们家，我其实是最没有作战天赋的那个，无论是体能还是作战技巧都远远逊于我的家人们……但即便如此，我也从没想过放弃，而是选择付出更多的努力——每天比大哥早起两小时，将训练量提到二姐的三倍……就这样，一步步坚持到了今天。
voiceDesc.en: I'm actually the least talented soldier of the family. My physical strength and combat technique fall far behind the family norm... Even then, I never gave up and simply devoted myself to greater training — I woke up two hours before my brother and trained thrice as hard as my sister... And I've kept at it till this very day.

voiceDesc.cn: 我学习厨艺的契机？唔，其实没有什么特别的理由，就是刚加入Z7的时候，我有幸品尝过其他队员做的菜，然后第二天就去请教了小道奇教官，接受了数周的野战生存保障训练。
voiceDesc.en: Why did I start learning how to cook? I don't really have a reason. When I first joined Z7, I tried the food prepared by other teammates. On day two, I asked Instructor Lil' Dodge for help. And this was how I received several weeks of Training for Ensuring Survival in the Wilderness.

voiceDesc.cn: 在来终末地之前，我也试过在一些雇佣兵公司实习，但每家或多或少都希望我更“专业”一点……直白点说就是，“只拿钱办事，少问为什么”。我承认这不是什么不可理喻的要求，只是我可能这辈子都做不到吧。
voiceDesc.en: I interned with a few PMCs before joining Endfield but all of them wanted me to be more "professional"... In layman's terms, they wanted me to take the pay and stop asking questions. They made their point and were reasonable about it. Unfortunately, I couldn't bring myself to comply.

voiceDesc.cn: 希望下个任务别再出现让安塔尔他们蹦出新点子的家伙，我们这个月给武库工程师添的麻烦已经够多了……对，您猜得没错，队长没来得及写的那些意见反馈报告现在还堆在我房间里。不过请放心，我会挑个第二天没任务的晚上通宵写完的。
voiceDesc.en: I just hope no one gives Antal and friends any more strange ideas for the next assignment. We've already made enough trouble for our Arsenal Engineer this month... Yeah, you guessed right. The Captain has a stack of Feedback Reports she couldn't finish, and they're all sitting in my bunk. Don't worry. If I got no assignments on the following day, I'll just pull an all-nighter and blitz through everything.

voiceDesc.cn: 队长是个非常有责任感的人，总是努力照顾我们Z7每个人的感受……只是很多时候，我还是希望她能更在乎自己一点，至少不必在聚餐时勉强配合其他人的口味，这样我就不用每次都找理由做她喜欢的东国点心了。
voiceDesc.en: We have a responsible Captain who deeply cares for everyone in Z7... but it'd be great if she took a little more care of herself. Even at team gatherings, she always puts others' tastes before her own. *Sigh* Honestly, I wish she'd just admit she loves Higashinese snacks. Then I wouldn't have to keep pretending I made them "by coincidence."

voiceDesc.cn: 我确实在环带见过像她这样的雇佣兵，狡诈、刻薄，也不合群，笑起来比不笑的时候更让人忌惮……但考虑到她最近都开始和安塔尔大聊源石虫的投掷技巧了，嗯，或许……应该再观察一段时间再下判断？
voiceDesc.en: I knew Bander mercs like her. Cunning, avaricious souls who kept to themselves, whose smiles looked scarier than their growls... But Fluorite started discussing techniques for throwing Originium Slugs with Antal... So, I guess we could ... give her some time before getting judgmental.

voiceDesc.cn: 也不知道是出于什么原因，埃特拉每次看我写的报告都会显得……很震惊。我只是把任务中发生的每件事都记了下来，顺带写了一些不成熟的感想而已……应该没什么值得惊讶的。毕竟相比她偏好的那些“艺术创作”，我的报告实属平平无奇。
voiceDesc.en: I don't know why, but Estella always appears ... shocked whenever she reads my reports. I simply described everything that took place in the mission... and only added a few immature ideas at certain sections... Nothing about my reports should be considered surprising. They're all pretty standard, especially when compared to her ... creative compositions.

voiceDesc.cn: 安塔尔不仅博学，还总乐于为人解惑。但问题是，他太喜欢为人解惑了。上回埃特拉随口问了句“长耳兽的耳朵为什么那么长？”，于是安塔尔一整天都在跟我们讲解相关的生物生态知识，直到返回帝江号才终于讲完——而这还是他省略了七成内容的精简版。
voiceDesc.en: Antal is knowledgeable and happy to answer questions. Problem is, he gets too eager when it comes to answering questions. Estella just casually mentioned: "Why do long-ears have such long ears?" Then Antal decided to spend the rest of the day giving us a lecture on ecobiology. It only ended when we got back to Dijiang — And he said he only gave us a summary that left out seventy percent of key contents.

voiceDesc.cn: 根据经验，那边应该有可以收集的东西。
voiceDesc.en: Experience tells me that there are gatherables over there.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，那边的东西……就算需要绕路，也是值得的。
voiceDesc.en: There's something over there... It's worth looking into, even if we need to take a detour.

voiceDesc.cn: 危险程度未知，建议慎重行动。
voiceDesc.en: Threat level unavailable. We should be cautious.

voiceDesc.cn: 如果有作战需求，我会提前规划好撤退方案。
voiceDesc.en: If combat is required, I'll ready our exit plan in advance.

voiceDesc.cn: 这也是一种珍贵的物资，尽快收集比较好。
voiceDesc.en: A rare material. We should gather them quickly.

voiceDesc.cn: 团队合作总是更高效点……一起挖吧。
voiceDesc.en: We are always more efficient working as a team... Let's mine this together.

voiceDesc.cn: 收集到了不少实用性较强的物资，是好事。
voiceDesc.en: Great. We've gathered plenty of useful supplies.

voiceDesc.cn: 这就是手册上说过的“醚质”吧……
voiceDesc.en: This must be the Aurylene mentioned in the manual...

voiceDesc.cn: 侵蚀的危害比常人以为的更可怕，必须慎重对待。
voiceDesc.en: Blight is more dangerous than what is commonly believed. We must deal with it carefully.

voiceDesc.cn: 工作手册上写过，适当休息有助于更好地完成任务。
voiceDesc.en: Adequate rest is conducive to mission completion. That's what the work manual says.

voiceDesc.cn: 支援品储备还够用，给。
voiceDesc.en: Take this. We still got plenty.

voiceDesc.cn: ……是我的失误。
voiceDesc.en: ...I miscalculated.

voiceDesc.cn: 小心，别逞强。
voiceDesc.en: Watch it. Don't push yourself.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的剑还撑得住。
voiceDesc.en: My blade is still intact.

voiceDesc.cn: 抱歉……我又……拖后腿了吗……
voiceDesc.en: Sorry... I've let everyone down again...

voiceDesc.cn: 这招不赖。
voiceDesc.en: Impressive maneuver.

voiceDesc.cn: 配合得不错，回去给各位加餐。
voiceDesc.en: Such teamwork deserves a feast.

voiceDesc.cn: ……有点过奖了。
voiceDesc.en: You ... flatter me.

voiceDesc.cn: 是所有人的功劳。
voiceDesc.en: Well, everyone helped.

voiceDesc.cn: 保险起见，最好慎重行动。
voiceDesc.en: We should play it safe and approach with care.

voiceDesc.cn: 我会做好支援工作的。
voiceDesc.en: I shall fulfill my role of support.

voiceDesc.cn: 都解决了吗？再检查一下吧。
voiceDesc.en: Area neutralized? Better run another check.

voiceDesc.cn: 是个理想的结果。
voiceDesc.en: We achieved an ideal outcome.

voiceDesc.cn: 真不愧是你……做得不错。
voiceDesc.en: Impressive... Only you could pull that off.

voiceDesc.cn: 无论如何，至少达成了这次的任务目标。
voiceDesc.en: In any case, we still completed the mission objectives.

voiceDesc.cn: 我人生中的大部分经历都在教我一件事：学会接受每一次失败，然后想办法跨过去。
voiceDesc.en: Most of my experiences in life taught me one thing: Accept your defeats, and find a way to surmount them.

voiceDesc.cn: 别碍事。
voiceDesc.en: Get lost.

voiceDesc.cn: 到你了。
voiceDesc.en: Your turn.

voiceDesc.cn: 休想靠近！
voiceDesc.en: Back off!

voiceDesc.cn: 站住！
voiceDesc.en: Halt!

voiceDesc.cn: 由我掩护！
voiceDesc.en: Take cover!

voiceDesc.cn: 久等了。
voiceDesc.en: Waiting's over.

voiceDesc.cn: 该我了。
voiceDesc.en: My turn.

voiceDesc.cn: 接得住吗？
voiceDesc.en: Tank this!

voiceDesc.cn: 尝尝这招！
voiceDesc.en: Taste this!

voiceDesc.cn: 别想逃。
voiceDesc.en: There's no escape.

voiceDesc.cn: 结束了。
voiceDesc.en: It's over.

voiceDesc.cn: 我来解决你们！
voiceDesc.en: I'm taking you down!

voiceDesc.cn: 不会让你过去的！
voiceDesc.en: No one's getting past me!

voiceDesc.cn: 滚开！
voiceDesc.en: OUT OF MY WAY!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员埃特拉，本名埃特拉·科尔，在环塔商会与联盟工团管辖区域均有活动记录。其在侦察与情报收集方面展现了过人天赋，经干员秋栗申请，纳入Z7行动组管理。

埃特拉有着丰富的经历，我本想深入了解她的过往，可她在签约过程中始终很安静，除了回答问题外并无主动沟通的意愿。此外，在仅有的一些话题中，她的回答常常让我无法理解……好在她并没有什么原则性的问题。鉴于其直属上司秋栗女士的良好声誉与预先担保，暂不考虑由于她沟通能力不足导致的管理风险，准许入职。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Estella (ID name: Estella Kerr) has official operational records with the TGCC and the UWST. She has demonstrated remarkable talents in scouting and intel gathering operations. Following Operator Akekuri's applications, Estella is now a member of Operations Team Z7. 

Estella's work experiences are rather extensive. I wanted to learn more about her past but she remained exceptionally quiet during the signing process and exhibited zero intents of communication apart from answering the questions I asked. And even amongst these limited things we talked about, I find most of her answers rather difficult to interpret... Fortunately, no issues of principle have been identified. However, given the positive reputation of her superior officer Miss Akekuri and the latter's guarantee, we shall overlook potential risks of personnel management that may result from Estella's lack of communication abilities. We hereby approve Estella's employment. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>提起Z7行动组集结周年纪念日，除埃特拉以外的成员，恐怕都不会觉得这是什么愉快的回忆。但是，也不会有人否认，这是一段终生难忘的回忆。
起初，秋栗只是发现纪念日那天正好没有外勤任务，便提议要不要小小庆祝一下。大家都觉得不错，便讨论起如何庆祝。由于那时他们驻扎在远离文明环带的荒野，大家的建议不外乎是一些户外活动，所以投票时均遭到了不愿进行体力活动的埃特拉的否决。最终，只有“河边野餐”这个方案通过了。它未必是所有人的最优选，但也没人不喜欢。
纪念日当天，大家情绪高昂地收集着食材，不外乎是一些山菜野味。唯独埃特拉，捧着一堆五颜六色的菌类归来，遭到了队友们的强烈抵制，拒绝她的食材入锅。最终，在秋栗的把关下，才勉强从埃特拉的食材中，取出了一些长相低调的蘑菇入锅烹饪。
伴着落日，小队的大家在河边架起了锅，开始享用劳动成果。然而，这些蘑菇虽然没有太强的毒性，却也不似长相般温和，尝起来辛辣无比。喝完了携带的水，还是不解辣，大家索性来到河边，捧起河水狂饮，希望能压制口中的辛辣。可喝着喝着，上游传来低沉的轰鸣——是上游的水坝在泄洪！
“坏了，我忘了今天没外勤就是因为工团的泄洪通知！”
关于被洪流卷入的细节，大家都记不太清楚了。待他们回过神，发现埃特拉已经踩着锅，像一个熟练的冲浪者一般踏浪远去了。当剩余四人互相搀扶着上了岸，天色已晚，只能摸黑顺着河向下游寻找埃特拉。最终，在凌晨时分，才在一个流民的篝火边找到了熟睡的埃特拉。流民们热情招待了秋栗一行人，他们也吃到了一顿真正的野味大餐。
在流民们的好心挽留下，小队决定在这里休息一夜。当秋栗枕着漫天群星，准备好好睡上一觉时，想起了明早还有外勤任务。最终，四人轮流背着无法叫醒的埃特拉，在东方鱼肚白时分，赶回了营地。
据事后回忆，埃特拉之所以无法叫醒，大约是偷吃了她自己采摘的菌类，以至于她将洪流看作了沸腾的人潮，她像个摇滚明星一般进行着“跳水”的仪式，被人流托举着高歌。至于埃特拉当时唱了什么，没人知道。秋栗只记得，自己背着埃特拉一步一步走回营地时，背上的少女说着梦话——关于回家。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>No Op Z7 teammates, except for Estella, have positive memories regarding the anniversary for the Founding of Operations Team Z7. However, everyone agrees that it was an unforgettable occasion. 
At first, Akekuri found that the team had no field assignments on the day of the anniversary and suggested celebrating the occasion. Everyone responded positively and a discussion on the means of celebration began. However, since the team was encamped in the wildlands far from the Civilization Band, every suggestion involved some form of outdoor activity. Estella, unwilling to engage in any physical exertion, naturally voted against every single proposal. In the end, "riverside picnic" was the only option that received a unanimous vote. It was not the favorite option for everyone, but at least nobody voted against it. 
On the day of the anniversary, everyone was eagerly gathering herbs and hunting game. Estella, however, returned with an armful of colorful mushrooms. Her teammates firmly rejected her suggestion to toss those wild fungi into the cooking pot. In the end, the team conceded. Under Captain Akekuri's watchful eyes, several unassuming mushrooms were allowed to be part of the stew. 
As the sun set, the team built a campfire by the river to enjoy what they had gathered throughout the day. Fortunately, the "unassuming" mushrooms turned out to be only mildly toxic. Unfortunately, they were incredibly spicy. The team emptied their water canteens to douse the heat but to no avail. Desperate, they rushed to the riverbank to wash the spicy taste away with river water. That's when they heard a low rumble coming from upstream — the dam had begun a reservoir drawdown! 
"Curses! I forgot about the UWST reservoir drawdown notice! That's why there's no field operations today!" 
No one remembered exactly how they ended up swept away by the floodwaters. When they finally came to, they found Estella skillfully surfing the rushing water on the team's cooking pot. The sun had already set when the four Op Z7 teammates pulled each other to shore. They had no choice but head downstream to look for Estella. Finally, the team found Estella sound asleep at a nomad campfire in wee hours of the morning. The nomads treated Akekuri and her team to a proper wildlands feast. 
The nomads were extremely accommodating and the team decided to rest there for the night. Just as Akekuri was about to fall asleep beneath the starry ceiling, she suddenly remembered a Z7 field assignment in a few hours' time. Estella could not be awakened, so the four Z7 teammates took turns carrying her. They successfully reached the Endfield camp at daybreak. 
According to Estella's memories, she was completely unconscious as she probably ate the other fungi she picked. She treated the flood waters as a packed and riotous moshpit, and fantasized herself as a rockstar performing a stage dive and surfing the crowd while she growled and screamed her songs. Nobody knew what Estella sang. Akekuri only remembered how she carried Estella and trudged back to camp. The young girl on her back did mumble a few things while she slept — things about home.</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【行动记录归档资料（已作废）】
“埃特拉干员，此次针对裂地者残党的潜入所进行的侦察与反侦察行动大获成功，你功不可没。我需要针对以下战果进行细节复盘，作为后续行动的参照与指导。”
“好的，过奖了。”
“你是如何巧妙避开了敌人的佯攻，并推测出其主攻部队的动向的？”
“是……我进行了非受迫性待命。当待命结束，敌人的大部队已行进至视野范围内。”
“也就是说，你接收到了相关指令吗？好强的前瞻性，是秋栗组长下达的吗？”
“是无氧代谢副产物累积与电解质失衡，我是这么感觉的……”
“唔……所以你只是因为休息错过了敌人的佯攻部队，结果碰上了主力部队。好吧……下一个问题。”
“你是如何截获了敌人的行动暗号，并破译出敌人下一步动向的？”
“拍子不对，我听到了。”
“什么的拍子？”
“残党的驻地，我潜伏了一天一夜，他们一直在播放《DEATH☆DREAMS》那张专辑，我从小时候就开始听了。秋栗和萤石嫌吵，我很久没听过了。”
“麻烦说重点……”
“这张专辑的编曲很简单，鼓组从头到尾都是4/4拍，我对每首歌的节奏型都很熟。但那天却很怪，低频不稳，有一个不断变化的声音潜伏在鼓点下。”
“越来越听不懂了，然后呢？”
“我以为是什么荒野Remix，就认真听了那个节奏，并记了下来。那是一段裂地者暗号，我学过。后来，我们集结并肃清了这个据点，发现他们在用震荡器向外发送暗码，《DEATH☆DREAMS》只是障眼法，糟蹋了好音乐。”
“呃……不管怎么说，你成功提供了关键情报，谢谢，询问结束。”

以上行动记录对一般行动组并无参考价值，申请作废。
——Z7行动组组长 秋栗</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Archived operational records (OBSOLETE) 
"Operator Estella, you were instrumental to the success of our espionage and counter-espionage mission against the surviving Landbreaker elements that infiltrated this area. For operational debriefing, we must now go over details of the following achievements we made in the field. They will be used as reference and instructional materials for our future operations." 
"Okay. You flatter me." 
"How did you successfully avoid enemy's feint and correctly deduce actions of the main attacking force?" 
"I ... uh... I was conducting voluntary standby. When I'm done standing by, the enemy's main force were within visual range." 
"In other words, can we assume you have received a relevant order? Sounds like incredible foresight. Did Captain Akekuri give you that order?" 
"I believe it was given to me by electrolytic imbalance and accumulation of anaerobic metabolites. At least that's what I felt..." 
"So... You're trying to say that you missed the enemy's feint attack because you were resting, but woke up to encounter the main enemy force? Okay... Erm... Next question." 
"So, how did you intercept the enemy's operational pass code and decipher their subsequent actions?" 
"The beat wasn't right. I heard it." 
"Beat? What's the beat?" 
"I spent a day in the camp of the surviving Landbreakers. They kept playing the DEATH☆DREAMS album. I have always been a fan since I was little. Akekuri and Fluorite called it noisy so I stopped playing it." 
"Can we get to the point, please...?" 
"Well, DEATH☆DREAMS has a simple structure. The drums were played on 4/4. I knew the rhythm and tempo of every song on the album. But the beats were off that day. Bass was off. There's a sound that's constantly changing lurking under the drums." 
"I'm afraid I'm losing you there. What happened next?" 
"I thought it was some wildlands remix so I focused really hard on the beat and jotted it down. And it happened to be a series of breaker codes. I've learned them before. We later rallied and cleared out the outpost and discovered they were using oscillators to send out their codes. DEATH☆DREAMS was just the camouflage. What a waste of good music." 
"Well... regardless, you successfully provided us with key intel. Thank you. This will be the end of our inquiry." 

Application rejected. The aforementioned operational log offers no values of reference to standard operations teams. 
— Akekuri, Captain, Operations Team Z7 </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【与秋栗组长就干员埃特拉背景调查的对谈记录】
由于干员情况特殊，秋栗组长事先与我进行了干员背景说明，并出示了相关物件资料。

物件：照片
这是一张老照片。银白色头发的菲林女孩坐在木制摇椅上，一脸幸福。她的身边是同为银白发色的青年男女，他们的手轻柔地搭在女孩两肩，看上去是非常幸福的一家人。
据秋栗介绍，这是埃特拉干员10岁生日时摄于家中书房的照片，那里如今已是一片废墟。天使与侵蚀迫使他们流离失所，一家人带着所有积蓄来到菈梵朵玛，希望可以在那里安顿下来。
可是，事情并没有如他们所愿。接下来是秋栗组长出示的报刊资料，记录了埃特拉一家人是如何在投资中受骗，损失了几乎所有存款。

物件：旧报刊
《麦道夫金融欺诈案终告破：受害者血本无归，主犯挥霍殆尽》
本报9日讯（记者 梅拉达）曾轰动塔卫二、造成巨额经济损失的特大金融诈骗案主犯伯纳·麦道夫，在潜逃多年后，已于日前被缉拿归案。
经司法机关深入调查查明，该犯罪团伙长期以虚假的高额投资回报为诱饵，编织了一个巨大的金融骗局。其利用新投资者的本金，伪装成支付给老投资者的所谓“收益”，以此制造盈利丰厚的假象，吸引更多不明真相的企业与个体商户不断投入资金。这种“拆东墙补西墙”的违法活动，完全背离了真实投资创造价值的规律。
经过执法部门锲而不舍的追捕，麦道夫终于落入法网，等待他的将是法律的严厉审判。但令人痛心的是，麦道夫团伙在潜逃过程中，已将绝大部分非法所得挥霍或转移，导致立案后可供追缴返还受害者的涉案资产所剩无几。这意味着，尽管主犯落网，但众多遭受重创的企业与个体商户，其巨大经济损失恐难以挽回。
此案再次以沉重的代价警示社会：天上不会掉馅饼。广大投资者务必高度警惕，擦亮双眼，谨防落入不法分子精心设置的陷阱。

案件告破时，埃特拉一家已经加入了工团，在北部矿区的39号矿洞工作，可好运还是没有眷顾这家人。秋栗组长拿出另一份简报。

物件：旧报刊
《北部矿区遭遇矿难 裂地者侵袭雪上加霜》
本报19日讯（记者 里瑟），北部矿区39号矿洞发生大型矿难，多名矿工滞留矿洞。地面办事处几乎在同一时间被裂地者突袭，多名工人及家属失联。
据矿区总负责人柳拜称，18日傍晚时分，39号矿洞即将结束作业，一声巨响后矿洞入口坍塌，仅少数距地表较近的矿工成功脱逃。目前，援救工作尚在进行，预计20日凌晨可以完成救援。目前，伤亡情况不明。
本报也采访到矿区地面办事处负责人波夫科娃。据她介绍，18日傍晚，矿洞巨响后5分钟，大量武装裂地者出现，对地面设施进行破坏与掠夺。工团武装在几分钟内就被裂地者击溃，地面办事处职员与生活区的家属纷纷出逃。目前，伤亡情况还在统计，出逃人员仍处于失联状态。至于矿难与裂地者的袭击之间是否有关联，目前尚未有确切的调查结果。
工团总部对此事高度重视，目前，已派出多支搜救部队，在北部矿区进行援救工作。本报也会持续跟进报导。

据秋栗组长介绍，科尔先生，也就是埃特拉的父亲，事后被救援队从矿洞中救出，所幸生命无碍。而埃特拉和母亲则在裂地者的袭击中走散。科尔太太很快被工团的救援队所救，埃特拉则被裂地者俘获，被迫作为苦力在荒野上辗转。可是，这样严酷的经历却无意中展现了她的天赋。
当时，Z7行动组潜入了某裂地者营地，秋栗组长遇到了埃特拉。这名浑身脏污的少女竟然通过口述交代了营地区域所有的地形结构与布防信息，甚至能单靠记忆在沙地上绘出地形图。通过这些情报，Z7行动组以极低的损失成功攻陷了该营地，并解救出了所有平民。
秋栗组长看重埃特拉的情报能力，邀请她加入终末地。而埃特拉在多年颠沛流离后，非常渴望有一个安定的归宿，几乎没有犹豫便选择了加入。秋栗组长特别补充，由于这段艰苦的经历，埃特拉干员对重体力活动呈现出非常抵触的态度。

以上是全部记录信息，已提交人力资源事务部进行参考。</>
