<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Log of Captain Akekuri's interview regarding Operator Estella's background check 
Given the extraordinary circumstances of the operator in question, Captain Akekuri met me beforehand to discuss the operator's background and showed me a number of relevant physical and documentary information. 

EXHIBIT: A photograph 
An old photograph shows a little Feline girl with silvery-white hair, happily sitting on a wooden rocking chair. A young man and woman sit beside her, their hands resting on her shoulders. Together, they look like a happy family. 
Information from Akekuri revealed that this was a photograph taken 10 years ago in the study of Estella's family home. The place is now a ruin. The Aggeloi and the Blight forced them to move. The family brought their entire savings and traveled to La Fantoma with the aim of settling down in that city. 
However, the family did not achieve their goals. Captain Akekuri next displayed a newspaper cutting that recorded how Estella's family was swindled by an investment scheme and lost almost the entirety of their savings. 

EXHIBIT: Old newspaper cutting 
MacDoff Financial Scheme Breakthrough: Criminals Splurge and Decimate the Victims' Savings 
Reported on the 9th of this month (Correspondent: Meralda). Bernard MacDoff, the chief suspect behind the super-massive financial scheme that shook Talos-II with the sheer scale of fortunes involved, was finally apprehended just yesterday after years of hiding. 
In-depth investigations by our judicial system discovered that the criminal organization had devised a massive fraud scheme, luring unsuspecting investors with promises of generous returns. Principals from new investors were disguised as “payments” to older investors, creating the illusion that the scheme was generating massive profits. Many unsuspecting companies and individual investors were enticed to increase their investments in the MacDoff scheme. Such illegal financial operation of paying older investors with money from the new is a complete abomination of genuine investments that aim to generate true value. 
Persistent efforts by our law enforcement agencies paid off when MacDoff was finally brought to justice. He will be facing the full severity of the law. Unfortunately, the MacDoff gang has either splurged or transferred their illegal gains during their escape and hiding. After the case was filed, the amount of assets recovered and returned to the victims was a paltry sum compared to their losses. This means that despite arresting the chief suspect, the massive losses incurred by many companies and individual investors can no longer be salvaged. 
This case is a stern warning to the general public: Money doesn't fall from the skies. Investors are advised to remain vigilant and alert. Be wary of intricately designed investment traps created by various criminal organizations. 

When the MacDoff case was closed, Estella's family had already joined the UWST and worked at Shaft 39 in the Northern Mineral Field. However, luck did not smile on this family. Captain Akekuri showed us another newspaper cutting. 

EXHIBIT: Old newspaper cutting 
Accident in the Northern Mineral Field Worsened by Landbreaker Raid 
Reported on the 19th of this month (Correspondent: Riise). A massive mining accident has occurred at Shaft 39 with many miners trapped in the pits. Surface facilities were also subject to a sudden Landbreaker raid at almost the same time. Many crew mates and their family members have gone missing. 
According to Chief Mineral Field Monitor Lyube, Shaft 39 was about to conclude their operations in the evening of the 18th when the shaft entrance collapsed after a loud explosion. Only a few miners closer to the surface managed to escape to safety. Search and rescue (SAR) operations are ongoing, and all SAR work is expected to complete by the morning of the 20th. The number of casualties is still unknown. 
Our correspondent also successfully interviewed Mineral Field Surface Facility Office Monitor Povkova. According to her, in the evening of the 18th, a large Landbreaker band appeared about 5 minutes after the massive explosion in the shaft. The raiders then began to vandalize and raid various surface facilities and buildings. Armed personnel of the UWST were defeated by the Landbreakers within minutes. Surface facility office staff and family members in the residences then started to run for their lives. Exact casualty figures are still being determined. Many escapees are still missing and cannot be contacted. Ongoing investigations have yet to identify a direct link between the mining accident and the Landbreaker raid. 
The UWST Commandery is extremely concerned with this incident and has deployed multiple teams to conduct SAR operations in the northern mineral field. We will continue to bring you the latest updates from the site. 

According to Captain Akekuri, Mr. Kerr (Estella's father) was rescued, very much alive, from the shaft. However, Estella was separated from her mother during the Landbreaker attack. UWST SAR teams quickly rescued Mrs. Kerr, but Estella herself was captured by Landbreakers. They brought her with them to the wildlands and subjected her to involuntary labor. However, her talents were unexpectedly revealed during this cruel experience. 
Operations Team Z7 infiltrated a Landbreaker camp and Captain Akekuri encountered Estella during that time. The dirt-covered girl verbally conveyed the geographical layout and defense deployment and even drew a map of the entire place on the sand. Estella's intel allowed Op Z7 to capture the camp and rescue all civilians with minimal losses. 
Akekuri was impressed with Estella's intel gathering abilities and invited her to join Endfield. Having spent many years in the wildlands, Estella also strongly desired to have a safe residence and joined our organization without hesitation. Captain Akekuri also added that this episode of extreme hardship in Estella's life has made the operator extremely adverse to any work involving heavy labor. 

All logs above have been transferred to the Human Resources Division for reference. </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【秋栗反复查看的一份医疗档案】
基本信息
患者名：埃特拉·科尔
职务：Z7行动组成员，终末地工业正式干员
行动代号：埃特拉
入院方式：战地无人机转运
接诊时间：23时07分
接诊地点：终末地三号谷地荒野医护站点

主诉
卷入爆炸，全身多处出血、剧痛45分钟后陷入休克。

现病史
患者原本在距离事发地5千米处执行侦察任务，于45分钟前自行变更行动计划，为掩护受困战友突围，强行冲入交叉火力区，被迫与敌人近距离缠斗，并暴露在敌人的火力压制下。自述被当场震倒，意识短暂模糊，随后匍匐撤离约20米，被Z7行动组其余成员发现并快速送医。

既往史
既往体健，否认慢性病、手术史、输血史，非矿石病感染者。

体格检查（入院时）
意识模糊，面色苍白，神情痛苦
生命体征：体温正常，脉搏细弱，血压偏低，呼吸微弱
头颅：左侧额颞区4cm裂创，骨皮质连续，未及骨折征
颈部：无气管偏移，平卧位颈静脉可见塌陷
胸部：右肋贯通伤口，直径约1.2cm；叩诊鼓音，呼吸音减弱；心音低钝，节律齐
腹部：右下腹肿胀压痛
四肢：左股骨中段开放性骨折，创口6cm，可见骨端；右小腿后外侧贯通伤，出血处已加压包扎；双下肢远端动脉搏动减弱
皮肤黏膜：多处擦挫伤

初步诊断
右侧开放性气胸
失血性休克（Ⅲ级）
左股骨开放性Ⅲ型骨折
多发软组织贯通伤
颅脑轻度闭合性损伤

紧急处理清单
开放性气胸处理
血容量复苏
抗休克
止痛
抗源石感染
左股骨与右小腿伤口
破伤风免疫

预后评估
紧急处理后，转入终末地医疗部门
根据战伤评估，24小时内生存率预估85%
若血流动力学稳定且无继发感染，预期6～8周后可进行负重训练

陪诊记录
陪诊人：秋栗、萤石、卡契尔、安塔尔</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: A medical record often reviewed by Akekuri 
BASIC INFO 
PATIENT NAME: Estella Kerr 
POSITION: Member of Operations Team Z7; full-time operator, Endfield Industries. 
OPERATIONAL CODENAME: Estella 
ROUTE OF ADMISSION: Combat UAV ambulance 
ADMISSION TIME: 2307 
ADMISSION LOCATION: Endfield wildlands medical station, Valley III 

CHIEF COMPLAINT 
Hit by an explosion. Multiple open and bleeding wounds. Shock after 45 minutes of intense pain. 

PRESENT ILLNESS 
Patient was conducting recon operations 5 klicks away from the site of the explosion but exercised personal initiative in changing the operational plan 45 minutes ago. Patient charged into a cross-firing zone to cover the retreat of trapped teammates but was exposed to enemy's suppressive fire. Patient described that she has been knocked off her feet by a blast and temporarily lost consciousness. She then crawled for about 20 meters before other teammates of Op Z7 discovered her and quickly sent her on medevac. 

MEDICAL HISTORY 
Healthy. Denies chronic illnesses, past surgeries, and past blood transfusions. Oripathy negative. 

PHYSIOLOGICAL EXAMINATION (AT ADMISSION) 
Clouded consciousness, pallor, grimacing in pain 
VITAL SIGNS: Normal temperature. Weak pulse. Blood pressure slightly below average. Weak breathing. 
HEAD: Open laceration (4 cm) at left temporal fossa. Cortical bone intact. No fractures. 
NECK: No tracheal deviations. Observable collapse of jugular vein when supine. 
CHEST: Penetrating wound of right rib cage, diameter about 1.2 cm. Percussion reveals tympany. Diminished breath sounds. Muffled heart sounds, no arrhythmia. 
ABDOMEN: Distension and tenderness of lower right abdomen. 
LIMBS: Open mid-shaft fracture of left femur, open wound measuring 6 cm long, end of bone visible; Penetrating wound of posterolateral aspect of right calf, pressure dressing already applied to site of bleeding; Weakened arterial pulse in lower extremities 
SKIN & MUCOSA: Multiple abrasions and contusions 

PRELIMINARY DIAGNOSIS 
RIGHT SIDE: Open pneumothorax 
Hemorrhagic shock (Lv.Ⅲ) 
Open fracture (type Ⅲ) of left femur 
Multiple penetrating wounds of soft tissue 
Light blunt trauma of cranium 

LIST OF EMERGENCY RESPONSES 
Open pneumothorax treatment 
Blood volume resuscitation 
Anti-shock treatment 
Pain management treatment 
Anti-Oripathy measures 
Dressing of wounds on left thigh and right calf 
Tetanus vaccination 

PROGNOSTIC ASSESSMENT 
Patient has been transferred to the Endfield Medical Division after emergency treatment 
According to combat trauma assessments, patient has 85% survival rate for the next 24 hours 
If hemodynamics remain stable and no subsequent infections occur, physical training and rehab can proceed after 6-8 weeks 

VISITATION RECORDS 
VISITORS: Akekuri, Fluorite, Catcher, Antal </>

voiceDesc.cn: 休息时间……要结束了吗？
voiceDesc.en: Is break time ... over already?

voiceDesc.cn: 再给我两分钟就出发……
voiceDesc.en: I'll be ready in ... two more minutes...

voiceDesc.cn: 又要出任务了吗？呼……趁我的体能还没耗尽……
voiceDesc.en: Another mission? Hooo... Fine... Hope it's over before I drop from exhaustion...

voiceDesc.cn: 该去探索哪些……不为人知的秘辛呢？哼哼……
voiceDesc.en: Now how should I explore those ... unspoken secrets? Hmm...

voiceDesc.cn: 啊啊……无法匹敌的力量……呼呃……好沉……
voiceDesc.en: Wow... A weapon of ultimate power... Hnnngghh... It's so heavy...

voiceDesc.cn: 武库的工程师们显然高估了我的持续作战能力……不过……就这样吧。
voiceDesc.en: The Arsenal engineers obviously overestimated my combat endurance... Hurrrr... Whatever.

voiceDesc.cn: 提升能力就能减少工作了吗？好耶……
voiceDesc.en: Oh, so getting better means less work? Yay...

voiceDesc.cn: 除了身体机能以外的部分都成长了……嗯，看来我已经没救了。
voiceDesc.en: Brain's upgraded, body's leveled up ... but zero progress for stamina. Welp, guess I'm doomed.

voiceDesc.cn: 真是突如其来的晋升机会……本以为还需要花更多时间的……
voiceDesc.en: This promotion is most unexpected... I thought it would take way, way ... way longer than this...

voiceDesc.cn: 看来我的工作比我预想中完成得还要出色……管理员……我需要请两天假犒劳一下自己……
voiceDesc.en: Turned out the results of my work exceeded my expectations... Endmin... I need a two-day leave to give myself some TLC...

voiceDesc.cn: 让我晋升这么快真的好吗……还是说这是什么试探下属的管理方式吗？我得好好琢磨一下……
voiceDesc.en: Why do I keep getting promoted...? Am I an experiment for new management strategies? I should try and figure this out...

voiceDesc.cn: 喔喔！这是不是意味着我可以去指挥秋栗做事了？哼哼……等下就去试试。
voiceDesc.en: Ooooh! Does this mean I get to order Akekuri around? Heh heh... Time to try things out.

voiceDesc.cn: 又是这个环节吗？你好……管理员，我的名字是埃特拉，还请不要分配太多重体力工作给我。
voiceDesc.en: Why do I have to do this again...? Greetings... Endministrator. I'm Estella. And please don't give me physically-intensive assignments. Thank you.

voiceDesc.cn: 哈……活过来了。我暂时不想再去做任何事了……
voiceDesc.en: Haah ... still breathing. For now, I just wanna do absolutely nothing...

voiceDesc.cn: 又过度劳动了……嗯……忙里偷闲的时光可要好好珍惜。
voiceDesc.en: I overworked myself again... Hngh... I better appreciate the break while it lasts.

voiceDesc.cn: 又是什么新的工作吗？我还是蛮期待的……真的哦。
voiceDesc.en: A new assignment? I'm looking forward to it... I really am. Honest.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员……休息得怎么样？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin... How goes your break?

voiceDesc.cn: 难得看到管理员这么有空。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, I hardly see you taking a break.

voiceDesc.cn: 自从我告诉安塔尔我不喜欢他的那些数字游戏后……他就再也不向我推荐了。嗯……其他人也应该这么做的。
voiceDesc.en: After I told Antal that I didn't like his math games, he stopped sharing them with me. Hmm... Actually, people should follow my example.

voiceDesc.cn: 武库的工程师总是向我抱怨我的枪破损率太高……那也没办法……我能挥舞起这么重的家伙已经是不小的奇迹了。
voiceDesc.en: The Arsenal engineers keep grumbling about how fast I break my lances... Honestly, the fact that I can swing these excessively heavy weapons is already a miracle.

voiceDesc.cn: 安德烈先生……他的脑袋能做到一百八十度旋转吗？嗯……下次我会去问问他的。
voiceDesc.en: Mr. Andre...? Can he turn his head 180 degrees? Hmm... I should ask him about this next time.

voiceDesc.cn: 秋栗很喜欢长耳兽，所以我专门收集了许多长耳兽的料理食谱送给她……不知为何在那之后她整整一个星期没和我说话……真奇怪……
voiceDesc.en: Akekuri loves long-ears so I compiled plenty of long-ear recipes and gave them to her... Then she stopped talking to me for an entire week... That was so weird...

voiceDesc.cn: 我已经习惯孤军深入的战术行动了……虽然很麻烦，但总得有人去做这些事。毕竟……我比其他人更耐得住寂寞。
voiceDesc.en: I'm used to carrying out solo infiltration operations... It's a hassle but someone has to do it. Especially because ... I'm a better loner than the rest of the team.

voiceDesc.cn: 噪音和金属乐更能让我变得平静……停住那些声音很容易，但我喜欢嘈杂声中的些许迷失感，会有些……忘我？
voiceDesc.en: Loud metal music calms me down... Stopping such noises may be easy, but I enjoy the sense of aimlessness amidst the cacophony. It helps me ... forget who I am.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，你愿意收下这个吗？放心……不是什么奇怪的东西。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, will you accept this? Have no fear... There's nothing odd about this thing.

voiceDesc.cn: 送给我的……？嗯……很感谢……很少有小队以外的人送给我礼物。
voiceDesc.en: It's for ... me? Well... Thank you... I usually do not receive gifts from people who are not in my team.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么不加入攻坚小组？不了不了，我对自己体能的不足可是很有自信的……不能给他人增加负担。
voiceDesc.en: Join the assault team? No, thank you. I am confident that I lack the physical strength to do so... And people shouldn't be forced to carry me around.

voiceDesc.cn: 有位同行曾说过我对信息的利用率太低……嗯……不过我根本没考虑过怎么去利用那些秘密，太麻烦了……收集它们只是我的爱好……
voiceDesc.en: Someone in the trade said I'm under-utilizing my intel... Hmm... I actually never thought about utilizing these secrets. It's just too much work... I guess I just enjoy collecting them...

voiceDesc.cn: 运气差？我的父母倒是时不时会怀念过去的生活，认为生活的落差是运气差所致……但是，嗯……我觉得无论什么样的经历都有它存在的意义，正如我由此认识了Z7小队的伙伴……
voiceDesc.en: Bad luck? My parents always reminisce about the good ol' days, saying it was just bad luck that our lives kept getting worse... But, well... I think every experience is meaningful in some way. It was how I met my fellow colleagues in Op Team Z7...

voiceDesc.cn: 遇到Z7小队前我正处于人生的最低谷……啊……真是灾难。钱被骗光，饥肠辘辘……秋栗和萤石起初把我和被救出的难民们安置在一起，直到我告诉她们裂地者换班的细节和组织情报……萤石一脸惊异地问我怎么做到的……嗯，那时她的表情我依然还记得。
voiceDesc.en: I was at rock bottom before meeting Team Z7. *Sigh* That time was a total disaster... Some hack cheated me of all my money and I was so hungry... At first, Akekuri and Fluorite had me bivouac with the other nomads they rescued. But when I decided to share details on the Landbreakers' organization and their patrol shifts... Fluorite couldn't hide her astonishment and asked me how I did it... Yeah, I still remember that look on her face.

voiceDesc.cn: 我想过随遇而安的生活……我曾以为霉运缠身的我有这样的想法很奢侈。直到我来到了终末地……加入了Z7小队，遇见了管理员……谢谢你们一直在包容我……
voiceDesc.en: I just want to live a peaceful life and accept whatever comes my way... There was a time when I thought this was wishful thinking for someone as unlucky as me. Then I came to Endfield ... joined Team Z7 ... and met you, Endmin... Thank you for tolerating my presence...

voiceDesc.cn: 我的过去没有那么跌宕起伏，我只记得自己跟着家人辗转各地……嗯，很累、很辛苦，和塔卫二上的大多数人一样。所以我想生活得更轻松一些……
voiceDesc.en: My past wasn't a roller coaster ride. I just followed my family and went from place to place... Yeah, I guess it was tiring and hard, but most Talosians went through the same thing. I just hope life can get more relaxing and easier...

voiceDesc.cn: 在空旷的环境……去感受失真的吉他声给耳朵带来的轻微刺痛感……嗯……我很喜欢……
voiceDesc.en: I like the metallic buzz when someone rips a distorted riff. When I'm out in the open, it gives my ears a strange tingling — it's weirdly comforting...

voiceDesc.cn: 我并不觉得敌后的工作艰苦，相反……不知何时将至的威胁有些微妙的刺激感……嗯，只要准备足够充分，没什么应付不了的。
voiceDesc.en: Working behind enemy lines isn't that hard. On the contrary ... it feels rather exciting when you don't know when the danger will strike... Well, nothing would catch you off guard so long as you're well prepared.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员会有觉得被我冒犯到的时候吗？抱歉……人事部门提醒过我这一点……Z7小队的大家让我不用太介意，理由是他们已经习惯了……
voiceDesc.en: I'm sorry, Endmin. Just tell me when you feel offended by me... HR reminded me about this... But my friends in Team Z7 told me it's alright because they said being offended by Estella is a part of life...

voiceDesc.cn: 该怎么利用情报去猜测人的内心？我只负责收集，萤石负责剖析……嗯，我也很想知道她是怎么做到的。不过……她只是告诉我说“经验之谈”。
voiceDesc.en: I just collect intel and Fluorite analyzes them. How do you use intel to understand how their mind works? Hmm... I hope Fluorite could share her secrets with me... The only thing she told me was that: "It's all down to experience."

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……作为超额劳动的报复，我要把秋栗与纸杯蛋糕的秘密公之于众……呵呵，我真是太恶毒了。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm... There will be a reckoning for this unfair assignment. Everyone shall learn about Akekuri's cupcake secret... Hurhur... Estella, you are such an evil girl.

voiceDesc.cn: 卡契尔是个毫无秘密的人……嗯，他的一切似乎都已经写在述职报告里了……世界上居然还存在这样的人？
voiceDesc.en: Catcher doesn't have any secrets... In fact, he's practically laid everything bare in his Work Performance Report... I never expected to meet a weirdo like him.

voiceDesc.cn: 萤石和我搭档的次数最多，她总是因为我说了什么而笑个不停，还会让我多说点话……嗯……人内心的想法真是难以捉摸。
voiceDesc.en: I tend to get partnered up with Fluorite. She kept laughing at things I said and even encouraged me to say more... Hmm... I guess ... people and their minds can be quite complicated.

voiceDesc.cn: 那位萨弗拉是个很认真的人……有时候是不是有点认真过头了？工作本就如此辛苦……不过他讲的笑话非常有意思，总能把我和萤石逗笑。
voiceDesc.en: The Savra is dedicated ... though I think he goes overboard at times. Work is tiring enough as it is... But I find his jokes quite interesting. They always make me and Fluorite laugh.

voiceDesc.cn: 那个看起来还不错……嗯，找个机会带回去吧。
voiceDesc.en: That one looks good... If possible, we should bring it back.

voiceDesc.cn: 那边那个……就算再累也有跑一趟的价值。
voiceDesc.en: Look there... Could be worth the trouble.

voiceDesc.cn: 呼……得去那边探索一番了。
voiceDesc.en: Hooo... I guess we'll have to investigate that area.

voiceDesc.cn: 是强敌……我可以只负责支援吗？
voiceDesc.en: High threat hostile... Mind if I stick to support?

voiceDesc.cn: 多希望这种场合能用上自动矿机……
voiceDesc.en: If only someone brought an auto-mining rig...

voiceDesc.cn: 我来帮忙了……不过……别对我有太多期望……
voiceDesc.en: I'm here to help... But don't expect too much from me...

voiceDesc.cn: 这下不算白跑一趟了。
voiceDesc.en: Now we've made good on this trip.

voiceDesc.cn: 啊，我曾经见过这个……
voiceDesc.en: Ahh... I think I saw this before...

voiceDesc.cn: 太好了，这下不用多绕路了。
voiceDesc.en: Great. Now we don't have to walk the long way round.

voiceDesc.cn: 多少恢复了些体力……能再多休息会儿就更好了。
voiceDesc.en: I'm a little recovered ... still, a bit more rest would be great.

voiceDesc.cn: 试试这个……或许能帮到你……
voiceDesc.en: Try this... Maybe it can help...

voiceDesc.cn: 之前的准备派上用场了……
voiceDesc.en: Guess the prep was worth it.

voiceDesc.cn: 当心……这时候不能硬撑。
voiceDesc.en: Watch out... Don't get hit.

voiceDesc.cn: 呼……武器好沉……
voiceDesc.en: Hurrr... The weapon's so heavy...

voiceDesc.cn: 抱歉……是我拖累了大家……
voiceDesc.en: I've let everyone down again...

voiceDesc.cn: 喔哦……刚才的动作我可不行。
voiceDesc.en: Wow... I would never pull that off.

voiceDesc.cn: 没错……就应该多依靠团队协作。
voiceDesc.en: Good... Team work is what we need.

voiceDesc.cn: 但我不想多来几次了……
voiceDesc.en: I'd rather not do this too often...

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……每个人都出了份力。
voiceDesc.en: Yeah... Everyone played a part.

voiceDesc.cn: 我不擅长持久战……加速解决吧。
voiceDesc.en: I'm no good in long battles... Please finish it quickly.

voiceDesc.cn: 到了不得不战斗的时候了吗？上吧。
voiceDesc.en: Do we really have to fight? Fine. Let's go.

voiceDesc.cn: 总算结束了……哈，我表现得还不错吧……
voiceDesc.en: Huh... It's over... I did well, right...?

voiceDesc.cn: 呼……幸好在体力槽见底前结束了。
voiceDesc.en: Hoo... So glad I didn't pass out halfway through.

voiceDesc.cn: 还好……没有拖太久……
voiceDesc.en: Good... At least it ended quickly...

voiceDesc.cn: 多亏了……大家……还好坚持下来了……
voiceDesc.en: Everyone ... did well... I'm so glad I made it...

voiceDesc.cn: 下一次……下一次我会更加全力以赴的……不能就这么结束……
voiceDesc.en: I can't let it end like this... Next time ... I'll try even harder...

voiceDesc.cn: 别乱跑！
voiceDesc.en: Stand still!

voiceDesc.cn: ……这里！
voiceDesc.en: Right there!

voiceDesc.cn: 将声波……冻结！
voiceDesc.en: Sonic ... freeze!

voiceDesc.cn: 破碎……之声！
voiceDesc.en: Shatter ... blast!

voiceDesc.cn: 哈啊……撕裂吧！
voiceDesc.en: Haa... RIP!

voiceDesc.cn: 总算……准备就绪了。
voiceDesc.en: Finally... I'm in position.

voiceDesc.cn: 让你们久等了……
voiceDesc.en: Sorry to keep you waiting...

voiceDesc.cn: 唔……嘿咻！
voiceDesc.en: Heave-HO!

voiceDesc.cn: 别急，这就来！
voiceDesc.en: Coming up!

voiceDesc.cn: 瞄准……弱点！
voiceDesc.en: Hit the weak ... SPOT!

voiceDesc.cn: 快点……倒下吧！
voiceDesc.en: You go DOWN!

voiceDesc.cn: 音爆……轰击！
voiceDesc.en: Sonic boom ... BOMBARD!

voiceDesc.cn: 汇聚……释放！
voiceDesc.en: Charge and ... blast!

voiceDesc.cn: 将声音凝结！
voiceDesc.en: O' sounds, converge!

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员萤石，在鼓动地方民众使用暴力手段反抗当地不法势力，并帮助终末地外勤队伍摆脱威胁后，经干员秋栗申请，纳入Z7行动组管理，此后无新增犯罪记录。

务必留意社交场合的萤石，她的所谓“私人恩怨”并不算什么，但与她交流本身就足够制造意外。好在大多数时候萤石并不反感当一个安静的听众，而我们更重视干员的战斗能力，这不是一个难以处理的情况。
但是，她抢答了我要问的每一个问题，甚至在我完成风趣回应之前笑了出来。算法推演中不曾出现此类结果，已纳入待分析特征库。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Fluorite once encouraged local civilians to violently resist a criminal organization and helped an Endfield field operations team escape certain threats. Operator Akekuri thus endorsed Fluorite's employment with Endfield Industries. She is now a member of Operations Team Z7. No new criminal records have been filed against the Operator since then. 

Pay particular attention to Fluorite in social settings. Her "personal grudges" are usually not as significant as we make them, but conversations with her may take unexpected turns. Fortunately, Fluorite is not averse to being a listener. Since we place greater importance on an operator's combat capabilities, her peculiarity is not particularly difficult to handle. 
However, she seized the initiative and answered every question on the list before I formally delivered it to her. In fact, she even started laughing before I could complete my engaging answers. This situation was not predicted by my algorithms. Hence, this interview has been added to the archives of unique case studies for further analysis. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>根据本人自述，萤石的源石技艺只是制造一些性状多变、具有黏着性的液体。如果情况属实（我得说，可信度并不高），那么她糟糕的社交表现就只能用“阅历丰富”来解释了——只有专家才知道怎样准确揣测别人的痛点，至于她为什么会毫不犹豫地戳下去则是另一码事。即便测试结果已经公开，依然有人固执地认为她一定还有其他诸如“读心术”之类的秘密能力。
“试想一下，你今天的体能测试差点儿不合格，刚刚挨了教官一顿臭骂。回宿舍的路上看到她，她突然冒出来一句‘没办法，半夜的三明治的确很香’……这还不够烦人吗？行，我知道偷吃宵夜是我不对，但她干嘛说出来呀！”
有人曾经这样向Z7行动组的成员们抱怨，却没有得到太多安慰，只收获了无数“我懂你”的眼神。平心而论，萤石并不喜欢惹是生非，性格方面甚至称得上沉默寡言。然而，她自由散漫的行动方式和太过犀利的沟通习惯结合在一起，大部分情况下都会让人不适。对于这些控诉，萤石的自我辩护简单而真诚：
“要我去道歉吗？”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>According to Fluorite herself, her Originium Arts solely focused on the creation of polymorphic fluids with adhesive abilities. However, if this were true (which I personally feel to be not), then her malignant social skills could only be explained by her "extensive experiences" — since she has expert-level abilities in identifying damaging information about others. Fluorite's willingness to reveal such information without hesitation is another thing entirely. Even though Arts assimilation test results are publicly accessible, there are those who stubbornly believe that Fluorite has secret "divination" abilities. 
"Just think about it. You almost flopped your PE and the instructor just gave you an earful. While heading back to the dorms you see Fluorite along the corridors and she suddenly goes, 'I guess it can't be helped. Midnight sandwiches are just so divine'... She's so friggin' annoying! Fine, I know I shouldn't be snacking at night but why would she say it out loud?" 
One Operations Team Z7 member once voiced their frustrations, but instead of receiving comfort, they were met with a chorus of knowing looks that silently said, "I feel you." In all fairness, Fluorite does not intend to stir up trouble and she hardly speaks during dialogs. However, her carefree nature combined with her excessively unforgiving tone proved to be rather discomforting to most people during many situations. When these issues were brought before Fluorite, her defense was simple and sincere: 
"You want me to go and apologize?" </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>维若娜，外号“双利手”“长舌妇”“子弹长眼”“无根草”，女，斐迪亚，绿发。
前任醉鬼帮打手、瘸帮打手、饿狼帮短铳队队员、疤痕佣兵队挂名（不用防备报复）、“歪脖子”罗根的头牌射手，据说金盆洗手后在白道的安保公司任职。
擅长使用短铳，也会用飞刀、手弩。行动敏捷，出手极快，十分狡猾，会使用各种陷阱。留意她手上的任何东西，不要听她说的哪怕一个字，以及不要在野外找她麻烦，非常危险。
事迹：以下犯上、偷窃帮派物资、背叛组织；煽动“异铁螺钉”小镇居民，搞垮“歪脖子”罗根的产业，致残帮派全部成员；另外，我们确信在公共场合猛踢某位发言人下体后逃走的就是她。
交易人：“不归路”酒吧找光头布朗。旧币不连号，见人见钱。手脚拿三成，舌头拿五成。
悬赏额：300000金票
更新：450000金票
更新：800000金票（金主要求，活捉再加二十万！）
更新：1200000金票

（潦草的手写体）“某位”发言人是鲍威尔，活该。

S.O.W.批注：经过劝说，萤石干员主动上交了这份悬赏令。目前暂时可以确认没有更多留有她书写痕迹的副本。关于公共场合袭击发言人一事，人力资源事务部已经与萤石干员进行过沟通，如需调阅相关记录，可直接向该部门咨询。
发言人鲍威尔并未受到严重身体伤害，但显然其公众形象严重受损。这不仅是因为他在剧烈疼痛下不太严肃的夸张表现，也因为他在发现萤石干员后展现的恶劣态度与其平日塑造的形象不符。经调查，发言人鲍威尔的初期政治活动主要集中在临近开拓区的数个自由市，并且他与许多小型犯罪组织头目有交往记录。例如，盘踞在“异铁螺钉”小镇的“歪脖子”罗根涉嫌非法作物交易和高危环境强迫劳动，曾数次向发言人鲍威尔献金以寻求庇佑。
考虑到萤石干员加入终末地前在“异铁螺钉”小镇最后的行为，不难理解她为何对暗中保护地方黑恶势力的发言人鲍威尔怀有仇恨。调取监控记录后，可以确认萤石当时已经蒙面，发言人鲍威尔的犯罪记录也已经送交环塔商会，暂时没有引发进一步公共关系问题的风险。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Verana. Known aliases: Double Hands, Gossipmonger, Shots-Got-Eyes, Strangleweed. Female. Phidia. Green haired. 
Former muscle Boozers, former muscle for the Lamelegs; former member of the gunslinger posse for the Hungry Lupos; honorary member of the Scarred Company (scratched out to avoid reprisal); top shooter working for "Weird Neck" Logan. Rumors say that Verana began working at a proper security company after leaving the underworld. 
Verana is extremely skilled in the use of hand guns, throwing daggers, and hand crossbows. She is famous for her quick-draws, cunning, and willingness to lay down various traps. Keep an eye on anything she holds. Do not believe anything (not even a word) she says. Do not attempt to confront her in the wildlands as it has proved to be extremely risky and dangerous. 
WANTED FOR: Violating the established order; stealing gang supplies, treason; inflaming local tensions in the town of Oriron Screw, toppling the business of "Weird Neck" Logan, and physically wounding and crippling every member of his operations. Also, we now have verified that she is the one who dealt a powerful kick to the nethers of a certain spokesperson in a public setting before fleeing the scene. 
INTERMEDIARY: Go to the bar Road of No Return and talk to Bald Brown. Payment upon delivery, to be made in old bills with no consecutive serials. Body parts also accepted. 30% for hands and feet. 50% for the tongue. 
BOUNTY: 300,000 T-Creds 
UPDATE: 450,000 T-Creds 
UPDATE: 800,000 T-Creds (Payer's request: Another 200,000 T-Creds if captured alive!) 
UPDATE: 1,200,000 T-Creds 

(Handwritten scribbles) That "certain" spokesperson is Powell. He deserved it. 

SOW Notes: After much persuasion from our side, Operator Fluorite voluntarily submitted this bounty poster. As of now, we can verify that no copies furnished with her handwriting can be found. The Human Resources Division has already conferred with Operator Fluorite regarding the public attack on the spokesperson. Please direct your inquiries to the said division if you need to peruse the relevant records. 
Spokesperson Powell did not suffer serious physical injuries, but his public image took a significant blow. This was due not only to his exaggerated and undignified reactions to the intense pain, but also due to the fact that he revealed a malicious demeanor (upon finding Fluorite), which sharply contrasted with the public persona he had built throughout the days. Our investigations further revealed that Spokesperson Powell's early political activities were primarily centered around several free cities near the frontiers. Records indicate frequent interactions with leaders of various minor criminal organizations. One such example is "Weird Neck" Logan, who once dominated the town of Oriron Screw and is a potential suspect in illicit crop trading and the use of forced labor in hazardous environments. Logan has, on multiple occasions, granted Powell monetary benefits in exchange for protection. 
Operator Fluorite's final action in the town of Oriron Screw obviously revealed her personal grudge against Spokesperson Powell, who had secretly offered protection for local criminal organizations. After accessing monitoring records, we verified that Fluorite carried out the deed while donning a mask. Spokesperson Powell's criminal records have since been submitted to the TGCC. This incident is unlikely to trigger further PR issues, for now. </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>“——关键在于，那些聚落已经全部荒废了。如果按萤石的自述绘制行动轨迹，你会发现她就像食腐动物一样追着衰颓的镇子迁移，等待尸体出现，然后再次‘起飞’……
“这里没有质疑她的意思——并非这些流浪者导致了聚落的衰败，而是他们往往只能找到处境不佳的落脚处。能触及边缘地带的援助实在有限，如果某个中转城市遭遇危机，供给断裂可能会引发连锁反应，把一整条物流链上的聚落全都毁掉。
“从最偏僻、最脆弱的地方开始，逃难者们乘着崩溃的波浪一路逃离，直到他们抵达一个足够稳定的新居所，或者和某个聚落一起消失……人们甚至给这种现象起了一个名字。
“只要那些城市间的联系依然脆弱，‘搁浅’还会发生无数次。危机会滋生特权，特权会滋生罪恶。到了某个临界点，文明就不再是家园，而是垄断者们套在奴隶脖子上的锁链。
“我们必须掌握阻止这一切继续发生的力量。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>"The thing is, those towns and villages have been completely abandoned. According to the path described by Fluorite herself, you'll realize that she's like a scavenger, swooping from one dying town to the next. Once a new 'corpse' appears, she would spread her wings and 'fly off' again..." 
"I'm not questioning her motives. These vagabonds were not the ones who caused the towns to fade away. Folks could only find less than ideal places to settle, places that only had limited access to support and resources from the fringes. If a hub city meets a crisis, then the resulting supply breakdown could initiate a chain reaction capable of killing every town along the route." 
"Death starts from the most isolated spots, the weakest link of the chain. Refugees would then ride the wave of collapse until they either arrive at a new town that offers enough stability, or fade away completely in the wildlands like a certain town out there... People even came up with a special name to describe this phenomenon." 
"As long as the links between our cities remain fragile and tenuous, the stranding will never end. Crisis breeds privilege, and privilege is a hot bed for sin. Once we reach the threshold, Civilization is no longer a home, but a yoke that the monopolists shackle onto the necks of their slaves." 
"We must master the power that can help us prevent this from happening." </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>妈妈，我打听到叔叔婶婶们现在的情况了：
戈登，合金萝卜自由市，卡车司机。
艾尔莎，团结号，似乎在一家杂货铺当售货员。
安达露西亚，新都筑自由市，记者。
大威廉，“异铁螺钉”小镇（已废弃），已故，轨道事故。
卡拉库尔特，只打听到她已经启程去玛尔斯波利斯，最后一次露面在五号谷地附近。
艾比，还没找到。
卡维尔，还没找到。
“长腿”，在监狱服刑，宏山人对犯人还不错。
阿尔丹，和我决斗，逃跑了，不打算去找。人渣。
…………
维若娜，现在也可以叫我“萤石”。我已经在天上了。这里很有趣，先不走了。
如果你捡到了这封信，而且是个好人，把它交给终末地工业，或者送去开拓区烧掉。谢谢。
——一张被叠成小块、皱巴巴的纸。从后勤干员手上拿回它时，萤石的眼神很少见地变得有些温柔。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Mama, I heard about how my uncles and aunts are doing: 
Gordon. Alloycarrot. Trucker. 
Elsa. The Unicity. Seems to be a cashier at a grocery store. 
Andalusia. Free City of Neo Tsukushi. Journalist. 
Big William. Town of Oriron Screw (abandoned). Passed away due to a railroad accident. 
Karakurt. I only managed to learn that she left for Morospolis. She was last seen near Valley V. 
Ebby. Not yet found. 
Cavill. Not yet found. 
"Long Legs". Currently serving his term. They treat inmates pretty well in Hongshan. 
Aldan. Tried fighting me but ran away. I don't intend to look for him anymore. Piece of trash. 
............ 
Verana, you can also call me "Fluorite" now. I've reached the skies. Place is interesting so I might stick around for a while. 
If you find this letter and regard yourself as a decent individual, please give this to Endfield Industries or burn it in the frontiers. Much appreciated. 
— A piece of wrinkled paper, folded many times. When the logistics operator gave this to Fluorite, she noticed a gentleness rarely seen in the latter's eyes. </>

voiceDesc.cn: 呀，来活了？
voiceDesc.en: Oh, we ready to play?

voiceDesc.cn: 要是有人没准备好呢？
voiceDesc.en: Hold on, what if someone's not ready for it?

voiceDesc.cn: 让我们好好相处吧，女士们、先生们？
voiceDesc.en: Peace and smiles, ladies and gents.

voiceDesc.cn: 哼哼，我还挺被看重呢。
voiceDesc.en: Wow, looks like I'm quite the catch.

voiceDesc.cn: 还算趁手……介意我做点小改装吗？
voiceDesc.en: Not bad... Mind if I tweak it a little?

voiceDesc.cn: 东西越好，事越麻烦，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: The fancier the gear, the bigger the hassle, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 没人陪我练习一下吗？真可惜。
voiceDesc.en: Nobody wants to spar with me? What a shame.

voiceDesc.cn: 这么多作战记录，不愧是终末地“工业”啊。
voiceDesc.en: So many battle records... Endfield sure lives up to the "Industries" part.

voiceDesc.cn: 看来后头的工作不轻松呢。
voiceDesc.en: Looks like the real work's just getting started.

voiceDesc.cn: 荣幸之至——出勤时间又要变长了，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: I'm truly honored ... but I guess it means even longer hours on field missions, yeah?

voiceDesc.cn: 下回发个勋章吧，我还从来没拿过呢。
voiceDesc.en: Maybe throw in a medal next time. Never had one before.

voiceDesc.cn: 如果文明环带边缘也在终末地想创造的“美好世界”里，那我们还有很多工作要做，不是吗？
voiceDesc.en: If the Band Fringes are part of the "better world" we're trying to build, then we've got plenty of work to do, don't we?

voiceDesc.cn: Z7行动组游击手，萤石。不说点什么吗？嗯……要不，散会？
voiceDesc.en: Op Z7 skirmisher, Fluorite. Got anything to say? No? How about we just call it a day?

voiceDesc.cn: 这回轮到谁倒霉了？
voiceDesc.en: Who's due for some bad luck this time?

voiceDesc.cn: 扰乱？牵制？还是……一步到位？
voiceDesc.en: Distract them? Disable them? Or ... just destroy them?

voiceDesc.cn: 放心，我会好好干的。
voiceDesc.en: Relax, I'll get the job done right.

voiceDesc.cn: 真忙呀，大英雄。
voiceDesc.en: Busy day, huh, big hero?

voiceDesc.cn: 又有多久没休息了？
voiceDesc.en: When was the last time you actually rested?

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……真难得，不像是找我出任务呢。
voiceDesc.en: Well ... this is new. No tasks for me today?

voiceDesc.cn: 秋栗她笑着进训练室了？还拿着剑？好，那我再躲一会儿……
voiceDesc.en: Did Akekuri just stroll into the training room, grinning ... with a sword? Guess I'll stay out of her sight for a bit longer...

voiceDesc.cn: 第一次摸到铳的时候，我连怎么打开它的弹巢都不知道，但对面已经冲上来好几人了……和开拓区比起来，这里的训练很温柔呢。
voiceDesc.en: The first time I picked up a gun, I didn't even know how to open the chamber. With a bunch of guys charging at me, it wasn't like I had a choice... Honestly, this training's a breeze compared to the chaos back in the frontier.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们小队这几位要不是刚好凑在一起，能惹的麻烦大概要多好几倍。放心，我当然会帮你看着他们啦。
voiceDesc.en: If it wasn't for pure luck that we ended up in the same team, we'd be doubling the trouble. But don't worry, I'll keep them in check.

voiceDesc.cn: 小时候，我们几个小鬼会在驮兽车上晒着太阳睡一整天，这样肚子才不容易饿……我没在抱怨员工福利，只是飞得这么高，不多晒晒太阳就可惜了。
voiceDesc.en: When we were kids, we'd sleep all day on the burdenbeasts, sunbathing so we wouldn't feel hungry... Not that I'm complaining about the perks; I just think it'd be a shame not to soak up a little sunshine at this altitude.

voiceDesc.cn: 你和佩丽卡监督一样，让人讨厌不起来呢。开拓区的“大人物”们只会揪着排场和面子不放，可就算没有那些东西，大家也愿意跟着真正的领袖，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: You're like Supervisor Perlica — can't really hate you. The big shots out in the frontier love clinging to their status and pride, but honestly, people will follow a real leader, with or without all that.

voiceDesc.cn: 再送你个小东西。放心，这次的不吓人。
voiceDesc.en: Here, a little gadget for you. Relax, nothing will pop out of it.

voiceDesc.cn: 以前，我有位“同事”收了一件礼物，然后就被抓去顶罪了——你拼命摇头做什么？
voiceDesc.en: Hmm, a "colleague" of mine once accepted a gift and ended up taking the fall... Why are you shaking your head so hard?

voiceDesc.cn: 交涉经验？最好别把那些地痞混混太当回事。他们只是眼线和爪牙，主子稍微动动饭盆，就得乖乖跟着跑。蠢材到处都是，最多不过掀点小风小浪，真正能把一片地方毒死的，还是那些霸着资源和权力不松手，垄断了一切的家伙。
voiceDesc.en: Negotiation skills? Please, don't flatter those street punks. They bark loud, but the moment their boss shakes the bowl, they come trotting back. They're just tools — no spine, no plan. They make a mess, sure, but the real rot? It's the ones sitting on all the power and resources, squeezing the rest of us dry.

voiceDesc.cn: 入伙前我犯了点事，是秋栗为我写的保证书。那时候，她的小队在拼命保护镇子，赶走了那些裂地者，但居民们却盯上了终末地的物资……换成是你，你会怎么做？
voiceDesc.en: I got in some trouble before I joined. Akekuri bailed me out. Her squad was busy saving the town, kicking out those Landbreakers. And the locals? They were too busy eyeing Endfield's supplies like vultures... Now, tell me, what would you have done?

voiceDesc.cn: 有一阵子，我有六个叔叔，八个婶婶，二十二个兄弟姐妹……倒像是一家子卡特斯了。他们是我和妈妈逃难路上的伙伴，我们彼此照顾。有人中途加入，也有人离开。即便这支队伍很快就散了，那也是我少数有“家庭”的时候。
voiceDesc.en: I've got six uncles, eight aunts, and twenty-two siblings ... yeah, we're very much like the Cautuses. We weren't all related, just folks who fled with me and my mom. Some came later, some vanished who-knows-when. But we stuck together, even if it was only for a short while. That was family enough for me.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们有四肢，却只用两条腿走路。如果自己不记得如何直起身子，就和那些野兽没区别了。开拓区到处都是这样的人。低头一辈子，就要当一辈子家畜，只有抬起头来，才能有机会做个人。
voiceDesc.en: Some people forget we've got four limbs, not just two to drag ourselves around. Stay hunched long enough, you stop looking like a person. The frontier's full of folks like that. But if you've got the guts to look up? Then maybe you've got a shot at something better.

voiceDesc.cn: 这封信，拿着。如果我回不来了，把它带去荒野烧掉吧。想打开看也可以，只是一些琐事罢了。收信人已经去世，他们想打听的消息只能让我去找了。你会帮我的吧，塔卫二的大英雄？
voiceDesc.en: Here, take this letter. Burn it in the wildlands if I don't make it back. You can read it if you want, just a bunch of little things. The person it's meant for is gone. Guess it's up to me to find the answers they were looking for. I'm sure the big hero of Talos-II will help me, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 这是我常用的小炸弹。只要调整附着面的黏性，就能让它在最合适的地方炸开。担心威力？没关系，它能拖延目标行动，这比直接破坏有用多了。
voiceDesc.en: This is one of my go-to bombs. Just tweak the adhesive surface, and it'll blow up exactly where it counts. Oh, don't stress about its power. It's way more effective at stalling the target than just blowing things up.

voiceDesc.cn: 看过履历之后，佩丽卡监督给了我“萤石”这个代号——自然状态有毒，但也能制作很多工业用品。翻过书之后，我大概懂她的意思了。不过，有点坏心眼呢。
voiceDesc.en: After going over my file, Supervisor Perlica gave me the codename "Fluorite". It's naturally toxic, yet perfect for creating all kinds of industrial products. I get what she meant after skimming through the book. But, honestly? Kind of a cheeky choice.

voiceDesc.cn: 小时候，我跟着妈妈到处逃难。后来，我自己一个人在开拓区过活。有的聚居地会拿种子粮救济难民，有的自由市会巧立名目征收各种杂税，哪儿都是我的家乡，哪儿也都不是。开拓区的聚落都“活”不长久，“家乡”的分量太轻了。
voiceDesc.en: When I was a kid, my mom and I were always running from one place to the next. Eventually, I had to survive on my own in the frontier. Some places gave us reserved grain as rations, while others taxed us with all sorts of made-up fees. Everywhere felt like home, yet nowhere truly was. The settlements in the frontier never lasted long, and the idea of "home" never really meant anything.

voiceDesc.cn: 其实，那片荒野一直都很美。侵蚀赶跑的动物不会一走了之，每年都会出现新的迁徙路线。灾害边缘总是长满野草，哪怕只消退一点，黄色和绿色都会马上填满空缺。它们自己循环得很好，只是没法再承受更多了……你说，“人”会不会才是那里最多余的东西？
voiceDesc.en: Beauty has always defined the wildlands. The animals driven away by the Blight never really leave — they just shift their paths each year. Grass creeps back the moment the Blight retreats. Nature has its own rhythm, and there's only so much it can take... Sometimes I wonder if we really belong in that balance.

voiceDesc.cn: 我待过的那几个偏僻地方，压榨别人最狠的往往都是秩序的维护者。他们知道有些地方一点动荡都受不起，就把居民当人质，维持了一个妙得恶心的平衡。改变现状吧，只要你的手还离他们那么远，这样的事就会永远存在。
voiceDesc.en: In the backwaters I've lived, it's always the enforcers who squeeze people the hardest. They know how fragile things are — one spark of chaos, and the whole place could crumble. So, they create a twisted balance by holding the locals hostage. Unless you're close enough to grab their throats, nothing's ever going to change.

voiceDesc.cn: 猜猜看，我展示的那串耳朵，是谁帮忙收进证物袋里的？就算是我们善良纯真的好队长，也知道塔卫二没有更好的选择。当然，她忍着不哭鼻子的表情，我还是挺喜欢的喔。
voiceDesc.en: Take a wild guess — who do you think sealed those ears into the evidence bag? Yep, even our kind-hearted Captain knew there wasn't a better choice on Talos-II. And that face she made, all teary but holding it in? Adorable.

voiceDesc.cn: 虽然那家伙好像乐在其中，但还是悠着点使唤他吧。有些人越是准备万全，越是害怕出纰漏。你知道，人不可能永远不犯错……从我先做起？不要，那多麻烦。而且，不管有多害怕，他都会挺过来的。
voiceDesc.en: He might look like he's enjoying it, but go easy on him. The super-prepared ones are usually the most afraid of screwing up. No one's mistake-proof... What, I should stop asking him for favors? Pfft, why should I? Don't worry — he'll push through, even if he's scared stiff. He always does.

voiceDesc.cn: 别随便试埃特拉听的音乐，也别真放她去找刺激。她是因为游刃有余才会冒出那些想法？我不觉得，做好善后准备吧，指挥大师。
voiceDesc.en: Don't touch Estella's playlist, or let her chase danger for real. You think she's got everything under control? Uh-uh. Better keep a mop handy, my dear.

voiceDesc.cn: 大蜥蜴就算战斗时也一直不慌不忙的，他大概根本没意识到危险在哪儿吧？队长其实没必要总因为这个生气，反正每个人有各自的活法。嗯……我对他没什么意见，只要别老盯着别人的尾巴不放就好。
voiceDesc.en: That big lizard's cool as ice, even in the heat of battle — probably doesn't even realize he's in danger. It drives the Captain up the wall ... but hey, that's just how he rolls. Me and him? Hmm... We're totally cool ... as long as he remembers my tail's not for staring.

voiceDesc.cn: 找到一点好东西，我能全拿走吗？
voiceDesc.en: Found something cool, mind if I take it all?

voiceDesc.cn: 难道你没看见那边的……啊，我什么都没说。
voiceDesc.en: Did you see that over there? Oh, never mind, forget I said anything.

voiceDesc.cn: 看到个好地方。嗯……应该会很有意思。
voiceDesc.en: Found a nice spot. Hmm ... seems like fun.

voiceDesc.cn: 各位，咱们有新玩伴了。
voiceDesc.en: Everyone, we've got a new buddy to play with.

voiceDesc.cn: 自己动手，这算忆苦思甜么？
voiceDesc.en: Ah, the good ol' DIY. Just like the bitter old days.

voiceDesc.cn: 来了，各位真勤快呀。
voiceDesc.en: *Yawn* Coming. Y'all are so productive.

voiceDesc.cn: 还有这种好东西？幸好上面没写名字。
voiceDesc.en: Wooo, what a find. And no name tag? Hmm...

voiceDesc.cn: 我以前也有过一个。嗯……后来的事不太让人高兴呢。
voiceDesc.en: I had one of these before... What happened after wasn't so great.

voiceDesc.cn: 要是那时候也能消除侵蚀的话……
voiceDesc.en: If only I could've eliminated the Blight back then...

voiceDesc.cn: 总算有时间补充炸弹了。
voiceDesc.en: Finally, time to restock on bombs.

voiceDesc.cn: 就说肯定能用上吧？
voiceDesc.en: See? I knew this would come in handy.

voiceDesc.cn: ……刚才只是运气不好，再来。
voiceDesc.en: That was just bad luck. One more round.

voiceDesc.cn: 当心，别中“大奖”了。
voiceDesc.en: Careful, don't get jinxed.

voiceDesc.cn: ……嘁，大意了。
voiceDesc.en: ...I slipped.

voiceDesc.cn: 这一回……没看透吗……
voiceDesc.en: I should've ... caught that.

voiceDesc.cn: 这不是挺能干嘛。
voiceDesc.en: Well, that was something.

voiceDesc.cn: 真卖力，边上可没摄像机呀。
voiceDesc.en: Not bad. Shame no one's here to film it.

voiceDesc.cn: 恭维我也没好处哦。
voiceDesc.en: Nice words, but save yourself some breath.

voiceDesc.cn: 毕竟咱们是精英团队嘛。
voiceDesc.en: Well, we are an elite team, after all.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……我这算是重操旧业了？
voiceDesc.en: Back to my old gig, huh?

voiceDesc.cn: 真敬业呀，有奖励吗？
voiceDesc.en: We're so committed! Fingers crossed for a bonus.

voiceDesc.cn: 好，又少一桩麻烦。
voiceDesc.en: Good, one less problem to worry about.

voiceDesc.cn: 真可惜，对面本来有机会的。
voiceDesc.en: Too bad, they almost had a chance.

voiceDesc.cn: 对，对。没你咱们赢不了。
voiceDesc.en: Yep, yep. We totally couldn't have done it without you.

voiceDesc.cn: 哼……遗憾，这位还是差了一点点。
voiceDesc.en: Hmph. Not bad, but not quite enough.

voiceDesc.cn: ……与其苦着一张脸，不如先动起来。这事还没完呢。
voiceDesc.en: Moping won't get us anywhere, but action will. C'mon, this isn't over yet.

voiceDesc.cn: 接好了！
voiceDesc.en: *Whistle* Fetch!

voiceDesc.cn: 看哪儿呢？
voiceDesc.en: Attention please.

voiceDesc.cn: 拿去，不谢。
voiceDesc.en: Here you go.

voiceDesc.cn: 喜欢这个吗？
voiceDesc.en: Hope you like this!

voiceDesc.cn: 计时开始喽。
voiceDesc.en: Tick tock!

voiceDesc.cn: 总算等到了！
voiceDesc.en: Hmph. Show time.

voiceDesc.cn: 破绽百出呢。
voiceDesc.en: They've got more holes than cheese.

voiceDesc.cn: 加点猛料。
voiceDesc.en: Savor this.

voiceDesc.cn: 吃得消这一发么？
voiceDesc.en: Bet you love it.

voiceDesc.cn: 毫无防备呢。
voiceDesc.en: Surprise.

voiceDesc.cn: 乖乖躺下吧。
voiceDesc.en: Bedtime, honey.

voiceDesc.cn: 都活得够久了吧？
voiceDesc.en: Guess you've lived long enough?

voiceDesc.cn: 动静会有点大哦。
voiceDesc.en: This is gonna be loud.

voiceDesc.cn: 现在还想逃跑吗？
voiceDesc.en: End of the road, pal.

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员安塔尔，Z7行动组成员。曾参与终末地工业源石自动化器械研发项目，经干员秋栗特别推荐，转入特种技术部门。

安塔尔从来不会掩饰自己的想法，当我问到他的学业情况时，他便完整向我讲述了自己每学期的学习和研究成果，虽然我只是依照惯例询问了一下……至少证明他确实热爱自己的专业，对待问题也足够认真。
在终于要结束被他拖延到长达三小时的谈话时，他突然好奇我有没有幽默系统，对我说，不介意的话他可以帮忙测试一下。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Antal is a member of Operations Team Z7. He was previously involved in Endfield Industries' Originium machine automation research project. Antal later transferred to the Specialist Tech Division following Operator Akekuri's special recommendations. 

Antal never hides his thoughts. When I asked him about his academic background as part of my routine inquiry process, he provided a comprehensive list of courses he took in every semester as well as his academic achievements... Nevertheless, this proves that Antal is passionate about his field of expertise and solemnly responds to various questions. 
As I was preparing to conclude the interview, which Antal had extended to nearly three hours, he curiously asked me if I have a humor-appreciation system. He also offered to test the system for me, if I did not mind. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>安塔尔并非像他看上去那么冷漠，难以相处，相信每一位和他有过接触的人都有这样的认知。这位热衷于研究源石技术、看起来过分板正的家伙，居然很喜欢给人讲冷笑话！一个技术人才，会绞尽脑汁想出需要用逻辑推理才能勉强理解笑点的冷笑话，他这么做的原因，只是想提升自己的幽默感吗？尤其当他顶着面无表情的脸试图引你发笑，你很难判断让你发笑的点到底是他的冷笑话，还是他身上表现出的反差。
他的队长秋栗对此倒是保持着非常乐观的态度：“至少他待人真诚，虽然有时说话不看场合。比如与敌人对峙时也会突然展示他的幽默感，可惜对方就不这么认为了。”
对安塔尔来说，“成为有趣的人”似乎是他人生的必修课，而所有人都是来考核他成绩的老师，从Z7小队的队友到不过一面之交的同事——只要是能给予有价值建议的对象，他都不吝于请教。
但是最近，安塔尔不再去打扰别人了，因为终于有人自愿长期给他反馈……等等，大概是自愿的吧？毕竟很少有人还没听完安塔尔的笑话就笑了起来。是的，我们的管理员，在以最大的耐心和安塔尔相处，会听完他所有的奇思妙想——包括他灵机一动的发明创意，以及抓住一个机会就展开的长达几小时的科普演讲。尤其某次，他竟然试图说服管理员脱下面具，理由是想对它做一些改装，比如加一双电光眼……最后当然是被路过的秋栗狠狠教训一通，当晚写了六千字检讨，并在第二天当着管理员的面大声朗读出来。
当然，这种惩罚对安塔尔来说完全没用，没过去几天，他灵活的大脑大概又要冒出一些奇妙的点子了。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Antal is not as cold or unsociable as he appears. Everyone who actually talked to him would agree with this statement. No one expected this stern-faced dude obsessed with Originium technology and sciences to be equally passionate about lame jokes! Why would this techie tell jokes so bad that one would need to devote all their brain juices and logical reasoning to fathom? Is he doing this to boost his sense of humor? When you look at his expression-less face and realize that he's doing his best to make you laugh, you might also find it difficult to determine why you end up laughing anyway. Is it because of his lame jokes? Or the stark contrast presented by his physical form? 
Akekuri, Antal's team captain, has maintained extreme optimism about this quirk: "At least he's sincere. Though there are times when he fails to read the context. For example, he may get a sudden urge to show off his sense of humor in the face of hostility. Unfortunately, the enemies often think otherwise." 
To Antal, "being someone interesting" may have become a lifelong pursuit, and he treats everyone as instructors capable of reviewing his performance. It doesn't matter if they are fellow teammates of Op Team Z7 or fellow Endfielders whom he only met once — Antal would humbly seek advice from anyone deemed capable of sharing valuable recommendations. 
Recently, Antal placed his antics on hold as a particular individual stepped up to the game and volunteered to offer constant feedback... Hold on. It's voluntary, right? I don't know if there are other people capable of laughing even before Antal finishes his bad jokes. Yes, we're talking about our Endministrator, who would, with the greatest patience, hang out with Antal, and listen to everything he has to say — ranging from eureka moments of inventive ideas to hour-long science lectures that he suddenly initiates when he finds an opportunity to do so. In a particular memorable moment, Antal tried to persuade the Endmin to take off the mask. His excuse was to apply certain mods like a pair of beam-firing eyes... Of course, Akekuri happened to be nearby and she fiercely reprimanded Antal's action. The Operator was forced to write a 6000-word self-examination essay and read it aloud before the Endmin on the following day. 
Of course, this punishment was hardly effective to Antal. It would only take a few days before his creative mind starts to formulate other interesting ideas. </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【干员培训纪录】
如果只看安塔尔目前的训练表现，我有理由认为他并不具备足够的正面作战能力。
他擅长用自己改造的法杖和浮游炮为队友提供辅助，但很少使用他本人的源石技艺。
或许有待进一步实战观察。
——训练教官批注

【权限记录】
根据Z7小队成员的报告，安塔尔的源石技艺堪称精湛，水准远远超过其他同期干员。在执行某一次任务时，他们曾亲眼见识过，安塔尔是如何在紧要关头挡在人质面前，利用自己的源石技艺将裂地者挥舞而来的大剑瞬间分解，救下包括他自己在内的两条生命。
当时所有人都格外紧张，如果安塔尔没能及时分解那把武器，他立刻会丢掉性命，可他本人却表现得十分冷静。自那以后，队友们对安塔尔有了更深的认知——这家伙其实非常迟钝，不论是感知危险情况，还是察觉别人的情绪波动，但他又愿意冒着生命危险去救人，也说明他是十分善良和勇敢的人。
事后面对队友的询问，安塔尔表现得格外谦虚——他说自己的源石技艺掌握得并不是很好，完全无法做到像他的奶奶那样将一个大件金属器械分解并重构，分解裂地者的武器是他能做到的极限。他还提到，小时候奶奶还特地做了一根小法杖送给他，用来弥补这方面的不足。
“你的天赋在别的地方——奶奶曾这么对我说过，而我一直对这件事深信不疑。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Operator training logs 
If we only look at Antal's current performance in training sessions, I have reasons to believe that he lacks direct combat capabilities. 
He is skilled at offering fire support for his teammates with his self-customized staff and orbiters. However, he seldom casts his own Originium Arts. 
Perhaps we can continue to monitor his performance in actual field battles. 
— An instructor's notes 

DOCUMENT: A certain log that requires sufficient authority level 
According to reports by members of Operations Team Z7, Antal is exceptionally skilled in Originium Arts. His ability to cast the Arts far exceeds that of other operators in his cohort. When conducting a certain operation, Op Team Z7 members witnessed how Antal, in a crucial moment, positioned himself before the hostage. The operator used his Originium Arts to instantly disintegrate the greatsword swung by the attacking Landbreaker, and saved both himself and the hostage. 
It was an extremely intense moment. Antal would immediately lose his life if he failed to de-weaponize the attacker. However, he himself remained extremely calm throughout the entire incident. Since then, members of Op Team Z7 gained a deeper appreciation of Antal's abilities — Though he was known for being slow when it comes to sensing dangers in the environment or picking up changes in the emotions of other people, he was willing to risk his own life to save others. This revealed Operator Antal to be an extremely kind and courageous individual. 
Antal was remarkably humble when his teammates asked him about what he did. Antal replied that he did not perfectly wield his Originium Arts and failed to achieve his grandmother's level of expertise. He claimed the old lady could take apart and reassemble large metal machinery, while disintegrating a Landbreaker's weapon was the most he could do. Antal also mentioned that his grandmother crafted a small staff for him during his childhood to make up for his lack of power. 
"Your talent lies elsewhere — That is what my grandmother told me. And I have absolutely faith in her words." </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>安塔尔出身于新蓝卡坞自由市的一个普通家庭，从小在奶奶经营的一家家用源石设备维修店里长大。
虽然生活的地方娱乐业发达，但安塔尔却对电影艺术之类的毫无兴趣，反而喜欢每天趴在桌子上看奶奶工作——比如维修一台运转异常的冰箱，为它更换源石启动器配件，再将屏幕碎裂、主板受损严重的电视机修复到完好如初……虽然身为维修师每天都有工作要做，但她从未忽视过孙子的成长。不忙的时候，她还会亲自给安塔尔设计制作一些小玩具：自动小跑车、电动魔方等等。所以安塔尔的童年从不缺少爱和陪伴。耳濡目染下，安塔尔也展现出他出众的组装、拆卸源石装置的天赋，最后得到全额奖学金去学院读书时，他也选了源石自动化应用相关的专业。
安塔尔就读学院的教育方式以保守著称，但他并不循规蹈矩，在发现自己的一些新奇发明并未得到老师的青睐后，他选择私下研究。毕业典礼那天，安塔尔作为优秀毕业生上台演讲。他将自己的最新发明——以源石驱动的自动化机械臂——安装在身后，用它冲着曾对此不屑一顾的老师们热情招手。突然，机械臂的四指垂下，只留一根中指竖立在空中静默不动。
尽管这次事件给校方的相关负责人留下了不小的心理阴影，安塔尔后来还是顺利毕业了。只不过，学校这边再没有一位老师愿意为他写就业推荐信。再后来，恰逢终末地工业前往新蓝卡坞附近的城市招募人才，其先进的技术和开拓精神深深吸引了安塔尔。事后，他主动向终末地投递了简历。完成面试后，安塔尔被正在组建队伍的干员秋栗选中，不久后正式成为了Z7行动组的一员。

啊……特训结束了我才意识到，难道这家伙勉强能算是个天才？
——Maze

勉强？
——同期受训的术师干员</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Antal was born in a normal household in the Free City of New Wrankwood. He spent most of his childhood growing up in a household Originium appliance repair shop belonging to his grandmother. 
Although Antal lived in a place known for its entertainment industry, he had no interest in the movies or performance industries. Instead, he preferred lying on the table and looking at his grandmother work — Her jobs include repairing a faulty refrigerator and swapping out its Originium starter component, or restoring a television with a shattered screen and severely damaged mainboard to mint conditions... The old repairlady had jobs everyday, but she never neglected her grandson. When she had time, she would personally design and make various toys such as mini sports cars and powered combo-puzzle cubes for the lad. Hence, Antal grew up very much loved and never felt lonely. Years of influence from his grandmother gave Antal an outstanding talent for assembling and taking apart Originium devices. He successfully secured a full scholarship in an academy and chose a major related to applications of Originium automation. 
The academy where Antal studied at was known for its conservative atmosphere. The youth, however, was not an adherent to the rules. When his novel inventions failed to acquire the favor of his professors, he chose to continue his project in private. For his academic excellence, Antal became the valedictorian for the graduation ceremony. He mounted his latest invention on his back — an automated Originium-powered robot arm, and enthusiastically used it to wave at the professors who once scoffed at the idea. And then suddenly, the open hand of the robot lowered four of its fingers, save for one that remained still and fully extended. 
Although the incident left quite a psychological trauma to members of the academy's administration, Antal was still able to graduate. However, no one in the academy was willing to offer letters of recommendation to his potential employers. Endfield Industries initiated a talent recruitment drive in cities near New Wrankwood a while later. The advanced technologies and pioneering spirit of the company seized Antal by his heart. He then submitted his resume to Endfield. After the interview, Antal was chosen by Operator Akekuri who was setting up an operations team of her own. He later became a formal member of Operations Team Z7. 

Oh... I only realized this after special training. The guy is pretty close to a true genius. 
— Maze 

Pretty close? 
— Caster operator in the same training cohort </>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>奶奶：
我收到您寄来的包裹了，这个新型施术单元正好能为我改造浮游炮提供帮助，别的一些附带的家乡特产我都分给了别人。其实您不用特地寄这些东西给我，我现在有固定的工资，即便每月购置一些工程改装用的零件也还有盈余。
我知道您寄电影角色玩偶、经典角色衣服，还有各种限定电影海报这些特产过来，是想让我用它们和其他人拉近关系，以前读书时您就是这么做的——虽然那些同学拿到东西后随手将它们塞进了闲置柜，再也没有拿出来过。那时您还写信说让我不要伤心，我真的没有，奶奶，正如我一直告诉您的那样，别人的反应无法影响我对他们的态度。
而且终末地的同事和学院的同学不一样，他们从来没有拒绝过我，也没否定过我的想法。我在这里的生活还不错，也更自由。顺便有件事我还想告诉您，我的沟通能力大有进步，多亏Z7队友们的教导，还有管理员一直陪我练习。
您之前还担心，以我的性格会不会和这位领导有什么冲突，现在证明是您多虑了。我们相处得很愉快，不管我分享什么，那个人都乐意接受，这也是我跟您写信频率降低的原因。您不用再担心我交不到朋友。不是索取与施舍，而是真诚相待，去探讨彼此的所有……我想我应该已经明白所谓“友情”的意义了。
以及，您托我转告的话，我已经告诉管理员了，对方很乐意，还说自己很早就期待能和您见上一面。

安塔尔</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Grandma: 
I have received the package from you. The new Arts Unit is just what I need to support my modified orbiter. I have distributed the other local specialties that came attached with the package. There is no need for you to send these things to me. I have a fixed salary good enough that I have some leftover after purchasing parts for engineering mods every month. 
I know you've sent plushes of movie characters, outfits of classic movie stars, and other limited edition movie posters so that I can use these to befriend other individuals. You have been doing this since I was attending the academy — However, those classmates of mine simply stashed the collectibles they received inside their closets and never showed them again. Your following letter told me not to be sad. I really wasn't, grandmother. It is just like what I've told you. Their reactions and responses will not influence my attitude towards them. 
My colleagues at Endfield are not like the classmates I have in the academy. The Endfielders never turned me down nor rejected my ideas. Life is here is good, and I enjoy more liberties. There is something else that I intend to tell you. My communication skills have vastly improved thanks to the instructions provided by my Z7 teammates and constant side-by-side training offered by the Endministrator. 
You once worried that my personality might start to conflict with my superior, but my current situation proves your worries are unnecessary. Our meetings have been enjoyable and the Endmin happily accepts everything I share. This also explains why I have been writing less to you. You no longer need to be concerned about my lack of friends. It is not about taking and giving, but mutual sincerity to explore and discuss everything about each other... I believe I have completely understood the true meaning of "friendship". 
Also, your request for passing on a message to the Endministrator has been carried out by me. The Endmin is enthusiastic and even said that the meeting with you should have taken place much earlier. 

Antal </>

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，准备开始工作吧。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm. Another shift begins.

voiceDesc.cn: 这次的测试对象是谁？
voiceDesc.en: Who's the test subject this time?

voiceDesc.cn: 轮到我出任务了么？正好，我也想找机会测试浮游炮的改造成效。
voiceDesc.en: A mission for me? Good. I happen to be seeking field-testing opportunities for modified orbiters.

voiceDesc.cn: 想好作战方案的话，告诉我要做什么就行，我相信您的判断。
voiceDesc.en: If you have a plan, just give your orders. I have faith in your judgment.

voiceDesc.cn: 未经调试的新武器，我需要对它进行一次效能评估。
voiceDesc.en: A new and uncalibrated weapon. I must subject it to a round of performance evaluations.

voiceDesc.cn: 性能有显著提升，虽然它会卡住我的鳞片。
voiceDesc.en: The new gear presents significant improvements. However, it snags against my dermal scales.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……感谢指导，我突然有了一个新思路。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm... I appreciate the instructions. A new train of thought has been inspired.

voiceDesc.cn: 出色的作战规划，管理员，我很乐意配合您行动。
voiceDesc.en: A most impressive battle plan, Endministrator. I am glad to be part of your operations.

voiceDesc.cn: 要给我涨薪吗？谢谢，那我每月就可以购入更多源石装置和施术单元用来研究和收藏。
voiceDesc.en: A raise? I appreciate additional funds for procuring more Originium devices and Arts Units. My research and personal hoard shall grow.

voiceDesc.cn: 晋升？意味着以后工作会更加繁忙？了解，所以新的任务是什么？
voiceDesc.en: A promotion, but one that entails additional work in the future? Understood. So, is there any new mission for me?

voiceDesc.cn: 这是对我求知欲望的鼓励吗？我正好写了一份关于协议核心的研究报告，您可以帮我检查一下是否存在漏洞。
voiceDesc.en: Is this encouragement for my thirst for knowledge? I just finished a report on the Protocol Automation-Core. You can review it in case I missed anything.

voiceDesc.cn: 老实说，这里的生活和读书时很不一样。在学院，我只要拿出研究成果就能得到高绩点，现在这些反而不再重要。信任队友，通过团队配合取得成果，是我要重新学习和适应的事。
voiceDesc.en: Life in Endfield is vastly different compared to my days in the Academy. Back then, I easily earned my GPA with my research, but this doesn't seem important now. I must learn and live with trusting my teammates and achieving results as a team.

voiceDesc.cn: Z7行动组安塔尔，向您报到。我对源石自动化器械有些研究，平时会帮忙改造和维修源石设备，如有需要可以来找我。顺便，我有个问题，您的面具是什么材质做的？碳纤维吗？
voiceDesc.en: Antal of Op Z7 reporting for duty. I've studied Originium automation and occasionally help with modifying or repairing Originium devices. You may approach me for such tasks... And I have a question for you. What is the material of your mask? Carbon fiber?

voiceDesc.cn: 有什么问题要和我讨论吗？
voiceDesc.en: You have something to discuss with me?

voiceDesc.cn: 我在想要跟您讲什么冷笑话。
voiceDesc.en: I am trying to compose a bad joke for you.

voiceDesc.cn: 新的工作安排吗？我明白了。
voiceDesc.en: A new job assignment? Affirmative.

voiceDesc.cn: 源石器械上的事都可以来找我，别的事也行。
voiceDesc.en: I am open to questions related to Originium devices, in addition to other things.

voiceDesc.cn: 很奇怪，一见到您，我的分享欲就格外强烈。
voiceDesc.en: Curiously, your presence greatly amplifies my eagerness to share my vast knowledge.

voiceDesc.cn: 我能检查一下您的武器吗，管理员？嗯，除了零件有些许磨损，别的没有太大问题，只需替换一个新的精密源石元件就行。没什么麻烦的，在Z7小队，我一直都这么做。
voiceDesc.en: May I inspect your weaponry, Endmin? Hmm. The only issue I see is the wearing down of certain components. Replacing a single precision Originium component will fix it. This repair job won't be much trouble. I offer this service for every individual in Team Z7.

voiceDesc.cn: 我在观察帝江号，它无疑是工程设计的巅峰，每一部分都极有学习和研究价值，中枢控制系统、协议网络节点与生命维持系统等等，我甚至已经构思好了下篇论文的选题。
voiceDesc.en: My studies of Dijiang reveal that she is a pinnacle of engineering. Central Control, the Protorig Network Node, Life Support systems, and various parts of the vessel offer ample opportunities of learning. It has granted me the structure for my next thesis.

voiceDesc.cn: 我根据萤石的经历想到一个冷笑话：收到敌人的威胁信息该怎么办？答案是退订。您笑了，证明它有效果，那为什么其他人没有这样的反馈？
voiceDesc.en: I have a joke based on Fluorite's personal experiences. How should one respond to a threatening message from an antagonist? Answer: Unsubscribe. You laugh. This joke is proven humorous. But why didn't the others laugh as you did?

voiceDesc.cn: 情绪持续低迷的话，可以跟我一起去室外享受自然日光浴，阳光会刺激大脑释放血清素，能有效驱散一定的负面情绪。以前，学院附近有一个喷泉公园，安静、日光充足，只要感到疲惫我就会去那儿休息。
voiceDesc.en: If your emotions are cold, join me in the outdoors. Solar radiation induces cerebral serotonin secretion that alleviates negative emotions. There was a fountain park near my Academy, one that offered serenity and plenty of solar exposure. When I studied in the Academy, the park was my resting grounds in moments of exhaustion.

voiceDesc.cn: 我昨天收到了奶奶的回信，她对我信中频繁提到的一个人很感兴趣，也就是您。她有句话让我代为传达：“您也看到了，这孩子有些较真，但本质不坏，还麻烦您多多担待，有机会真想找您喝杯茶，再聊聊他小时候的事。”
voiceDesc.en: My grandmother's reply arrived yesterday. She seems rather interested in a particular individual that I repeatedly mentioned in my letters to her. I shall relay her message to the said individual, which happens to be you, Endmin: "You should know by now that a certain young Savra may be quite stubborn, albeit in a good-natured way. Please bear with him. I hope to share some tea with you and tell you more about how I raised that little scaley kid."

voiceDesc.cn: 很多人会站在帝江号上眺望塔卫二，我也尝试过这么做，但发现除了提供给我不同的观察角度，似乎没能像他们一样去怀念家乡，也许是因为奶奶的关系吧。她总是告诉我：“不必沉浸于过去，你该去追寻更广阔的未来。”
voiceDesc.en: Many people gaze upon Talos-II from the decks of Dijiang. I did the same and though it offered a novel perspective, I did not share the nostalgia they felt. Perhaps my grandmother is to blame. She taught me: "Do not obsess about the past. Seek and broaden your future."

voiceDesc.cn: 在社会交往中，人们选择通过赠予对方物件来传达心意和感受。所以我准备了一份礼物，想送给您。
voiceDesc.en: Conventions of socialization dictate that people exchange gifts to convey their feelings. I have prepared this particular gift for you, recipient.

voiceDesc.cn: 谢谢，我明白送礼这一行为的意义，我会珍惜。
voiceDesc.en: I am grateful. I understand what it means to offer a gift, and I shall treasure this offering.

voiceDesc.cn: 选择加入终末地的原因很简单，这里有连学院也无法讲授的全新技术。学院对技术进步的观念有些过于保守，我还是更欣赏终末地敢于探索实践的创新精神。
voiceDesc.en: Joining Endfield was not a difficult choice. You offer new technologies that are absent in the Academy. The scientific society can be overly conservative in the advancement of certain fields. Endfield, however, offers an admirable spirit of exploration, innovation, and practical applications.

voiceDesc.cn: 对我手上这本书很好奇？是《高难数独题精选》。闲暇之余，我会做一些数学谜题来调节情绪。我曾向Z7的队友们分享过这个方法，但他们全都拒绝了。管理员，或许您可以尝试一下。
voiceDesc.en: My book? It is indeed the Selection of Extreme Sudoku Challenges. Arithmetic puzzles help modulate my emotions during idle time. I have shared this pastime with members of Z7 but reception was negative. Perhaps you can give this a try, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 您也要给我讲个冷笑话吗？“有位萨弗拉总喜欢在白天讲冷笑话，这是为什么？因为白天很温暖，别人就不会被冷到。”……哈哈哈，我没有嘲笑您的意思，我真的在笑。
voiceDesc.en: A bad joke for me? I shall hear it. "Why does a Savra only drop cheesy jokes during the day? Because the sun's out, and even the cringe deserves a little vitamin D." ...Hrra-Hrra-Hrra. I did not mean to insult, Endmin. Such is the sound of a Savra's genuine laughter.

voiceDesc.cn: 虽然改造过很多源石设备，但我最怀念的还是小时候奶奶送给我的那根法杖，“现在它可以陪着你去改造世界”，这句话我一直记到今天。
voiceDesc.en: I have modified plenty of Originium devices. But the one I miss the most is the staff my grandmother gave me when I was young. I remember her line to this day: "It shall accompany you as you modify this world."

voiceDesc.cn: 奶奶曾经告诉过我，研究者穷极一生去向世界寻求答案固然浪漫，但在道路上无人陪伴岂不太过孤独？我以前一直不明白她的意思，但当我有了新思路想把这份喜悦分享给您，而您却不在我身边时，我终于理解她说的孤独是什么意思。
voiceDesc.en: My grandmother told me that spending a lifetime to answer a scientific question may be romantic, but lonely is a life without friends. I did not understand what she meant. Then came a time when I wanted to share the joy of a new discovery, but you were not around. This incident taught me about loneliness.

voiceDesc.cn: 萤石教过我一个无聊时用来消遣的纸牌游戏，还提出输家要答应赢家一个要求。我们玩了五次，现在她要为我单独开设五节课，一对一辅导，课程内容是“如何让人迅速变成聊天高手”。
voiceDesc.en: Fluorite taught me a card game for passing the time. She also told me that the loser must do anything for the winner. We played five games. She is now obliged to give me five one-on-one sessions on "quickly becoming a joyful partner in conversations".

voiceDesc.cn: 您要去吃晚餐了吗？不，我不能去。由于我私自捕获了一只天使没向队长报备，她罚我今天晚上不准去餐厅进食。
voiceDesc.en: Having dinner? No. I cannot go. I have hunted down an Aggelos without reporting to my Captain. She has punished me by denying me night time feeding privileges at the canteen.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么加入Z7行动组而没参加科研项目？事实上，我最初的就职意向的确是去研发中心。不过那时面试我的是秋栗队长，她认为比起待在研究室，通过实战去测试改造的源石设备，更易于发现一些性能问题。我同意她的看法，所以加入了她的队伍。
voiceDesc.en: Why did I choose Z7 instead of an R&D project? The R&D Center was my initial interest but Captain Akekuri was my interviewer. She believes that modified Originium devices should be taken out of the lab and subject to actual combat scenarios. This will better identify their issues. I concur, therefore I joined her team.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么执着于讲各种冷笑话？因为读书时有人指出我缺乏幽默感，我认为对方说得没错，这是一种缺陷，必须得到修正。
voiceDesc.en: Why do I obsess about bad jokes? During my schooling days people complained about my lack of humor. I agree with them. My defect must be corrected.

voiceDesc.cn: 加入终末地离开家的时候，奶奶说她很高兴，她觉得这是一次机会：可以让我稍微将注意力从书籍和源石装置转移到别的地方——去和队友好好相处，再交个朋友。
voiceDesc.en: My grandmother told me she was happy I left home for Endfield. She treated this as an opportunity to get me off the reading and Originium devices. She hoped I would learn about getting along with teammates and even ... make a friend.

voiceDesc.cn: 秋栗队长吗？招我进来的人，好说话，我什么都听她的。虽然她平时总说没问题我们可以的，但她又经常失眠，半夜一个人在外面散步，问她原因也不说，您知道为什么吗？
voiceDesc.en: Captain Akekuri? She recruited me and is very friendly. I heed all her instructions. Though she says our team is doing okay, she often loses sleep and would pace about in the middle of the night. She refuses to divulge the reasons. I hope you may tell me why, Endmin.

voiceDesc.cn: 外出执行任务时，小队饮食都是卡契尔在负责，厨具在他手上比我的浮游炮还听话。只不过下雨的时候他就不怎么理人，但又不赶人走，很奇怪。
voiceDesc.en: Catcher is responsible for preparing the rations during field operations. He wields kitchenware better than how I wield my orbiters. When it rains, however, he refuses to talk but neither does he object to my presence. I find this rather perplexing.

voiceDesc.cn: 某种程度来说，萤石也算是我的鳞片伙伴。我喜欢她的尾巴，结实有力，但她不让我进一步接触。除此以外，她说话还很艺术，我应该向她学习。
voiceDesc.en: I consider Fluorite to be a fellow scaley friend of mine, to some degree. I find her strong, powerful tail attractive but she forbade me from making tactile assessments. Fluorite is also an artful conversationalist. I can learn much from her.

voiceDesc.cn: 埃特拉是我最先要考虑保护的队友，因为她和我一样都是白色的，很容易在战斗时暴露行踪，需要重点关注。
voiceDesc.en: When entering a battle, I need to consider defending Estella. We both share reflective and conspicuous skin tones. It is a key concern that dangerously exposes us in battle.

voiceDesc.cn: 不错，那边有新发现。
voiceDesc.en: Good. A new discovery has been made.

voiceDesc.cn: 一些重要的新发现，不去看看吗？
voiceDesc.en: We should take a look at that key discovery.

voiceDesc.cn: 请允许我去探究其中的奥秘。
voiceDesc.en: Allow me to investigate this mystery.

voiceDesc.cn: 发现高规格敌对单位。
voiceDesc.en: Elite hostile unit detected.

voiceDesc.cn: 矿物用途多样，可以多采集一些。
voiceDesc.en: Minerals serve multiple purposes. We should gather some.

voiceDesc.cn: 这样效率更高。
voiceDesc.en: This will boost our efficiency.

voiceDesc.cn: 发现不少有用资源，等下可以筛选一些用作设备维护的材料。
voiceDesc.en: Rich resource stash found. We should sort through it to identify gear maintenance materials.

voiceDesc.cn: 一些醚质在我们接近时会突然闪避，这是为什么？某种能量互斥？
voiceDesc.en: Some Aurylenes suddenly move away when we approach. Why? Can it be some form of energy-based repulsion?

voiceDesc.cn: 这是否意味着，我们对侵蚀有了更深的了解……
voiceDesc.en: Does this mean we have achieved better understanding of the Blight...?

voiceDesc.cn: 人不是机器，需要时间休整。
voiceDesc.en: People are not machines, and must set aside time for rest.

voiceDesc.cn: 正在紧急抢救。
voiceDesc.en: Initiating emergency treatment.

voiceDesc.cn: 已恢复正常状态。
voiceDesc.en: Nominal conditions restored.

voiceDesc.cn: 识别到敌方攻击指令。
voiceDesc.en: Hostile attack order detected.

voiceDesc.cn: 状态不佳，但还能坚持。
voiceDesc.en: Conditions sub-optimal, but still functional.

voiceDesc.cn: 抱歉，思路中断，无法提供援助。
voiceDesc.en: Train of thought derailed. Support ... unavailable.

voiceDesc.cn: 精彩的表现。
voiceDesc.en: An outstanding performance.

voiceDesc.cn: 默契的配合。
voiceDesc.en: We achieved tacit synergy.

voiceDesc.cn: 谢谢，但我应该能做得更好。
voiceDesc.en: Thank you, but I could've done better.

voiceDesc.cn: 这是必然的结果。
voiceDesc.en: A definitive outcome.

voiceDesc.cn: 施术单元状态良好。
voiceDesc.en: Arts Unit optimal.

voiceDesc.cn: 专心战斗，我会掩护你们。
voiceDesc.en: Focus on the battle. I shall provide covering fire.

voiceDesc.cn: 又有新的收获。
voiceDesc.en: New knowledge gained.

voiceDesc.cn: 任务完成，还算轻松。
voiceDesc.en: Mission complete. It was a walk on a cake.

voiceDesc.cn: 每个人都是团队不可或缺的一部分。
voiceDesc.en: Everyone has been indispensable to the team.

voiceDesc.cn: 战斗中总有不可控的变量，这是我们能取得的最好成果。
voiceDesc.en: Our results are optimal, despite the unexpected variables of combat.

voiceDesc.cn: 根据小队刚才的受损情况，撤退是我在计算后得出的最优解。
voiceDesc.en: Tabulations of losses incurred showed that extraction was the best solution for the team.

voiceDesc.cn: 破绽。
voiceDesc.en: Flaw sighted!

voiceDesc.cn: 停下。
voiceDesc.en: Hmph! Paralyze!

voiceDesc.cn: 方向确认。
voiceDesc.en: Direction set.

voiceDesc.cn: 目标锁定。
voiceDesc.en: Target locked.

voiceDesc.cn: 全力攻击。
voiceDesc.en: Max output.

voiceDesc.cn: 充能完毕。
voiceDesc.en: Fully energized.

voiceDesc.cn: 随时准备。
voiceDesc.en: Unit prepped and hot.

voiceDesc.cn: 关键一击。
voiceDesc.en: Critical zap.

voiceDesc.cn: 迅速解决。
voiceDesc.en: Hasten victory!

voiceDesc.cn: 电能释放。
voiceDesc.en: Ion burst.

voiceDesc.cn: 变压控制。
voiceDesc.en: Voltaic surge.

voiceDesc.cn: 去吧，制胜关键。
voiceDesc.en: Victory electrified.

voiceDesc.cn: 增幅回路，启动。
voiceDesc.en: Circuit amplified.

voiceDesc.cn: 动力运行。
voiceDesc.en: Time to power up.
