recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员洛茜，全名洛茜娜·狼珀·卢皮诺，裂地者狼群氏族成员，作为狼群代表之一与终末地工业达成合作关系。隶属于特种技术部门。

由于干员狼卫的身份特殊性，终末地与狼群氏族的合作事务实际上都围绕着洛茜干员开展。
洛茜并不常驻于帝江号，更多的时间会留在狼群处理氏族事务，但找到她不会像找到狼卫一样困难。她也乐于接受终末地的一些训练计划。小道奇对她的评价：战术素养极高，具有相当的领袖魅力和战场指挥才能。
洛茜干员更像是大众眼中狼群氏族该有的样子，重视族人，遵守规则，尊重长辈。洛茜干员来到帝江号的第一天，就拜访了几乎所有部门的负责人，以及极具声望的干员。她乖巧懂事的一面给很多人留下了深刻的印象。
但在面对敌人时，你又会看到她锐利、凶狠的一面。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Rossi, full name Rossina Wulfperl Luppino, is a member of a Landbreaker clan known as the Pack. As one of the clan's representatives, she has entered a cooperative partnership with Endfield Industries. Rossi now serves under the Specialist Tech Division.

Given the unique status of Operator Wulfgard, all collaborative affairs between Endfield Industries and the Pack are effectively focused upon Operator Rossi.
Rossi is not a permanent resident aboard Dijiang. She spends most of her time with the Pack and handling clan affairs. However, locating her is far less challenging than finding Wulfgard. She is also quite receptive to participating in some of Endfield Industries' training programs. Evaluations from Lil' Dodge states: "Exceptionally high tactical acumen. Possesses considerable leadership charisma and battlefield command talent."
Operator Rossi aligns more closely with public perception of what a member of the Pack should be: devoted to the family, conforms to the code, and respectful of their elders. On her very first day aboard Dijiang, she paid visits to nearly every department head as well as operators of considerable renown. Her well-mannered and conscientious demeanor left a strong impression on many.
However, if you were to face her in combat, you shall witness an entirely different side of Rossi: razor-sharp and utterly ruthless.
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>《洛茜的观察笔记》
罗赞爷爷
罗赞爷爷走路时总是没有声音，真是奇怪，他明明有着那么高的个头，脚步声却像踩在毛绒地毯上般细微，在他身上几乎从来都看不到破绽。无论我藏在哪里，都会被他发现。
每次看到罗赞爷爷用铳时，都会感觉时间像凝固了一样，连呼吸声都听不见了。不知道过了多久，他才会缓缓放下铳。我从没看到过他开枪，他用纸擦拭完铳身，将其收回盒子里，训练就结束了。我试着模仿过几次，但……没法像他那样坚持那么久。
…………
卡特洛
卡特洛总是脚步匆匆，真不知道他都在忙些什么。他的训练方式倒是很简单，枯燥无味的力量训练穿插几组动态射击训练，要么就是实战演习……真没意思，完全找不到什么参考价值，略过！
…………
弧光姐姐
弧光姐姐能够很快地在陡峭的石壁上移动。是不是只要速度够快就能办到呢？我问了弧光姐姐，她说需要借助一些法术……弧光姐姐训练时还会冥想，她说那会让她放空脑中的杂念。呜……一动不动那么久太困难了。
…………
管理员
管理员总是会照顾别人的步伐，关心对方有没有跟上自己，和卡特洛完全不一样！管理员的训练基本都和操纵源石有关，那些源石在管理员手中会化身为锐利的武器。究竟是用了什么方法呢？这肯定是只有管理员才能做到的事，想学也没有办法……</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Rossi's Observation Notes
Nonno Rozzan
Nonno Rozzan is always so quiet when he walks. Davvero strano ... he's so tall, yet his footsteps are as light as if he were walking on a thick carpet. I've almost never seen him slip up. No matter where I hide, he always finds me.
Every time I watch Nonno Rozzan handle his gun, it feels like time just ... si ferma. Even the sound of breathing disappears. I don't know how long it lasts before he finally lowers it. I've never actually seen him pull the trigger. He just wipes the barrel down with a cloth, puts it back in its case, and that's the end of training. I've tried to imitate him a few times, but ... I can't hold the stance for nearly as long as he does.
...
Catello
Catello's always in a hurry. Seriously, what's he so busy with? As for his training methods ... annoyingly simple. Mind-numbingly boring strength drills mixed with a few sets of dynamic target practice, or just straight to live combat exercises... Così noioso. Absolutely nothing worth learning from. Skipping this!
...
Sorella Arclight
Sorella Arclight can move across steep cliff faces so quickly. Is it just a matter of pure speed? I asked her, and she said it requires some Arts... She also meditates during her training. She says it helps her clear her mind of distractions. Ugh... Staying completely still for that long is way too hard for me.
...
Endministrator
The Endmin always adjusts to the pace of other teammates so everyone can keep up. Totally different from Catello! And the Endmin's training is mostly about manipulating Originium and turning the rocks into razor sharp weapons. How can anyone do that? Something only the Endmin can do, I guess. No point trying to learn it...</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>成年礼？狼群之中，每个人的成年礼内容都不太一样，有的人是独自完成一场狩猎，有的人是搞定一场复杂的生意。
狼群似乎不担心这些年轻人把事情搞砸，他们会大胆地把那些重要事务作为试炼内容交给年轻的小狼，这在氏族之外的人看来简直是疯了。
至于洛茜娜……狩猎和生意这些事情她在更小的时候就完成过，对她而言，这些事情只是家常便饭。
狼群给她安排了一场特殊的试炼。
他们把洛茜娜扔在了一个荒废的村落，村落里只有五个倒霉的匪盗。那些匪盗都是些亡命之徒，他们早就盯上了彼此手中仅剩的保命玩意儿，说不准哪天就会暗算对方。
五个人相互掣肘，谁也不敢轻举妄动，但……一旦微妙的平衡被打破……
洛茜娜的首要任务是在那群匪盗手中活下来，但除此之外还不够。那里隔三差五就会有野兽袭击，有时是一只，有时是一群。
老狼们把洛茜娜扔下之后就走了，他们一点也不担心她能否在那样的环境里活下来。
两周后，老狼们前往那个村落，被眼前的一幕惊呆了。
村落中建起了篱笆，五个匪盗和洛茜娜轮班值岗，警惕着野兽来袭。没有袭击的日子，五个人中有的外出打猎，有的收集淡水，居然成为了一个像模像样的团队。
没有人知道洛茜娜是如何让这些彼此觊觎的人听从她的安排的。按她自己的话说，只是“让他们明白了活下去的唯一方法”。
顺带一提，卡特洛也经历过这样的试炼。呃……他用几天时间杀光了附近的野兽，留下了足够的食物，然后在谁也不知道的情况下溜走了，到了结束试炼的日子才回来。
——狼群干部马尔科·狼豪·卢皮诺的访谈记录</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Coming of Age? Within the Pack, everyone's rite of passage is different. For some, it's completing a solo hunt. For others, it's closing a complex business deal.
The Pack doesn't seem worried about these youngsters messing up. They boldly assign critical matters as trials to the young wolves, a practice that would seem utterly insane to anyone outside the Pack.
As for Rossina... Hunts and business deals? She'd already pulled those off at an even younger age. To her, they were just routine.
So the Pack arranged a special trial for her.
They left Rossina in a deserted village, with only five luckless bandits for company. Those outlaws were desperate men, each already eyeing whatever meager means of survival the others had left, just waiting for a chance to stab each other in the back.
The five of them kept each other in check, none daring to make the first move. But ... if that delicate balance was broken...
Rossina's first task was simply to survive the bandits. That wasn't enough on its own. Beast attacks were also frequent there. Sometimes a lone predator, sometimes an entire group.
The Elder Wolves dropped her off and left without a second thought. They seemed unconcerned whether she could survive in such an environment.
When they returned to the village two weeks later, the sight that greeted them left them stunned.
A fence had been erected around the village. The five bandits and Rossina were taking shifts on watch, vigilant against beast attacks. On days without raids, some of the five would go out hunting, others would gather fresh water. They had actually shaped into a proper, functioning team.
Those men once constantly viewed each other with suspicion. No one knows how Rossina got them to follow her lead. In her own words, she just "made them understand the only way to survive."
It's also worth mentioning that Catello went through the same trial. Well... He spent a few days killing all the nearby beasts, left enough food behind, then slipped away without anyone noticing. He only returned at the end of the trial.
— Interview Transcript with Pack associate, Marco Wulfhowl Luppino</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>“狼群派这样乳臭未干的小毛孩来，是罗赞那群老家伙都死光了吗？”
洛茜看了一眼正带着手下捧腹大笑的埃瑞克，她不由得对这位被称作“荒野重炮”的首领失去了兴趣。
这本是洛茜第一次经手氏族的“生意”。一周前，一支商队在前往卢皮诺家的途中被埃瑞克截获。看在狼群的名号上，他们不敢动运送货物的人，但应当归还的货物却少了一大半。卡特洛此刻又不在氏族中，于是洛茜主动请缨，想要在这一笔“生意”上大显身手。
但洛茜此刻有些后悔这个决定，这一趟还不如留在家里狩猎有趣。眼前的“荒野重炮”扭动着肥硕臃肿的身躯，用手拍打着桌子。打从一进门，他就在不断试图激怒洛茜。
强者总是内敛的，不露破绽的。这是洛茜在氏族中学到的心得，不论是罗赞，或是其他老狼，他们没有人会这般粗野地夸耀着暴力。
“罗赞爷爷告诉我这是一笔‘生意’，在我看来，生意总是有赚钱的一方，和亏本的另一方。”
洛茜的目光扫过整个营帐，火药的味道飘到了她的鼻尖，她锁定了对方埋设炸弹的位置。火药的用量很少，看来对方并不是想以杀死自己为目的，活着的狼看起来对他们更加有用。
“狼群不介意在生意中让一些利给朋友，但不巧，我还没通过成人礼，还不能算狼群的一员。我只喜欢赚，不喜欢亏。”
“看来狼群不准备坐下来好好谈谈这个问题了，对吧？”
埃瑞克的目光微动，四周的匪盗神情变得严肃，有的已经把手按在了武器上。
有两个剑手，两个巨斧手，门外应该还埋伏着好几个术师，从营帐内的站位来看，很难在短时间内把他们处理干净。那么——
洛茜结束了观察，她把玩着桌上的餐叉，伺机而动。
“你知道吗？从我到这鬼地方的第一天起，总有人不停给我说这事不能干，那人不能杀，要听狼群的规矩——狼群的规矩。”
埃瑞克的情绪激动起来，他死盯着眼前孤身前来的小女孩。原本这次的准备是针对狼群的罗赞，但没想到来的只是个小孩子……埃瑞克感觉自己受到了羞辱。
“规矩？谁的拳头大，谁就是规矩！”
埃瑞克提起了重炮。狼群重视族人，拿下这个小女孩，可能会更有用。
霎时，一把餐叉飞向了埃瑞克，洛茜从座位上跳起，身影突然消失不见。埃瑞克随手挡开了餐叉，正欲瞄准……
“别乱动。”
一把匕首抵住了他的后颈。
四周的匪盗这才拔出武器，但为时已晚。
“别过来！你们先别过来！”
埃瑞克大叫着，他感受到了后颈传来的一丝丝凉意。
“你是不是在指望门口的术师能帮自己？但是好奇怪啊，怎么这么安静。看来我的族人已经快我一步完成工作了。你刚说什么来着？哦，规矩……”
冰冷的刀尖似乎又近了一寸。
“你现在懂得什么是狼群的规矩了吗？”
洛茜收起匕首，埃瑞克暴怒地转过身。他筹备的这一切，会被这样的小孩捣毁？
“货我都交给碾骨了。如果你们真有胆子，就去从他们手里拿回来啊！等你们被屠戮殆尽，这地方的规矩就由我说了算！”
“你说什么？”
一股从未感受过的杀气从眼前的女孩身上传来。
埃瑞克并不知道在这个女孩面前提起碾骨氏族的下场，但他很快就会知道了。

看着一片狼藉的营帐，洛茜不由叹了口气。
“做生意真是件麻烦的事情。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>"The Pack sent a tiny pup to talk? Did old Rozzan and his crew kick the bucket or something?"
Rossi glanced at Erik, who was roaring with laughter along with his crew, and instantly lost any interest she might have had in the leader famously known as the "Cannon of the Wildlands".
This was Rossi's first time handling the clan's ... "business". A week prior, a merchant convoy bound for the Luppino family had been intercepted by Erik. Out of respect for the Pack's name, they hadn't dared touch the couriers, but a sizable portion of the goods meant for return had gone missing. With Catello absent from the clan at the time, Rossi had volunteered, eager to prove her mettle with this particular "deal".
But at that moment, Rossi was starting to regret her decision. This trip was even less interesting than a hunting trip in home turf. The so-called "Cannon of the Wildlands" was wriggling his bulky, bloated body while slapping the table with his hand. From the moment she'd walked in, he'd done nothing but attempt to provoke her.
True strength is reserved, unyielding, never showing a crack. That was a lesson Rossi had learned within the clan. No one, not even Rozzan or the Elder Wolves, ever boasted so crudely about their violence.
"Nonno Rozzan told me this is 'business.' From where I stand, every deal has one side that profits, and another that takes the loss."
Rossi's eyes swept across the tent. The scent of gunpowder drifted to her nose, and she pinpointed where the other side had planted the explosives. The amount was small. Clearly, killing her wasn't the goal. A live wolf seemed far more useful to them.
"The Pack doesn't mind letting our business friends wet their muzzles a little. Unfortunately, I haven't passed my rite of passage yet, so I'm not a true member of the Pack. And I only want profit. I don't do losses."
"Looks like the Pack isn't planning to sit down and talk this out properly, eh?"
A flicker passed through Erik's eyes. The bandits around them grew serious, some already resting their hands on their weapons.
Two swordsmen, two axemen, and probably several casters lying in wait outside the tent. Judging by their positioning inside, it'd be tough to clear them out quickly. So—
Having assessed the situation, Rossi toyed with a fork on the table, waiting for the right moment.
"Listen. From the very first day I set foot in this blighted place, someone's been blabbering non-stop in my years. I can't do this. I can't kill that. I must follow the rules — the Code of the Pack."
Erik's agitation grew. He stared hard at the girl who'd come alone. All these preparations were meant for Rozzan of the Pack. But the old man sent a bratty girl instead... Erik felt insulted.
"The Code? It's written by those who are bigger and holds more power!"
Erik hefted his cannon. The Pack prized their kin. Taking this girl hostage could prove far more useful.
In a flash, a fork shot toward Erik. Rossi sprang from her seat and suddenly disappeared. Erik swatted the utensil away and raised his weapon to aim.
"Behave and be still."
A dagger pressed against the back of his neck.
The surrounding bandits finally drew their weapons, but it was too late. 
"STOP! DON'T GET ANY CLOSER!" Erik yelled, feeling a chilling prick of cold against the back of his neck.
"Counting on those casters at the door to bail you out? But that's odd ... it's way too quiet. Seems my clan wrapped things up even faster than I did. What were you saying again? Oh, right ... the Code..."
The icy tip of the blade seemed to press an inch closer.
"Do you understand what the Code of the Pack is?" Rossi sheathed her dagger.
Erik whirled around, furious. All his careful planning, ruined by a child like this? "I gave the goods to the Bonekrushers. Try and take them back if you have the guts for it! Once they've wiped you out, then I'll be writing up a new Code for this turf!"
"What did you say?"
A killing intent he had never felt before radiated from the girl standing before him.
Erik didn't know the price of bringing up the Bonekrushers around this girl, but he was about to learn. And soon.

Looking at the wrecked tent, Rossi couldn't help but sigh.
"Business is such a hassle."</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>三次钟声响起，席间的人摘下礼帽，一个个走上前，将手中的鲜花摆在了冰冷的棺木中。
有人在轻声啜泣，有人低下头默不作声。罗赞默默地环视四周，他没有发现那个熟悉的红色的身影。
棺木里，是那次事件中活下来的最后一位老狼，他的余生都在病痛中度过。碾骨的毒烟侵袭了他的内脏，刀刃贯穿了他的四肢，但他依然紧紧地抱住了襁褓中的那个幼小的婴儿……直到把她交给另一个男孩……
“她还是没有来……”
有人向罗赞传达了这一信息，他点了点头，把葬礼交给了另一位老狼。
他知道能在哪里找到女孩，每当她心烦意乱的时候，她都会把自己扔到训练场，一直待到深夜。
罗赞静静地看着那个女孩，女孩也发现了他，但彼此都没有说一句话。女孩用力地把剑刺入训练假人，随后瘫倒在地。没人知道她在这里练了多久。
“他走了。”
罗赞走到躺在泥土上喘气的洛茜身边，淡淡地说道。
“我知道，我知道……”
洛茜用兜帽遮住了自己的眼睛，但声音却止不住地颤抖。自她懂事以来，每周都会去拜访那位老人，让他见证自己健康长大的样子。对于洛茜而言，老人是她与那些灵魂连接的纽带。
“你应该在场的，他会希望你在的。”
“但，都是因为我……是为了我才……”
没等洛茜说完，罗赞将其提了起来，扛在了肩上，朝着葬礼所在的庭院走去。
“我不能去见他……都是我……我不要……”
洛茜在罗赞肩上挣扎着，撕咬着。她的指甲划破了他的皮肤，牙齿扎进了他的手臂。罗赞的表情没有一丝变化，依然走向葬礼的方向。
很快，洛茜用尽了力气。她趴在罗赞身上，垂着手臂。
“我没有成长为一位可靠的狼……”
洛茜喃喃道，不知道是在对着罗赞，还是对着谁。
“没有能够独当一面，没能带领起大家，我什么都没做好……我不值得他们拯救……”
罗赞停下了脚步，庭院内早已空无一人，只剩已经燃成灰烬的遗物，和孤零零的棺木。棺内的老人面容安详，身上摆满了鲜花。
“每当你来照看他后，他总喜欢拉着我聊天，可能是上了年纪吧，他总是记不清上次说过了什么，一个话题颠来倒去地说，说了七八遍都不罢休。”
罗赞放下了洛茜，他的手搭在棺材边，看着熟悉的老朋友。
“他总是说起年轻时候的光辉事迹，说起和我的几次争执。只是细节总是在变，今天是他做错了事，明天是我闯了祸。同样的内容每次都说得不一样。只是有一句话，他从来没有变过说法。”
罗赞摸了摸洛茜的脑袋。
“他每一次都会说，救下你，是他这一生最伟大的成就。”
洛茜低下了头，她摘下胸前的浅色吊坠——老人赠与自己的那串吊坠，将其和鲜花摆在了一起。
棺木阖上。女孩也不再哭泣。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Three tolls of the bell sounded. One by one, the people at the gathering removed their hats and stepped forward to place fresh flowers into the cold coffin.
Some wept quietly, others bowed their heads in silence. Rozzan scanned the surroundings, but he didn't spot that familiar crimson figure anywhere.
The last of the Elder Wolves who survived the incident laid in the casket. He spent the rest of his days in pain. Though the Bonekrusher's haze ravaged his organs and their blades pierced his limbs, the Elder Wolf held on tightly to the swaddled young pup ... until he passed her into the arms of another boy...
"She's still not here..."
The words reached Rozzan. He gave a slow nod, then quietly passed the rest of the service over to another Elder.
He knew where to find her. Whenever she was upset, she'd lose herself in the training grounds and stay there until late into the night.
Rozzan watched the girl in silence. She noticed him too, but neither said a word. With one last fierce thrust, she drove her sword into the training dummy and collapsed to the ground. No one knew how long she had been pushing herself here.
"He's gone."
Rozzan approached Rossi where she lay gasping on the ground, his voice quiet and flat.
"I know... I know..."
Rossi pulled her hood down over her eyes, but her voice shook uncontrollably. Ever since she was old enough to understand, she had visited the wounded Old Wolf every single week so he could see that she was growing up strong and well. To her, he was the last living thread connecting her to those lost souls.
"You should have been there. He would have wanted you there."
"But ... it was because of me... He did it all for..."
Rozzan hoisted her up and slung her over his shoulder before she could finish, carrying her toward the courtyard where the funeral was being held.
"I can't face him ... it was all my fault... I don't want to..."
Rossi thrashed and bit against Rozzan's shoulder. Her nails scraped his skin, her teeth sank into his arm. Rozzan's expression didn't flicker. He just kept walking toward the funeral.
Soon, Rossi's strength gave out. She slumped against Rozzan's back, arms hanging limp.
"I didn't become the wolf the Pack could rely on..."
Rossi murmured, unsure if she was speaking to Rozzan, or to someone no longer there.
"I never learned to stand on my own. I couldn't lead anyone. I haven't done a single thing right... I didn't deserve their sacrifice..."
Rozzan came to a stop. The courtyard was empty now, save for the ashes of burnt offerings and a solitary coffin. Inside, the elder lay peacefully, covered in flowers.
"Every time you came to see him, he'd always pull me aside afterward to talk. Maybe age caught up to the wolf and he never remembered what he told me. Just kept ranting the same stories on and on."
Rozzan set Rossi down. He rested a hand on the edge of the coffin, gazing at his old friend.
"He'd always go on about the glory days, the few times we butted heads. But the details ... those kept changing. One day he was the one who messed up, the next it was me. The same story was told different every time. Only one thing he ever said never changed."
Rozzan reached over and ruffled Rossi's hair.
"Every single time, he'd say that saving you was the greatest thing he ever did."
Rossi lowered her head. She took off the pale pendant from around her neck, the one the elder had given her, and placed it among the flowers.
The coffin sealed. The young wolf never cried again.</>

voiceDesc.cn: 这是在管理员面前表现的机会！
voiceDesc.en: This is my chance to show Endmin what I'm made of!

voiceDesc.cn: 我不会辜负大家的期待的！
voiceDesc.en: I won't let anyone down!

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群的洛茜，管、管理员，有什么任务要交给我？
voiceDesc.en: Rossi from the Pack. E-Endmin... What's our mission?

voiceDesc.cn: 我会努力做到最好的，管理员！
voiceDesc.en: I'll do my absolute best, Endmin!

voiceDesc.cn: 好帅气的武器！我在氏族里都没有见过这样的！
voiceDesc.en: Ah! This weapon is so cool! I've never seen anything like this back in the clan!

voiceDesc.cn: 穿上这身有点不太好移动……嗯？是管理员给我挑选的吗？那，就要它吧！肯定有什么深意……
voiceDesc.en: It's a bit hard to move in... Oh? You picked it out for me, Endmin? I'll take it then! Hmm... There must be some deeper meaning behind this...

voiceDesc.cn: 我是群狼的后裔！
voiceDesc.en: I am a descendant of the Pack!

voiceDesc.cn: 成熟的战士是这样战斗的吗……嗯……这样……这样……然后再那样……好，我学会了！
voiceDesc.en: So that's how seasoned warriors fight... Hmm ... like this ... and then like that... Okay, I think I've got it now!

voiceDesc.cn: 晋……升？啊，我懂了，氏族里也有类似的仪式！不过我一次都没有体验过，感觉……还不赖？
voiceDesc.en: Pro ... motion? Ah, I get it! We have similar ceremonies back in the clan, though I've never actually experienced one myself. You know what? This isn't ... half bad.

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿嘿，我做得还不错吧？不这样可承担不了氏族的重任，我可是还要带领狼群名扬塔卫二呢。
voiceDesc.en: Hehe, I'm doing pretty well, right? Gotta be this good to shoulder the clan's responsibilities. After all, I'm gonna make the Pack famous across Talos-II!

voiceDesc.cn: 哼哼，对于我来说，晋升简直再简单不过了！下次晋升是什么时候？我已经做好准备了！要等待机会？那好吧……
voiceDesc.en: Promotions are a piece of cake for someone like me! When's the next one? I'm totally ready! Gotta wait for the right opportunity? Well ... alright then.

voiceDesc.cn: 这就证明我是最出色的干员了吧？不知道卡特洛有没有这么顺利。下次再见到那家伙，我可要好好炫耀一下！
voiceDesc.en: Doesn't this prove I'm the top operator now? Wonder if Catello had it this easy. Next time I see him, I'm totally rubbing it in his face!

voiceDesc.cn: 我是洛茜娜，授名是狼珀，寓意是狼群的瑰宝！可要乖乖记好了哦！啊……管理员用自己喜欢的方式称呼我就好……
voiceDesc.en: I'm Rossina, granted name Wulfperl, meaning the Pack's treasure! You'd better remember that! Ah ... Endmin, you can call me whatever you prefer...

voiceDesc.cn: 嗜血的时刻已至！我是说……用餐时间到了！
voiceDesc.en: The hour of bloodshed is upon us. It's time to hunt. I mean ... it's time to eat.

voiceDesc.cn: 我是狼群的爪牙！……好像不太对？反正……啊呜！
voiceDesc.en: Prey, beware! I am the paws of the Pack! ...Wait, that doesn't sound right? Anyway... Awoo!

voiceDesc.cn: 对于精锐来说小菜一碟！
voiceDesc.en: Piece of cake for an elite like me!

voiceDesc.cn: 管、管理员！今天有什么任务要交给我吗？
voiceDesc.en: E-Endmin! Do you have any missions for me today?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，可以传授我一些作为领导者的经验吗？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, could you share some leadership experience with me?

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地是怎么管理这么多干员的？什么……系统……什么……中控来着？搞不懂……不过很值得学习。
voiceDesc.en: How does Endfield manage so many operators? Something about ... systems? And some kind of ... central control? I can't figure it out ... but it's definitely worth learning.

voiceDesc.cn: 氏族的老狼让我多来帝江号上看看，他们说在这里能学习到作为领导者的知识和经验，尤其是在管理员身边。可是能抓到管理员的机会太少了！
voiceDesc.en: The elder wolves from the clan told me to visit Dijiang more often. They said I could learn about leadership here, especially by your side. But getting a chance to catch you is just so hard!

voiceDesc.cn: 帝江号上的哥哥姐姐们总把我当小孩子看待！可我已经是狼群的精锐了，下次要和他们说清楚才行，不能再这样了！！不过他们给的小点心都很好吃……
voiceDesc.en: The big brothers and sisters on Dijiang always treat me like a kid! But I'm already an elite of the Pack. Next time I'll make it clear to them, this has to stop! ...Though the snacks they give me are really good ...

voiceDesc.cn: 氏族事务优先！不过，如果终末地有什么突发情况，我肯定会第一时间赶到的。只是不知道管理员需不需要我的帮助……管理员那么优秀，哪怕没有我也能轻松解决危机的吧，但我还是想帮到管理员……怎么办呢……
voiceDesc.en: Clan affairs come first! But if anything urgent happens to Endfield, I'll definitely rush over right away. It's just ... I'm not sure if you really need my help... You're so capable, you could probably handle crises easily, even without me. But I still want to be helpful... What should I do...

voiceDesc.cn: 我听说在帝江号上能找到卡特洛，可他在这儿怎么也是神出鬼没？嗯……该说是本性难移吗？再找不到他，罗赞爷爷可就要生气了！我可不想见到他发火的样子……管理员，您知道在哪里能找到卡特洛吗？
voiceDesc.en: I heard Catello could be found on Dijiang, but why's he so elusive here too? Hmm ... guess old habits die hard? If I can't find him soon, Nonno Rozzan's gonna be furious. I really don't wanna see him angry... Endmin, do you know where I might find Catello?

voiceDesc.cn: 帝江号上为什么也查询不到管理员的相关记录呢？我好不容易才学会使用这个什么情报档案库……查到的净是些没用的信息，或者就是说我权限不够……呜……管理员，您有时间亲自跟我说说您的那些英勇事迹吗？
voiceDesc.en: Why can't I find any records about you on Dijiang, either? I finally learned how to use this so-called Intel Archive, but all I get are useless results or "No Authority" messages... Ugh... Endmin, do you have time to tell me about your heroic deeds yourself?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，这是我得到的战利品！全都送给您！别担心，我还会弄到更多的！
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, these are the spoils I've collected! They're all for you! Don't worry, I'll get even more!

voiceDesc.cn: 这是……给我的？我真的可以收下吗？谢谢您，我会好好领会管理员的用意的！
voiceDesc.en: This is ... for me? Can I really have it? Thank you! I'll make sure to understand the meaning behind your gift!

voiceDesc.cn: 这个？这个……我只是在记录管理员您的言行，我觉得这些细节也有值得我学习的地方。啊……不能给您看，这是私人物品！
voiceDesc.en: This? Well ... I'm just taking notes on your words and actions, Endmin. I think even the details are worth learning from. Ah ... please don't look! These are personal notes!

voiceDesc.cn: 我我我、我听过好多好多管理员的传说。一直在想您会是个怎么样的人！直到真正见到您，才觉得您比传说中更令人钦佩。具体哪一点？嗯……行事方式、领导力，我、我也不知道该怎么形容……
voiceDesc.en: I-I've heard so many legends about you. I've always wondered what kind of person you'd be! But now that I've actually met you, I feel like you're even more admirable than the stories say. What exactly? Well ... your methods, your leadership... I-I don't even know how to put it into words...

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群的孩子会在十三岁时参加成人礼。族人们会聚在一起，为新的“狼”选出授名。卡特洛的授名是“狼卫”，而我则是“狼珀”。我喜欢氏族赋予我的名字，每当念出它时，我就能感受到狼群的血在我的身体里流淌……管理员觉得这个名字怎么样？
voiceDesc.en: Children of the Pack participate in the coming-of-age ceremony at thirteen. The clan gathers to choose a granted name for the new "wolf". Catello's name is "Wulfgard", and mine is "Wulfperl". I love the name the clan gave me. Every time I say it, I can feel the blood of the Pack flowing through me... What do you think of it, Endmin?

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，我最近的任务表现还算不错吧？那个……可以找您要一些奖励吗？啊……不用太费心，多和我聊聊天就可以了！……可以吗？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, I've been doing pretty well on missions lately, right? So ... could I maybe ask for a little reward? Ah ... nothing too fancy, just chatting with me more would be enough! ...Is that okay?

voiceDesc.cn: 我知道自己的能力还不足以胜任狼群的领袖，但元老们坚持让我代理氏族事务……所以、所以我想在管理员身边学到更多，学习怎么成为一个值得信赖的人。还有佩丽卡姐姐、M3姐姐……我会让大家刮目相看的！
voiceDesc.en: I know I'm not skilled enough yet to lead the Pack, but the elders insist I handle the clan's affairs... So I want to learn more by your side, Endmin. I want to learn how to become someone trustworthy like you, and Perlica, and M3... I'll make everyone see me in a new light!

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地的哥哥姐姐们教了我好多东西，佩丽卡姐姐给我讲了协议同步器的用法，艾维文娜姐姐带我去逛了商会的服装店和首饰店，还有、还有……赛希姐姐说要与我探讨平方时间复杂度……那是什么？
voiceDesc.en: The big brothers and sisters at Endfield have taught me a lot! Perlica explained how Protosyncs work, Avywenna took me to TGCC's clothing and jewelry stores, and ... and Xaihi said she wants to discuss quadratic time complexity with me... I don't even know what that means.

voiceDesc.cn: 这里的哥哥姐姐们都很照顾我，还会给我小礼物。但，我也是通过了狼群试炼的，名副其实的狼！成熟的狼不能喜欢孩子气的东西，应该喜欢匕首和钱币！所以我收集了很多。等我再长高一些，大家就可以放心把那些最危险的任务交给我来处理了！
voiceDesc.en: The big brothers and sisters here all take good care of me. They even give me gifts. But I've passed the Pack's trials! I'm a real wolf! A mature wolf shouldn't like childish things. They should prefer daggers and coins! So I've collected plenty of those. Once I grow a bit taller, everyone can finally trust me with the most dangerous missions!

voiceDesc.cn: 我一直以为罗赞爷爷就是世界上最强大的人，但他却总告诉我天外有天，还总是提到管理员。后来我还在别处听说了许多您的传奇事迹，哇，世界上居然还有这样的人！我一直想来看看您真实的样子，自从听说您苏醒了，我就在计划什么时候来个突然袭击了……嘿嘿。
voiceDesc.en: I always thought Nonno Rozzan was the strongest person in the world, but he kept saying "there's always someone greater" and mentioned you all the time, Endmin. Later, I heard tons of legendary stories about you elsewhere. And I was like, "Wow, we actually got someone like you out there?!" I've always wanted to see what you're really like. Ever since I heard you woke up, I've been planning to surprise you one day ... hehe.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的第一把匕首是一次紧急狩猎后的奖励！装着它的盒子金光灿灿的，我现在还保管得好好的呢。这也是我最喜欢的一把，总是带在身边，不过它不够锋利，只能用来切一切水果。如果管理员也喜欢的话，嗯……等我带上盒子一起送给您！
voiceDesc.en: My first dagger was a reward after an emergency hunt! The box it came in was all shiny and golden, I've kept it safe ever since. This one's my favorite too. I always carry it with me, though it's not very sharp, good mostly for cutting fruit. If you'd like it, Endmin ... well ... I'll give it to you once I bring the box along too!

voiceDesc.cn: 小时候的事吗……狼群总是处于和碾骨氏族的斗争中，是哥哥带着我四处求医问诊，也是族人们帮忙……啊……不应该在管理员面前说这些的！到此为止、到此为止，管理员，我们还是说一说关于您的事吧，我听说……
voiceDesc.en: About my childhood... The Pack was always caught in conflicts with the Bonekrushers. It was my brother who took me around seeking medical help, and the clan members also... Oh! Ah ... I shouldn't be talking about this in front of you! Forget it, Endmin. Let's talk about you instead! I've heard that...

voiceDesc.cn: “源石会开辟道路。”啊……我、我只是试着说一下，完了完了……不会被管理员讨厌吧？我知道学习管理员不是一味地模仿这么简单，我只是觉得……这样确实很帅气……
voiceDesc.en: "Originium will carve a path for us." Ah... I-I was just practicing... Oh, no, no... Will you hate me for this? I know learning from you isn't just about copying... I just thought ... it sounded really cool...

voiceDesc.cn: 我也可以像哥哥一样使用狼群的授名作为代号，但……我还没怎么被氏族以外的人那么叫过，有点不好意思。直接用“洛茜娜”的话又会显得太小孩子气，我可不要！所以，我就用了“洛茜”作为自己的代号，那代表着我斗篷的颜色。
voiceDesc.en: As a Pack member, I could use my granted name as a codename like my brother does, but ... I haven't really been called that by anyone outside the clan yet, so it might feel a bit embarrassing. And "Rossina" just sounds too childish ... no way I'm using that! I ended up going with "Rossi" as my codename, after the color of my cloak.

voiceDesc.cn: 我不会放过哪怕一个碾骨氏族的暴虐之徒！这是狼群和碾骨之间的世仇。为了救下我，有太多狼……太多家人死在了碾骨手下。这是狼群的仇恨，也是我的仇恨。狼群是这个世界上最记仇的氏族，终有一天，我们会算清这笔账！
voiceDesc.en: I won't let a single one of those Bonekrusher brutes get away! This is a blood feud between the Pack and the Bonekrushers. Too many wolves, too many family members, died at their hands just to save me. This is the Pack's vengeance, and mine too. We're the clan that holds grudges longest in this world, and one day, we will settle this score!

voiceDesc.cn: 那上面沾染着族人的鲜血……但对我来说，每当触碰到它时，我就会感到无比的安心，仿佛那些族人们不曾离我远去。这件斗篷刺痛着我，提醒我决不忘记仇恨，但它也给予了我勇气，还有家人的温暖……嗯，他们一直陪伴着我。
voiceDesc.en: It's stained with the blood of my kindred ... but to me, every time I touch it, I feel an incredible sense of peace, as if they never really left. This cloak burns, reminding me never to forget the vendetta, but it also gives me courage, and the warmth of family... Yes, they're always with me.

voiceDesc.cn: 我之前把收集来的匕首跟钱币都放进了一个特制的宝箱里，结果由于搬家弄丢了……里面还有些不能见人的东西……是小时候做的手工。我费了好大劲才把宝箱找回来。现在我可以把东西都存放在帝江号上啦！也可以拿存东西当理由来找哥哥姐姐们玩。啊，不对……是来学习！
voiceDesc.en: I used to keep all the daggers and coins I collected in a special treasure box, but I lost it during the move… What's worse is it had some really embarrassing stuff inside — crafts I made as a kid. It took me forever to find the box again. Now I can store everything safely on Dijiang! Better yet, I can use storing things as an excuse to hang out with the big brothers and sisters here. No … I mean, to study here!

voiceDesc.cn: 荒野上的人所做的一切都是为了活下去，有时还能看到和我一样大的孩子在做坏事……哪怕是那些裂地者，有时铤而走险也只是为了生存。我觉得任何人都应该按自己的想法活着，但是……管理员，终末地是不是能改变这一切，让那些孩子也能和我一样去做自己想做的事呢？
voiceDesc.en: Everything people do in the wilderness is just to survive. Sometimes I saw kids my age doing terrible things just to get by... Sometimes even Landbreakers took desperate risks simply to stay alive. I think everyone should be able to live by their own choices. Endmin, can Endfield change all this, so those kids can pursue their dreams like I do?

voiceDesc.cn: 相信我，那边肯定有好东西！
voiceDesc.en: Trust me, something good is over there!

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群不会遗漏任何荒野中的资源，留意那边！
voiceDesc.en: The Pack never overlooks any resources in the wild. Keep an eye on that area!

voiceDesc.cn: 那边有奇怪的气味，去看看吧！
voiceDesc.en: There's a strange smell over there. Let's go check it out!

voiceDesc.cn: 有危险的味道，要上吗？
voiceDesc.en: Smells like danger. Should we engage?

voiceDesc.cn: 能分给我几块这样的石头吗？我想把它们镶嵌在匕首上。
voiceDesc.en: Can you spare a few of those stones for me? I want to inlay them into my dagger.

voiceDesc.cn: 大家一起来，工作很快就结束了！
voiceDesc.en: Let's do this together. We'll finish this work in no time!

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……我本想着如果打不开的话，可以试试咬一口。
voiceDesc.en: Hmm ... I was thinking if it won't open, maybe I could try biting it.

voiceDesc.cn: 为什么有的醚质总会飞来飞去，有的却静止不动呢？真神奇。
voiceDesc.en: Why do some Aurylene float around while others just stay still? It's marvelous.

voiceDesc.cn: 搞定啦！再也没有这些恼人的侵蚀啦！
voiceDesc.en: All done! No more of that annoying Blight!

voiceDesc.cn: 好好吃饭，好好睡觉，好好休整。这是群狼的智慧！
voiceDesc.en: Eat well, sleep well, rest well. That's the wisdom of the Pack!

voiceDesc.cn: 快，用这些来恢复！
voiceDesc.en: Quick, use these to recover!

voiceDesc.cn: 真有效，我好多了！
voiceDesc.en: I feel much better now!

voiceDesc.cn: 小心！有些不对劲！
voiceDesc.en: Careful! Something's coming!

voiceDesc.cn: 不行……没时间舔伤口了……
voiceDesc.en: No time ... to lick my wounds now...

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群……不会就此作罢的……
voiceDesc.en: The Pack ... won't let this slide...

voiceDesc.cn: 漂亮的一击！
voiceDesc.en: Nice hit!

voiceDesc.cn: 哇啊！完美的配合！
voiceDesc.en: Whoa! Perfect teamwork!

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿嘿嘿，还有更厉害的呢！
voiceDesc.en: Hehehe, I've got better tricks up my sleeve!

voiceDesc.cn: 这就是我们要的成果！
voiceDesc.en: This is the fight we want!

voiceDesc.cn: 群狼的血液在沸腾！
voiceDesc.en: The blood of the Pack is boiling!

voiceDesc.cn: 我可不想错过这次狩猎！
voiceDesc.en: Wouldn't wanna miss out on this hunt!

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群之名终将响彻大地！
voiceDesc.en: The name of the Pack will echo across the land!

voiceDesc.cn: 给我记好了，这就是招惹狼群的下场！
voiceDesc.en: Learned your lesson? This is what happens when you mess with the Pack!

voiceDesc.cn: 哼哼哼，因为我也在嘛！
voiceDesc.en: Heh-heh-heh. With me around, victory is a sure thing!

voiceDesc.cn: 狼群从不畏惧留下伤痕！
voiceDesc.en: They bit deep, but the Pack isn't afraid of more scars!

voiceDesc.cn: 这点失败不算什么，洛茜娜……我是不会放弃的！
voiceDesc.en: This little setback means nothing... I, Rossina won't give up!

voiceDesc.cn: 扯碎你！
voiceDesc.en: Get ripped!

voiceDesc.cn: 颤抖吧！
voiceDesc.en: Tremble!

voiceDesc.cn: 撕咬吧，狼魂！
voiceDesc.en: Tear them apart!

voiceDesc.cn: 猎杀时刻！
voiceDesc.en: Hunting time!

voiceDesc.cn: 灼热的爪痕！
voiceDesc.en: Scorching claws!

voiceDesc.cn: 你逃不出狼的追杀！
voiceDesc.en: We'll hunt them down!

voiceDesc.cn: 让我看见你的恐惧！
voiceDesc.en: I'll make them fear!

voiceDesc.cn: 想往哪儿跑？
voiceDesc.en: No escape!

voiceDesc.cn: 逮到你了！
voiceDesc.en: I got you!

voiceDesc.cn: 倒下吧！
voiceDesc.en: Down you go!

voiceDesc.cn: 嗷呜！
voiceDesc.en: Awoo!

voiceDesc.cn: 蒸腾吧，群狼之血！
voiceDesc.en: Seethe, blood of the Pack!

voiceDesc.cn: 我是利刃的化身！
voiceDesc.en: The blade is me!

voiceDesc.cn: 群狼之魂，与我同在。
voiceDesc.en: Wolf spirits, stand with me.

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>骏卫，本名赫尔森，罗德岛驻外干员，铁誓军盾卫旗队指挥官，常年驻扎在塔卫二北方的环北极圈前线。因局势需要，现加入终末地工业，协助执行相关作战任务。

第一次见到骏卫，他不折不扣的军人身姿就给我留下了深刻的印象。骏卫行事果断且迅速，绝不拖泥带水。并且无论事情大小，只要他给予了承诺，就一定会尽全力做到。
虽然骏卫没有对《环带公约》的三巨头表现出明显的偏好，但很显然，他对联盟工团的“城市母亲”情有独钟。他并不介意漫步在移动地块生产坞的阴影下，和工人们聊聊天。有时候，他也会遇到几个对理想和生活感到迷茫的工团成员。他很擅长激励士气，即使对方是远离战场的普通人，他也有办法令人对未来重拾信心。在骏卫留给铁誓军战士和工团成员的印象中，锋利但从不伤人的冷幽默也是其中之一。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Pogranichnik (ID name: Khorsyn) is a Rhodes Island liaison and a Banner Commander for the Order of Steel Oath. He spent years at the Polar Circle front in the north of Talos-II. Given the needs of the current situation, Pogranichnik joined Endfield Industries to provide relevant combat support. 

Pogranichnik uncompromising looks of a professional soldier left me quite an impression when I first met him. He acts with great decisiveness and alacrity, and never with doubt nor hesitation. Once he promises to take upon a task, no matter how small or severe, he would see it through to the best of his abilities. 
Although Pogranichnik displayed no obvious preferences for the Big Three of the Band Accord, he exhibited a special emotional connection to the Mat' Gorodov of the UWST. He would not mind talking to crew mates seeking shade in the city plate construction yards. There were even occasions when he met UWST crew mates confused about life or suffering through the pain of shattered dreams. Pogranichnik is exceptional at boosting morale, even for commoners faraway from the battlefield. He always found a way to instill confidence back into people's hearts. Oathkeepers and UWST crew mates who knew Pogranichnik often highlight his cold, sharp, yet endearing sense of humor. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【两张照片】
一张边角泛黄的照片。骏卫和熔炉要塞兵工厂的几位工匠并肩而立，其中有男有女，种族各异。在所有人的背后，是一道覆盖着冰雪的钢制要塞强化工事，两名铁誓军哨兵在工事顶端举起望远镜凝视远方。更远处，稍显模糊的地平线上，要塞的轮廓若隐若现，大口径火炮直指天际。而在骏卫的身边，一位工匠带着不同于众人的骄傲神情，手指向天空，那里悬浮着一艘庞大的飞行器，通过照片无法看清它完整的姿态。

一张俯瞰要塞大厅的照片。大厅正中的铁誓军战士们抬起手来，对讲台上的骏卫举杯。照片的左上角，骏卫将一只拳头放在身后的巨幅地图上；照片右上角，是一张很长的餐桌，除了一位脸庞棱角分明的银发老者——因望向另一边而面貌不清，每一个人都佩戴着旗队指挥官的徽记和绶带，他们同样举起了手中的杯子。而在照片的左下角，年轻的新兵们勾肩搭背，其中一位不知从哪里拿出了手风琴，周围的战士们大张着嘴，似乎在齐声欢呼。大厅中有许多笑容，但骏卫从未向任何人主动展示过这张照片，也未曾将它装进哪一个相框。

【三份食谱】
正餐食谱C5：“原切驮兽肉排套餐”，由联盟工团提供。厚切整块驮兽腿肉，添加营养剂，烟熏风味。工人卫队军标食谱，连续二十年荣获全联盟工团中央生产计划委员会嘉奖。
“盾卫们还在适应营养添加剂的异味。除此之外，这是一份无可挑剔的作战口粮，能量充足，营养充分，肉排口感良好——我在记忆中品尝过相似的味道，它来自乌萨斯。”

正餐食谱C8：“磐蟹奶酪盖饭定食”，由环塔商会提供。菈梵朵玛特供磐蟹，新都筑烹饪大师亲自操刀，以耶尔什的奶酪烹饪激发极致鲜味，为铁誓军的无畏战士们带来山海一体的味觉享受。
“自热口粮中难得一见的精致食谱，在维持旗队士气的方面效果显著，但对盾卫们来说，目前的分量并不足以补充他们消耗的体能，请改进。”

正餐食谱C12：“尚蜀风味即热锅”，由宏山科学院提供。在装口粮包的箱子背面，有人用潦草的笔迹写着：赫尔森，你的兵也算是能征善战，可饮食的口味怎么能这么清淡！光看着嘴里都淡出羽兽来！看在你对我一口一个“天师”的份上，这种口味的吃食我白送给你们了，驱寒提神暖肠胃，别忘了熬一下驮兽油，打个油碟。
“这道主菜击败了我的战士们，半个旗队的盾卫喊着要止痛剂，还有人从地上抓起雪往嘴里塞。不过，旗队在接下来三十公里的徒步行进中都没有再感到寒冷。”

【一张地图】
一张绘制在鞣制瘤兽皮上的巨幅地图，为了应对现有源石技术装备全部失效的情况而绘制。
地图上密密麻麻地标注着铁誓军的防区和补给线，以及重要防御工事的所在位置。熔炉要塞兵工厂的所在之处同样被囊括其中。
在地图所示的南部，数十道弯弯扭扭的路线沿着等高线延伸至各个要塞，其中有些穿过了黑森林——这些路线是铁誓军与文明环带间的生命线，北方走廊的末梢。而在北部，还有一道极为显眼的锯齿状战线。这条战线像一道伤痕，从铁誓军的主要防区一路向北延伸，直到极光壁的边界为止。
在地图陈列架旁的标签上，绘制这张地图的骏卫留下了笔迹：
一千两百三十七个名字，这就是它的价值。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Two Photographs
An old photograph with yellowing edges, featuring Pogranichnik standing amongst a diverse crew of various races. The group stood before a fortified defense works forged of steel and covered by snow. Two Oathkeeper scouts stood atop the defenses, gazing into the far distance with binoculars. BACKGROUND: Contours of a fort could be seen in the slightly blurred horizon, along with large caliber cannons pointing at the skies. CHARACTERS OF NOTE: A particular crew mate standing next to Pogranichnik wore an expression of pride that stood out from the others. The man pointed at the skies where a giant vessel floated above everything. This photograph does not show the entirety of the said vessel. 

A photograph of a great hall within a fort, taken from above. Soldiers of the Order of Steel Oath who stood in the middle of the hall raised their cups into the air at Pogranichnik who stood on the stage. UPPER LEFT: Progranichnik placing a fist on the massive map behind him. UPPER RIGHT: A long dining table. A silvery haired old man with a chiseled face, though the features were obscured as he faced the other way. All those seated at the table wore badges and sashes of banner commanders, and like the soldiers, they also raised their glasses. LOWER LEFT: Young recruits rubbing shoulders with each other. One of them played an accordion and those nearby seemed to be singing and cheering loudly with their mouths open. NOTE: The hall is filled with plenty of individuals in festive spirits, but Pogranichnik never showed the picture to anyone, and neither did he frame it. 

DOCUMENT: Three Recipes
Entrée Recipe C5: Primal Cut Burdenbeast Steak Set. Courtesy of UWST. A primal cut of burdenbeast shank, nutrient-fortified, smoked. Standard UWST Guards military fare. Winner of the United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II Central Production Planning Committee Awards for 20 consecutive years. 
"The Shieldguards are still getting used to the unique taste of the fortifying agents. Besides that, this is most impeccable as field rations. It offers sufficient calories, nutrition, and the fillet has been prepared to provide an excellent texture — I remember tasting something similar before, something from Ursus." 

Entrée Recipe C8: Metal Crab Doria Set. Courtesy of TGCC. La Fantoma metal crabs and Kjersch cheese come together in this preparation by master chefs of Neo Tsukushi. This is designed to create explosions of freshness that blend the Talosian hills and oceans. A gastronomic experience fitting for the indomitable Oathkeepers. 
"A culinary wonder rarely seen in self-cooking rations. They are quite effective in maintaining the morale of the fighting banners. However, caloric content of this particular item is currently incapable of meeting the Shieldguards' requirements. Please improve upon it." 

Entrée Recipe C12: Instant Shangshu Hot Pot. Courtesy of HAS. These words were messily scribbled on the back of the rations crate: "Khorsyn, your soldiers are battle-hardened veterans. And what do you feed them with? Trough slop so stale that they're crying FOWL! Since you've been most respectful to this tianshi, this entire crate is on me. Guranteed to dispel the cold and put heat in your guts. Don't forget to warm the burdo-tallow for the grease dip." 
"This entrée has utterly decimated my warriors. Half of the Shieldguards in the entire banner cried out for painkillers. A number of them managed to find strength to crawl on the ground and stuff handfuls of snow in their mouths. However, no one in the banner complained about the cold in the 30-klick foot march." 

DOCUMENT: A Map 
A massive map illustrated on massive piece of tanned cystybeast hide. It was made just in case all instruments and machinery running on Originium technology fail. 
The map is densely marked with Order of Steel Oath defense zones, supply routes, and key strong points. Arsenals of Fort Forgefane have been included as well. 
The southern area of the map shows dozens of roads meandering along the contours that connect the various Order forts. A few of these routes pass through Myrkwood — lifelines that connect the Civilization Band to the Order of Steel Oath and the very edge of the Northern Corridor. The northern area of the map shows a jagged battle line that stretches across the land like a scar. It stretches from the main defense zones of the Order and ends only at the fringe of the Aurora. 
In the memo section furnished next to the map display rack, Pogranichnik, the author of this map, left this handwritten message: 
1,237 names. That's the worth of this. </>

<@profile.key>【记录在█████要塞的对话片段】
“请等一下，教官，请等一下。刚才的授课非常精彩，您一定是对抗天使的专家。我们刚才听那些战士喊您——赫尔森？”
“能帮助你们掌握在交战中活下去的方法就够了。你们找我有什么事？”
“太好了，我叫瓦季姆，瓦季姆·伊格纳季耶维奇·斯米尔诺夫，这是穆拉维约夫，我们两个来自联盟工团。”
“伊格纳季？我记得这个名字。新兵，你是因为你的父亲离开的故土？你的父亲常给我们看你的照片。”
“家父尚在时，常常在书信里写下您的事迹。能和您一同挡住冲击战线的天使，是他的荣幸——他一直在信里这么写。”
“没错！我和瓦沙小时候，经常像信……信里的一样！玩模仿铁誓军盾卫的游戏。我们希望能像信里的您那样英勇。”
“我们……我和穆拉维约夫通过了要塞的选拔，希望继承父亲的勇气，哪怕献出生命！”
“令人钦佩的志向。但我希望你们能明白，牺牲不是目的，铁誓军的战斗是为了阻止更多的牺牲。”
“赫尔森教官，从还在学校念书起，我就在想象，当北地的天使冲击着防线，其他旗队的战士们都在苦苦支撑，眼看就要挡不住了，终于，身后传来铁盾砸地的巨响——是英雄赫尔森带着盾卫冲了上来！这声巨响让每个人知道，你们矗立的地方，就是敌人无法逾越的边界。”
“瓦沙说得对，教官，我们不怕牺牲！”
“不。我见过太多想要成为英雄的人倒在这里。如果你们真的想要成为一名盾卫，需要的就不是对‘英雄’或者‘牺牲’的崇拜。”
“可您……”
“你们需要活下去，出现在其他人需要你们的地方，需要将盾立在你们的面前。然后——”
“帮助……其他人活下去？”
“不错，你们确实听得很认真。这是盾卫在列阵作战时最基本的战术，我们并肩而立，为了让更多人活下去——无论是苟且偷生，传承意志，还是为了执行下一次的有效战术反击。”
“您的教导让我充满了力量，赫尔森教官！我……我们！咳，瓦沙，你倒是说句话呀！”
“我，还有穆拉维约夫！我们一定会成为盾卫，去您的旗队服役！”
“那么，我期待与你们并肩而立的那一天。”</>

<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Excerpt of a Conversation Recorded at Fort ████
"Sir Instructor, please wait! That lesson was most engaging. You must be a true expert in fighting the Aggeloi. We just heard those warriors calling you — Khorsyn?" 
"The lesson will serve its purpose if it helps you survive an actual engagement. Is there anything else I can assist you with?" 
"Oh, this is great! I'm Vadim. Vadim Ignatyevich Smirnov. This one here is Muravyov. We're both from the UW." 
"Ignaty? I know this name. Did you leave your home because of your father, recruit? He often showed me pictures of you." 
"Yes. When he was around, he often mentioned your heroic deeds in his letters. He was proud to fight along your side against the Aggeloi that tried to breach our defenses — Always. In every letter." 
"Yeah! When Vasha and I were kids, we were ... trying to be the heroes described in the letters! We played games pretending to be the fighting Shieldguards. Everyone wants to be as brave as you!" 
"We... Well, Muravyov and I passed the selection trials of the Fort. We want to inherit our father's courage, even at the cost of our lives." 
"A most respectable goal. But I want you to understand that sacrifice is never the objective. On the contrary, the Order fights to avoid that altogether." 
"Instructor Khorsyn, back when I was still at school, I've always been picturing this in my mind! The Aggeloi of the north smashing themselves into the frontlines and the banners buckling under their weight. Just when the buggers were about to breach, the Oathkeepers heard the mighty thud of iron shields slammed into the earth — Khorsyn and his Shieldguards had arrived and they charged forth! That mighty thud told everyone that you were the unbreakable front! The grounds where you stand would never be taken!" 
"Vasha is right, instructor. We're not afraid of sacrifice!" 
"No. I've seen too many aspirants falling at this place. If you really want to be a true Shieldguard, being a hero or sacrificing your lives are not the qualities you need." 
"But you..." 
"Son, you must learn to survive. Only then could you appear at places that need you most. Then you must place the shield before you, and —" 
"Help the others ... survive?" 
"Exactly. You actually listened during class. This is the most basic tactic of the Shieldguard wall. We stand side by side to shelter the others and help them live — We do not care if they're trying to save their skins, inheriting a legacy, or getting ready for an effective tactical counterstrike." 
"Your lessons is truly empowering, Instructor Khorsyn! I ... we ... AHEM! Vasha, say something!" 
"Yeah! I ... I mean, Muravyov and I will both become Shieldguards! We shall serve in your banner!" 
"Then I shall look forward to the day when I fight along your sides." </>

<@profile.key>环塔联合服务研究所关于█████战役的汇报：
尊敬的环塔企业联席会议的各位代表，本人——特派观察员兼战争资产保险业务代表坦纳·奥瑞根，在此对本人随铁誓军参与的█████战役做出报告。
在此次铁誓军与北方天使集群的高强度冲突中，由《环带公约》缔约各方提供的战争资产遭到了严重的损耗。铁誓军方面的主要资产损失主要包括三十一部步行火炮平台以及其他用于加固防区的重型无人装备，更多损失细节请查阅各位代表手边的纸质附录a3。
…………
诚然，由于突然出现的未知个体，铁誓军逼近极光壁的攻势被迫中止。但请各位代表注意，在进攻行动中造成的所有损失，恰恰证明了我方与铁誓军进一步展开合作，提供无偿援助的前景。在协助完善铁誓军的工业生产设施建设后，北方对各企业的产品需求将不减反增，还将从大宗装备购置领域合作转入更加深层、对我方更加有利的技术产权合作。
…………
此次战役中，本人随负责主要进攻方向的旗队到达一处山脊前方，逼近前进要塞。仅凭肉眼观测，完全无法从毫无空隙的天使集群中找到要塞的位置——直到那位在消耗战争资产时毫不吝啬的旗队指挥官赫尔森，在天使集群的另一侧杀出，盾卫随之列阵上前，将战线推过山脊，把要塞火炮的导引信标部署在高处。
与此同时，先前导致其他方向的旗队受挫的未知个体再次在极光下方出现。各位代表，在此我想声明一项本人与铁誓军方面达成的共识：在任何情况下，我们绝不能放任此类个体进入人口密集区域。彼时，我尚处在相对安全的前线指挥中心，但该个体引发的超域活动已让我携带的记录设备陷入失灵状态。在这一危急时刻，盾卫旗队的领袖赫尔森在战线的最前方率领进攻，在他的身后，盾卫们举起铁壁，英勇又坚定地向前推进。接下来的景象无法用客观的语言描述，我看到红色的光切开最坚固的天使，让它们化作沉默的墓碑；盾墙每分每秒都在出现空缺，但任何一处空隙都会立刻由另一名盾卫补上。在进行了四十七分钟的激烈交战后，赫尔森和他的盾卫在天使集群的中央踏出一条道路，围困了那个需要对数百名最优秀的铁誓军战士阵亡负责的未知个体，在一次交锋中将它雕塑般的表面沿中轴线切开。未知个体将其内侧构成物喷向空中试图突围，但自空中降下的火焰以及铁甲间喷涌出的蒸汽最终扑灭了它的反抗。
…………
各位代表，本次作战印证了铁誓军不可取代的地位。我方的支援行动不仅是对《环带公约》利他精神的阐释，更是对北方前线“关键韧性战略”的投资。本次报告的另一项主旨在于澄清，铁誓军真正的遗产不在要塞深处的遗产库内，而是被寄托在赫尔森这样的关键人物身上。在可预见的未来，他们无法被估价，也不能被交易，但毫无疑问——“文明环带的英雄”将是环塔商会最有价值的投资。</>

<@profile.key>DOCUMENT: Summary of the Battle of █████ by the TGCC United Services Research Center: 
Esteemed representatives attending this joint session of TGCC concerns and corporations, I am Tanner Orrigan, special observer and battle asset insurance agent. I am here to give you a report on the Battle of █████, which I witnessed and experienced as an observer embedded with the Order of Steel Oath. 
This high intensity conflict between the Order of Steel Oath and the Northern Aggeloid Host resulted in severe losses of military assets, contributed by all signatories of the Band Accord. Primary asset losses incurred by the Order include: 31 pieces of artillery walkers and other heavy UAVs for reinforcing a number of defenses zones. For details, please refer to the printed annex a3 provided next to you. 
...... 
Obviously, the sudden appearance of the unknown entity forced the Order to stop their offensive against the Aurora. But I would like to remind all esteemed representatives that all losses incurred in this offensive strongly prove our willingness to further our partnership and provision of unconditional aid to the Order. Once we assist the Order with the construction of industrial production facilities, the North will only need more goods from various companies. There is a healthy chance that the current model of bulk equipment purchases will give way to a new paradigm of a multi-tiered technology and intellectual property partnership, one that is far more beneficial to our interests. 
...... 
During this battle, I was embedded with a banner that was part of the main offensive. We approached a ridge and made our way towards a forward fort. However, unassisted vision was unable to pinpoint the exact location of the fort as the massive Aggeloid host blanketed the entire topography — This ended when the Banner Commander Khorsyn, the one who had been most uninhibited in expending military assets, began his attack on the other side of the Aggeloid host. The Shieldguards advanced in formation, pushed the battle lines over the ridge, and deployed signal flares at the high grounds to help the fort artillery to direct their firing. 
It was during this time that the unknown entity, the very one that blunted the other Banner offensives, re-appeared at the bottom of the Aurora. Esteemed representatives, I would like to take this moment to voice a consensus that I have reached with the Order of Steel Oath: Under no circumstances can we allow any entity of its type to enter densely populated areas. So, back to the topic. When the entity re-appeared, I was in the relative safety of a forward command center. However, Æther activities triggered by the said entity had rendered my recording devices inoperable. At this moment of desperation, Khorsyn led his Banner of Shieldguards and attacked from the very front. The Shieldguards raised their shields and pushed the advance with steadfast determination and valiance. I am afraid I could not describe what I saw next in an objective manner. I saw red flashes hewing apart the greatest Aggeloi, turning them into silent headstones. Every hole that appeared in the bastion of iron shields was quickly sealed by another Shieldguard. After 47 minutes of brutal battle, Khorsyn and his Shieldguards managed to carve a path right through the Aggeloid host and besieged the unknown entity that was responsible for killing hundreds of the Oathkeepers' best soldiers. In a single exchange, Khorsyn split the statuesque carapace right through the median plane. The strange matter encased within the unknown entity attempted escape by ejecting itself into the air. However, fire rained down from the skies as steam vented from the gaps in the armor. The final throes of resistance were extinguished at long last. 
...... 
Esteemed representatives, the Order of Steel Oath has proved their indispensability through this battle. Our support is more than just supporting the spirit of altruism espoused by the Band Accords. It is an investment towards the crucial strategic resilience of the Northern Front. Another objective of this report is to clarify that the actual legacy of the Order lies not within their Vault of Relics, but amongst key personnel, like Khorsyn. The values of these individuals cannot be appraised, and neither could they be traded. However, "Heroes of the Band" will be a most valuable investment opportunity for the TGCC — That is without question. </>

<@profile.key>“城市母亲”。
还未去过那里时，我曾无数次在联盟工团拍摄的各种艺术片里看到这个名字。那是塔卫二全联盟工团的心脏，高耸的指挥塔，集成式移动地块生产坞，与记忆所见的那些移动城市一样——坚固、庞大无比。
然而，在进入那座城市后，我首先看到的不是惊人的工业巨构，而是扛着建材、奔赴劳动现场的工团成员们。这些永远不会失掉精力的工人们，正将“血液”输送到这座城市的每一个角落，在每一平方米的混凝土表面留下自己的手印。
出于好奇，我没有去寻找一位本地向导，而是跟随着刚刚结束一天工作的工人，走进了一栋庞大、简约的建筑。一阵拥挤后，我来到了大厅的二层，在一张柔软的椅子上坐下——直到这时，我才意识到，这里是这座城市的工人剧院。而刚才那队刚刚结束工作的工人，已经换好服装，变成了舞台上的音乐剧演员。
与我的猜测不同，他们没有演出歌颂劳动英雄的戏码，反而将一出讽刺官僚的诙谐喜剧搬上了舞台——在工人们默契的“唬骗”下，腐败官僚以为自己真的找到了在塔卫二上并不存在的赤金，最终尝到了贪婪的苦果。当然，工人们仍然在故事里扮演了英雄，只不过英雄们充满了幽默感，还有对幸福生活的无穷热情。
当剧目散场，我怀揣心事，即将离开剧场的时候，一对大约十岁的双胞胎姐弟不知怎么发现了我的身份。“铁誓军！铁誓军！”他们兴奋地尖叫着，拦在我的面前，对我行了个相当稚嫩的铁誓军军礼。他们的父母，还有其他工人不得不费一番功夫，才将两个不断提出我难以解答的问题的小家伙带走。但我可以从表情上看出，如果再稍微年轻一些，那些在场的成年人也会毫不犹豫地做出同样孩子气的事情。
还未离开罗德岛时，我见过一个梦境。梦里的宴会上，集团军贵族的孩子们穿着华丽，被仆人和家庭教师严密看管，如同一个个被精心打扮的玩偶。他们的眼里也有过与那对双胞胎相似的纯真和激情，只是夹杂了其他东西。家族的荣耀？还是对老一辈权力的渴望？我说不清，只知道那些杂质绝不可能来自他们自己的意志。慢慢地，我看着杂质化为野心，闪烁着构思阴谋时闪烁的寒光，最终变成我无论如何都认不出的样子。
当我走出剧院，独自走上“城市母亲”的街头的那一刻，一种奇异的自由感追上了我。我仍会想起身后冲锋的帝国百战先锋、患有矿石病的女孩、沦为废墟的地下诊所、四处奔走的人群、嬉戏打闹的孩童，他们仍在我体内的某处驻留，但我已几乎不再感到沉重。
旧日的坟墓上立起了新碑，短暂地游览过这座城市后，我很快回到了北方。那是一片牺牲了一整个时代、没有旧世界的尘埃和新世界的蓝图、只为“活着”而战的战场。
那是我们的战场。
——未署名的语音转录记录，留档于罗德岛</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Mat' Gorodov. 
I've seen this name countless times in UWST art films before my actual visit. She is the heart of the United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II, replete with massive command towers that scraped the skies and integrated city plate construction yards. She resembled the nomadic cities that I've seen in my memories — Solid and absolutely gargantuan. 
But when I entered the city, the first thing I saw was not awe-inspiring industrial mega structures. No, it was crew mates carrying building materials and rushing towards their work stations. The crews never seemed exhausted, and they labored to transport the lifeblood of this city to very corner. Every inch of concrete bore the prints of their hands. 
I did not seek the service of a local guide as I intended to satisfy my curiosities myself. Instead, I chose to shadow a crew mate who just concluded his day of labor, and followed him into a massive, minimalist building. After a bit of jostling, I arrived at the second floor of the main hall and sat myself down on a soft chair — And I only realized, at that moment, that I was in a crew theater. The crew mate who just finished his shift had already changed into his costume and became an opera performer. 
I did not succeed in guessing the plot of the performance. They did not sing praises for the heroes of labor. Instead, it was a comedy that critiqued bureaucracy — The crew of workers tacitly worked together and "misled" the corrupt official into discovering Pure Gold, something that does not exist on Talos-II. In the end, the official ate the bitter fruits of his greed. Of course, the workers remained the heroes of this tale. But these heroes were humorous and shared a boundless passion for a happy life. 
The show ended and I left the theater with various thoughts weighing heavily in my mind. It was then when a girl around ten years of age and her twin brother realized who I was. "An Oathkeeper! From the Order of the Steel Oath!" they squealed excitedly. The children stood in front of me and saluted me in the way of the Order. Their parents and other workers pulled them away with some difficulty, as they had an endless stream of questions that I find rather difficult to answer. But I could tell, from their expressions, that these adults would have done the same as the children if they had been younger. 
I had a dream before I left Rhodes Island. I dreamed of a banquet. The children of army group nobility were dressed lavishly and kept under the watch of servants and governesses, like intricate dolls meticulously prepared for show. These groomed children exuded the same innocence and passion given off by the twins. But the gazes of these young nobles also carried something else. Was it family honor? Or a desire for power wielded by their elders? I could not tell, but I do know that the taint did not come from their own accord. I witnessed the taint transforming into ambition and shone with the cold glint of schemes and conspiracies. In the end, they became something that I could no longer recognize. 
After I left the theater, I trailed the streets of Mat' Gorodov on my own. It was then when a strange sense of freedom caught up to me. I could still recall elite imperial strikers following me in those great charges, the girl with Oripathy, underground clinics reduced to ruin, crowds trying to make a living, and children playing with each other. These memories lingered somewhere within me, but they no longer weighed me down. 
A new milestone has been erected upon the grave of days long gone. I concluded my short tour of the city and quickly returned north. Therein lies a battlefield where an entire generation fell. A place absent the dust of the old world nor grand blueprints for the new. A field of carnage where survival was the only objective. 
That is where we fight. 
 — Audio transcript recorded by an anonymous individual, currently archived at Rhodes Island</>

voiceDesc.cn: 已到达待命位置。
voiceDesc.en: In position and standing by.

voiceDesc.cn: 随时准备拔营。
voiceDesc.en: Ready to break camp on command.

voiceDesc.cn: 战斗即是军人的天职。
voiceDesc.en: A soldier is born to fight.

voiceDesc.cn: 我们总是需要为生存付出代价。
voiceDesc.en: Survival is never free. We always have to pay.

voiceDesc.cn: 必须学会如何去运用暴力，只为生存，无关善恶。
voiceDesc.en: One must learn to wield violence — not for good nor malice, but for the sake of survival.

voiceDesc.cn: 在军需官眼中，完备的武装无异于胜利的起点。
voiceDesc.en: To a quartermaster, proper armament is the first step toward victory.

voiceDesc.cn: 懈怠与疏忽，才是战场上最棘手的敌人。
voiceDesc.en: Remissness and negligence pose the deadliest threat on the battlefield.

voiceDesc.cn: 很有价值的战斗……真令人热血沸腾。
voiceDesc.en: A valuable battle ... My fighting spirit has been stirred.

voiceDesc.cn: 无需勋章与仪式，我明白这代表着什么……谢谢你的信任，终末地的管理员。
voiceDesc.en: No badge or ceremony is needed. I fully appreciate the significance of this... Thank you for your trust, Endministrator of Endfield Industries.

voiceDesc.cn: 如果是在铁誓军的堡垒，今晚我就不得不成为一场宴会的主持了。
voiceDesc.en: If this happened at the Oathkeepers' fortress, I'd have to play the host at tonight's feast.

voiceDesc.cn: 无论在战场还是别处，这都是一种荣誉。管理员，感谢你托付的信任，我会在最前线证明它的意义。
voiceDesc.en: Whether on the battlefield or elsewhere, this is an honor. Thank you for your trust, Endministrator. I'll prove that this trust is well placed through my actions on the frontlines.

voiceDesc.cn: 塔卫二的战争依然残酷，至今仍有无数人于北方前赴后继，只为众多的生机能够延续。我相信，管理员你所做的，会让这惨烈的循环得到一份庄严的结局。
voiceDesc.en: War remains a brutal affair on Talos-II. Numerous souls have marched into the north, fighting and falling so that the rest of this world may live. Endmin, I have no doubt that your actions will put a solemn end to this cruel cycle of war and sacrifice.

voiceDesc.cn: 骏卫，罗德岛驻外干员兼铁誓军军官，向你报到。事态紧急，我希望尽快了解你的作战计划……最好就是现在。
voiceDesc.en: Pogranichnik, Rhodes Island operator, and officer serving the Order of Steel Oath, reporting for duty. The situation is urgent. I respectfully request a brief on your battle plan, at your earliest convenience.

voiceDesc.cn: 再推演一次作战计划，如何？
voiceDesc.en: Let's go over the battle plan once more, shall we?

voiceDesc.cn: 战场上的生与死，往往只在一念之间。
voiceDesc.en: The slightest slip of mind decides who lives ... and who dies in battle.

voiceDesc.cn: 我并未尝试过这种工作……但出于战略考量，或许值得一试。
voiceDesc.en: I've never tried this sort of work... But from a strategic perspective, it may be worth a try.

voiceDesc.cn: 你好，管理员，又来巡视了吗？
voiceDesc.en: Greetings, Endministrator. Here for another inspection tour?

voiceDesc.cn: 向你致敬，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Salutations, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 帝江号比我以为的更加巨大，但我熟悉它的各个部分却只花了极短的时间。这大概要归功于建造者赋予它的，那近乎精巧的合理构造。这是一个远大理想的起点，我很期待，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: Dijiang is much larger than I expected, but I hardly spent any time familiarizing myself with its entire layout. That's thanks to the ingenious and impeccable designs by its creator. It's a great starting point for a great dream, Endmin, and I'm eager to see how that dream unfolds.

voiceDesc.cn: 集成工业系统确实远超我的想象。借由协议核心，泰拉文明的军工机器将拥有一颗无可匹敌的钢铁心脏，能够不断向这颗星球所有危险的角落输送血液。管理员，你们将会拯救无数人的性命，我可以向你保证。
voiceDesc.en: The Automated Industry Complex is far beyond what I imagined. With the Protocol Automation-Core, the suite of Terran military-industrial machines will finally have a potent heart, one that sustains stable deliveries of essential resources to every imperiled corner of the planet. Endmin, your work will save countless lives. On that I give you my sincere promise.

voiceDesc.cn: 终末地的武库工程师着实令人钦佩，竟然能在这样有限的时间内，完成所有人员的武器维护工作……这样的效率即使是在北方前线也称得上是数一数二。不过，他们的负责人为何如此年幼？
voiceDesc.en: The Arsenal Engineers of Endfield are truly impressive. They managed to complete weapon maintenance for every personnel despite the tight schedules... Such efficiency is rare, even on the Northern Front. Though I must admit, I didn't expect someone that young to be in charge of your Arsenal.

voiceDesc.cn: 我看过小道奇教官为你们拟定的训练方案，十分务实也足够循序渐进。我并没有改动的打算，只是会根据经验额外追加一两场小小试炼……但想必是难不倒你的，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: I've reviewed Instructor Lil' Dodge's training program for you. The content is practical and the difficulty curve is well-balanced. I don't intend to make any changes to it, though I added one or two extra minor trials based on my experience... But I trust that won't be a problem for you, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 在你醒来前，我已许久未直接参与过终末地的行动。对我而言，罗德岛、终末地、铁誓军，并无不同。我只是想保护那些值得保护的东西，而这一次，我可以义无反顾。
voiceDesc.en: Before you were awakened, I hadn't taken part directly in Endfield operations for years. To me, whether I serve at Rhodes Island, Endfield, or the Order of Steel Oath makes no difference. I only want to protect what I believe is worth protecting. And this time, I shall advance, and never retreat.

voiceDesc.cn: 眺望塔卫二总是能给我莫大的鼓舞，足以覆盖整颗卫星的异类被战士们以血肉之躯拦截在北方极光下的方寸之地中。这是铁誓军最伟大的军事成就之一，也是我们值得被委以文明延续之重任的铁证。
voiceDesc.en: Every time I look out over Talos-II, I feel a surge of inspiration. Massive swarms of abominations, capable of engulfing the entire planet, are forced into cauldrons in the auroral north. Mere soldiers of flesh and blood were the brick and mortar that held the enemy in check. This is one of the Oathkeeper's greatest military feats, an undeniable proof that we are worthy ... of the immense responsibility of preserving civilization.

voiceDesc.cn: 这是我在北方意外得到的……也许对你有用，管理员。
voiceDesc.en: I stumbled upon this in the north... It might prove useful to you, Endministrator.

voiceDesc.cn: 感谢你的馈赠，管理员。这对我来说亦是一种嘉奖……请收下这个吧，就当是我的回礼。
voiceDesc.en: Thank you for your gift, Endministrator. I take it as a commendation as well... And please accept this as my token of gratitude.

voiceDesc.cn: 离开罗德岛后，我最先落脚的地方是工团的工业母舰。出于一些原因，我想见证某一段过往在这片土地缔造出的结果。看到那座顽强的城市时，我确实深受触动。如果乌萨斯人的后裔能以另一个面貌赢得属于他们的荣誉，那么，赫尔森也不应该再犹豫下去。
voiceDesc.en: After leaving Rhodes Island, I first visited the Industrial Mothership of the UWST. For some reason, I wanted to see what fruits a certain chapter of history had borne in this land. When I laid eyes on that indomitable city, I was deeply moved. If the children of Ursus can leave the past behind, start things anew, and achieve their own feats of honor and glory, then I, Khorsyn, have no reason to hesitate any longer.

voiceDesc.cn: 铁誓军的军旅生活教会我三件事。第一，信任你的战友；第二，不要轻易退缩；第三，不可怀揣侥幸。在那里，违背上述任意一条都可能为自身或是战友带来不幸。
voiceDesc.en: Military life with the Oathkeepers has taught me three lessons: First, trust your comrades; second, never back down easily; third, never push your luck. In the north, violating any of these principles could bring misfortune to you or your comrades.

voiceDesc.cn: 我在铁誓军重组并训练了盾卫。这个想法诞生自我抵达堡垒群的前夜。厚重的建筑群依山而建，萨米的黑森林像深绿色的火焰，沿着河流燃烧。无数人的墓碑如同城墙排列，挡住来自北方的敌人。铁誓军是文明环带的一面盾，而我又为铁誓军带去了另一面。我相信，这些战士坚不可摧。
voiceDesc.en: During my time with the Oathkeepers, I reorganized and trained the Shieldguards. The idea took shape on the night before I reached the Oathkeepers' bastion complex. Massive structures rose in the shadow of the mountains. Sami's Myrkwood stretched out in the darkness, as if dark green flames creeping along the riverbanks. Countless tombstones stood in rows, forming a wall that held back the enemies from the north. The Oathkeepers is a shield protecting the Civilization Band, and I've forged another shield for them. I believe these soldiers will never break.

voiceDesc.cn: 赫拉格更像是我的良师益友。我饱尝了他的遗憾与愧疚，也学习了他的想法与技能。这里没有乌萨斯的赫拉格将军，这里只有罗德岛和终末地的赫尔森。偶尔，我庆幸自己了无牵挂。偶尔，我又会感到……孤独。我所保护的东西若是虚指，那和帝国虚伪的荣光并无二致。管理员，我希望……你能成为我的答案。
voiceDesc.en: Hellagur is more like a mentor and friend. I've come to understand his regrets and guilt, and I've learned from his thoughts and skills. There is no Hellagur the Ursine General here — only Khorsyn of Rhodes Island and Endfield. At times, I feel grateful I have no past to weigh me down. Other times, I feel ... the ache of solitude. If what I'm protecting turns out to be another empty ideal, then it's no different from the hollow glory of the Ursus Empire. Endministrator, I hope that ... you'll be one to give me an answer.

voiceDesc.cn: 我希望管理员你能够实现目标；我希望罗德岛的人们能够回到普通的生活；我希望铁誓军有朝一日铸剑为犁，解甲归田；我希望生命能在这颗古老的星球得以延续。管理员，每当获胜，我都希望能与你们一同庆祝。但哪怕仅有一次的失败到来，我希望你能活下去，以任何方式活下去，那我便不枉此行。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, it is my solemn wish that your vision is fulfilled; that everyone at Rhodes Island can return to a life of peace and common joys; that the Oathkeepers can finally beat their swords to plowshares and enjoy the company of their loved ones; and that life can finally sink its roots deep into this ancient planet. I look forward to celebrating every victory with you and your friends. Even in the face of a devastating defeat, I pray that you will survive by any means necessary. If you do, then everything I've done will be worth it.

voiceDesc.cn: Z7行动组的年轻人们确实让我印象深刻。他们虽然只接受了简单的军事训练，却凭借个人努力收获了与普通军人同等水平的作战意识……这点尤为可贵。
voiceDesc.en: The youths of Op Team Z7 are truly impressive. They've only received basic military training, but managed to develop combat awareness on par with that of standard military combatants. Such achievement is rare, and commendable.

voiceDesc.cn: 我在北方有过很多工作经验。除了指挥官之外，我同时还是军需官和教官。我锻造过武器，为新品种的瘤兽挤奶，甚至亲自酿过一些葡萄酒……
voiceDesc.en: I worked all kinds of jobs in the north. Besides being a commander, I also doubled as a quartermaster and drill instructor. I forged weapons, milked new breeds of cystybeasts, and even made grape wine...

voiceDesc.cn: 什么是军人的荣誉？就算是我，恐怕也没法做出断言。但管理员，倘若有一天你到达北方的要塞，可以去看看铁誓军在那里立下的纪念碑……上面的每一个名字，都曾是一个答案。
voiceDesc.en: What is a soldier's honor? I'm afraid even I cannot give a definitive answer. But should you ever visit the Oathkeepers' fortress in the north, I urge you to visit our memorial... Every name engraved upon the monument once held an answer to that question.

voiceDesc.cn: 大司库管理着一座遗产库。“遗产”的定义多种多样，除去铁誓军历代英杰的遗物，还有一些是难以复原的泰拉技术，或是原理未知的前文明发现。我曾被允许挑选一把“遗产”作为己用，但我拒绝了。借用前人荣耀的事，我早已做过一次。此身此世，我应当留下属于自己的荣耀。
voiceDesc.en: The Grand Treasurer manages a massive vault of legacies. They include not only relics of Oathkeeper legends, but also currently unrestorable Terra technologies, and mysterious artifacts of the Precursors. I was once given the chance to choose a relic to wield, but I refused. I had already drawn on the glory of a past legend. For the rest of my life, I will leave behind my own glorious legacy.

voiceDesc.cn: 铁誓军的敌人大部分时候都是天使和锚点，以及超域活动带来的灾害。但极少数情况下，我们会面对一些自身无法理解的现象：巨大的生物痕迹，奇异人类个体的目击报告……这也是我得知管理员苏醒后，立刻申请重回终末地的原因。
voiceDesc.en: Most of the time, Oathkeepers are fighting Aggeloi, Ankhors, and the disasters caused by Ætherside activities. But there have been extremely rare occasions where we faced inexplicable phenomena: traces of giant creatures, witness reports of peculiar individuals... This is why I immediately requested to return to Endfield when I heard the Endmin had been awakened.

voiceDesc.cn: 北方和很多人的想象并不相同。百年的运营使得铁誓军的堡垒也拥有兴盛的商业和娱乐业，人们在习以为常的战事下孕育了一种朝气蓬勃的生活方式。而堡垒之外，萨米人在那里的黑森林安家，古老的知识和文化得以保留，大篷车来往于堡垒与森林之间。管理员，你应该去一趟北方。那里很美，我会陪着你。
voiceDesc.en: The north is actually quite different from what most people imagine. After a century of development, the Oathkeepers' fortresses have become bustling hubs of commerce and entertainment. People became accustomed to constant war, and have created a rather vibrant way of life. Outside the fortresses, the Samifjod built settlements in Myrkwood to preserve their ancient knowledge and culture. Their caravans would often travel between the fortresses and the forest. Endmin, you should pay the north a visit. It's a beautiful place, and I'll gladly accompany you if that is your wish.

voiceDesc.cn: 工业母舰，这座工团最大的城市如今有很多名字与简称。而我知道一个她在泰拉时的名字——“塞梦珂”。在帝国的暴政下，她曾被沉入了一片大湖。我不清楚乌萨斯为何要捞起她，又为何要把这样一座废城改造成他们在异星的飞地。但至少，这座塔卫二现存最巨大的移动城市，已然成为了无数人的精神象征。
voiceDesc.en: Industrial Mothership, the largest city of the UWST, now goes by many names and aliases. But I know her name was Simonch when she was still in Terra. She sank in a lake under the tyrannical rule of the Ursus Empire. I still don't know why the Empire salvaged her afterwards, nor why they repurposed that ruined city into an exclave in a foreign world. Nevertheless, she is now the largest nomadic city on Talos-II, and a spiritual symbol for many.

voiceDesc.cn: 最初挑选盾卫的时候，我看见的是一群比我还要年轻的战士。第一步，我需要从他们的身上削去锐气，他们应当守卫，而非主动出击；随后，我将战术倾囊相授，令他们成为战线本身；最后一步，让他们掌握活下去的方法……在这件事上，我始终担心自己做得还不够。牺牲不是目的，牺牲是为了阻止更多的牺牲。
voiceDesc.en: When I first chose my Shieldguards, I saw a motley of trainees even younger than me. My first task was to strip away their aggression, for they are guards and not attackers. Next, I taught them every tactic I knew so they not only defend, but become the living frontline itself. Finally, I made sure that they mastered survival... But in that regard, I've always felt that I haven't done enough. Sacrifice is never the objective. It is a last resort for the sole purpose of avoiding more sacrifices.

voiceDesc.cn: 我听说过余烬女士的事迹，她是一名可敬的战士。我想管理员应该有所了解，她的长官令她回到南方重组小队，其实是给她一个“回到普通生活”的机会。这是一种意义不大的宽容。能和自己的过去和解的战士，压根就不会走到这一步。
voiceDesc.en: I've heard stories about Miss Ember, a most remarkable warrior. Her assignment to the south wasn't just about rebuilding her squad. Her commander wanted to give her a chance to lead a normal life. I believe you have noticed this already, Endmin. Sadly, she is unlikely to appreciate the meaning of this generosity. A soldier who could make peace with their past would never have gone so far as she has.

voiceDesc.cn: 萨米人并没传闻中那么排外。的确，他们对外来者常怀戒备，百余年来始终在“祖灵之父”遗留的庇荫下生活，但对尊重萨米习俗的旅人，他们也不吝于救济。独眼巨人曾将萨米的牙齿赠与塞什卡用作其飞空据点的动力源，雪祀也把传承的法术向铁誓军倾囊相授。看得出，萨米人来到塔卫二后也在用自己的方式延续过往的生活。
voiceDesc.en: Contrary to what people say, the Samifjod are not xenophobes. It is true that for more than a century, they've been living under the lingering protection left behind by their All-Father. Yet, they generously offer help to travelers who respect Sami traditions. The Cyclops once gifted Sami's Teeth to the Seš'qamam to power the floating bastion. The Snowpriests are also more than willing to share their Arts with the Oathkeepers. It is clear that the Samifjod have found their own way of embracing a new life on Talos-II while preserving their heritage.

voiceDesc.cn: 那或许是你们需要的东西。
voiceDesc.en: You might find that useful.

voiceDesc.cn: 如果不想错过重要的物资，最好留心下那里。
voiceDesc.en: Keep an eye on that area, if you don't want to miss key supplies.

voiceDesc.cn: 未知的区域，切记保持队形。
voiceDesc.en: Maintain formation, especially in uncharted territories.

voiceDesc.cn: 注意提防，那边的敌手不容小觑。
voiceDesc.en: Stay alert, the enemy there is strong.

voiceDesc.cn: 优质的矿藏……它们将成为我手中的利剑与坚盾。
voiceDesc.en: This'll shape up nicely — perfect for both offense and defense.

voiceDesc.cn: 群策群力之下，再没有难事。
voiceDesc.en: When we pool our strength, no task is beyond us.

voiceDesc.cn: 是十分珍贵的物资储备，足以影响战局。
voiceDesc.en: Strategic reserves like these can shift the tide of battle.

voiceDesc.cn: 获得醚质的战略意义恐怕高于它本身的价值。
voiceDesc.en: Its strategic significance probably exceeds its operational value.

voiceDesc.cn: 不利的因素最好从一开始就解决掉。
voiceDesc.en: Adverse variables are best taken out during the earliest phases of war.

voiceDesc.cn: 每一次的休整都尤为重要。这意味着在下一场战斗来临前，你还有准备的机会。
voiceDesc.en: Every chance of recuperation counts. It might be your only chance to prepare for the next battle.

voiceDesc.cn: 注意恢复，切勿心急。
voiceDesc.en: Hang in there. No rush.

voiceDesc.cn: 一时疏忽了。
voiceDesc.en: That was an oversight.

voiceDesc.cn: 全军！避让！
voiceDesc.en: All units! Incoming!

voiceDesc.cn: 还未到绝境。
voiceDesc.en: This is far from desperate.

voiceDesc.cn: 战场的终点……不该在此……
voiceDesc.en: This is no place ... for my war to end...

voiceDesc.cn: 高明的决策。
voiceDesc.en: A brilliant strategy.

voiceDesc.cn: 教科书般的示范。
voiceDesc.en: A textbook maneuver.

voiceDesc.cn: 诸位过奖了。
voiceDesc.en: You flatter me.

voiceDesc.cn: 你们证明了团队的价值。
voiceDesc.en: We have proven the power of unity.

voiceDesc.cn: 战场从不仁慈。
voiceDesc.en: War is never about mercy.

voiceDesc.cn: 开始接敌。
voiceDesc.en: Engage.

voiceDesc.cn: 均在作战计划内。
voiceDesc.en: Our battle plan proved its worth.

voiceDesc.cn: 不错的战果。
voiceDesc.en: The results speak for themselves.

voiceDesc.cn: 值得庆祝一番。
voiceDesc.en: It is worth a celebration.

voiceDesc.cn: 胜利总是代价高昂……珍视你由此得到的，勿忘你为此失去的。
voiceDesc.en: Every victory bears its price... Hold dear what you've learned, but don't forget what we've paid.

voiceDesc.cn: 无需因失败感到耻辱，正视它，然后让它成为你更进一步的垫脚石。
voiceDesc.en: Don't let failure weigh you down. Own it, and let it propel you to greater heights.

voiceDesc.cn: 退下！
voiceDesc.en: Move aside!

voiceDesc.cn: 无用的挣扎！
voiceDesc.en: Pathetic!

voiceDesc.cn: 绝无侥幸！
voiceDesc.en: Never tempt fate!

voiceDesc.cn: 绝无怯懦！
voiceDesc.en: Never fear!

voiceDesc.cn: 绝无退让！
voiceDesc.en: Never retreat!

voiceDesc.cn: 已就绪。
voiceDesc.en: At your command.

voiceDesc.cn: 我来了结。
voiceDesc.en: They're mine to end.

voiceDesc.cn: 新月！
voiceDesc.en: Crescent moon!

voiceDesc.cn: 弦月！
voiceDesc.en: Half moon!

voiceDesc.cn: 满月！
voiceDesc.en: Full moon!

voiceDesc.cn: 瞑目吧。
voiceDesc.en: Rest in silence.

voiceDesc.cn: 终局已至！
voiceDesc.en: Your death awaits.

voiceDesc.cn: 听我号令！
voiceDesc.en: AT MY COMMAND!

voiceDesc.cn: 随我进军！
voiceDesc.en: Soldiers, ADVANCE!

voiceDesc.cn: 盾卫！列阵！
voiceDesc.en: Shieldguards! FORMATION!
