recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>干员庄方宜，武陵科学发展区管代，兼任息壤新材项目负责天师。经宏山科学院推荐，与终末地工业合作进行裂隙相关的研究。

和庄天师的对话进行得异常顺利，飞速看完几份合作协议后，她没有疑惑，没有异议，轻松署上名字，好像签下的文件只是通知她明天到岗，而不是对未来十几年的规划与安排。这样无条件的信赖究竟来自何方呢？也许管理员会有答案。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Operator Zhuang Fangyi serves as the Viceroy of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District and also the Tianshi in charge of the Novel Xiranite-based Materials Project. Upon recommendation from the Hongshan Academy of Sciences, she entered into cooperation with Endfield Industries to conduct rift-related research.

My meeting with Tianshi Zhuang concluded with striking efficiency. She reviewed the cooperation agreements quickly, raised no questions or objections, and signed without hesitation — as though she were simply confirming a next-day onboarding notification, not committing to a partnership that would shape the next ten years and beyond. Where does such unconditional trust come from? Perhaps the Endmin has the answer.
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>自从庄天师来到帝江号，泡在实验室内的工作狂又多了一位。
对待自己的工作，她称得上享受。每一天，她会亲自把日程排满，再一件件完成，绝不浪费一天中的任何一秒。而庄天师在武陵城的家，永远整洁如新，新到像从来没有住过人。相反，她的实验室内却堆满生活用品。
如果不是宏科院派人干预，强制令其休假，庄天师永远也不会停止工作。他们担心，在如此恐怖的工作安排下，庄天师很快会倒在实验第一线，殊不知，无所事事的日子对她来说才像囚笼。
休假第一天，她还能做出悠闲的模样，享受无所事事的时光，但很快，焦躁便攀上她的眉间，她开始在沙滩上来回踱步，忧心实验室中的一切。
假期每过去一天，她便惆怅一分，最后的日子里，她几乎直不起身，只能瘫在床上，喃喃呼唤着：“实验……我得去实验室，不能再这样浪费时间了。马上就要出结果，我实在是等不了了。”
等到假期结束，她踏进实验室，兴高采烈的模样好像她真的度过了一个美好的假期，但其实她只是为假期的结束而感到愉悦。就连公认的大忙人佩丽卡监督都忍不住惊叹。
但如此狂热的工作态度，并非不能理解。等待庄天师实验结果的不只有她自己，整个宏科院乃至塔卫二都在关注她的身影。
在裂隙灾害愈发频繁、严重的当下，庄天师处在实验中的每一秒，都有可能出现应对灾害的全新解法。她的时间，某种意义上，并不全然属于她自己，它们被慷慨地分给了无数被裂隙夺去家园与生命的人，分给了塔卫二被裂隙灾害牢牢桎梏的未来。她不敢浪费，也不能浪费，哪怕一分，哪怕一秒。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Ever since Tianshi Zhuang came aboard the Dijiang, there's been one more workaholic buried in the labs. 
The Tianshi approaches her work with great enthusiasm. Every day, she packs her schedule herself, ticking off each task without wasting a second. Her home back in Wuling City stays spotless — so clean it feels as though no one has ever lived there. In contrast, her lab is cluttered with personal items, as if that's where life actually happens. 
If not for HAS stepping in and ordering a mandatory break, Tianshi Zhuang would never have put down her work. Some feared that the sheer amount of work would soon leave Tianshi Zhuang collapsed at the lab bench. What they failed to realize was that she actually found the lack of work to be more unbearable. 
On the first day of her forced vacation, she gave an illusion of rest. But soon, restlessness crept into her expression, and stillness gave way to anxiety. She started pacing up and down the beach, worrying about everything back in the lab. 
With each passing day of the break, her mood grew heavier. By the end, Tianshi Zhuang who could barely get out of bed kept murmuring these words: "The lab ... I need to get back to the lab. The results could come in any moment. I cannot waste any more time." 
After the break was finally over, she returned to the lab with a smile so radiant that people thought she had a really beautiful vacation. In truth, she was only glad that the ordeal by vacation was over. Even Perlica, another widely recognized workaholic, was astonished by Tianshi Zhuang's professional commitment. 
There is a reason she works the way she does. She isn't the only one waiting for the results. The entire HAS, and Talos-II itself, are watching her progress closely. 
As rift disasters grow ever more frequent and devastating, every moment Tianshi Zhuang spends at work carries the possibility of a new solution. Her time is no longer hers alone, but generously sacrificed for those who have lost homes and lives to the rifts. She dare not, and she cannot allow even a second to go to waste.</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>“我很喜欢庄天师，但我真的不了解她。”所有与庄天师共事过的干员都会这么感慨。
庄天师的过往清晰可见，任何前往武陵城的人都可以在迎宾客的介绍下了解个大概，如果想要多知道些，可以去天师府学院翻阅她的文章，当然，全部看完可能要花点时间。到这里，她的形象已经足够完整了——一位在科研道路上深耕多年的学者，一位恪尽职守在武陵坚守十年的管代天师。
如果抛开学者和管代身份，你还想多了解她本人，那就得有个和她共事的机会。人们对她的第一印象往往就像武陵城三月的春风，温和，舒畅，让人轻松愉悦。一起合作后，之前让你焦头烂额的工作，会因为她的加入，迎刃而解，这时她就是盛夏送来的凉风，抚平烦躁，令人心平气静。直到某天，你们的实验遇到瓶颈，明明庄天师的神色异常平静，但你却觉得有一场风暴正在酝酿。
首先，是她的语速，与她对话时，字句仿佛像雨点般噼里啪啦砸在脸上，没有几个人能跟上她说话的速度。其次，是她的步速，每次走动都像一阵暴烈的旋风，带着桌上报告的纸页哗啦乱飞。然后，是她解决问题的速度，犹如闪电一般，准确无误地找到症结，狠狠将其劈个粉碎，在一片灰暗中，用闪光帮助大家寻找方向。
于是很快，问题解决，风暴也平息。
经受过几次风雨洗礼，你以为自己足够了解庄天师，但等回过神来，你还是会意识到自己见识的不过是更为立体的学者与管代形象。然后，你便醒悟，她从不和你聊自己，她从不和任何人聊自己。
你走进了风暴中心，却发现那里什么都没有。

【《宏山晚报》第八版】
讣告
宏山科学院的优秀学者，医生庄含青因病于上周日6时23分在宏山第一医院不幸逝世，享年42岁。
现定于本周四在宏山殡仪馆大厅举行家属告别仪式。
联系人：其兄庄长青 其妹庄岱青

【通信记录】
庄长青：你们谁看到方宜了？我今天忙了一天，一回过神发现她不在灵堂了。
庄岱青：你放心，我正陪着她呢。
庄长青：没事就好，没事就好，唉……幸好还有你在，她一个几岁大的孩子，遇到这样的事。
庄长青：自从含青去世后……她就一言不发，你和她亲近些，她有和你说什么吗？
庄岱青：没……她什么也不愿意和我说。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>"I really like Tianshi Zhuang, but I don't seem to know her well." Every operator who worked with her feels this way. 
Tianshi Zhuang's past is easy to trace. Any visitor to Wuling City can get the basics from a local tour guide or receptionist. For those who wish to know more, simply dig deeper into the archives of the Tianshi Bureau Academy to peruse her publications, though reading them all takes some dedication. And those who manage to do all that would have a clear picture of the Tianshi — A scientist deeply immersed in her work, a Viceroy who has dutifully served Wuling for a decade. 
If you wish to set aside Tianshi Zhuang's titles and know her personally, seek out an opportunity to be her coworker. Most people describe their first impression of her as the soothing gusts of Wuling City in March: gentle, comforting, and refreshing. As a coworker, Zhuang could unravel even the most recalcitrant of problems. She would be the cool midsummer breeze that takes away frustration and restores balance. The comfortable peace would last until your experiment hits a bottleneck. And then you'd sense a storm quietly brewing beneath her composed exterior. 
Her speech would change. It becomes quick and relentless, like a sudden downpour of which few can keep pace. Her stride would quicken. Every step a violent gust, sending reports flapping and fluttering off the tabletops. And finally, her problem-solving would transform. Like a blitz, she strikes directly at the source of the issue to completely shatter it, a guiding flash of light in the face of doom and gloom. 
Soon enough, the problem is no more. The storm subsides. 
You might think you know Tianshi Zhuang after several tumultuous rounds of collaboration. But as you catch your breath, you would realize that you only saw her scholarly side of Her Viceroyalty more clearly. And then it hits you: she never talks about herself. Not to you, not to anyone. 
You had stepped into the eye of the storm — and found nothing but stillness. 

DOCUMENT: Hongshan Evening News Vol. 8 
Obituary 
Surgeon Zhuang Hanqing, a distinguished scholar at Hongshan Academy of Sciences, passed away due to illness last Sunday at 6:23 AM at Hongshan First Hospital, aged 42. 
A family memorial and farewell service will be held this Thursday in the main hall of Hongshan Funeral Home. 
Contacts: Her brother Zhuang Changqing; sister Zhuang Daiqing 

Communication Log 
Zhuang Changqing: Has anyone seen Fangyi? I've been busy all day. Just realized she's not in the mourning hall. 
Zhuang Daiqing: Don't worry. I'm with her now. 
Zhuang Changqing: That's a relief to hear... I'm glad you're here. She's just a child, and this is such a heavy loss. 
Zhuang Changqing: Ever since Hanqing passed ... she hasn't said a word. You know the girl better than me. Has she said anything to you? 
Zhuang Daiqing: No... She won't speak to me either.</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>在武陵科考站事故发生不久后，庄天师临危受命，负责管理几处安置点。在她的指挥下，迅速拉开了一道受灾区域和安全区域间的稳固防线，从人员调配，到灾区清理与资源补给，她都提供了必要的支持。
庄天师在灾害中的出色表现，让宏科院高层予以重望，尽管合适人选众多，还是坚持将重建武陵科考站的重任交给了年纪尚轻的她。
如此压力下，庄天师全身心投入到息壤的研究中。有时，她甚至开始畅想，如果自己是台永不疲倦的机器该有多好。
其实她早就是机器了，实验室那台预演侵蚀爆发周期的倒计时钟便是她的发条，数字每跳一次，她就愈发紧绷。随后，危机解除，无形的手松开发条，她就像上足劲的娃娃般在实验室与观测站内忙个不停。
那段时期，她放弃了很多，也忽视了很多……
直到有天，庄天师从工作中抬起头，或许只是想伸个懒腰，但却在无意间捕捉到同僚的对话。
“好饿，好想吃火锅……”那是个新来的天师，脸上还长着几颗青春痘。但他的同僚却只是淡漠地回复：“别闹，你是来搞科研的。”
闻言，男孩只是端起桌子上的咖啡杯狠狠灌了一大口，拍拍自己的脸，自言自语道：“不行不行，这里又不是你家，给我把这些心思收起来。”
据庄天师自己回忆，那一刻她感觉被天师雷法狠狠劈了一遭，一阵阵地晕眩。
晕眩停止后，很多因忙碌而被忽略的东西变得清晰——堆成山的罐头盒、浑浊的空气、灰败的面容、蜷缩在墙角睡觉的同僚、对桌因长期伏案而佝偻的脊背……她焦急地想找一些绿色，却发现办公室唯一的绿色是自己的终端显示屏。
她匆忙跑出实验室，想看看室外的绿色，却发现道路两旁的梨花临近枯萎，开始一片片凋落，而她因每日伏案，甚至没留意到它曾怒放过。
恍惚间，庄天师的记忆回到过去，所有人围着她，看她落笔，绘出直线与曲线，一笔笔，一座城市的草稿跃然纸上。
当时她说什么了？
她说，武陵城会是所有人的家。
那她又是为什么忘了呢？
她不知该如何作答。
但至少此刻，她清楚，迟到总比不到好。
于是当天傍晚，学院内所有天师都听到庄天师的呼喊，她像疯子一样在楼宇间穿行，高声邀请每个人走出实验室，欣赏梨花被风吹落的景色。有些天师还未反应过来，她便挨个敲响一间又一间的门，要求每个人抓紧去享受最后的春光。如果还有人不为所动，她便将窗户打开，让梨花瓣飘进办公室。
此后，有人回忆起那天，笑说庄天师忙傻了。但庄天师却只是笑笑，告诉大家自己是忙明白了。</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>Shortly after the Wuling Science Station incident, Tianshi Zhuang was entrusted with managing several temporary shelters. Under her command, a strong line of defense between the disaster site and the safe zone was quickly established. She also provided essential support to personnel deployment, disaster site remediation, and supply distribution. 
Her exceptional performance during the disaster impressed the HAS leadership. Despite many other qualified candidates, they insisted on entrusting her with the rebuilding of Wuling Science Station. 
Under such pressure, Tianshi Zhuang immersed herself completely in research on Xiranite. At times, she even caught herself wishing she were a machine that never needed rest. 
In a sense, she already was one. The lab's countdown clock for Blight rupture simulations governed her every move, each tick tightening her focus. When the crisis eased, tension gave way to activity as she buzzed between the lab and the Monitoring Center like a fully wound-up clockwork doll. 
It was a period when she sacrificed much ... and missed even more. 
Then one day, something unexpected shifted her perspective. She looked up from her work, perhaps just to stretch, and overheard a conversation. 
"I'm starving, I really want hot pot..." said a newly joined Tianshi, acne still dotting his youthful face. Another Tianshi responded indifferently, "Stop thinking about food. You're here to do research." 
The young Tianshi gulped his coffee, patted his cheeks, and muttered, "Right. This isn't home. I should keep my mind on the mission." 
Tianshi Zhuang herself recalled how she felt dizzy and stunned by this incident, as though struck by a fierce bolt of Tianshi Lei Fa (Thunder Arts). 
When the dizziness faded, she clearly realized what she had neglected — the piles of food tins, stale air, exhausted faces, some colleagues curled up in corners asleep, and another opposite her with a back crooked after spending long hours at the lab bench. Desperately she searched for something green, only to find the glow of her terminal screen. 
She rushed outside in search of living green, but the pear trees along the path were close to shedding their wilted flowers. The daily routine of work kept her so trapped that she never noticed them in full bloom. 
In a lapse of stupor she had a flash back. There was a time when everyone gathered around her as she drew straight lines and gentle curves to draft a city upon a sheet of paper. 
What did she say then? 
She said Wuling City would be a home for everyone. 
So why had she forgotten? 
She had no answer for that. 
But she knew one thing: Better late than never. 
That evening, every Tianshi in the Academy heard Tianshi Zhuang's call. She raced through every departmental buildings as though possessed, loudly calling out for everyone to leave the labs and admire the falling pear blossoms. Many were taken by surprise and did not know how to respond, so she went door to door and urged everyone to seize what remained of spring. And when even that failed, she threw open the windows and let the petals drift into the offices. 
When people later spoke of that day, some laughed and said Tianshi Zhuang had worked herself out of her mind. She would only smile and say that she had worked herself to clarity.</>

recordDesc.cn:
<@profile.key>【毕业典礼上的演讲】
“那个……各位同学好，我是██届毕业生庄方宜，很高兴能够代表同学们站在大家面前。
“身为在座中年纪最小的学生，就连刚入学的师弟师妹，也比我大两岁。所以，我首先想感谢的，是哥哥姐姐们这些年来对我的照顾。
“感谢他们，会在我够不到书架最顶层时，帮我取下需要的资料；感谢他们每次上课，都会为我留出最前面的位置；感谢他们不论实验进程多么艰难，都不会在我面前爆粗口……
“当然，我最感激的是，他们将我当作未成年人照顾，却从不认为我的想法与提议幼稚。因为连续跳级，我失去了交往同龄朋友的机会，但却收获了与很多年长者的珍贵友谊；我失去了与同龄朋友一同成长的机会，但却收获了许多前辈们给予的指导与引领。
“如今，我即将进入宏科院深造，在那里遇到的伙伴，大概率更为年长……我也希望，未来能得到他们的指点，缔结新的友谊……”

【悼词】
“我知道在座诸位中，有太多人比我更适合站在这里，为那些离去的人念出这段悼词。在这么多父母、孩子、挚友与恋人中间……我只是一个后辈。
“科考站中，我年纪最小，之所以能够代表大家陈述哀思，也是因为大家对我的照顾……
“一路走来，我受到许多人的照顾。我曾无数次问过前辈们，该如何回报他们待我的一片赤诚，但他们总是笑着说，只要我能做好手中的事，不辜负众人期待，就算最好的回报。
“他们虽然离去，但投注在我身上的期待，却始终未曾淡化，他们对息壤项目的期许，也并未减淡分毫，我知道，这就是我回报他们的时候……
“那些期待与期许，我都会好好担在肩上。”

【开学典礼致辞】
“各位同学，你们好。我很荣幸，你们来到武陵，选择将自己最美好的青春留在实验室，留在这里，留在对抗侵蚀与裂隙的第一线。
“我知道，你们中有许多人之所以选择武陵，是因为家中的父母长辈，曾为科考站奉献了一切……看到你们稚嫩、满是朝气的面庞，我总能想到从前。那时我也坐在台下，听着你们的父母与长辈向我指出那条道路，带领我走上那条道路。
“我曾以为，他们交至我手中的，是倾尽一生换得的科研成果，现在我知道，还有受他们感召，追随他们脚步，来到武陵的你们。
“我曾以为，回报他们最好的方式，是继续那条道路，头也不回地抵达他们理想中的未来，现在我知道，我还得回头看，看那些后来人，为他们指出那条道路，向他们指出未来的模样……
“谢谢你们。
“谢谢你们愿意陪我走上这条路。”

【新干员欢迎会的录像记录】
“我喝醉了吗？好像有点……不应该啊，我才喝了几杯……
“这是第九瓶？嗯……好像是有点多了。
“你知道吗？上一次这么开心，还是我第一次去科考站，他们也为我准备了欢迎会。
“不过我那时年纪很小，只能喝果汁。看他们干了一杯又一杯，傻乎乎地笑着，我也觉得晕晕的。气氛到了嘛。
“今天就……像回到过去一样，未来就摊在面前，等着我前行。
“我还需要说什么呢？什么都不必说……开心就够了。”</>
recordDesc.en:
<@profile.key>[Graduation Speech] 
"Hmmm... Greetings, everyone. I am Zhuang Fangyi from the Class of ██. It is truly an honor to stand here today on behalf of my fellow graduates. 
"I'm the youngest amongst you. Even fellow students who just enrolled are two years ahead of me. So I'd like to begin by thanking everyone for your care and support throughout these years. 
"Thank you for helping me reach the top shelves when I couldn't. Thank you for always saving me a front-row seat for the lectures. Thank you for holding back your frustration even when experiments stalled... 
"Most of all, although everyone spoiled me with loving exceptions usually reserved to a younger sibling, none of my ideas or suggestions were ever brushed off as childish. I skipped many years in school and lost the chance to befriend peers of my age. But in return, I gained invaluable friendships with those older than me. I missed out on one kind of companionship, but received guidance, mentorship, and trust from another. 
"Now, my next step is to continue my studies at the Hongshan Academy of Sciences. The colleagues I meet there are likely to be even more experienced... I also hope to learn from them and build new friendships..." 

[Eulogy] 
"I am keenly aware that many among you are far more suited than I to stand here today and deliver this eulogy for those we have lost. In the presence of parents, sons and daughters, lifelong companions, and loved ones ... I am but a mere youth. 
"I was the youngest member at the Science Station. The reason I could convey our longing on behalf of everyone is a result of your patience, guidance, and care... 
"I have made a journey blessed with support from all sides. I often asked my experienced peers how I might repay the trust and sincerity they showed me. They would always smile and tell me that doing my work and honoring the expectations placed upon me were the best means of repayment. 
"Though they are no longer with us, the trust they invested in me has not waned, nor has their faith in the Xiranite project. I understand that this is the moment to repay them in full... 
"And faithfully I shall bear those hopes and expectations upon my shoulders." 

Orientation Speech 
"Greetings, everyone. It is a great honor to welcome you to Wuling, where you have chosen to commit your most beautiful years to the laboratories, to this place, and to the forefront of our fight against the Blight and the Rift. 
"I know many of you chose Wuling because your parents and elders who sacrificed everything for the Science Station... Seeing your young, eager faces brings back memories — I sat where you are seated right now, and listened to your parents and elders who led me onto this path. 
"I once thought their greatest gift to me was the scientific achievements they had spent their lives creating. Now I realize the gift includes you who arrived at Wuling — who answered their call to follow their footsteps. 
"I once believed that the best way to honor their memories was to stay on that path and reach, without hesitation, the ideal future they dreamed of. Now I understand that I must also lead those who follow, to guide them onto that path and help them envision the future... 
"Thank you. 
"Thank you for choosing to walk this path with me." 

Recording: New Operator Welcome Party 
"Am I tipsy already? Maybe a bit... But this isn't right. I only had a little.. 
"Is this the ninth? Hmm ... maybe it's a bit too much. 
"You know, the last time I felt this happy was when I first arrived at the Science Station. They threw me a welcome party too. 
"I was very young back then so I only had juice. But I felt tipsy just the same, watching them toast cup after cup and laugh without worry. The mood was perfect. 
"Today ... feels just like that again. The future is laid out before me, waiting for me to step forward. 
"What more is there to say? Nothing... Just being happy is enough."</>

voiceDesc.cn: 迎敌或是迎客，都得整装后再出发。
voiceDesc.en: Be it for foes or guests, we prepare fully before stepping forth.

voiceDesc.cn: 出门前，要不要先喝杯茶提提神？
voiceDesc.en: How about a refreshing cup of tea before heading out?

voiceDesc.cn: 你找我帮忙，想必是遇上棘手的问题了，直说就好。
voiceDesc.en: Since you've sought my aid, I assume it's a tricky matter. How may I help?

voiceDesc.cn: 上次外出执行任务……都是好几年前了，但愿别生疏。
voiceDesc.en: It's been years since I last embarked on a mission... Hopefully I haven't lost my touch.

voiceDesc.cn: 再好的武器，也得朝夕相处磨合上几天。等用惯了，我再和你说说感受，好吗？
voiceDesc.en: Even the finest weapon requires time to master. When I've grown accustomed to it, I'll share my thoughts.

voiceDesc.cn: 新的是更厉害些，可那旧的用惯了，确实……也不舍得。
voiceDesc.en: This new one is indeed more powerful, but I've grown attached to the old one...

voiceDesc.cn: 学得越多，就越是清楚，自己学到的不过沧海一粟。
voiceDesc.en: With each new thing I learn, I realize ever more keenly that my knowledge is but a drop in the ocean.

voiceDesc.cn: 不行。哎，看到屏幕里的自己，怎么看都觉得呆呆傻傻。不如，你来和我切磋切磋？
voiceDesc.en: *Sigh* I can't bear seeing my clumsy self on the screen ... perhaps you could spar with me in person instead?

voiceDesc.cn: 都是分内事……不用了吧？
voiceDesc.en: I only did what I should ... such courtesy is unnecessary.

voiceDesc.cn: 好了好了，可别再夸了。你要是有时间，来帮我看看正攻关的课题？
voiceDesc.en: Alright, alright, that's quite enough praise. If you're free, would you mind looking over the research I'm working on?

voiceDesc.cn: 这是干什么？哎，真的不用……下次你请我吃顿饭好了？或者，等你下次去海边，帮我带一株当地特产的耐盐植物？
voiceDesc.en: This is far too generous of you, really... Tell you what, a simple meal together would be more than enough. Or, should you visit the coast, a small salt-tolerant plant would make a perfect token.

voiceDesc.cn: ……好意我心领了，不过我也得问一句，你在武陵的荣誉市民奖章什么时候来拿？到时候可别悄悄就带走了，我们都等着给你好好办场典礼呢。
voiceDesc.en: ...I truly appreciate your kind gesture. And I also have a gentle reminder for you: When you're able, please come to Wuling to claim your Honorary Citizen medal. And promise me you won't take it and leave without letting us know. We all want to hold a proper ceremony for you.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员，正式加入前，我想再补充一下。身为管代，我处理起行政工作来算是得心应手，不过……我来终末地，更希望以普通天师的身份，将精力用在研究上。
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, before I officially come on board, I'd like to say a few words. As Viceroy, I am experienced in administrative duties. However ... here in Endfield, I wish to serve as a regular Tianshi and focus on research.

voiceDesc.cn: 你刚刚……叫我名字了？
voiceDesc.en: Did you just ... call me? Are you looking for my company?

voiceDesc.cn: 我为天师仪新增了一个模块，要一起看看效果吗？
voiceDesc.en: Endmin, I added a new module to the Tianshi apparatus. Shall we see how it performs?

voiceDesc.cn: 你要是信我，可以直接放手让我做。都是小事，我一个人就够。
voiceDesc.en: If you trust me, you can leave these minor matters to me. I can handle them on my own.

voiceDesc.cn: 我正好要去实验室，顺路的话一起走？
voiceDesc.en: I'm heading to the lab. Care to join me if it's on your way?

voiceDesc.cn: 真巧，刚还说要去找你呢。
voiceDesc.en: Lovely coincidence. I was just thinking of coming to see you.

voiceDesc.cn: 我确实是第一次来帝江号，不过……我的全息投影肯定来这里开过会。
voiceDesc.en: It's my first time on Dijiang, but ... my holographic projection has been here for meetings before.

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯……你说要的巨型龙泡泡雕像，我细细想了想，也不是送不上来。但摆在哪里，就该你好好想想了。
voiceDesc.en: I've given some thought to that giant Chubby Lung statue you asked for... Delivery is possible, but ... you might want to think carefully about where to place it.

voiceDesc.cn: 与终末地的……说顺嘴了，不好意思。与武陵的合作项目已经出结果了，实验报告已经上传，你这几天要是有时间，记得看一眼。
voiceDesc.en: Our cooperation plan with Endfield ... pardon me, with Wuling has concluded, and the experiment report has been uploaded. If you have time over the next few days, please be sure to take a look.

voiceDesc.cn: 我这次来帝江号不是为正事……因为武陵的梨树结果了，想顺路给大家送些来。
voiceDesc.en: I didn't come to Dijiang for work this time... The pear trees in Wuling have fruited, so I thought I'd bring some to share with everyone.

voiceDesc.cn: 小时候在宏山，最喜欢跟着老师去天文台，她数着天空中的星星，说其中一颗是帝江号，我看着，觉得可真是个遥远的地方。现在帝江号就在眼前，遥远的，反而是那段回忆了。
voiceDesc.en: When I was a child, I loved accompanying my master to the observatory. She would count the stars and point out one as Dijiang. I would watch it, thinking how far away it must be. Now, with Dijiang right before me, it is the memories that feel distant.

voiceDesc.cn: 都说是读书万卷，行路万里。我读过的书有很多，但去的地方确实不多，宏山、武陵，还有帝江号，算下来，也就三个。确实，我是很容易就留在一个地方，十年、二十年……说不好，一辈子也不是没可能。
voiceDesc.en: They say one should read widely and travel far. I've read a great deal, yet I've not visited many places. Hongshan, Wuling, and Dijiang make just three. This is hardly surprising, for I have a habit of lingering in one place for many years — ten, twenty ... or perhaps even a lifetime.

voiceDesc.cn: 我从宏山述职回来，给你带了些礼物，不是很贵重，但……都是精心挑选过的，希望你能喜欢。
voiceDesc.en: I've just returned from a work trip to Hongshan and brought you a few gifts. They are modest, but I picked each one with care... I hope you like them.

voiceDesc.cn: 论礼数，我该好好收藏才是，可要是算上私心，不如就放在手边，放在眼前。
voiceDesc.en: By etiquette, I should put it in proper storage, but personally, I'd rather keep it within reach, where I can see it at all times.

voiceDesc.cn: 帮我扶下，别让它倒了，我来填土。如果当时不来武陵，我可能会在宏山做个职农或者农业天师，我家里的长辈，平日里都喜欢侍弄花草，家里生机盎然的，谁来了都神清气爽。所以当年做武陵城的规划时，我第一时间就想好了，如果别人来到这里，会闻到怎样的气味，感受怎样的气息。
voiceDesc.en: Oh, Endmin! Could you hold it steady while I fill in the soil? Had fate not led me to Wuling, I might have remained in Hongshan, working as a farmer or a Nongye Tianshi. My family has always loved tending to flowers and greenery, so our home was brimming with verdant life, refreshing everyone who visited. This is why, when I helped plan Wuling City, my first thought was: what fragrance should greet each visitor, and what atmosphere should embrace them.

voiceDesc.cn: 紧张什么？我这次可不是来抓你去学院的，方兴衢里开了一家新的烂肉面，我是来拉你一起去尝尝的。不过，我确实也该反省下自己了，怎么我一出现，你第一个想到的，竟然是工作。
voiceDesc.en: Relax, I'm not here to haul you off to the Academy. There's a new noodle shop on Fangxing Avenue that serves braised meat noodles, and I thought I'd bring you along to try it. That said, why does seeing me instantly remind you of work? Maybe I should take a moment to reflect on that.

voiceDesc.cn: 武陵城里要举办“双人同行”长跑比赛，我想问问你，愿不愿意和我一起报名参加？从城东到城西，再从城北到城南，只要日出日落间能跑完，就算达标。你担心跑不动？放心，我是去年的冠军，实在不行，可以打横抱着你跑……放心，能拿名次。
voiceDesc.en: Wuling is hosting a "Three-Legged Race", and I was wondering if you'd run it with me. The course runs from east to west and then north to south. If we finish before sunset, we pass. Worried you might not make it? Relax, I was last year's first place. If needed, I can carry you the rest of the way. So fret not, we are definitely going to place.

voiceDesc.cn: 你在看什么？有关我的报道？是关于我们之前发布的论文？啊……原来是讲这些……我家里的事，你直接问我不就好了。父母走后，是舅舅和小姨悉心抚养我长大，只不过，他们每个人都有自己的工作，不能时时刻刻陪着我。所以从小到大，我很渴望身边能多些朋友；可真有了朋友，却又觉得还是一个人更清净。
voiceDesc.en: What are you reading? Oh, it's about me? The paper we published earlier? Ah... I see, it's about my family. You could have just asked me directly. After my parents passed, my uncle and aunt raised me with great care. But they each had their own responsibilities and couldn't always be by my side. So, from a young age, I longed for more companionship. And yet, when I finally found friends, I started missing the quiet and peace of solitude.

voiceDesc.cn: 武陵城的风波虽已平息，但也不难预见，之后会有怎样的挫折困顿等在前方。别紧张，管理员，多难多苦，我们都会一直陪在你身边。冬天总会过去，春天总会再来。人说踏雪凌霜行千里，定不负，来年春晓——下个春天的好风景，我们一起去看。
voiceDesc.en: Peace may have returned to Wuling City, but we can easily foresee the many trials and challenges that lie ahead. Don't worry, Endmin. No matter how difficult things may be, we will stay by your side. Winter always yields to spring. As the saying goes, the verdant season does not disappoint those who brave the snow and frost, as it shall wake as promised. And when the beauty of new spring finally arrives, let us go and admire it together.

voiceDesc.cn: 你提的方向和我们此前的设想很是契合，但在技术上一直未能突破。既然有了全新的解决思路……噢，我只是突然被窗外的花香味吸引了。今年的花开得很早呢，真好……管理员，既然良景如此，我们不如移步室外去聊？
voiceDesc.en: What you proposed harmonizes well with our earlier vision, though the technical barriers have long eluded us. Now that a new path has revealed itself... Ah, forgive me, my thoughts were carried off by the fragrance drifting in from the window. The flowers have bloomed so early this year, how wonderful... Endmin, since the season itself invites us, shall we take our discussion outdoors?

voiceDesc.cn: 武陵城里有很多植物都是天师们从自己家乡带来的，刚把它们移栽进土里时，我总觉得是他们扯下了一片家的模样，贴在了武陵，以后想家了，就来这儿看看。后来，我才明白，他们是把自己的家打包进了种子，在武陵生根，武陵就是家了。
voiceDesc.en: Many of the plants in Wuling were gifts from Tianshi brought from their homelands. When I first saw them rooted here, I thought it was as though they had taken a piece of home and pinned it upon Wuling's earth, so they could look upon it whenever homesickness crept in. Only later did I realize that it wasn't just the seeds that had taken root — they had as well. To them, Wuling was no longer a stranger, but a home.

voiceDesc.cn: 加入溶液五毫升……嗯，颜色变化正常，没有沉淀或者浑浊。还有催化剂，辅助释放风味物质……得控制下温度，防止焦化……缓缓加入，溶解速率良好……欸，管理员？没有没有，我没在做实验，我正在……做饭？弭弗以前总抱怨我吃得不健康，不是速食就是外卖，现在闲下来，就想自己学着做点什么吃，你要尝尝吗？
voiceDesc.en: Add five milliliters of the solution... Okay, color change looks normal — no weird precipitate or cloudiness. Next, a little catalyst to bring out the flavor... Temperature is fine, nothing is burning. Dissolution rate looks okay... Hmm, Endmin? No, no, I'm not running an experiment. Actually I'm ... I'm cooking. Mi Fu always criticized me for living on instant food or takeout, so with some free time at last, I thought I'd try making something myself. Want to give it a taste?

voiceDesc.cn: 呼……稍、稍等，我刚晨跑完，让我喘口气。对、对啊，我知道现在是凌晨五点。这也没什么吧？四点起，五点结束运动，五点半开始工作，十几年都是这样子。没，我不爱睡长觉的，说原因嘛，就当我太贪心了吧。想做的，想要的都太多，只好拿时间来换了。不过话说回来，你又为什么一个人在实验室？
voiceDesc.en: Whew ... a moment, if you please. I just finished my morning run and need a breath. Y-yes, I'm aware it's five in the morning, but that's nothing out of the ordinary. Up at four, exercise done by five, at my desk by half past five ... this rhythm has carried me through more than a decade. No, I was never fond of sleeping in. There's simply too much I wish to do and achieve, so I trade sleep for time. That said ... what brings you alone to the lab at such an hour?

voiceDesc.cn: 算一算日子，也快到前辈们的忌日了。管理员，你要是有空，可以陪我一起去趟安思园吗？很可惜，当年我不能为他们收殓尸骨，送回各自的家乡。我很清楚，斯人已逝，不论在武陵设立几座纪念馆，几块纪念碑，都于事无补，但终归……还能让他们留在大家的记忆中，多一分，多一秒。
voiceDesc.en: It will soon be the anniversary of my late seniors. Endmin, if you have the time, will you walk with me to the Serenity Garden? I still regret that I could not gather their remains and return them to their homelands. And I understand that no monument in Wuling can bring them back. Yet if, through these memorials, we can keep their memory alive, even for a moment longer, then their efforts were not in vain.

voiceDesc.cn: 是啊，武陵城建在裂隙旁有多危险，我何尝不知道呢？但当年建城时，我们没有任何人想过要离开。武陵城继承了科考站的使命，天师们不会后退，这座城……也不会后退。
voiceDesc.en: Of course building Wuling City right next to the rift is extremely dangerous. I knew that better than anyone else. But nobody wanted to relocate the city when we rebuilt it. Wuling inherited the duty of the Science Station, and the Tianshi will never falter. Nor will this city.

voiceDesc.cn: 比起自己的安危，前辈们更在乎如何让自己的研究成果在灾难中保存下来。即使在我看来，失去他们才是更大的损失。息壤可以再造，但人却不能再生。可管理员，我也清楚，科研路上，重来的机会少得可怜。但愿意在这条道路上继续钻研的后来者，却源源不断。我想……前辈们正是知道这一点，才做出那样的决定。
voiceDesc.en: My predecessors placed the preservation of their scientific achievements above their own lives. Yet to me, it is their passing that feels like the greater loss. While Xiranite can be reproduced, the departed cannot return. I understand that in the pursuit of science, opportunities to begin anew are painfully rare. Even so, there are always those who choose to walk this path with resolve. Perhaps ... my predecessors understood this well, when they made their choice.

voiceDesc.cn: 弭弗她……真的很有意思，当时武陵城初建，一件件事堆过来，我常会一个人跑到城外的山上静心……算了，不怕你笑话，说是静静，其实是背着人抹眼泪去了。当时弭弗还是清波寨的人，见了我，总是挥着拳头就来了，可唯独那次碰见我，她却什么也没说，陪我坐了一夜。
voiceDesc.en: Mi Fu is ... quite interesting. When we first started building Wuling City, challenges came one after another, and I often escaped to the mountains to find peace. Don't laugh, but "finding peace" was just an excuse. In truth, I was quietly wiping away my tears. Back then, Mi Fu still belonged to Qingbo Stockade, and she would always come at me swinging her fists. Except that one night, she said nothing and simply sat beside me until dawn, keeping me company.

voiceDesc.cn: 我现在面前确实有两条路，一条是继续息壤的研究，一条是放弃息壤，开始其他的项目。我能预见，即使现在放手，息壤研究在天师府同僚手中，也会按照预定的道路推进下去。我也是时候，在更需要我的领域，尽些力气。可……一想到这项目有可能是前辈们唯一留下的东西，我又怎么能放得下呢。
voiceDesc.en: Right now, I'm faced with two choices: continue my Xiranite study, or turn to other pursuits. I know that even if I step aside, my colleagues at the Tianshi Bureau will carry on the research along its intended course. And perhaps it's time I contribute more where I'm most needed. Yet this project may be the sole legacy of my seniors; how could I possibly walk away from it?

voiceDesc.cn: 快，赶紧坐下来帮我拆盲盒，研究院里的息壤炉被拆掉后，厂家和我商量，决定在十周年纪念款龙泡泡中加入息壤元素……的确，他们是说要送我一套，但要不是自己拆出来，乐趣何在呢？更何况，十二个里面抽一个，盲盒抽中的概率已经很高了，真正难的是研究出成果，花一辈子……也未必等得到那一天。
voiceDesc.en: Quick, sit with me and help me open these blind boxes. After the Xiranite forge at the Institute was decommissioned, the manufacturer and I embedded Xiranite elements into the 10th Anniversary Limited Edition Chubby Lung. They offered to send me a full set, but where's the thrill in that? Hehe. Besides, the odds of winning are one in twelve, which is quite generous compared to the unpredictability of scientific research, where even a lifetime of effort doesn't guarantee success.

voiceDesc.cn: 有些好东西，我们不算白来。
voiceDesc.en: There is something of value here. Our journey has not been in vain.

voiceDesc.cn: 真是片风水宝地……也不知道有什么宝贝藏在这里。
voiceDesc.en: What a blessed land... I wonder what marvels are buried here.

voiceDesc.cn: “未知”……这个词真的能诱惑到我。
voiceDesc.en: The "unknown"... A profoundly alluring concept...

voiceDesc.cn: 小心，来者不善，可别莽撞。
voiceDesc.en: This is no friendly encounter. Proceed with caution.

voiceDesc.cn: 我做学生时，采集矿物的效率可不输你。
voiceDesc.en: When I was in school, I could collect minerals as efficiently as you.

voiceDesc.cn: 别急，我来帮你。
voiceDesc.en: Steady. I'll help you.

voiceDesc.cn: 这东西可了不得，在哪里都能派得上用场。
voiceDesc.en: This is no ordinary object. It could have many purposes.

voiceDesc.cn: 收集它的方式值得我们好好研究一番。
voiceDesc.en: It's worth taking a close look at how Aurylene is collected.

voiceDesc.cn: 或许，侵蚀的清除效率还能进一步提升。
voiceDesc.en: I wonder if there's a way to clear the Blight more effectively.

voiceDesc.cn: 暂且歇歇吧，留着精力，更难的还在后面呢。
voiceDesc.en: Never hesitate to take a break. What lies ahead could prove even more demanding.

voiceDesc.cn: 这有些药，你拿去。
voiceDesc.en: Here, use this medicine.

voiceDesc.cn: 是好些了。
voiceDesc.en: Much better.

voiceDesc.cn: 小心！
voiceDesc.en: Careful!

voiceDesc.cn: 没事，不用管我。
voiceDesc.en: It's nothing. Don't worry about me.

voiceDesc.cn: 管理员……抱歉。
voiceDesc.en: Apologies... Endmin...

voiceDesc.cn: 干净利落，真漂亮。
voiceDesc.en: Clean and slick. Nice move!

voiceDesc.cn: 堪称……天衣无缝。
voiceDesc.en: Your execution was impeccable.

voiceDesc.cn: 过奖了。
voiceDesc.en: You flatter me.

voiceDesc.cn: 哪里，都是大家的功劳。
voiceDesc.en: Oh, it was a team effort.

voiceDesc.cn: 不怕苦战，只怕无谓之战。
voiceDesc.en: We fear no hard fight, only a futile one.

voiceDesc.cn: 我这就来。
voiceDesc.en: I'll be right there.

voiceDesc.cn: 赢这一次，其实不算很难。
voiceDesc.en: Truth be told, this wasn't a hard-won battle.

voiceDesc.cn: 你信吗，管理员？下一次，我们也会赢。
voiceDesc.en: Believe it, Endmin. Victory will be ours next time as well.

voiceDesc.cn: 辛苦诸位了。
voiceDesc.en: Thank you all for your hard work.

voiceDesc.cn: 能咬牙坚持下来，就不算输。
voiceDesc.en: If you never give up, you never really lose.

voiceDesc.cn: 人还在，那就什么都在。
voiceDesc.en: So long as we still stand, nothing is truly lost.

voiceDesc.cn: 灭。
voiceDesc.en: Purge.

voiceDesc.cn: 无用。
voiceDesc.en: Abysmal.

voiceDesc.cn: 落青霆！
voiceDesc.en: Thunder roars!

voiceDesc.cn: 释剑去！
voiceDesc.en: Blades unleashed!

voiceDesc.cn: 风雷动！
voiceDesc.en: Storm awakens!

voiceDesc.cn: 嗯，就等你了！
voiceDesc.en: Ready when you are!

voiceDesc.cn: 这就来！
voiceDesc.en: I'm with you!

voiceDesc.cn: 还不服软？
voiceDesc.en: Yield now!

voiceDesc.cn: 何苦胡搅蛮缠！
voiceDesc.en: Futile struggle!

voiceDesc.cn: 破绽百出。
voiceDesc.en: How inept.

voiceDesc.cn: 不成气候。
voiceDesc.en: Incompetent.

voiceDesc.cn: 惊霆无声，流电掣雨。
voiceDesc.en: A hush of thunder, a streak of rain.

voiceDesc.cn: 雷雨并作，化育万物。
voiceDesc.en: A burst of storm, a birth of life.

voiceDesc.cn: 青霄碧落，乌云尽扫。
voiceDesc.en: A reign of blue, a lance of sun.

弭弗，宏山科学院下辖武陵科学发展区巡卫队队长，以交流形式访问终末地工业，由特种技术部门负责对接。

弭弗队长说是要来看望几个在终末地的老朋友，但来到这里之后，她的眼神很明显在打量每一位干员的战斗力，还时不时轻声对遇见的干员说：“不想和我比划比划吗？”看到训练室，她眉毛一挑，眼睛都亮了。体验过后，她表示：“要是知道这里能打得这么痛快，我早就该来了！”并立即把访问日程延长了几天。总之，希望她在终末地的交流之旅能够尽兴。
——终末地人事助理 马丁·马文·马伦
recordDesc.en:
Mi Fu is the Watchguard Captain of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District under the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). She is currently an exchange visitor at Endfield Industries. The Specialist Tech Division is responsible for her reception. 

Captain Mi Fu claimed the purpose of her visit was to see a few old friends from Endfield. But since her arrival, it has become obvious that she has been studying and judging every operator by their combat prowess. On several occasions, she said these words softly to operators she came across: "Interested in sparring with me?" When Mi Fu saw our training cabins, she raised an eyebrow and became interested at once. After experiencing the facilities offered, she expressed: "I would have been here ages ago if I knew the place offered great fights like this!" And immediately extended the duration of her visit by a few more days. In any case, we hope her exchange visit to Endfield will be as enriching and entertaining as possible. 
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries

【武陵科学发展区人事晋升记录】
姓名：弭弗
籍贯：武陵
工作年限：三年
现任职务：武陵巡卫队队员
拟担任职务：武陵巡卫队队长

履历与简况：
原本来自清波寨，后成为武陵科学发展区在编人员。于武陵城建立后，担任巡卫。任职以来，常驻一线，熟悉城内外安全环境，处置各类突发案件果断迅速。忠于武陵城，对违法犯罪绝不姑息，坚决打击。在基层民众中口碑较好，具有一定威慑力和号召力。

优点：
战斗能力突出，身体素质过硬，具备处理高风险挑战的能力。
处事果断，执行力强，能在复杂局面中迅速做出行动。
对下属关心照顾，能够在队伍中形成较强凝聚力。
民众基础较好，获得一定信任与支持。民众评价她“是有点冲，但为人公道”。

不足：
暴力倾向明显，遇事习惯以拳脚先行，缺乏程序意识。
文书、汇报等工作能力略显不足，政务能力有限。
性格急躁，沟通耐心不足，易与他人发生摩擦。
对熟识人员过度信任，情感因素可能影响判断。

综合评定：
弭弗在巡防和打击犯罪中成绩突出，多次平息突发案件，属可倚重的实干型干部。但其作风强硬粗直，程序观念淡薄，存在越权风险。民众满意度高，整体表现功过并存，需继续加强约束与引导。

鉴定意见：
弭弗性烈如火，善恶分明。她虽常出格，但未尝违心。其拳头所指，绝非为己，皆为守护百姓。虽有鲁莽暴力之嫌，实因胸中无弯绕；她有程序之疏，不善辞令，实则粗中有细。其短处在此，其长处亦在此。
本人愿对其品行与立场做出担保，建议由其担任武陵巡卫队队长职务，作为维护武陵治安的中坚力量，并由本人在日常工作中予以监督与辅导。

DOCUMENT: HR Promotion Records of Wuling Scientific Developmental District 
NAME: Mi Fu 
REGION OF ORIGIN: Wuling 
WORK EXPERIENCE: 3 years 
CURRENT POSITION: Wuling Watchguard 
PROPOSED PROMOTION: Wuling Watchguard Captain 

CURRICULUM VITAE & BACKGROUND: 
Mi Fu was a Qingbo Stockade resident who was later recruited by the Wuling Scientific Developmental District, and was made a watchguard after the completion of Wuling City. Since assuming the role, she has constantly worked at the frontlines, demonstrating extensive knowledge regarding security issues within Wuling City and the peripheral regions, as well as decisiveness and alacrity when handling various emergencies and cases. Mi Fu is committed to Wuling City, has zero tolerance for any form of delinquency or criminality, and always acts with strict justice. She has a good reputation, exercises effective deterrence, and serves as a rallying point for the general public. 

STRENGTHS: 
Exceptional combat prowess. Impressive physicals and fortitude. Capable of handling high-risk threats. 
Decisive and skilled in executing orders. Capable of making the right calls when facing complex situations. 
Caring and nurturing towards those working under her. Capable of forming a strong, cohesive team. 
Good reputation among the general populace and has earned their trust and support. Public reviews include: "A little blunt but always just." 

AREAS TO IMPROVE ON: 
Over eagerness in applying force. Tendency to employ physical measures when resolving various situations. Lack of procedural awareness. 
Slight disadvantage in clerical work such as report drafting. Limited administrative skills. 
Quick tempered. Lacks patience for communication. Prone to conflicts with others. 
Gives inordinate trust to familiar individuals. Decision-making may be affected by personal relationships and emotions. 

OVERALL RATING: 
Mi Fu has delivered remarkable results in patrol work and law enforcement. Having successfully quelled multiple emergencies, she is a promising officer who can be relied upon for field work. However, she inclines toward blunt approaches that lack finesse, has poor procedural awareness, and runs the risk of violating the proper chain of command. Nevertheless, the general public is very satisfied with Mi Fu's performance. The candidate has made positive contributions, although mistakes are not absent. Further guidance and strengthening of her self-restraint will be required. 

OPINIONS OF THE REVIEWER(S): 
Mi Fu has a fiery disposition and a great passion for upholding justice. Though she often acts out of turn, her actions are never meant for ill. She swings her fists not for herself, but for the safety of the people. Callousness is a mere outcome of her straightforwardness. Occasions of procedural non-compliance and lack of clerical perfection only hide, not cancel, her meticulous attention to detail. She may fall short in such areas, but they are also where she excels. 
I am willing to vouch for her character and good standing, and to recommend her for promotion to Watchguard Captain of Wuling City, where she will become the mainstay of the city's public safety. I will also personally supervise and guide Mi Fu in her daily work. 

REVIEWER(S): Zhuang Fangyi 
October 19, Year 145

哼，红脸婆啊，说起来我和她从小就是一路玩过来，打过来的。小时候谁不服谁，抬手就干一架，打到两边都鼻青脸肿才算完事。那时候她凶是凶，可我也不怕她。后来她跑去武陵城了，成了什么“巡卫队长”，见面就更爱摆臭脸。可我知道，她再怎么瞪眼，巡卫那身皮下面还是她。
现在再动手，应该会打个平手吧——不过将来我肯定会赢回来。现在她力气是比我大，可别忘了，我从小就比她灵活，早晚要让她跌个大跟头。
说到拿武陵东西的事，她可难缠得很。明明一切都算计好了，结果在仓库附近就碰见她，像是早就等在那里一样。打起来也占不了多少便宜，有时还免不了吃亏。不过话说回来，她也没把寨里的兄弟姐妹往死里逼，倒是有几个，被她抓进了武陵城，结果待着待着就不回来了，还说那里有活路。
总之，我才不服呢。红脸婆啊红脸婆，早晚我要亲手打服你，让你知道本大当家才是最厉害的。
——汤汤，清波寨大当家

我啊，就是被弭弗抓的。那时候我跟着人去搬点东西，结果被她堵个正着，吓得腿都软了。结果她下手没我想象的重，完了就问一句：“要不要在武陵城待一阵子？”我当时糊里糊涂地点了头，结果真就被她带了进去。
一开始还觉得，她这不是刁难人吗？可后来在城里找了份活，有屋住，有口饭吃，慢慢才明白过来，她其实是在给我们出路。她嘴上不好听，总是板着脸，可没少替我们这些人操心。
听人说，她经常往竹林那片送些物资，都是武陵城多出来的东西。我当时还纳闷，这些淘汰的东西有啥用。后来才知道，是给寨里人拿的。她表面上天天跟寨子过不去，可心里一直都惦记着。
——某武陵城居民，原清波寨寨民
recordDesc.en:
Hmph. That mad woman! I actually grew up with her and gave her many good beat ups. We don't like each other but I like to give her buggly bruises and she tried to give some back. Mad Mimi was seriously mad back then, but okay. I ain't scared of her. Anyway, she later ran off to Wuling, got herself a badge, and even got promo-ed to be a "Watchguard Captain". She thought it gave her the right to put on a stupid stinkface. Yeah, whatever. She can do that stinkface glare all day. I know what's under her stupid watchguard skin. Mad woman. That's who! 
If I fight her again, we probably end up in a draw. But you'll see. Chief Supreme's gonna win eventually. So what if she's got bigger arms? Don't you forget! I've always been faster and wiser and dodgier. I'll give her absolute wreckage. 
Yeah, and about our Wuling raids, that Mad woman's big trouble. The Fam got everything planned out but we just kept running into her at the depot and warehouse and hidey spots. Like she's already waiting for us. We gave a good fight but Mimi's got a nasty crew and threw many of us in da slammer. Worse, she also tried to undermine our Stockade biz by treating the captured Fam really well. Some of the Fam decided to stay in Wuling 'coz the food and living are better. 
You'll see! I'm gonna pawn that mad woman real good. On my own. Alright? Just you wait, mad woman! Chief Supreme is coming to town and putting you at the baby seat! 
— Tangtang, Supreme Chief of Qingbo Stockade 

Yeh, Fam. Mi Fu threw me in jail. I was hauling phat lewt with the Fam when she suddenly appeared in our way. My legs turned to noodles at once. Then she knocked me around a bit but it wasn't that bad. Anyway, she asked: "Wanna stay in town for a while?" Look, man, I was seeing double and there were stars all around me. I didn't know if I nodded or not, but she really dragged me to town. 
At first I be like, man, I was going straight to hell! But later I got a job at town, roof and bed, plus nice food. Then I learned that Mad Mimi be giving us options. She got that mean face and talked like I owed her money, but Mimi probably had to go plow through tons of burdo-shite trying to get some of the Fam decent gigs. 
Oh yeah, you heard, the loot stashes at the grove that we've been nicking from the Wulingers are actually extra supplies from town. I was a bit confused why bother carry the old and obsolete tools to that place. Turned out they were meant for the Stockade. People say Mad Mimi is super tough on the Stockade Fam, but actually she's always helping and caring in her sneaky way. 
— Anonymous, current citizen of Wuling (former Qingbo Stockade resident)

recordDesc.cn:
《清波武艺考》（节录）
“清波武艺”发源于武陵地区的清波寨聚落，并一直在其居民内部传承，甚至连《武典补遗》也未曾记录。
要理解清波寨武艺的特点，就不得不追溯清波寨的历史。耻辱战争前后，一批炎国的难民决心远离纷争与战乱，来到了如今的武陵地区。武陵甚大裂隙既是对他们生活的威胁，也是保护他们不受各种敌人骚扰的屏障。他们就此定居了下来，逐步建立了清波寨。从某种意义上说，他们是武陵地区的“原住民”。
这么看来，清波寨似乎是一座“世外桃源”，但事实并非如此。在武陵甚大裂隙的影响下，这里的自然环境可以算是十分恶劣，横行的天使、凶猛的野生动物和频繁发生的裂隙活动，使得清波寨的居民经常需要与外在“敌人”斗争。在激烈的对抗中，逐渐形成了具有清波寨特色的武艺。这既是一种强身健体的体操，也是一种活用身体机能的源石技艺。其中一些招式，颇具在地特色。
譬如著名的“涌泉步”，沿着溪流闲庭信步，却可以让水面翻涌。最初我以为这是靠意念控制水流的巫术，但实际上，是运用源石技艺，将能量聚集在脚步上，以精妙的控制传导到水中，引发其震动的武术。再如“飞竹叶尖”，要在物理意义上踩着竹叶凌空前行，就要讲究在脆弱的竹叶上发力，以施展源石技艺的“一丝细腻的韧劲”。这些微妙的感觉，修炼得当，可以在极其微小的动作下，就爆发出恐怖的“拳劲”。
清波武艺的传人、武陵科学发展区巡卫队队长弭弗，将这股“拳劲”形容为一道“雷”。攻击敌人时，将身体作为发力的“铳”，起似飞龙在天，落如雷霆挫地。笔者观摩了弭弗队长清剿天使的战斗，确实有如同雷霆般的气势，甚至可以与天师雷法相埒。
除了强大的武艺，清波寨内还形成了独特的格斗文化。很长一段时间里，清波寨的习武之人热衷于相互挑战。每逢“打擂”的日子，全寨的男女老少都会兴致勃勃地前往观看，为对决呐喊助威。在加入武陵之前，弭弗队长就曾是打遍全寨无敌手的强者。可惜清波寨的擂台最近遭遇损坏，正在大修，笔者无缘访问，只能委托弭弗队长在修好后再提供相关影像资料。
笔者曾向弭弗队长表达想要采访清波武艺的大宗师，也就是她大师父“江伏翁”的愿望，但弭弗队长说，大师父业已归隐，自己也不知道他如今在哪里。弭弗队长向笔者展示了一张二师父寄来的明信片，上面说大师父在文明环带一座城市的街头看两个小孩打架，盯了一个多钟头才依依不舍地离开。临走前，那个老人还喟然长叹：练了一辈子武，还不如两个小孩打架来得痛快，想打就打，打完就没事了，令人神往。
最后，笔者向弭弗队长提议整理清波武艺的资料，编入《武典补遗续编》，弭弗队长欣然同意。她表示有更多人能够用这拳头保护武陵，再好不过。或许到那个时候，她就可以放下这里（指武陵），重新开始那久违的、想打就打的痛快日子了。
recordDesc.en:
DOCUMENT: A Study of Qingbo Martial Arts (Excerpt) 
The origins of Qingbo Martial Arts can be traced back to the village known as Qingbo Stockade in the region of Wuling. It is a practiced tradition of the Stockade residents. However, this collection of fighting techniques is so esoteric that it was not recorded in the Addendum to the Martial Codex. 
One must study the history of Qingbo Stockade to understand the unique features of Qingbo Martial Arts. During the lead-up to the Humiliation War and the several years that followed, a group of Yanese refugees who were determined to distance themselves from factional conflicts and warfare traveled to what became the modern region of Wuling. The Wuling Very Large Rift (VLR) did pose a threat but also provided a barrier against hostile raids and attacks. The refugees thus decided to settle and build a village that eventually grew into Qingbo Stockade. According to some, these Stockaders were the original residents of Wuling. 
From this perspective, Qingbo Stockade seems to be a peaceful sanctuary, but this assumption is far from the truth. The Wuling VLR has created a very hostile environment with large numbers of roaming Aggeloi, fearsome wild beasts, and frequent rift activities. The Stockaders have been constantly fighting against these outside "enemies" and these intense battles gradually gave rise to several combat techniques unique to the Qingbo Stockade. Training in these techniques not only strengthens the body but also heightens one's control over their innate Originium Arts. A few of the moves and skills also highlight the unique features of the Qingbo area. 
An example is the famous "Stride of Surging Spring" that allows martial artists to effortlessly stroll across a flowing river while leaving roiling currents in their wake. At first I mistook it for a form of witchcraft that mentally manipulates flowing water. But the Stride turns out to be an Originium Arts technique that focuses Arts energy into the tips of the feet, then channels it into the water with incredible precision to generate resonating vibrations. Another example is the "Jaunt Across Bamboo Leaves" that is literally leapmancy using flimsy bamboo leaves as support. The technique involves applying a "sliver of resilient pulse" of Originium Arts upon fragile-looking bamboo leaves. Such levels of finesse and control, if honed properly, could unleash a terrifying burst of "Pulser Punch" with barely any movement. 
Watchguard Captain Mi Fu of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District happens to be a practitioner of Qingbo Martial Arts. She described the "Pulser Punch" as a "bolt of lightning". When attacking the enemy, the martial artist should treat the body like a "handcannon", soar like a flying Lung, and descend like a lightning blast. This humble author has personally witnessed Captain Mi Fu in action during a mission to eradicate the Aggeloi. She struck them with such force that her moves seem on par with the Tianshi Lei Fa (Thunder Arts). 
In addition to their powerful martial arts, the Stockaders also established a unique tradition of martial competition. For many years, all martial artists of Qingbo Stockade eagerly challenged each other to see who was the best. On the day of the Arena Showdown, every Stockader, regardless of gender or age, would gather to witness the fights and cheer on their favorite contenders. Captain Mi Fu herself was an undisputed champion of the Stockade before she joined Wuling. Unfortunately, the Stockade arena was undergoing major repairs due to recent damage when the author was penning this section. Deprived of the opportunity to visit the site in person, I could only ask Captain Mi Fu to send me photographs or other image data of the repaired arena. 
I once expressed to Captain Mi Fu my wish to interview the Grand Master of Qingbo Martial Arts, the "River-Tamer" himself. However, the Captain told me that the Grand Master became a hermit and even she did not know where he went. The Captain also showed me a postcard sent by her Senior Master that talked about their travels. The Grand Master's attention was held, for more than an hour, by two kids fighting each other at some alleyway of the Civilization Band. Before leaving, the old man sighed and said: "Trained all my life, but still I envy these kids. They fight when they want and remain friends afterwards. A beautiful sight indeed." 
Finally, I gave Captain Mi Fu a proposal for organizing and compiling information related to Qingbo Martial Arts, and including it within the Continuation for the Addendum to the Martial Codex. The Captain happily agreed and expressed that it was her wish to have more people to protect Wuling with their fists. When that day arrives, she could leave the place (Wuling) and restart her lifelong wish of fighting whenever she wanted.

recordDesc.cn:
“管理员，能不能帮忙拖住弭弗一天？”
某个深夜，彦宁忽然慌慌张张地找到管理员，表示有急事相求。
据彦宁说，她在帮忙整理庄方宜办公桌上的杂物时，看到了一封给弭弗的信，于是就顺手寄给了巡卫驻地。
但她很快得知，这封信原本并不打算马上寄出。换言之，“如果在阿庄想要的时间之前让弭弗读到这封信，那就麻烦了！你能不能帮忙盯着她，我去追回这封信！”
于是管理员以“观摩”为名，陪弭弗度过了一天的执勤。
从清晨搭救被天使困住的行商，上午新巡卫的魔鬼训练，午后调停方兴衢商户的纠纷，到在竹林里偶遇“大当家”……弭弗的拳头没有停过，但始终有效。
连轴转的一天结束，暮色四合，但管理员仍然没有去意——彦宁还没有成功找到那封信。
回到巡卫驻地，弭弗点亮昏黄的台灯，开始写例行文书。窸窸窣窣的风声从窗外传来，她猛地扔下笔，追出门，却只见风掠过落叶。这一天，她似乎总是心不在焉。
弭弗回到桌前，合上案卷，掏出了那封一早签收但来不及阅读的、揉皱了的、沾着汗渍的、来自总桩办公室的信件……

【一封本不打算寄出的信】
弭弗：
你读到这封信的时候，我应该已经动身了。如果我没能回来，以后武陵城里的治安和行政事务，就得靠你多担待。
你是一步步陪着这座武陵城，从荒地上简陋的工地，变成如今楼宇成形、街市有序的样子的。你和大家一起搬过砖，守过夜，用拳头把麻烦都抵挡在外。我相信你和这里有深厚的连接，所以能放心把这担子交给你。
你从来不怕事，这是好事。但你脾气急，遇事爱硬顶。我知道你只是性子直，但保护一座城市，比起动拳头、决胜负，更需要费心思量。有时候三思而后行，不是软弱，而是为了让事情更稳，我也能更放心。
还有清波寨的事。你心里总绷着那根弦，见到他们就像火星碰见火星。其实你的心是软的，有些人不懂，我看得清，这没什么可羞愧的。以后，你可以大大方方地和汤汤做朋友。
对了，原本我劝你练字，是希望磨炼你的耐心，没想到你的字和拳头一样刚直险峻。现在你的字已经练得很好了，以后不用再花那么多时间。当然，如果空闲的时候有兴致，可以找葛天师请教。不过找他的时候不用带糖油粑粑，他的健康状况不允许。
你常说这辈子吃够了甜食，再也不想碰，怕被腻到吐。但我一直想对你说，喜欢的东西，不必强忍。忙忙碌碌，能让自己高兴的机会不常有，总得留点小快乐。偶尔再吃几块，也没什么大不了的。
最后说点心里话。我真正想交给你的，不是这座城，而是你自己。记得第一次见你时，你还是个小丫头，眼睛里全是火光，挥着拳头，一眨眼就冲到了我面前。这些年，你身上的担子越来越重，挥剑挥拳越来越凌厉，但眉头总不见舒展，反倒看不见真实的你。
所以记住，如果有一天你觉得不痛快了，不想干了，那就放下。别觉得愧对谁，也别怕别人说什么。你要去哪里都行，回寨里也好，去远方也好，甚至什么都不做也行。你不是被武陵拴住的人，你应该是自由的。
照顾好自己。该笑的时候，就笑出来吧。

庄方宜
recordDesc.en:
"Endmin! Please help me keep Mi Fu occupied for a day!" It was late at night when Yan Ning paid a sudden visit to the Endministrator for an extremely urgent business. 
According to Yan Ning, she saw a sealed letter to be sent to Mi Fu while she was cleaning Zhuang Fangyi's desk. She thus took it upon herself to mail it to the Watchguard's barracks. 
But she quickly learned that the letter was not meant to be delivered at once. In Yan Ning's words: "If Mi Fu reads the letter before the hour intended by Fangyi, things could get really bad! Please keep Mi Fu distracted while I intercept the letter's delivery!" 
And hence, the Endministrator used the excuse of "live auditing" and kept Mi Fu company for the entirety of her daily shift. 
It began early in dawn when a traveling merchant surrounded by the Aggeloi called for help. Captain Mi then spent the entire morning mercilessly training the new watchguards. In the afternoon, she had to arbitrate disputes between shop owners of Fangxing Avenue followed by an unexpected encounter of the "Supreme Chief" at the bamboo grove... Mi Fu's fists never rested, yet they remained effective as always. 
Her restless shift finally ended when the sun has finally set and night took over. Still the Endministrator remained as Yan Ning has not yet intercepted or retrieved the letter. 
Back at the watchguard barracks, Mi Fu turned on the desk lamp and began filling in the procedural files and records under its warm, yellow glow. The wind outside made whistling sounds. She suddenly lowered her pen and headed outside, but saw nothing but loose leaves carried in the breeze. The Captain had felt rather restless on this day. 
Mi Fu returned to her desk and closed the case files. From her pocket she took out a letter from the Main Pillar Office, creased and soaked in sweat. She had signed and accepted it in the morning but never found time to read it. 

DOCUMENT: A Letter Not Intended for Delivery 
Mi Fu: 
I'm probably already on my way by the time you read this letter. In the event that I do not make it back, I will be counting on you to handle all public safety and administrative affairs of Wuling City. 
You have accompanied Wuling in every step. You were there when it was just a simple construction site in the wilderness and stayed till it became a city with beautiful buildings and orderly roads. You toiled with the construction crew, stood the night watch, and kept trouble at bay with your fists. I know your ties to Wuling run deep, and this is why I entrust this heavy duty to you. 
You never shied away from duty or responsibility. That is your strength. But your temper lacks patience and is obstinate. I understand this is part of your character, but the task of defending a city goes beyond fighting off enemies and winning battles. It requires tact and mindfulness. Deliberating and acting with prudence are not signs of weakness, but measures taken to guarantee success and give me a peace of mind. 
There is also the matter of Qingbo Stockade. This subject pulls you taut and tense. Meeting fellow Stockaders seems to ignite your fuse, but I know you have been struggling to act with mercy. Some people might not know the truth, but I see it clearly. It is nothing to be ashamed of. You have every right to be a friend of Tangtang without feeling the need to keep it a secret. 
And remember when I advised you to practice calligraphy? At first I was hoping it could improve your patience, but your words turned out just as stern and unyielding as your fists, and assumed a beauty of their own. The lessons are no longer necessary, but of course, if you find calligraphy enjoyable and have the leisure of time, seek Tianshi Ge for advice. There is no need to bring Tangyou Baba to him. His health no longer allows them in his diet. 
You often said how you had enough sweets for your lifetime and never wanted to see them again because sweetness now makes you sick. But I believe otherwise. There is no need to avoid what you like. Duty is heavy and taxing. Rare are the opportunities of personal happiness, and tiny indulgences should be kept available. A piece or two every now and then will do no harm. 
Finally, I have a few personal words to say to you. What I wanted to give you most is not this city, but yourself. You were a young girl with a fiery gaze when I first met you. In a single blink you charged straight for me with a fist poised to strike. But years have passed. You took on greater responsibilities, your fists became more merciless, and your frowns never eased. I have not seen your true self for a while. 
So remember, if there comes a day when you feel unhappy and work becomes a chore, then just leave it at that. Do not feel beholden to anyone and just ignore what the others say. Go wherever you like. Head back to the Stockade or travel across Talos-II. You can even choose to do nothing. You owe Wuling nothing, and thus you should be free. 
Take care of yourself. Smile and laugh when the time is right. 

Zhuang Fangyi

voiceDesc.cn: 你亲自指挥？不赖。
voiceDesc.en: Leading this op yourself? Not bad.

voiceDesc.cn: 有架要打，找我就行。
voiceDesc.en: If there's a fight, I'm in.

voiceDesc.cn: 听凭调遣。
voiceDesc.en: I stand ready.

voiceDesc.cn: 让我瞧瞧，你们是怎么干的。
voiceDesc.en: Show me how you run things.

voiceDesc.cn: 我自己就是武器，擅长给对手“锦上添花”——就是让他们的身上挂彩。
voiceDesc.en: I am a weapon. I leave "souvenirs" on my opponents — bruises that they won't forget.

voiceDesc.cn: 这些玩意儿是为了保护我，还是保护我的对手？
voiceDesc.en: Are these for my safety, or my opponents'?

voiceDesc.cn: 我琢磨出了些新招，什么时候能露一手？
voiceDesc.en: I figured out some new tricks. When do I get to use them?

voiceDesc.cn: 这才是战斗啊，爽快！这些人都是你的手下？有空跟我比划比划吗？
voiceDesc.en: HEH! Now that's a real fight! Are they part of your crew? Care for some sparring?

voiceDesc.cn: 老实说，你干得挺不赖。没错，认可从来都是双向的。呼——行，我接受你的领导。
voiceDesc.en: If I'm being honest, you're doing just as well. Recognition goes both ways. Alright, I'll follow your lead.

voiceDesc.cn: 嚯，挺新鲜。在武陵，都是我给巡卫队员晋升，我自己已经有些日子没有站在被晋升的这一边了。
voiceDesc.en: Hah, this is new. Back in Wuling, I'm usually the one promoting the watchguards. It's been a long time since I stood on the receiving end myself.

voiceDesc.cn: 做领头的，和单打独斗完全不一样。你懂的吧，带着手下一群人，还得惦记这惦记那的，真没那么痛快。
voiceDesc.en: Leading a crew is night and day from going solo. You know what I mean, right? You've got people to manage, missions to juggle. It's just not as clean and slick as kicking ass yourself.

voiceDesc.cn: 你和头儿怎么都能想出那么多漂亮话的？我每次都只会拍拍他们的肩膀……嗯，你说你也可以拍拍我的肩膀？唉，这种事情你先说出来不就没意义了！
voiceDesc.en: I'm always wondering how you and Boss come up with those fancy words. The only trick I know is to give people a pat. What? You can give me a pat too? Tsk, aiya, saying it out loud ruins the point!

voiceDesc.cn: 不浪费时间了，这一次，换我来给你解决麻烦。不过，我的手段比较直白，损坏报销就交给终末地了！
voiceDesc.en: Enough talk. This time, I'll clean up the mess for you. But I do things directly. If something breaks, Endfield foots the bills.

voiceDesc.cn: 是时候好好活动活动了！
voiceDesc.en: Time for a real brawl!

voiceDesc.cn: 我们是过命的交情，对吧？
voiceDesc.en: We're battle-forged teammates, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 知道了。只不过，那些精密设备要是坏了，可别怪我。
voiceDesc.en: Alright. But if any delicate stuff gets wrecked, don't blame me.

voiceDesc.cn: 嘿，来了啊！
voiceDesc.en: Yo, you're here!

voiceDesc.cn: 忙着呢？好久没跟你过过招了。
voiceDesc.en: Busy? It's been a while since we last sparred.

voiceDesc.cn: 在这儿光站了一分钟，我就目击到至少三名可疑人士。哦？他们都是朋友？你的社会关系还真是复杂。
voiceDesc.en: I've barely been here a minute, yet I already spotted three suspicious individuals. Oh? Your friends? Your social circle is really something.

voiceDesc.cn: 我来这儿找谁？趁武陵没事儿，来见一些朋友，黎风、陈千语、潘师傅，还有小猫崽子……不过，能见到你，也不算白跑一趟。
voiceDesc.en: Why am I here? Came to visit some friends, since things quietened down at Wuling — Lifeng, Chen, Master Pan, and the little kitty... But just seeing you makes the trip worthwhile.

voiceDesc.cn: 你来晚了，纪念品已经一个都不剩全分完了。还能是什么？当然是刚出锅的糖油粑粑了。
voiceDesc.en: You're late. The souvenirs are gone. C'mon, what else could they be? Freshly fried sweet rice cakes, of course.

voiceDesc.cn: 比起武陵的街道和竹林，帝江号显得有点太安静了，真让人不习惯。嗯？我没说过吗？我最讨厌安静。安静的地方才最吵，人心里的声音会说个不停。
voiceDesc.en: Dijiang's way too quiet compared to Wuling's streets and groves. It doesn't feel natural to me. Oh? I never told you how much I hate quiet places? Well, they're actually the loudest. Because when everything goes quiet, the voice in your mind starts talking, and it just won't stop.

voiceDesc.cn: 不怕得罪你，我没那么喜欢这地儿。我喜欢天就是天，水就是水的地方。这儿的墙又冷又硬，活像个盒子把人盖在里面。什么？训练室空出来了？不早说！我去预定了！
voiceDesc.en: No offense, but I'm not a fan of this place. I like actual skies and actual water — not these cold walls boxing you in. What? The training gym's free? You should've said that earlier! I'm booking it now!

voiceDesc.cn: 在我刚练武的时候，有一晚，盯着满天的星星，心里暗自发誓，要打败这么多的对手。说不定其中一颗就是帝江号吧？没想到，我真一路“打”到这儿来了。
voiceDesc.en: When I first started training, there was a night I stared at the starry sky, and I secretly swore to myself: I'll defeat as many opponents as the stars above. Maybe Dijiang was one of those stars. And to think I actually "fought" my way here. Kinda surprised.

voiceDesc.cn: 拿着，这个。我自己做的……别笑！敢说出去，饶不了你。
voiceDesc.en: Here, take it. Made it myself... Don't laugh. If anyone else knows this, you're done.

voiceDesc.cn: 我俩什么交情，还送这个……嗯，不对。你觉得我们现在是什么样的交情了？
voiceDesc.en: C'mon, we're way past the gifting phase... Wait a sec. What phase are we at in our friendship right now?

voiceDesc.cn: 我和人结交的方式，就是过招。能赢能输，能熬能打的人，才算可靠。你？嗯……你应该早就超出“可靠”的程度了。
voiceDesc.en: I bond with people by fighting them. Only those who can take a win, a loss, and a beating are reliable. You? Hmm... I think you're way beyond "reliable".

voiceDesc.cn: 头儿把我留下的时候，我从没见过那么多种点心……也从没有吃过那么好吃的糖油粑粑。我玩儿命一样吃了三个月，吃得再也不想碰任何甜食。呵，血腥味儿也是甜的。对，我讨厌在武陵闻到血腥味儿。
voiceDesc.en: When the boss took me in, I'd never seen so many kinds of snacks ... or tasted sweet rice cakes that good. So I stuffed my face for three months straight, till I couldn't even look at anything remotely sweet. Heh, even blood smells sweet. And I hate smelling blood in Wuling.

voiceDesc.cn: 我那几个师父啊……三师父是个刀子嘴豆腐心，她的“鹤形”我一直没练成，被唠叨了好几年；二师父看上去让人望而生畏，但其实很温柔，当年我吃的穿的用的没少让他操心；只有大师父和我最合不来，但大家都说我的脾气和他最像：只会用拳头这一种方式，来解决所有的问题。
voiceDesc.en: Those who taught me how to fight...? Master was all bite but has a most gentle soul. I couldn't replicate her Crane Form and she nagged about that for years. Senior Master looked terrifying, but he was gentle. He worried over everything I ate, wore, and used. As for my Grand Master ... we never got along. Everyone says my temper is just like his. Both of us solved everything with our fists.

voiceDesc.cn: 拜师时师父给我算过命，说我注定只会与“对手”结缘。和对手战斗，和对手相识，再和对手分道扬镳。头儿、小猫崽子，还有那几位师父们，最后都成了我的对手。但你不一样——你从来都不是我的对手，反而一直在和我背靠背并肩作战。这种感觉……希望能长久一点。
voiceDesc.en: While being inducted as a disciple, my masters read my fortunes. They said I'd only bond with my "opponents". I'll fight them, befriend them, and then go our separate ways. The boss. Little kitty. Even my masters. Everyone ended up as my opponent. But you're different — We never fought face-to-face. Our battles were more like back-to-back and side-by-side. I hope this ... can last a little longer.

voiceDesc.cn: 来了终末地才知道，原来息壤堰、武陵城、清波寨……真的都这么小，小到几乎看不见，我还一直在这小圈子里打转。师父说得没错，活着就要翻一座又一座山，破一道又一道关隘。只要跟着你，接下来就有打不完的对手，是吧？
voiceDesc.en: Coming to Endfield made me realize something. The Xiranite Dam, Wuling City, and Qingbo Stockade ... They are so small and barely visible on the map. Yet I kept running circles in that tiny world. My masters are right. Life is all about busting my way through an endless range of mountains and obstacles. And if I stay by your side, there'll always be another fight waiting, yeah?

voiceDesc.cn: 这拳套看上去不错吧？你要不要试着戴戴看，保证一点都不沉。这是在我成为队长后配发的特别定制装备，用的是那年产的第一批息壤。真佩服那些天师，能让这拳套在打架的时候“随心所欲”，和我一起发怒——你见过吗？
voiceDesc.en: These gauntlets look neat, right? Wanna try them on? No worries. They aren't that heavy. I got these custom-made sluggers when I became captain. Crafted with the first batch of Xiranite produced that year. Gotta hand it to the Tianshi artificers. These gauntlets move with my "will" and even share my rage — Ever seen how they work?

voiceDesc.cn: 练武的基础，得学竹子，就城外到处都是的那种。静练站桩，像冬天的竹子，扎在土里一动不动；等熬到了春天，练实了一口气，身子里有了奔腾涌动的劲头，就能噌噌地生长。
voiceDesc.en: Martial training starts with bamboo mastery. The kind you see growing everywhere outside the city. For the silent stand, be like the winter bamboo, sunk into the ground and unmoving. Keep it up till spring to cultivate a strong chi that surges within, then release it for a spurt of growth. Such is the way of bamboo.

voiceDesc.cn: 刚开始学武时，大师父让我拿竹子当对手。拳头砸在竹子上，磕得生疼，指节磨得鲜血淋漓。但他告诉我，人不该怕竹子，应该让竹子怕我，逼我咬着牙继续打。不知道练了多久，只记得后来有一天，拳头再也不怕竹子了，接着是石头、铁器、天使……只有先毫不畏惧地向对手挥拳，才有可能战胜他。
voiceDesc.en: When my training began, Grand Master told me to fight the bamboo. I pounded them till my knuckles were bruised and bleeding. Then he said, "Don't fear bamboo. Make bamboo fear you." So I clenched my teeth and kept at it. Can't remember how long it took, but one day came when my fists stopped flinching. Then I fought stone, ferrium, and the Aggeloi... You gotta summon your courage and throw that punch. Only then you stand a chance of winning.

voiceDesc.cn: 我的房间里为什么挂着那么多书法帖子？素质拓展，不行吗？……我的字很漂亮？真的？头儿教的。她说写书法能静心定念，对我有益。不抓贼的时候，就练一两笔。不过我始终觉得写写画画没什么意思，运笔和挥剑也没多少不同。
voiceDesc.en: Why do I have so much calligraphy in my room? Nothing's wrong with a little cultural pursuit, right...? My writing looks good? Hmm, really? The boss taught me. Told me it helps by clearing and focusing the mind. I write a word or two when I'm not out busting criminals. Honestly, it never really caught on to me. A brush stroke is no different than a sword swing.

voiceDesc.cn: 清波寨的人，喜欢用拳。他们很少招架，只会进攻。来武陵城以后，发现这儿的人喜欢剑——更长，更利，更“文明”，也更精巧。于是我就学着用，但头儿说，我舞剑时活像抱摔一棵杨柳树。
voiceDesc.en: The Stockaders prefer fighting with fists. They hardly block and go straight for the hit. After arriving at Wuling, I found that the Wulingers preferred blades — for the longer reach, sharper edge, and refined elegance. I tried to learn, but the boss said my swordmancy looked ... awkward, like I was trying to wrestle a willow tree.

voiceDesc.cn: 这俩字很怪？原先我不叫这个名字。自打来武陵城以后，阮一就叫我“叛徒”；小猫崽子……到今天都在喊“红脸婆”，懒得理她。至于“弭弗”，那时，头儿把我关医疗室里熬了一个多月，我就是不开口说话。有一天，她正坐在床边翻书，忽然问我叫什么，我就随手指了俩字。她说：“真好，那我以后就叫你弭弗了。”呵，还挺顺耳的。
voiceDesc.en: "Mi Fu" sounds weird? Well, it wasn't my name at first. Ruan Yi started calling me "Traitor" since the day I joined Wuling. And that little kitty ... she just keeps yapping "Mad Woman" at me. Tsk, like I really care... Actually, I got the name "Mi Fu" while I was kept in a medical room. The boss left me there for over a month, but I refused to say a word. One day, she was reading beside my bed and suddenly asked for my name. I just pointed at two random characters in her book. She looked at them and said, "Perfect. Mi Fu it is, then." Hur. This name does have a good ring to it.

voiceDesc.cn: 头儿……刚走？哈，我心里总觉得，她更适合待在你们这里。你们做的事天大地大，才够她多飞两圈。就算是自愿的，武陵对她也有点小了。你懂我的意思么？你们得招待好她！要是她伤了一根寒毛，不止我，全武陵都会来找你们麻烦。
voiceDesc.en: The boss ... just left? Hur. I honestly think she's more at home in your place. You got some really super projects. Big enough for her to soar around with. Wuling's actually a bit small for her, even though she picked it herself. Know what I mean? You'd better take good care of her! If she gets so much as a scratch, it's not just me you have to worry about. It'd be you versus everyone in Wuling.

voiceDesc.cn: 说不清我是什么时候成为一个武陵人的。被头儿强留养伤的几个月，看着他们在泥泞的荒地上规划未来，忽然有种不一样的感觉钻进心头。他们也不嫌弃我，使劲给我送吃的，我不爱欠人东西，就给他们帮点忙。方兴衢奠基那天，我竟然也被写进了建设者名单，忽然就想起了这句话：“你的拳头要是用在保护人上面，该有多好。”
voiceDesc.en: I don't know when I became a true Wulinger. While the boss kept me in the med room for months, I watched them plan a future in the muddy wilderness. Something just clicked. They treated me as one of them and kept bringing me food. I started helping 'cause I hate owing favors. Then I found my name in the builders' list when they turned the sod for Fangxing Avenue. Then I remembered her words: "It would be wonderful if your fists protected people."

voiceDesc.cn: 真巧，你们上次来，还去了那地方。我可有十年没回去过了吧。我走以后，汤汤总是从密道那儿跑过来找我，我就亲手把那里封上了。她不该来，我也不该回去。我知道她会……呵，这次看到那壁画，我才知道她在我脸上画了那么大一个……我得找她算账去！
voiceDesc.en: What a coincidence. You actually went to the secret passage on your first visit. I haven't been there for ten years. After I left, Tangtang kept sneaking in through the passage, so I sealed it myself. She shouldn't have come, and I shouldn't have gone back. I knew she would ... well, I didn't expect her to be so messed up putting a huge cross on my face in that graffiti... Stupid kitty, I'm going to settle this with her!

voiceDesc.cn: 汤汤……那个小猫崽子，我跟她的账还没算完呢。她在这儿，给你们惹了什么麻烦没有？怎么，还真有？我来帮你教训她，就不劳你操心了。她那么在乎你，我怕她挨了你的骂就更想不开了，那才麻烦。
voiceDesc.en: Tangtang... I have unfinished business with that little kitty. Did she give you any trouble? Wait, she actually did? Tsk, tsk, tsk... Don't worry, I'll handle her. She cares way too much about you. If you yelled at her, she'd probably spiral into depression. Now that would be a real headache.

voiceDesc.cn: 那边有东西，先说好，巡卫一向鼓励拾金不昧。
voiceDesc.en: Something's over there. But remember, watchguard policy encourages returning lost property.

voiceDesc.cn: 有贵重的玩意落在那儿，就把它当无主之财处置，收起来吧。
voiceDesc.en: Valuables spotted. Guess we can treat them as unclaimed property.

voiceDesc.cn: 新区域，去巡逻一圈，排除风险。
voiceDesc.en: A new zone. We better run a patrol and make sure it's trouble-free.

voiceDesc.cn: 哈，值得挑战的对手。
voiceDesc.en: Hah, I see a worthy opponent.

voiceDesc.cn: 劈碎的矿石，不影响使用吧？
voiceDesc.en: The ore should still work if it's smashed up, right?

voiceDesc.cn: 我来，两下的事儿。
voiceDesc.en: I got this. Two hits is all it takes.

voiceDesc.cn: 不错的东西，还好没砸烂。
voiceDesc.en: Solid find. Good thing we didn't wreck it.

voiceDesc.cn: 以前还以为这玩意儿是幽魂，来了武陵城才知道，大家都管它叫醚质。
voiceDesc.en: Used to think they were ghosts. I only learned they're called Aurylenes after coming to Wuling.

voiceDesc.cn: 小意思，拦不住我。
voiceDesc.en: Hah. This goop can't stop me.

voiceDesc.cn: 我还没累，一身是劲儿呢！……好吧，听你的。
voiceDesc.en: C'mon, I'm still good to go...! Fine, if you say so.

voiceDesc.cn: 别在这儿挂彩！
voiceDesc.en: Don't you dare fall here!

voiceDesc.cn: 起！再战！
voiceDesc.en: Back in the fight!

voiceDesc.cn: 躲远点儿！
voiceDesc.en: Keep your distance!

voiceDesc.cn: 哼，现在才开始有点意思。
voiceDesc.en: Heh. Now this feels like a real fight.

voiceDesc.cn: 拳出……无悔……
voiceDesc.en: Our fists ... know no regrets...

voiceDesc.cn: 够干脆，有本事！
voiceDesc.en: Clean and sharp. Impressive!

voiceDesc.cn: 团队行动，漂亮。
voiceDesc.en: Nice teamwork!

voiceDesc.cn: 职责而已。
voiceDesc.en: Just doing my job.

voiceDesc.cn: 谢谢……你们。
voiceDesc.en: Thanks, team.

voiceDesc.cn: 畅快打一场！
voiceDesc.en: Time to fight!

voiceDesc.cn: 该给他们长长教训了。
voiceDesc.en: Time to give them a proper lesson.

voiceDesc.cn: 头儿听到这个消息，想必会很高兴。
voiceDesc.en: The boss will be glad to hear this.

voiceDesc.cn: 顺利结案。
voiceDesc.en: Case closed.

voiceDesc.cn: 你也挺能打的！
voiceDesc.en: You fight pretty well too!

voiceDesc.cn: 你们……有事儿给我来扛。不要逞强。
voiceDesc.en: Team ... let me handle the hard part. Don't push yourself.

voiceDesc.cn: 只要还能动，就不要认输。
voiceDesc.en: Never concede if you're still on your feet.

voiceDesc.cn: 倒下！
voiceDesc.en: Stand down!

voiceDesc.cn: 痛快！
voiceDesc.en: Hell yeah!

voiceDesc.cn: 别想逃！
voiceDesc.en: No escape!

voiceDesc.cn: 吃我一拳！
voiceDesc.en: Eat this!

voiceDesc.cn: 到你了！
voiceDesc.en: Your turn!

voiceDesc.cn: 该出手了！
voiceDesc.en: Knuckle up!

voiceDesc.cn: 是时候了！
voiceDesc.en: Let's rumble!

voiceDesc.cn: 立即伏法！
voiceDesc.en: Surrender now!

voiceDesc.cn: 当头棒喝！
voiceDesc.en: Grit your teeth!

voiceDesc.cn: 抗拒从严！
voiceDesc.en: Do not resist!

voiceDesc.cn: 你没机会了！
voiceDesc.en: End of the line!

voiceDesc.cn: 我来掀桌子！
voiceDesc.en: I'll teach you the hard way!

voiceDesc.cn: 统统……逮捕！
voiceDesc.en: You deserve ... the slammer!

voiceDesc.cn: 敬酒不吃吃罚酒！
voiceDesc.en: I asked you nicely!
